Data.[\"UnknownGloves\", \"part\", \"Descript: Strange mitts will fit most wrists and fingers.
Data.[\"UnknownGoggles\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Rounded seers are held by a strap.
Data.[\"UnknownGrenade\", \"part\", \"Descrip: A cannister of blast is sheathed in undeciphered metal.
Data.[\"UnknownHelmet\", \"part\", \"Descript: A head topper was fashioned for unknown purpose.
Data.[\"UnknownJewelry\", \"part\", \"Descrip: A rounded torc gleams for unintended eyes.
Data.[\"UnknownKnife\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A sharp edge tops a strange hilt.
Data.[\"UnknownMask\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: A false face was shaped to fashion and stitched with unknown intent.
Data.[\"UnknownMed\", \"part\", \"Description: A strange substance fills a channel of glass.
Data.[\"UnknownOddTrinket\", \"part\", \"Desc: Light gleams off the edging of a small curio.
Data.[\"UnknownPistol\", \"part\", \"Descript: Blemishes cross the short barrel of an unidentified gun.
Data.[\"UnknownRifle\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Blemishes cross the long barrel of an unidentified gun.
Data.[\"UnknownShield\", \"part\", \"Descript: A curved screen of bang-hard surface material is wielded by a welded grip.
Data.[\"UnknownStrangeFurniture\", \"part\",: A sitting object of vacant intent catches dust and offlight.
Data.[\"UnknownStrangeMeat\", \"part\", \"Des: An unknown organ bleats with the desperation of life.
Data.[\"UnknownStrangePlant\", \"part\", \"De: An unfamiliar tendril of green in leaf-sheath circles itself.
Data.[\"UnknownStrangeTubes\", \"part\", \"De: Tubes of unknown purpose splay at welded joints.
Data.[\"UnknownSword\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A blade of considerable length runs through a strange hilt.
Data.[\"UnknownTool\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: The array of strange parts are summed together as a kind of tool.

Foods.[\"Albino Ape Heart\", \"part\", \"Descr: A four-chambered slab of wet and raw tissue slumps under its own sopping weight.
Foods.[\"Albino Ape Heart\", \"part\", \"Food\: It's chewy and tastes of warm rust.
Foods.[\"Arsplice Seed\", \"part\", \"Descript: Millennia of chymified metropolis that's fed the grass-coral-fungi hybrid shadow-forking in its guts are resorbed inside the seed coat of an eco wad.
Foods.[\"Arsplice Seed\", \"part\", \"Food\",: Beams of snug warmth sprout like fractals inside your body.
Foods.[\"Banana\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Its spline is richly hued in ripeness, and Spindle glitter dots the peel.
Foods.[\"Barkbiter Jerky\", \"part\", \"Descri: Bear flesh was cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
Foods.[\"BaseBreatherGland\", \"part\", \"Food: The gland ruptures with a pop and fills your mouth with its foul fluid.
Foods.[\"BaseBreatherGlandPaste\", \"part\", \: Mist-damp tissues were ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
Foods.[\"Bear Jerky\", \"part\", \"Description: Bear flesh was cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
Foods.[\"Beetle Jerky\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Mashed beetle meat was cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
Foods.[\"Black Puma Haunch\", \"part\", \"Desc: Pinches of opal black fur stick to the wet leg meat.
Foods.[\"Boar Jerky\", \"part\", \"Description: Boar flesh was cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
Foods.[\"Bop Cheek\", \"part\", \"Description\: It's a choice cut of laminated sponge. It jiggles to the touch.
Foods.[\"Bop Cheek\", \"part\", \"Food\", \"Me: It's chewier than anything you've eaten before.
Foods.[\"Bundle of Noisegrass\", \"part\", \"D: Starbright grass peaked at a local maximum of meaning and then was cut and bundled.
Foods.[\"Canned Have-It-All\", \"part\", \"Des: The stencil on the tin depicts an animal with claws, or are they hooves? Snoods (or horns? antlers?) pucker its nose and brow. Shaggy, knotted fur, or ruffled feathers, sheath it from the heat (or cold).
Foods.[\"Clump of Grave Moss\", \"part\", \"De: Bleached cyan grave moss has grown into a rare and supple clump.
Foods.[\"Clump of Grave Moss\", \"part\", \"Fo: It crunches into flakes in your mouth.
Foods.[\"Compacted Bone Matter\", \"part\", \": Ageless bone was pulverized and compacted inside the scarred intestine of a bone worm.
Foods.[\"Compacted Bone Meal\", \"part\", \"De: Ageless bone was pulverized and compacted inside the scarred intestine of a bone worm. Then it was ground into meal.
Foods.[\"ConfusionBreatherGland\", \"part\", \: Aromatic dew dampens the deflated flaps of tissue and obfuscates the surrounding air.
Foods.[\"ConfusionBreatherGlandPaste\", \"part: Strange tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
Foods.[\"Congealed Blaze\", \"part\", \"Descri: Blaze was extracted from its injector, thickened in the acrid air, and bottled for culinary use.
Foods.[\"Congealed Hulk Honey\", \"part\", \"D: Hulk honey was extracted from its injector, thickened in the acrid air, and bottled for culinary use.
Foods.[\"Congealed Love\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Love was extracted from its injector, thickened in the acrid air, and bottled for culinary use.
Foods.[\"Congealed Rubbergum\", \"part\", \"De: Rubbergum was extracted from its injector, thickened in the acrid air, and bottled for culinary use.
Foods.[\"Congealed Salve\", \"part\", \"Descri: Salve was extracted from its injector, thickened in the acrid air, and bottled for culinary use.
Foods.[\"Congealed Shade Oil\", \"part\", \"De: Shade oil was extracted from its injector, thickened in the acrid air, and bottled for culinary use.
Foods.[\"Congealed Skulk\", \"part\", \"Descri: Skulk was extracted from its injector, thickened in the acrid air, and bottled for culinary use.
Foods.[\"CorrosiveBreatherGland\", \"part\", \: Aromatic dew dampens the deflated flaps of tissue and stings the surrounding air.
Foods.[\"CorrosiveBreatherGlandPaste\", \"part: Tart tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
Foods.[\"Crab Jerky\", \"part\", \"Description: Crab legs were cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
Foods.[\"Croc Jerky\", \"part\", \"Description: Croc flesh was cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
Foods.[\"Crushed Grave Moss\", \"part\", \"Des: Grave moss grew into a rare and supple clump, which was then crushed and placed on a spice tray.
Foods.[\"Crusty Loaf\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Every autumn, many gulch dwellers hike to the Stiltgrounds to purchase the Fall wine. They return to their homes, steep wheat bran in the wine, and leaven dough in their clay ovens. A few are luckier; fungus grove dwellers need only step outside to harvest yeast, and friends to fungi need only shake their yeast-ridden appendages.
Foods.[\"Crystal of Eve\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Psychal energy hovers near the zero-point as soft fuzz but peaks in the tetrahedral habit. This crystal was cracked off a root-bouquet before the system could develop chime-sentience. It vibrates with nascent thought and feeling.
Foods.[\"Crystal of Eve\", \"part\", \"Food\",: The crystal shatters and concentrated thoughtstuff swells in tide and soaks your mind.
Foods.[\"Cured Dawnglider Tail\", \"part\", \": Salt has blanched the prism of colors out of the cuts of coiled meat, but a tinge of the smell of smoke remains.
Foods.[\"Dawnglider Tail\", \"part\", \"Descri: A mosaic of keeled scales coils like a wound rope. It's crusted with char and smells like smoke.
Foods.[\"Dawnglider Tail\", \"part\", \"Food\": It tastes of spiced char with a swelling heat.
Foods.[\"Dreadroot Tuber\", \"part\", \"Descri: Earth scars brook the cinnamon bulb, warped by the pressures of soil and chrome to a shape that encodes a chiliad of ruin.
Foods.[\"Dream Smoke\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Dreamstuff was quickened into memory and bottled before it could evaporate to emotional humidity.
Foods.[\"Dried Lah Petals\", \"part\", \"Descr: Dried, these thick yellow-brown petals bear a closer resemblance to meat jerky than most other flowers.
Foods.[\"Dried Vanta Petals\", \"part\", \"Des: Light drips off the dried lunes' boundaries of influence and seeps into the void.
Foods.[\"Drop of Nectar\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Eaters' nectar was extracted from its injector, thickened in the acrid air, and bottled for culinary use.
Foods.[\"Ekuemekiyyen Greens\", \"part\", \"De: Malachite leaves and pistachios are bound by star twine. The greens puff gallantly at the absence of toxins in the air.
Foods.[\"ElderConfusionBreatherGland\", \"part: Aromatic dew dampens the deflated flaps of tissue and obfuscates the surrounding air.
Foods.[\"ElderConfusionBreatherGlandPaste\", \: Strange tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.

Foods.[\"ElderFireBreatherGland\", \"part\", \: Aromatic dew dampens the deflated flaps of tissue and scorches the surrounding air.
Foods.[\"ElderFireBreatherGlandPaste\", \"part: Scorched tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
Foods.[\"ElderIceBreatherGland\", \"part\", \": Aromatic dew dampens the deflated flaps of tissue and freezes the surrounding air.
Foods.[\"ElderIceBreatherGlandPaste\", \"part\: Frosted tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
Foods.[\"ElderNormalityBreatherGland\", \"part: Aromatic dew dampens the deflated flaps of tissue and polarizes the surrounding air.
Foods.[\"ElderNormalityBreatherGlandPaste\", \: Hexagonal tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.

Foods.[\"ElderPoisonBreatherGlandPaste\", \"pa: Toxic tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.

Foods.[\"ElderSleepBreatherGlandPaste\", \"par: Deflated tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
Foods.[\"ElderStunBreatherGland\", \"part\", \: Aromatic dew dampens the deflated flaps of tissue and arrests the surrounding air.
Foods.[\"ElderStunBreatherGlandPaste\", \"part: Still tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
Foods.[\"Eyeless Crab Legs\", \"part\", \"Desc: Jointed and spined legs are arrayed in a pool of bone jelly.
Foods.[\"Eyeless King Crab Legs\", \"part\", \: Enormous jointed and spined legs are arrayed in a pool of bone jelly.
Foods.[\"Fermented Tongue\", \"part\", \"Descr: A chopped tongue was soured in its own saliva and twisted around a stick.
Foods.[\"Fermented Yondercane\", \"part\", \"D: Weeks old salt crystals line the fluted valleys of a wet stalk.
Foods.[\"Fermented Yuckwheat Stem\", \"part\",: Weeks old salt crystals huddle in the stem's elbowed forks.
Foods.[\"Fire Ant Gaster Paste\", \"part\", \": Calefaction was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
Foods.[\"Fire Ant Gaster\", \"part\", \"Descri: A halo of smoke lifts off the calcified orb.
Foods.[\"Fire Ant Gaster\", \"part\", \"Food\": It's a tough chew with red-hot spice.
Foods.[\"FireBreatherGland\", \"part\", \"Desc: Aromatic dew dampens the deflated flaps of tissue and scorches the surrounding air.
Foods.[\"FireBreatherGlandPaste\", \"part\", \: Scorched tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
Foods.[\"Fish Jerky\", \"part\", \"Description: Fish meat was cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
Foods.[\"Food Cube\", \"part\", \"Description\: Spongy foodstuff molded into a slate-hued cube of perfect proportions. What forces married the messiness of eating with the precision of cubes?
Foods.[\"Freeze-Dried Hoarshrooms\", \"part\",: Wrinkled toadstools were cooled and dehydrated in their own hoarfrost.
Foods.[\"Frog Jerky\", \"part\", \"Description: Frog meat was cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
Foods.[\"Goat Jerky\", \"part\", \"Description: Goat flesh was cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
Foods.[\"Godshroom Cap\", \"part\", \"Descript: Sight senses blur on spongent craters of a swollen coral moon. Is this the flesh of gods?
Foods.[\"Hoarshroom\", \"part\", \"Description: Rime sparkles on the lampshade cap that glows with soft biolumin.
Foods.[\"Hoarshroom\", \"part\", \"RulesDescri:
Duration: 180-220 rounds
You cast light in radius 2.
For the first 5 rounds after imbibing, you gain 0.6 hit points per level (minimum 3) each round.
+20 cold resistance
You cannot be poisoned.
Foods.[\"Humble Pie\", \"part\", \"Description: Seasoning the minced meat that's trapped under the crust is a smidge of yyffur dust, shaved from the stalk of the eponymous mushroom and finely ground. The whole mushroom is much too powerful for a mammalian psyche (consuming one would obliterate the ego in mere moments), but a smidge of dust on a tasty pie can remind one of one's place in the cosmos.
Foods.[\"Humble Pie\", \"part\", \"Food\", \"M:
It tastes bitter.
Your {{Y|Ego}} is reduced by {{C|1}}
Foods.[\"Hunk of Cheese\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Cheesecloth sticks to the greasy faces of a pigwrought cuboid. For two years microbes have colonized its faces, ripening it to high taste.
Foods.[\"IceBreatherGland\", \"part\", \"Descr: Aromatic dew dampens the deflated flaps of tissue and freezes the surrounding air.
Foods.[\"IceBreatherGlandPaste\", \"part\", \": Frosted tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
Foods.[\"Lagroot Tuber\", \"part\", \"Descript: Starchy dendrites were slashed from the earth and shaved down.
Foods.[\"Lah Petals\", \"part\", \"Description: Pungent, ochre-toned petals look like an aromatic herb, but their savory flavor is closer to broth than tisane.
Foods.[\"Lover's Blossom\", \"part\", \"Descri: The heart of the jilted lover burns under embered petals, pinched to anguish in citrine anthers and laid on a weeping bed of sepal jade.
Foods.[\"Mashed Lag\", \"part\", \"Description: Peeled lagroot tuber was mashed, salted, and jarred.
Foods.[\"Mirror Dust\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: An artifact of the mirror world was shattered and ground to fine dust.
Foods.[\"Mirror Shard\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A shard of glass shines on sharp edges, its crack patterns characteristic of geologic pressure-tempering.
Foods.[\"NormalityBreatherGland\", \"part\", \: Aromatic dew dampens the deflated flaps of tissue and polarizes the surrounding air.
Foods.[\"NormalityBreatherGlandPaste\", \"part: Hexagonal tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
Foods.[\"Ogre Ape Heart\", \"part\", \"Descrip: A four-chambered slab of wet and raw tissue slumps under its own sopping weight.
Foods.[\"Ogre Ape Heart\", \"part\", \"Food\",: It's chewy and tastes of warm rust.
Foods.[\"Phase Silk\", \"part\", \"Description: Spooled thread cut from the dual-dimensional hearth-mesh of a phase spider.
Foods.[\"Pickled Mushrooms\", \"part\", \"Desc: Plucked from the dirt, they live their new lives wading in the brine.
Foods.[\"Pickles\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Warted fruits are set as islands in an ocean of brine and jarred in a world glass. They rot at salt's pace now.
Foods.[\"Plump Mushroom\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Beneath a cap of spread gills, the stem contours to a bursting waist. The fungus is fat on the dead of its sliver of loam.
Foods.[\"PoisonBreatherGland\", \"part\", \"De: Aromatic dew dampens the deflated flaps of tissue and stings the surrounding air.
Foods.[\"PoisonBreatherGlandPaste\", \"part\",: Toxic tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
Foods.[\"Psychal Gland Paste\", \"part\", \"De: Memory-soaked nerves were ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
Foods.[\"Psychal Gland\", \"part\", \"Descript: A labyrinth of nerves poke through their limpid tissue wrapper.
Foods.[\"Psychal Gland\", \"part\", \"Food\",: The gland ruptures with a pop and fills your mouth with a cold fluid. Someone else's memories seep into your own
Foods.[\"Qudzu Stem\", \"part\", \"Description: A stalk of red celery is floured in the abraded dust of centuries.
Foods.[\"Raw Barkbiter Meat\", \"part\", \"Des: Raw barkbiter flesh is tinctured in its own spilled blood.
Foods.[\"Raw Bear Meat\", \"part\", \"Descript: Raw bear flesh is tinctured in its own spilled blood.
Foods.[\"Raw Bear Meat\", \"part\", \"Food\",: It tastes awful, but it meets the bare necessities.
Foods.[\"Raw Beetle Meat\", \"part\", \"Descri: Bug muscle is heaped and plated on broken shell.
Foods.[\"Raw Beetle Meat\", \"part\", \"Food\": The taste is bitter and salty.
Foods.[\"Raw Boar Meat\", \"part\", \"Descript: Raw boar flesh is tinctured in its own spilled blood.
Foods.[\"Raw Fish Meat\", \"part\", \"Descript: Flesh of cheek and jowl is tinged with the smell of salt.
Foods.[\"Raw Frog Meat\", \"part\", \"Descript: Frog leg is tinctured in its own spilled blood.
Foods.[\"Raw Goat Meat\", \"part\", \"Descript: Raw goat flesh is tinctured in its own spilled blood.
Foods.[\"Raw Goat Meat\", \"part\", \"Food\",: The meat strips dissolve into salt and fat.
Foods.[\"Raw Meat\", \"part\", \"Food\", \"Mes: The meat is tough but the meal is filling.
Foods.[\"Raw Pig Meat\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Raw pig flesh is tinctured in its own spilled blood.
Foods.[\"Raw Scorpiock Meat\", \"part\", \"Des: Bug muscle is heaped and plated on broken exobone.
Foods.[\"Raw Worm Meat\", \"part\", \"Descript: Worm flesh is tinctured in its own spilled slick.
Foods.[\"Ripe Cucumber\", \"part\", \"Descript: A long and warted neck of mint green was fruited on a fertile vine and picked crisp.
Foods.[\"Ripe Cucumber\", \"part\", \"Food\",: The bite is crisp, and then it bursts into water.
Foods.[\"Rubber Tree Seed\", \"part\", \"Descr: Smooth and sunstriped shells insulate the explosive treeshoot to come.
Foods.[\"Salthopper Chip\", \"part\", \"Descri: Chitin was shaved from the exoskeletal flank of a caught salthopper and dry-beaten to a snappy crisp.
Foods.[\"Scorpiock Jerky\", \"part\", \"Descri: Mashed scorpiock meat was cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
Foods.[\"SleepBreatherGland\", \"part\", \"Des: Aromatic dew dampens the deflated flaps of tissue and makes humid the surrounding air.
Foods.[\"SleepBreatherGlandPaste\", \"part\",: Deflated tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
Foods.[\"Sliced Bop Cheek\", \"part\", \"Descr: A choice cut of laminated sponge was carved into serving slices. They jiggle to the touch.
Foods.[\"Smoldered Mushroom\", \"part\", \"Des: The truffle is encrusted with a wine-colored char residue born of gases unknown to the world-surface. Deep, deep in the earth and across the Pale Sea, it was smoldered to succulence.
Foods.[\"Soul Curd\", \"part\", \"Description\: Ubernostrum was extracted from its injector, thickened in the acrid air, and bottled for culinary use.
Foods.[\"Spark Tick Plasma\", \"part\", \"Desc: The scutum was scraped dry, smashed, and ground. Bits of the tick were squeezed of its magnetic lifeblood and vialed.
Foods.[\"Spark Tick Scutum\", \"part\", \"Desc: A paper-thin bowl of bone is etched with the bright and furcate marks of lightning.
Foods.[\"Spark Tick Scutum\", \"part\", \"Food: It crackles on your taste buds.
Foods.[\"Spine Fruit Jam\", \"part\", \"Descri: The spiny fruit of fracti were mashed, set over an open flame, left out to cool, and jarred for later use. Bits of spiny pulp lay suspended in the fruity aether.
Foods.[\"Spine Fruit\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: A rib of fractus shoots a wet and pointy pear off its sunbloated greenery.
Foods.[\"Starapple Preserves\", \"part\", \"De: Sweet starapples were mashed, set over an open flame, left out to cool, and jarred for later use. Bits of stringy pulp lay suspended in the fruity aether.
Foods.[\"Starapple\", \"part\", \"Description\: Juice drips off the bright skin sheathing the quincunx core. To eyes wet with hunger, it shines like a garnet in the vulcan salt.
Foods.[\"StunBreatherGland\", \"part\", \"Desc: Aromatic dew dampens the deflated flaps of tissue and arrests the surrounding air.
Foods.[\"StunBreatherGlandPaste\", \"part\", \: Still tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
Foods.[\"Sun-Dried Banana\", \"part\", \"Descr: Moisture was baked out of fruit by the salt sun, but Spindle glitter still alights the disc-chip.
Foods.[\"Taco Suprema\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Thin and ancient paper, a palimpsest of grease, wraps the crisp saddle of fried wafer. Seven strata of congealed nectar fill the crispy cleft.
Foods.[\"Taco Suprema\", \"part\", \"Food\", \: A divine crisp dissolves into salted manna.
Foods.[\"Tongue Twist\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A triad of tongues are twined together in a fibrous twist. They gleam with a coat of saliva.
Foods.[\"Tongue Twist\", \"part\", \"Food\", \: The taste is familiar on your tongue.
Foods.[\"Urberry\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Earth-dense juice pressures the berry skin into a perfect and light-curving sphere. Inside, a pip encodes a millionfold instruction set for the shape of shapes.
Foods.[\"Vanta Petals\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Light drips off the lunes' boundaries of influence and seeps into the void.
Foods.[\"Vanta Petals\", \"part\", \"Food\", \: They're freezing with the absence of heat and light.
Foods.[\"Vinewafer Sheaf\", \"part\", \"Descri: Bunched wafers reaped from the moisture-sucking watervine plant and bound by twine.
Foods.[\"Vinewafer\", \"part\", \"Description\: A little nub of cork swells with moisture. It was watered over hot weeks by a splayed frond, vested with inhuman patience, who sucked one mote of rain from a hundred-mile wind.
Foods.[\"Voider Gland Paste\", \"part\", \"Des: Air-shunting arciforms were ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
Foods.[\"Voider Gland\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Space is partitioned across three displacement chambers to create negative pressure around the shunting organ.
Foods.[\"Wild Rice\", \"part\", \"Description\: Plum-white rice hulls fizzle to the touch and their awns groan an erratic and lyrical sound.
Foods.[\"Worm Jerky\", \"part\", \"Description: Worm meat was cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
Foods.[\"Yondercane\", \"part\", \"Description: The fluted stem of tasseled yonderbrush bends to a farpoint out of focus.
Foods.[\"Yuckwheat Stem\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Children cry at the crisp snip of a yuckwheat stem, as they have for hundreds of years. They bawl, and flail, and writhe from their mothers' grasps, deaf to reassurances of the plant's medical potency. Snipped and crushed, the stem tastes acidic on their tongues and their faces contort in children's agony. But they sleep better at night, so their mothers say.

Furniture.[\"AgolgotShrine\", \"part\", \"Descript: A monstrous head slumps in old stone, etched cysts sprouting from the central chine to evoke the spread of disease from its halfgod source. Generations of moss skirt the beast's warted legs.
Furniture.[\"Air Well\", \"part\", \"Description\": Stone was carved and shaped into a rough dome with square, even-spaced windows to let air flow. The small difference in temperature inside the dome causes dew to condense from air and accumulate in a catch basin below.
Furniture.[\"Alchemist Table\", \"part\", \"Descri: A table scorched with the radial patterns of hot chemistry holds a phial rack and alembic.
Furniture.[\"Anvil\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: A hunk of crude granite has been smoothed on top for metalworking and rounded at the side into a shaping horn.
Furniture.[\"Archway\", \"part\", \"Description\",: It's an open portal of stacked stone.
Furniture.[\"Armchair\", \"part\", \"Description\": Kneaded under the salt sun by a leatherworker and stuffed with glowcrow feathers for the repose of its owner.
Furniture.[\"Armor Rack\", \"part\", \"Description: Wooden and chrome poles let armor rest peacefully.
Furniture.[\"Base Ring Gate\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Water ribbons climb bone-blanched marble columns in high relief. They mount the archivolt and snake between helical rings before a sharp turn upward on the keystone. Here becomes there.
Furniture.[\"BaseBookshelf\", \"part\", \"Descript: Wood planks are nailed at orthogonal angles, and dust sleeps on the paper jackets.
Furniture.[\"BaseDoubleMetalDoor\", \"part\", \"De: A pair of furrowed metal plates are fit to the arch of the double doorway, and a slide panel is cut from their centers.
Furniture.[\"BaseDoubleWavyDoor\", \"part\", \"Des: Metals cut by the cosine saw were fit-welded and put to a double-wide steel frame. The lock stiles are padded in chrome.
Furniture.[\"BaseWedgeChest\", \"part\", \"Descrip: A latched box of polished and ageproof metal is indented with numbered rectangles.
Furniture.[\"Bed\", \"part\", \"Description\", \"S: Fabrics were stuffed with watervine chaff and laid across wooden slats in the style of the hillfolk.
Furniture.[\"Bedger\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Historians of leisure divide all epochs into the following three ages: the span before ursine creatures evolve or civilizations rise to admire them, the span between ursine prominence and a civilization's capacity to fashion divans in their likeness, and thence the span until the civilization's fall.
Furniture.[\"Bedroll\", \"part\", \"Description\",: A goat wool bed fastened with canvas ties.
Furniture.[\"BeltCurtains\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Under a tarnished metal frame hangs a sheet of black rubber cut into pliable curtain strips.
Furniture.[\"Bench\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: Planks of wood are nailed together simply to form the austere seat.
Furniture.[\"BethsaidaShrine\", \"part\", \"Descri: Slumping shoulders edge the valley of a cracked stone back, and two pairs of mated arms join at their hundred-knuckles in the stonecarver's depiction of the halfgod's quickening. Generations of moss skirt the beast's varicose legs.
Furniture.[\"BeyLahOven\", \"part\", \"Description: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the thick clay oven, and with it comes the smell of lah broth and steamed matz.
Furniture.[\"Book Table\", \"part\", \"Description: Dwellers in the earth-clefts fashion tables in the style of puzzle boxes. Their drawers house the stenographic imagination.
Furniture.[\"Bottle\", \"part\", \"Description\",: A vessel of freeblown glass curves at the lunar arc. The style hints that it originates from the coast of the Fuming God Sea, on the far side of Moghra'yi, and that it was likely exported by the dromads.
Furniture.[\"Brain Sculpture\", \"part\", \"Descri: Foam plush is arranged into gyri and sulci to mimic the brain maze.
Furniture.[\"Brazier\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Burnished bronze is burned to light-in-ceremony by hot coal.
Furniture.[\"Brinestalk Gate\", \"part\", \"Descri: Brinestalk is shaved into pickets and set across an iron-latched rail.
Furniture.[\"Broadcast Power Station\", \"part\",: Metal was braided into electromagnetic scaffolding, and through it the modulator molds the clay of the baseband and divulges the shape of the new signal.
Furniture.[\"Bubblething\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: During the enterprise of invention, you sometimes require the use of a shapeless gray foam. Or, at the very least, you might require it one day, and so some tinker prudently got ahead of the problem and invented the brass foaminator. Inscribed on the base: 'All the foam, none of the sadness at maybe one day needing foam and not having it'.
Furniture.[\"Bust of K4K5\", \"part\", \"Descripti: The delphic countenance of the Tungsten King is frozen in chrome, cast to perfect specification.
Furniture.[\"Bust of Mehmet I\", \"part\", \"Descr: Hard chrome was cast in the mold of soft cheeks and rounded brow; the patron king of scholarship is canonized.
Furniture.[\"Cage\", \"part\", \"Description\", \": The box is wrought from chewed wire and dented iron.
Furniture.[\"Campfire Remains\", \"part\", \"Descr: A burnt out wood core is enveloped in footprinted ash.
Furniture.[\"Campfire\", \"part\", \"Description\": The warming phosphor of early earth is neatly latticed by woodbrick, and functions now as a microscopic star.
Furniture.[\"Candelabra\", \"part\", \"Description: Wax weeps from the stubborn candles, drips onto the sconces, forms a waxfall through the tiers of bronze.
Furniture.[\"Canvas Folding Chair\", \"part\", \"D: Jointed wood and knit watervine make a movable wharf for the ass.
Furniture.[\"Catchbasin\", \"part\", \"Description: Stoneware catches the tiny bit of moisture surrendered by the bone-dry air.
Furniture.[\"Chair\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: Planks of wood are nailed together at right angles in the style of the marsh dwellers.
Furniture.[\"Chairbear\", \"part\", \"Description\: Historians of leisure divide all epochs into the following three ages: the span before ursine creatures evolve or civilizations rise to admire them, the span between ursine prominence and a civilization's capacity to fashion divans in their likeness, and thence the span until the civilization's fall.
Furniture.[\"Chalkboard\", \"part\", \"Description: Sheared slate stone is powdered with the cloudy remnants of externalized thought and held aloft by the monster.
Furniture.[\"ChavvahOven\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the round crystalline oven, and with it comes the smell of cooling static. Curiously, there are no prepared meal ingredients here.
Furniture.[\"ChefOven\", \"part\", \"Description\": Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the thick clay oven, and with it comes the smell of scrumptious food.
Furniture.[\"Chest\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: A wood storage box with a hinged lid and latch. Notches scratched on the surface hint at the full probability array of language, and also its absence.
Furniture.[\"ChestIsner\", \"part\", \"Description: A wood storage box with a hinged lid and latch. Notches scratched on the surface hint at the full probability array of language, and also its absence. A drop of spilled water is engraved on an open lock.
Furniture.[\"Clockthing\", \"part\", \"Description: Barathrum's invention records time to the momentary tick by regulating its advance with a crown wheel. On learning of its utility, the water barons commissioned the assembly of dozens more in order to take precise measurements of their reservoirs at set moments of the day.
Furniture.[\"Clockthing_QGirl\", \"part\", \"Descr: Q Girl replaced the old oscillator on this Barathrum clock with a swing pendulum. Now the several hours per day that Time cheats from its observers are reduced to mere minutes.
Furniture.[\"ConveyorDrive\", \"part\", \"Descript: Grease drips from an engine of bright chrome and stains the idlers. Pulley wheels are positioned at odd angles to churn flat rubber belts through space.
Furniture.[\"ConveyorPad\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Putrid dross sticks to the grooves of flat black di-rubber.
Furniture.[\"CrematoryConveyorPad\", \"part\", \"D: Bone-grey ash sticks to the grooves of flat black di-rubber.
Furniture.[\"Crib\", \"part\", \"Description\", \": Wood slats are megaliths to a child. Feather pillows are cold meadows. Here are the boundaries of their dusk-world.
Furniture.[\"Crypt Door\", \"part\", \"Description: Bright tracery charts a life time of meaning through the black marble void of the door's surface. A family name is inscribed on a memorial plaque.
Furniture.[\"Crypt Door\", \"part\", \"Render\", \: ornately engraved marble door with plaque
Furniture.[\"Crypt Double Door N\", \"part\", \"De: Bright tracery charts a life time of meaning through the black marble void of the door's surface. A family name is inscribed on a memorial plaque.
Furniture.[\"Crypt Double Door S\", \"part\", \"De: Bright tracery charts a life time of meaning through the black marble void of the door's surface. A family name is inscribed on a memorial plaque.
Furniture.[\"CryptPlaqueTutor\", \"part\", \"Rende: ornately engraved marble door with plaque
Furniture.[\"CyberneticsRack\", \"part\", \"Descri: Chrome pegs form a lattice where bionic modules await coupling.
Furniture.[\"CyberneticsStationRack\", \"part\", \: Chrome pegs form a lattice where modules await coupling.
Furniture.[\"CyberneticsTerminal2\", \"part\", \"D: A rectangle of neutrofoam imprinted with the human form hangs beneath an arch of glass. Across the foam at eye level, glyphs loop on an elliptical screen. Surgical machinery, obscured by blinding light, beetles out from the underside of an enclosing dome.
Furniture.[\"Death Gate E\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Patinae have transformed the cyclopean bronze doors into great shelves of seafoam and coral. Lyrical death is depicted on the panels in high relief: chained cables lift inverted pyramids through a calcified village, gaseous fire, and vaults of brine. Skeleton harpists traipse across the freize, and goats chew copper bones on the cornices.
Furniture.[\"Death Gate W\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Patinae have transformed the cyclopean bronze doors into great shelves of seafoam and coral. Skeleton harpists traipse across the freize, and goats chew copper bones on the cornices.
Furniture.[\"Desk\", \"part\", \"Description\", \": Wood was salvaged from moist groves, shaved into planks, and carried to the freeholds on the Shale Bridge. There it was received by carpenters who, acclimated to the wetless air, eagerly took the rich wood for their own projects.
Furniture.[\"Display Breadboard\", \"part\", \"Des: Plastic housed in grainy wood is perforated in a grid of contact points. Capacitors and inductors are fastened in the spring clips and networked with a bouquet of wire.
Furniture.[\"Door\", \"part\", \"Description\", \": The slate is touched with years of handprints and a ring of rust flakes off the top of the hinges. The door continues, though, its stubborn assertion of 'in' and 'out'.
Furniture.[\"DoorSwitch\", \"part\", \"Description: Buttons are set in a vertical pair across a rectangle of scrawled-on metal.
Furniture.[\"Double Door\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: The two slates are touched with years of with handprints and a ring of rust flakes off the top of all its the hinges. The doors continues, though, their stubborn assertion of 'in' and 'out'.
Furniture.[\"Double Striped Door E\", \"part\", \": Rail to rail panels are bulwarked by a crossbar for reinforcement of the in and out margin.
Furniture.[\"Double Striped Door N\", \"part\", \": Rail to rail panels are bulwarked by a crossbar for reinforcement of the in and out margin.
Furniture.[\"Double Striped Door S\", \"part\", \": Rail to rail panels are bulwarked by a crossbar for reinforcement of the in and out margin.
Furniture.[\"Double Striped Door W\", \"part\", \": Rail to rail panels are bulwarked by a crossbar for reinforcement of the in and out margin.
Furniture.[\"Double Windowed Door\", \"part\", \"D: At some moment in the double door's past, an indweller unspooled their will to curiosity and cut an aperture for sight through the boundary.
Furniture.[\"Dresser\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Wood was precisely cut into drawers and set on brass rails to house clothes.
Furniture.[\"Eater Hologram\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Burnt light erupts on the chromium plate and shatters into a figure from the deep past. Hair, skin, brow, thigh: the features hatch a new emotion inside you, the sense of the strange-familiar. As you move about, the figure moves in parallax; you wonder at how this Eater managed to incise themself into your spacetime braid.
Furniture.[\"EaterStatue\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Features erupt from a stone canvas and shatter into a figure from the deep past. Hair, skin, brow, thigh: the details hatch a new emotion inside you, the sense of the strange-familiar. As you move about the petrified likeness, you wonder at how this Eater managed to incise themself into your spacetime braid.
Furniture.[\"Electric Generator\", \"part\", \"Des: A cased rotor is fed charge through a handcrank and supplemented by solar heat. Its scratched metal surfaces vibrate at ground frequency.
Furniture.[\"Electric Generator\", \"tag\", \"Hero: Appliances,Energy Cells,Power Grids,the Depleted,the Jacked,the Power-Hungry,Tinkers
Furniture.[\"Electrothing\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Two copper bulbs form a spark gap that facilitates current along a path of ionized gas. The thing snaps and sparks at you.
Furniture.[\"ElevatorSwitch\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Buttons are set in a vertical pair across a rectangle of scrawled-on metal.
Furniture.[\"Empty Urn\", \"part\", \"Description\: Geometric shapes of meaning tessellate the ringed rows around the crematory vessel: stars, triquetrae, nonagons, and lunes.
Furniture.[\"Ergomax Chair\", \"part\", \"Descript: Plastic white as salt bleach was contoured to the posture for ideal rumination.
Furniture.[\"Ewer\", \"part\", \"Description\", \": Bronze was melted and cooled, shaped and etched, to deliver the water of life.
Furniture.[\"Exit Teleporter\", \"part\", \"Descri: A brass hem surrounds a foam shunting pad, and the above-head fretwork is braided into the once-familiar glyphs of exit symbology.
Furniture.[\"EzraOven\", \"part\", \"Description\": Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the round clay oven, and with it comes the smell of steamed goat and sweet bananas.
Furniture.[\"FactoryArm\", \"part\", \"Description: Metalfoam is packed and plated into a colossal simulacrum of the bio-arm, where the heads of the biceps and triceps brachii gleam. Colossal joints chirr at the effort of rotation.
Furniture.[\"Floor Cushion\", \"part\", \"Descript: Stuffed with watervine chaff and glowcrow feathers, this buttoned pillow lets folk repose with crossed legs.
Furniture.[\"Fluxthing\", \"part\", \"Description\: Four flanged couplings form a cross with a wavegraph readout at the center. As liquids and gases pipe through, flux readings appear in neon strings.
Furniture.[\"Folding Cot\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Watervine canvas is stretched and folded over wood legs.
Furniture.[\"Food Processor\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Wired metal squares a cabinet of drawers and burners for toasting, pickling, and freeze-drying.
Furniture.[\"Force Projector\", \"part\", \"Descri: Inside the glass and steel chassis, a sea of force fluid churns in turbulence. It's then pulverized into solid matter by the dynamo and projected into space as a field.
Furniture.[\"Forge\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: Brinestalk splinters and smokes inside a piped hearth of old stone.
Furniture.[\"FossilizedRemains\", \"part\", \"Desc: Teeth, shell, and bones were blackened into stasis by the earthy gunk.
Furniture.[\"Four-Poster Bed\", \"part\", \"Descri: Wood was meticulously turned into columns and ornamentally whittled. Quilted downs were bartered from the seamstresses on the banks of the River Svy, layered as a cake and frosted with pillows. Here the moneyed slumberer finds a favored ingress to the dreaming dale.
Furniture.[\"Full-Scale Recompositer\", \"part\",: A fullerite hem surrounds a foam landing pad, and the above-head fretwork is braided into the once-familiar glyphs of recomposition and return symbology.
Furniture.[\"Full-Spectrum Techlight\", \"part\",: Sharp points of chrome are the vertices of this utilitarian light fixture. Full-spectrum brightness bursts from its edges and lights the world.
Furniture.[\"Fused Security Door\", \"part\", \"De: A furrowed metal plate is fit to the arch of the doorway. Its hinges and rails were melted and fused to the wallframe.
Furniture.[\"Fusion Power Station\", \"part\", \"D: Bits of tiny matter are smashed together behind the lune of a chrome cylinder, and the heat is used to pump electricity downgrid.
Furniture.[\"Fusion Power Station\", \"tag\", \"He: Appliances,Energy Cells,Power Grids,the Depleted,the Jacked,the Power-Hungry,Tinkers
Furniture.[\"Fusion Pumping Station\", \"part\", \: Bits of tiny matter are smashed together behind the lune of a glass cylinder, and the heat is used to pump water into pipes for dispersal.
Furniture.[\"Gas Burner\", \"part\", \"Description: Gas is pushed through a hose and ignited into flame. Dew gives texture to the hose barbs.
Furniture.[\"Glass Door\", \"part\", \"Description: Panes of see-through and polished glass are fit on a slide rail.
Furniture.[\"Glass Furnace\", \"part\", \"Descript: Soda ash and limestone flow down a series of hot crucibles and canals toward the batch blanket, where glass is then retrieved and refined.
Furniture.[\"Glass Printer\", \"part\", \"Descript: Behind the pane of a bronzed frame are the programmable instruments of glassmaking: stove and blowpipe for hot work, oiler and wheel for cold.
Furniture.[\"GlassHydraulicPipe\", \"part\", \"Des: Glass was blown into a machine artery.
Furniture.[\"Globe\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: In high relief, folds and knots of sandy hued shapes crown the sapphire surface of the spherical model. The juxtaposition of scales, the proportion of sea to land, and the collective wisdom harnessed to devise such a thing make your head spin.
Furniture.[\"Golem Mound\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Wet clay sticks to a wheel and soldering board. It's flowered with diodes, circuits, vane pumps, and magnets.
Furniture.[\"GrabberArm\", \"part\", \"Description: Metalfoam is packed and plated into a colossal simulacrum of the bio-arm, where the heads of the biceps and triceps brachii gleam. Brass pinchers snap the kinesis out of their target.
Furniture.[\"Gravchair\", \"part\", \"Description\: Plastic smoothed on a heat lathe was kneaded into a design that evokes an Eater's intuition for how a perfect ball warps spacetime around itself.
Furniture.[\"Grit Gate Honey Vase\", \"part\", \"D: Painted crenulations wrap around the equator of this metal vase.
Furniture.[\"GritGateChromeBeacon\", \"part\", \"D: Sine waves breaking on the glass lune encode the behavioral primitives of the enclave's mechanical children. The electron field sucks them through the antenna and into the aether.
Furniture.[\"GritGateCommPanel\", \"part\", \"Desc: Metal slats diffuse the volume of a two-way speaker. A small button pops from the bottom corner.
Furniture.[\"GritGateMainframeRoomCommPanel\", \"p: Metal slats diffuse the volume of a two-way speaker. A small button pops from the bottom corner.
Furniture.[\"GritGateOven\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the dark electric oven, and with it comes the smell of bitter yuckwheat and boiled plasma.
Furniture.[\"Gun Rack\", \"part\", \"Description\": Wooden and chrome poles let guns rest peacefully.
Furniture.[\"Half Candelabra\", \"part\", \"Descri: Wax weeps from the stubborn candles, drips onto the sconces, forms a waxfall through the tiers of bronze.
Furniture.[\"HamilcrabMannequin\", \"part\", \"Des: The biped form emerges out of a gigantic cocoon of wood and fiberglass.
Furniture.[\"Hammered Dulcimer\", \"part\", \"Desc: Strings of gnu gut are stretched across the trapezoid. The note spoon hangs in a wooden sheath.
Furniture.[\"Hammock\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Brinestraw was braided into a rope lattice saddle for slinging between two old oaks and napping. The fibers on the middle-sag are extra frayed from the center-mass strain of a reclining ass.
Furniture.[\"Harp\", \"part\", \"Description\", \":
Gnu-gut strings run strata across the soundboard, and rose gold caps the rich wood knee and head.
The frame forms half a heart; the Eaters' favorite remains.
Furniture.[\"HeavyPowerLine\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Copper, carbon, and glass fiber were rounded into a robust electrical conduit.
Furniture.[\"Hookah\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Smoking stems bloom from a crystal waterpipe.
Furniture.[\"Hydraulic Bubblething\", \"part\", \": During the enterprise of invention, you sometimes require the use of a shapeless gray foam. Or, at the very least, you might require it one day, and so some tinker prudently got ahead of the problem and invented the brass foaminator. Inscribed on the base: 'All the foam, none of the sadness at maybe one day needing foam and not having it'.
Furniture.[\"Hydraulic Irrigator\", \"part\", \"De: Magnetized steel drives a diaphragm upward and life water is propelled through chrome pipes to thirsty plants.
Furniture.[\"Hydraulic Press\", \"part\", \"Descri: Down a traverse beam of plate shear metal thrusts a hydraulic piston. Its flat bottom is scratched into grooves by bits of trash.
Furniture.[\"Hydraulic Turbine\", \"part\", \"Desc: Perfect-cut chrome rotors are stacked along a generator shaft, and wide fin blades catch the fluid push and spin electric yarn.
Furniture.[\"Hyperbiotic Bed\", \"part\", \"Descri: Hidden micro-reactors smash together particles, generate heat, and power the biotic machine apparatus that rejuvenates the weary slumberer.
Furniture.[\"Hyperbiotic Chair\", \"part\", \"Desc: Hidden micro-reactors smash together particles, generate heat, and power the biotic machine apparatus that restores life to the wounded recliner.
Furniture.[\"ImplantedEaterStatue\", \"part\", \"D: Erosion has smoothed its features into abstraction, but once it stood in monument to the coupling of machine and folk.
Furniture.[\"Induction Charging Station\", \"part\: Induction coils are rooted under a cork pad, where electric juice is transferred to battery cells.
Furniture.[\"Industrial Fan\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Cyclopean blades shaped to the airfoil are housed inside a metallic ring nicked with the scars of time. In the distant past, someone directed the course of air at grand scales.
Furniture.[\"Iron Gate\", \"part\", \"Description\: Iron pickets are set across a latched rail.
Furniture.[\"Iron Maiden\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Rust-caked spines line the interior of an iron sarcophagus. Dissatisfied with the caliber of earthly punishments, its deviser sought to deprave even the restful slumber of eternity.
Furniture.[\"JoppaOven\", \"part\", \"Description\: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the thick clay oven, and with it comes the smell of hot starapple jam and toasted matz.
Furniture.[\"Jug Eastern Style\", \"part\", \"Desc: Clay was rounded and kilned to store oils and wine.
Furniture.[\"Jug Wide Eastern Style\", \"part\", \: Clay was rounded and kilned to store oils and wine.
Furniture.[\"Jug\", \"part\", \"Description\", \"S: Clay was rounded and kilned to store oils and wine.
Furniture.[\"Keresh Statue\", \"part\", \"Descript: Abandoned in a tucked-away hut on Bey Lah's outskirts, this enormous statue of hornsfel languishes under a layer of withered vegetation. It depicts a majestic deer with one hoof raised from the ground, its humanlike eyes judging its surroundings and finding them wanting. The metal plaque on the base of the statue hasn't fared well over the centuries, and the only glyphs you can make out are 'K', 'R', 'S', and 'H'.
Furniture.[\"Kiln\", \"part\", \"Description\", \": A burnished steel jacket hugs a smoldering fire pit. Scorchstrokes of many materials cake its sides.
Furniture.[\"Kline\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: Convivia in the limen, the boundary between sun-baked Moghra'yi and the shade of the Spindle, involves the mulling of cider, holography, and the arrangement of klinai at right angles.
Furniture.[\"Kyakukya Monument 1\", \"part\", \"Ru:
This object is a monument to a scene from the history of {{M|Kyakukya}}.

Under the Beetle Moon, folks settled here to gather goods of passage for Ape Saad Oboroqoru, and so Kyakukya was founded.
Furniture.[\"Kyakukya Monument 2\", \"part\", \"Ru:
This object is a monument to a scene from the history of {{M|Kyakukya}}.

In 979, Nuntu, the legendary albino ape, grew tired of bludgeoning things to death and journeyed to a root-strangled place on the River Svy. There he came upon Kyakukya and its inhabitants. The villagers of Kyakukya asked Nuntu to employ his magisterial skills and lead the village.
Furniture.[\"KyakukyaOven\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the round mud oven, and with it comes the smell of mulled cider and brined mushrooms.
Furniture.[\"Lathe\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: Handwheel and spindle turn to sand off matter and gift the world with helices and round things. Metal dust accrues on the ground beneath.

Furniture.[\"Light Sculpture\", \"part\", \"Descri: Blue laser light bursts out of the reference beam and reimagines a wavefront sculpted on a light lathe. Air adds a layer of grain.
Furniture.[\"Locker\", \"part\", \"Description\",: A metal locker that looks worn with age.
Furniture.[\"Long Jug\", \"part\", \"Description\": Clay was spun on the potter's wheel and shaped into waves, fired, and glazed into a traditional vessel.
Furniture.[\"Loudspeaker\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Magnetized innards digest electrical signals and belch out the waveform, while a diaphragm breaths dust onto a brass grill.
Furniture.[\"Low Table\", \"part\", \"Description\: It's scratched on top where a pestle splintered the wood.
Furniture.[\"Mannequin\", \"part\", \"Description\: The biped form emerges out of a cocoon of wood and fiberglass.
Furniture.[\"Marble Dais\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Smooth cerulean marble looks like holographic light annealed into solid rock. It's edged and cornered with gold.
Furniture.[\"Massage Chair\", \"part\", \"Descript: It's fitted with a crankshaft that turns a dimpled rubber sheet and kneads kinks out the hindparts of its sitter.
Furniture.[\"MechPilotSeat\", \"part\", \"Descript: Teal foam pads the inside back and the deep seat well, and dials deck the curved armrests. The whole chair swivels atop an ejection motor.
Furniture.[\"MedLocker\", \"part\", \"Description\: Surfaces of dull steel are smudged with finger age. The lid is painted with a red crux and latched shut.
Furniture.[\"Medical Bed\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Plastic white as salt bleach was contoured for peaceful slumber, convalescence, and realignment of the humours.
Furniture.[\"Medical Chair\", \"part\", \"Descript: Plastic white as salt bleach was contoured for ideal digestion and harmony of the humors.
Furniture.[\"Melted Jug\", \"part\", \"Description: Glazed and superheated clay lies cracked open. Two pictographs have been rendered illegible.
Furniture.[\"Melted Pad\", \"part\", \"Description: Tracery on the fullerite hem is melted bright white and drips onto the cracked foam pad. Lily sprouts quicken in the cracks and push forth; life creeps outward.
Furniture.[\"Melted Reliquary\", \"part\", \"Descr: Marble striations smear into melted pink rock slag; the ageless box lies open.

Furniture.[\"Metal Door\", \"part\", \"Description: A furrowed metal plate is fit to the arch of the doorway, and a slide panel is cut from its center.
Furniture.[\"Metal Table\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Steel was anointed with liquid chrome, cooled, and beaten into a flat and workable surface.
Furniture.[\"Millstone\", \"part\", \"Description\: Circles of limestone, porous and oyster-gray with the shells of old things, are arranged in vertical slabs and turned against each other to grind fibrous grains into flours.
Furniture.[\"MopangoOven\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the round bone oven, and with it comes the smell of leavened pastry, sweet bananas, and warm skulk.
Furniture.[\"Multicabinet\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Slide drawers of galvanized metal are arranged in a cabinet as rectangles of assorted dimensions. Storage is fractal.
Furniture.[\"Mushroom Case\", \"part\", \"Descript: Half-moon glass roofs the subterrarium and protects the corpse eaters, who have prospered inside. They are an arcology of gills.
Furniture.[\"NormCore\", \"part\", \"Description\": Diamond manifolds pressurize quartz into its Ω form, crystallizing spacetime along the ley lines in the local region. Drops of normality condensate on the flue refract light into an inner dimension.
Furniture.[\"Oboroqoru Statue\", \"part\", \"Descr: This stone idol of Oboroqoru stands twenty spans tall. Its nameless sculptor chose to depict the ape god sitting cross-legged with each of his three pairs of gargantuan arms grasping each other. The idol is swathed in vines, its caretakers ceding to nature save where the herbage has threatened to obscure Oboroqoru's gentle countenance. Wreaths of flowers of every hue the forest begets -- azure, chartreuse, indigo, carnelian -- litter the base of the shrine, insignificant offerings to what appears to be a callous god.
Furniture.[\"Octagonal Table\", \"part\", \"Descri: Decorated with painted mandalas and shaped by the geometric hand, the table honors symmetry and numerology.
Furniture.[\"Ornate Bench\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Guild furniture makers, conspiring in a bright workroom beneath the Eaters' sun, stretched a cushion to the precise size of two ardent lovers and set a pleasing mail diamond at its right angle. The claw-and-ball feet suggest movement.
Furniture.[\"Ornate Chair\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Plumpness in the cushion is gauged to the seated thinker, lancet arches press into the playful back, and claw-and-ball feet suggest a hidden life within the piece itself. This is a chair laden with meaning.
Furniture.[\"Ornate Potted Plant 1\", \"part\", \": Slink-green plant lobes splay out of the ancient cauldron with chromium incision. They live and breathe like their loam-bound cousins, but their bio-data was spliced with the amaranthine seed. They do not die even as the Eaters about them decompose.
Furniture.[\"Ornate Potted Plant 2\", \"part\", \": Slink-green plant lobes splay out of the ancient cauldron with chromium incision. They live and breathe like their loam-bound cousins, but their bio-data was spliced with the amaranthine seed. They do not die even as the Eaters about them decompose.
Furniture.[\"Ornate Potted Plant 3\", \"part\", \": Slink-green plant lobes splay out of the ancient cauldron with chromium incision. They live and breathe like their loam-bound cousins, but their bio-data was spliced with the amaranthine seed. They do not die even as the Eaters about them decompose.
Furniture.[\"Ornate Potted Plant 4\", \"part\", \": Slink-green plant lobes splay out of the ancient cauldron with chromium incision. They live and breathe like their loam-bound cousins, but their bio-data was spliced with the amaranthine seed. They do not die even as the Eaters about them decompose.
Furniture.[\"Ornate Table\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Etched chromium on the lavish legs tapers to claw-and-ball feet, and on the marble surface, geometric imperfections were rasped off and flung into an iron bucket that may still exist somewhere. Eaters spoke here, and planned.
Furniture.[\"Orrery\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Brass gears, balls, and rings turn in precise mimicry of worlds and stars.
Furniture.[\"Oven\", \"part\", \"Description\", \": Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the thick clay oven, and with it comes the smell of scrumptious food.
Furniture.[\"Painted Column L\", \"part\", \"Descr: Marble blossoms on top as a spiraling volute. The column is splattered with paint.
Furniture.[\"Painting\", \"part\", \"Description\": Nacreous oil wets the ecru linen and has dripped onto the easel. From the plane of the canvas, an image is pressed out.
Furniture.[\"Pitcher\", \"part\", \"Description\",: A trailed vessel was first thrown on the potter's wheel in the soft warmth of morning. A canyoneer shaped the lip with extra care to preserve the precious liquids of life.
Furniture.[\"Platform\", \"part\", \"Description\": A black and grated metal platform is meadowed with the dust of time. It's crisscrossed with the tracks of tiny lifethings.
Furniture.[\"PowerLine\", \"part\", \"Description\: Copper, aluminum, and glass fiber were rounded into an electrical conduit.
Furniture.[\"Psiamp Sarcophagus\", \"part\", \"Des: It's worked from otherworldly limestone. The stone was quarried from a drift-world spinning about a darkling star whose weak luminescence didn't bleach the voidstuff from the rock's coral. Now it insulates its slumberer from the rays of materiality and conducts them to the psychic aether.
Furniture.[\"QasShrine\", \"part\", \"Description\: The halfgod kneels on hinds worked wide in old stone. Tiled polygons spill off the statue's base to evoke Qas's rightening of space, time, mountain, and village. Generations of moss skirt the beast's treecutter hooves.
Furniture.[\"QonShrine\", \"part\", \"Description\: A godswan sits in stone grace with its gigantic kite train furled to a dizzying gyre. She wears a blank and unreadable expression, to evoke the carver's sense of her as uncertainty's incubus. Generations of moss skirt the beast's down feathers.
Furniture.[\"Quantum Rippler\", \"part\", \"Descri: Out of a gold-plated box, kaleidoscopic tiles and tones harmonize over several dimensions.
Furniture.[\"Random Statue\", \"part\", \"Descript: This statue worked from *material* intricately depicts *creature.a**creature*:
Furniture.[\"Reclamation Cist\", \"part\", \"Descr: A coffin of steel, brass, and cathode tube conceals an array of precision instruments used to suck organ-matter from the dead and deliver it back to kith and kin.
Furniture.[\"Recoming Nook Door\", \"part\", \"Des: Bright tracery charts a life time of meaning through the black marble void of the door's surface. A family name is inscribed on a memorial plaque.
Furniture.[\"Recoming Nook Door\", \"part\", \"Ren: ornately engraved marble door with plaque
Furniture.[\"Recoming Reliquary\", \"part\", \"Des: In a dusty corner of the past, nameless workers glazed striated marble and inlaid it with amethyst to house the earthly gear of a High Eater returned.
Furniture.[\"Recoming Water Jug\", \"part\", \"Des: Clay was spun on the potter's wheel and shaped into waves, fired, and glazed into a ceremonial vessel. Two pictographs are panelled side-by-side: 'life' and 'drink'.
Furniture.[\"Rectangular Bells\", \"part\", \"Desc: Rectangle keys are arranged down the angled ladder to step upwise in pitch. Hanging on frame is a note mallet.
Furniture.[\"Regen Tank\", \"part\", \"Description: Tetraxenonoglass walls and convalesscent gel recreate the conditions of the amnion where reptile, bird, and mammal embryos are nurtured to whole life.
Furniture.[\"Reliquary\", \"part\", \"Description\: In a dusty corner of the past, nameless workers glazed striated marble and inlaid it with gold to house the heirlooms and grave goods of a slump-shouldered Eater.
Furniture.[\"RermadonShrine\", \"part\", \"Descrip: A spiny monstrous fish sits in a pool of stonecarved water. Underneath is the finned tail that poets have beating a foamy brine out the pipes at Maqqom to form the Hinnom lake. Generations of moss skirt its underfin.
Furniture.[\"Reshaping Nook\", \"part\", \"Descrip: The characteristic glass arch marks the enclosure as a becoming nook gutted and wire-stripped for a new purpose. A claw extends for soldering and shaping, and in the underdrum, a wheel spins wet clay fresh and ready for sunslag fermentation.
Furniture.[\"Reshaping Pad\", \"part\", \"Descript: A crude stone hem surrounds a foam landing pad, and the above-head fretwork is braided into the new-fangled glyphs of reshaping and return symbology.
Furniture.[\"Rock Tumbler\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Rubber lines the inner topology of a motorized barrel. A kettle of ebon carbide grit sits in the underchamber ready to abrade.
Furniture.[\"Ruined Ring Gate\", \"part\", \"Descr: Water ribbons in high relief crumble off the broken marble. Pieces of the arch that once enclosed the forward motion of travelers now lie on smooth backs somewhere else.
Furniture.[\"RustLocker\", \"part\", \"Description: Brass bands frame an old iron box eaten red by air and rain.
Furniture.[\"Sarcophagus\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Black marble was quarried from the vast reaches of the underearth and chiseled into a stone blanket for the dead.
Furniture.[\"Sconce\", \"part\", \"Description\",: A brightly burning handfire hangs across wood and iron.
Furniture.[\"Scrapable Deposit Box 6\", \"part\",: Metal slates partition the chrome carton into golden rectangles. Inside, artifacts await their planned abrasion and return to mineral form.
Furniture.[\"Scrapasan\", \"part\", \"Description\: This bowl-shaped basket of scrounged textiles and padding yawns with the promise of a humble, comfortable embrace followed by a laborious escape.
Furniture.[\"Security Door\", \"part\", \"Descript: A furrowed metal plate is fit to the arch of the doorway, and a sliding panel sits recessed in the center. The panel is impressed with the mold of a key card.
Furniture.[\"Sewing Machine\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Inside the scratched metal C a needle and a bobbin prepare to punch a pair of threads into a lockstitch. Initials are carved all around its pedestal.
Furniture.[\"ShugruithShrine\", \"part\", \"Descri: Chiseled spines wreathe the sinuous worldeater, who dug the earthly caves that were peopled by late-stage troglodytes. The hundred-nine eyes of legend peer across time, and generations of moss skirt the beast's banded undergirth.
Furniture.[\"Sign\", \"part\", \"Description\", \": A terracotta board has been painted with ochre and ground iron.
Furniture.[\"Sleek Table\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: A sharp rectangle seems to have been balanced on a metal pole over a smaller rectangle, forming a steady working surface. No welding scars are visible.
Furniture.[\"Sofa\", \"part\", \"Description\", \": Rich green tufts are weaved to a dense and soft lattice, stuffed with watervine chaff and glowcrow feathers, and then hung on a angled wood frame.
Furniture.[\"Solar Condenser\", \"part\", \"Descri: Chrome flanges maximize the surface area for evaporated air to re-settle as distilled dew.
Furniture.[\"Solar Power Station\", \"part\", \"De: Photovoltaics are arrayed across two socketed lunes. They spin for optimal range and confer sun energy to a vacuum-cased flywheel.
Furniture.[\"Solar Pumping Station\", \"part\", \": Sunrays are captured by photovoltaics across the foundation around a chrome cylinder, and the heat is used to pump water into pipes for dispersal.
Furniture.[\"Solar Still\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Heat from the salt sun evaporates brackish water. When the water condenses again, it's separated into its pure and impure elements: salt gloms on the still, while freshwater collects in the basin.
Furniture.[\"Starmchair\", \"part\", \"Description: Starfish arms are stuffed with plant matter, stiffened, and fixed around a concave disc to the perfect shape of a floor cushion for bipeds. The axial arm keeps the neck straight and upright, and a meadow of underspines administers a subtle therapeutic puncturing.
Furniture.[\"StiltOven\", \"part\", \"Description\: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the bright stone oven, and with it comes the smell of hot spine fruit jam and roasted tail.
Furniture.[\"StiltWell\", \"part\", \"Description\: Sphinx scenes of post-Edification glamour are arrayed in gold and sunken relief around the lip of the black marble fount. The tracery of its bright veins spikes the eye but, downwell, recedes into a starless depth.
Furniture.[\"Stool\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: Nothing is in situ, everything is in motion, and the seated must prepare for the next moment where the memory of leisure is burned in neurotic effigy. The stool abides these truths.
Furniture.[\"Striped Door\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Rail to rail panels are bulwarked by a crossbar for reinforcement of the in and out margin.
Furniture.[\"SultanReliquaryE\", \"part\", \"Descr: Cyclopean marble slates enclose an interdiction prism for imperial treasures, including the creatural and sovereign Face. Across their vast surfaces, goldwork plots the geometric sequences of life and its boundaries; water spills down the bodies of world-caryatides and curls back to the welkin.
Furniture.[\"SultanReliquaryW\", \"part\", \"Descr: Cyclopean marble slates enclose an interdiction prism for imperial treasures, including the creatural and sovereign Face. Across their vast surfaces, goldwork plots the geometric sequences of life and its boundaries; water spills down the bodies of world-caryatides and curls back to the welkin.
Furniture.[\"SultanSarcophagusE\", \"part\", \"Des: Cirrus clouds of neon stir inside a glass lune and beam light through the prefigured likeness of the sultan. A bleary shape thus hovers supine above the starless and gigantic black rock divan. The artist may have intended this to evoke a lightning storm over a dark plain or a lily on the pitch of a river: something to represent the bright and gaseous mind roaming over the inert body.
Furniture.[\"SultanSarcophagusW\", \"part\", \"Des: Cirrus clouds of neon stir inside a glass lune and beam light through the prefigured likeness of the sultan. A bleary shape thus hovers supine above the starless and gigantic black rock divan. The artist may have intended this to evoke a lightning storm over a dark plain or a lily on the pitch of a river: something to represent the bright and gaseous mind roaming over the inert body.
Furniture.[\"Table\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: Branches of the living tree were resorbed and reformed into trunk knots. Then, hundreds of years later, the oiled saw of a gorge woodworker disarranged the arbor geometry and flattened it for civil use. That history remains cast in two dimensions, powdered with dust and scratched in pencil.
Furniture.[\"Tall Brazier\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Burnished bronze is burned to light-in-ceremony by hot coal.
Furniture.[\"Techlight1\", \"part\", \"Description: Sharp points of chrome are the vertices of this utilitarian light fixture. Brightness bursts from its edges and lights the world.
Furniture.[\"Techlight2\", \"part\", \"Description: Sharp points of chrome are the vertices of this utilitarian light fixture. Brightness bursts from its edges and lights the world.
Furniture.[\"Techlight3\", \"part\", \"Description: Sharp points of chrome are the vertices of this utilitarian light fixture. Brightness bursts from its edges and lights the world.
Furniture.[\"Telescope\", \"part\", \"Description\: Glass lunes refract light and paint images in fictive angular size.
Furniture.[\"TempleSwitch\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A solitary button is center-set in a rectangle of scrawled-on metal.
Furniture.[\"Throne\", \"part\", \"Description\",: The ornamentation of etched metal and precious stones designate the axis mundi.
Furniture.[\"Tinted Glass Door E\", \"part\", \"De: Panes of polished glass were frosted dark and fit on a slide rail.
Furniture.[\"Tomb Techlight1\", \"part\", \"Descri: Sharp points of chrome are the vertices of this ornamental light fixture. Brightness bursts from its edges and ignites the world.
Furniture.[\"Torchpost\", \"part\", \"Description\: A brightly burning handfire hangs across wood and iron.
Furniture.[\"Torture Chair\", \"part\", \"Descript: In its new context the peptic chair menaces. Dried blood paints the plastic seat, and its catheters fray like a knot of worms.
Furniture.[\"Troll Door 1\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A elephant slab of copper-painted metal slumps out of its ancient doorframe. The handle is kept still by an ornate mechanical lock.
Furniture.[\"Troll Door 2\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A elephant slab of silver-painted metal slumps out of its ancient doorframe. The handle is kept still by an ornate mechanical lock.
Furniture.[\"Troll Door 3\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A elephant slab of gold-painted metal slumps out of its ancient doorframe. The handle is kept still by an ornate mechanical lock.
Furniture.[\"Unfinished Sculpture\", \"part\", \"D: The wet paints of earth -- clay, slag, chrome, and dye -- slouch a half-idea with material weight. The transformation is arrested through indecision or neglect.
Furniture.[\"Unicomputer\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Inside a metal chassis, amber glyphs ride the scanlines painted by a cathode ray. Frustum keys are arranged in quiet rows.
Furniture.[\"Universal Charging Station\", \"part\: Shelves, pads, slates, and cradles are worked from metal like a chrome honeycomb. Electrical power gets concentrated into battery-juice and served into its docked cells.
Furniture.[\"Unlit Torchpost\", \"part\", \"Descri: A sconce of wood and iron hangs lightless.
Furniture.[\"Vase\", \"part\", \"Description\", \": A large storage vase with a decorative slip. The style hints that it was fired in the home-kiln of a canyon dweller.
Furniture.[\"VehicleConsole N\", \"part\", \"Descr: Inside a metal frame damp with soup dew, a glass lune is painted with the data glyphs of navigation and two-body alignment. 3D models of a large and smaller creature rotate on their vertical axes, and a psychoelectric scan shows the status of the meld.
Furniture.[\"VehicleGolemExit\", \"part\", \"Descr: A pair of retractible chrome panels are fit on oiled tracks.
Furniture.[\"VehicleGolemPassengerSeat\", \"part\": Teal foam pads the inside back and the deep seat well, and a single dial dresses the right armrest. The whole chair swivels atop an ejection motor.
Furniture.[\"VehicleGolemSeat\", \"part\", \"Descr: Teal foam pads the inside back and the deep seat well, and dials deck the curved armrests. The whole chair swivels atop an ejection motor.
Furniture.[\"VehicleGolemSupportColumn\", \"part\": Clay was fired around steel and erected in the rib cage for structural support.
Furniture.[\"Village Hologram 1\", \"part\", \"Des: Flickering interference patterns of light form a moire-cascading tableau.
Furniture.[\"Village Hologram 2\", \"part\", \"Des: Flickering interference patterns of light form a moire-cascading tableau.
Furniture.[\"Village Monument Amphora\", \"part\",: The bellies of vessels are sacred, for they both carry the waters of life and project the fluid past onto the convex present.
Furniture.[\"Village Monument Birdhouse\", \"part\: Etched into this mead hall for small, winged friends are stories they cannot understand.
Furniture.[\"Village Monument Diptych\", \"part\",: A narrative is confined to the etched boundaries of this stone, to the reductive duality of its form.
Furniture.[\"Village Monument Monolith\", \"part\": Moss-stuff inserts itself into the story-world evoked into being by the carved rock.
Furniture.[\"Village Monument Obelisk\", \"part\",: Stone asserts its importance by orienting toward the firmament, whence the oldest wisdom stirs.
Furniture.[\"Village Monument Orb\", \"part\", \"D: Reverence was paid to the orb, smoothed toward ideality and hoisted on brass legs.
Furniture.[\"Village Monument Sculpture\", \"part\: From the hands of a metalworker rods and strips erupted and cooled into shape.
Furniture.[\"Village Monument Stele\", \"part\", \: Glyphs inscribed into the ancient stone are refracted into the present.
Furniture.[\"Waterbed\", \"part\", \"Description\": Wooden slats are laid on right angles in the style of the hillfolk. In place of a chaff cushion, however, lies a plastic mattress pumped with unctuous water, an alternative favored by raft-floaters who pine for the waves of the lake.
Furniture.[\"Waterbed\", \"tag\", \"HeroNameTitleC: the Weary,the Tired,the Ebb and Flow,Sailors
Furniture.[\"Wavy Door\", \"part\", \"Description\: Metals cut by the cosine saw were fit-welded and put to steel frame. The lock stile is padded in chrome.
Furniture.[\"Weapon Rack\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Wooden and chrome poles let weapons rest peacefully.
Furniture.[\"Wide Bottle\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Glass was blown to a wide bowl and thin stem in the tradition of the grove-carpeted mountain lagynos. Were the style's first artisans working through the thick and ripe air of the musa wood? Did Spindle glitter dust their marvers and pipes?
Furniture.[\"Windowed Door\", \"part\", \"Descript: At some moment in the door's past, an indweller unspooled their will to curiosity and cut an aperture for sight through the boundary.
Furniture.[\"Wire Extruder\", \"part\", \"Descript: A glinting spindle of steel is spiraled with grooves for stripping wire from raw nuggets and ingots.
Furniture.[\"Wooden Water Wheel\", \"part\", \"Des: Wood paddles black with wet-rot catch the force of the babbling brook and set the wheel to the slow motion of centuries.
Furniture.[\"Wooden Wind Turbine\", \"part\", \"De: Sailcloth is fastened to brined wooden arms that rotate by windsong and turn the central shaft.
Furniture.[\"WoodenMechanicalTransmission\", \"par: Wood was shaved, cut to smooth-volumed shafts, and fit inside gearboxes to convey motion in continuity.
Furniture.[\"Work Chair\", \"part\", \"Description: Tight-fitted black mesh straightens the spine. Wheels descend from casters and locomote.
Furniture.[\"Workbench\", \"part\", \"Description\: Knotted wood of good moisture content holds the weight of earth at right angles. Scorch marks and salt decorate the grooves.
Furniture.[\"Woven Basket\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Marsh reed was handcrossed by warp and weft into a vessel for sheaf and other dry goods.
Furniture.[\"Yd Village Monument 1\", \"part\", \":
This object is a monument to a scene from the history of the {{M|Yd Freehold}}.

Centuries after the height of the Gyre, the svardym Goek, Mak, and Geeub met the galgal Many Eyes while languishing inside of a reef sponge. Together they founded the Yd Freehold to live out the rest of their lives.
Furniture.[\"Yd Village Monument 2\", \"part\", \":
This object is a monument to a scene from the history of the {{M|Yd Freehold}}.

In 901, the villagers of the Yd Freehold and its founders abolished all forms of hierarchy from their settlement. The two pillars of civic life in the Freehold thus became anarchy and authenticity.
Furniture.[\"YdFreeholdGlassHydraulicPipe1\", \"pa: Glass was blown into a machine artery and ion-colored to fluorescent green-yellow with uranium.
Furniture.[\"YdFreeholdOven\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the round clay oven, and with it comes the smell of fermented tongue and congealed love.
Furniture.[\"YurlSign\", \"part\", \"Chat\", \"Say: Fine Wares from the Consortium of Phyta
Furniture.[\"hologram of Shekhinah\", \"part\", \": [Shekhinah turns toward you, His arms wide.]

Glorious Shekhinah, Argent Adonis and First Father, poses in luminous mummery. With the stature of the ageless stars, fixed and permanent, He appraises the temple erected in His honor and cocks His head in approval. Befitting the memory of His union with the Kasaphescence, He clothes His manifestation in cerulean shades, forsaking the viridians and russets of the lowly plants and clay earth.
Furniture.[\"statue of Shekhinah\", \"part\", \"De: Here Shekhinah has been sculpted into permanence with magnificent cerulean marble. His body is chiseled to blessed perfection. His golden diadem crowns him Father among Fathers.
Furniture.[\"statue of athlete\", \"part\", \"Desc: Carthax the athlete is depicted here mid-stride. His glistening silver hair is tied behind his head, in astral tradition, as he vaults through the firmament.
Furniture.[\"statue of knight\", \"part\", \"Descr: The statue of Bel wears its tremendous weight in polished marble. He wields his epochal aegis, storied for obstructing a swirling gas cloud in the starry dawn.
Furniture.[\"statue of mason\", \"part\", \"Descri: Nisroch the star mason is depicted here straddling the earth with his mighty legs. He dons his favorite sash, whose folds are exquisitely worked in gold.
Furniture.[\"statue of scholar\", \"part\", \"Desc: Resheph, who's called 'the Above', lifts an enigmatic finger to heal the wounds of the sick.
Furniture.[\"statue of wizard\", \"part\", \"Descr: Dagon the orator domineers the west apse with his brazen pose. His golden coronet shines splendidly in the fire's shine.

Genotypes.[null, \"stat\", \"Agility\", \"ChargenD: Your {{W|Agility}} score determines your accuracy with both melee and ranged weapons and your ability to dodge attacks.
Genotypes.[null, \"stat\", \"Ego\", \"ChargenDescr: Your {{W|Ego}} score determines the potency of your ability to haggle with merchants, and your ability to dominate the wills of other living creatures.
Genotypes.[null, \"stat\", \"Intelligence\", \"Cha: Your {{W|Intelligence}} score determines your number of skill points and your ability to examine artifacts.
Genotypes.[null, \"stat\", \"Strength\", \"Chargen: Your {{W|Strength}} score determines how effectively you penetrate your opponents' armor with melee attacks, how much damage your melee attacks do, your ability to resist forced movement, and your carry capacity.
Genotypes.[null, \"stat\", \"Toughness\", \"Charge: Your {{W|Toughness}} score determines your number of hit points, your natural healing rate, and your ability to resist poison and disease.
Genotypes.[null, \"stat\", \"Willpower\", \"Charge: Your {{W|Willpower}} score modifies the cooldowns of your activated abilities, determines your ability to resist mental attacks, and modifies your natural healing rate.

HiddenObjects.[\"Amaranthine Dust\", \"part\", \"Descr: The darkling crystal was shattered and abraded to dust; a million worlds of self have crumbled.
HiddenObjects.[\"Archon Hologram\", \"part\", \"Descri: A depiction coheres of the explosive energy of the universe bottled in a shielded bulb and pistoned into a vast and edged intelligence. From there the great machinic archons of the Eaters fissioned in their oracula and, with baetyls as fingers, lathed the waking world.
HiddenObjects.[\"Barathrum Hologram\", \"part\", \"Des: The bright countenance and mane of short quills on the young urshiib cut through even a canvas of fraying light. His shoulders are drawn back with fresh purpose, and his eyes pierce the foreground with a laser's precision.
HiddenObjects.[\"BaseArkCore\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: A curtain of blue, magenta, and scarlet hangs over the sacred hold of moon-and-sun shade and hypernova gold (color specifications handed down directly from the machinic being who ensued from the entheos within). Raw amateriality is titrated out the container boundary and canaled in managed doses to processors that crack it in order to do the uncomputable: decide from nothing.
HiddenObjects.[\"BaseEaterFloorClock\", \"part\", \"De: Goldleaf digits of a nondeterministic number system are arrayed inside the circumference of an ecliptic mosaic.
HiddenObjects.[\"BaseEaterGreatMachineShrine\", \"part: Marble eaters kneel in priestly concordance with the Great Machine, drawing levers and priming hydrants to steer and be steered by the Computed Will. A dais of crystal diodes gives a dashboard view to the churning of geocultures hundreds of thousands of light years away.
HiddenObjects.[\"BaseHologramProjector\", \"part\", \": A switch aligns the particle scatter on the far circle and shines an incising light.
HiddenObjects.[\"BaseMoverChute\", \"part\", \"Descrip: A chute of superconductive timber is keyed to rhyme with adjacent leylines and furnish a frictionless glide.
HiddenObjects.[\"BaseMoverCouch\", \"part\", \"Descrip: An arched sofa brings movers together via the blunted tyranny of here and now. The wooden seat, cut from tree-things on a Coven moon world, bears a notch of some form made by every sitter in its hundred chiliad history.
HiddenObjects.[\"BaseShevaHydraulicPipe\", \"part\", \: Melted sand from thirty sun-worlds was blown to topological improbability and capped with finials of starless gold.
HiddenObjects.[\"BaseSpindleSupport\", \"part\", \"Des: Flanged ursteel anchors secure the tapered ribbon of Gjaus to its low earth point.
HiddenObjects.[\"BaseStarOrchidTempleGate\", \"part\",: The stair, stage, and loop gate are cast in marble relief to their surroundings by hyperdimensional filament. The holograph vista of anotherworld temple is evanesced, and instead local lilies fill the frame.
HiddenObjects.[\"BaseStarOrchidTemplePlaqueEndcap\", \: Metal cribbed from the blackened nozzle of a starship was melted down by the Exhaustiers' Guild and cast to a monumental scaffold. The silhouettes of fried voidfauna are still visible on the burnished veneer.

Items.[\"Fish Corpse\", \"part\", \"Food\", \": Soft meat slips off the pin bones.
Items.[\"Fist of the Ape God\", \"part\", \"De: Lifeblood the color of amaranth and dried in moonlight paints the clenched and giant fist of the dead forest Saad.
