Items.[\"Fixit Spray\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: An aerosol can blown full of foaminating caulk.
Items.[\"Flamethrower\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A limpid fuel pump exposes ribbons of oil slick, and behind it a voltage gauge ticks. The slanted heat shield is scorched black.
Items.[\"Flange from the Great Machine\", \"pa: A gigantic whorl lip snapped off the driving wheel of culture, fell out of its star vault's orbit, and, through the eroded methods of time, arrived here. Astroexotic spores lash its metasteel underrim, pilgrims from a hot fungal core biding time between now and some mystifying future point.

Casts mottled with dust particles were culled and fed to lithovores, leaving only the perfect hexagonal prisms.

Items.[\"Flexivest\", \"part\", \"Description\: A swathe of elastyne is sheer-stretched over a cuirass of semi-hard plastic, forming a suit of maneuverable mail.
Items.[\"Floating Glowsphere\", \"part\", \"De: A phosphorescent opal-like fits in the palm of a hand and glows with the light of auroras absorbed chiliads ago. It floats about preternaturally.
Items.[\"Flowers\", \"part\", \"Description\",: They're petal-shaded arks of nectarous secrets.
Items.[\"Folded Carbide Arrow\", \"part\", \"D: A narrow shaft fletched with bird feather is capped by a head of folded carbide.
Items.[\"FoldingChair\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Tubes of known purpose splay at welded joints and support a plank for sitting.
Items.[\"Force Bracelet\", \"part\", \"Descrip: A small hexagonal switch sits across an unadorned wristcuff of chrome.
Items.[\"ForceKnife\", \"part\", \"Description: A length of raw space was kineticized and sharpened to a point.
Items.[\"ForceModulator\", \"part\", \"Descrip: The emitted frequencies of your tiniest bits are synchronized with the standardized band for force emission.
Items.[\"Freeze Ray\", \"part\", \"Description: Gaseous coolant billows through a chiffon tube, putting dew on the wide and planar barrel chrome. It spills out onto the air from a ice-chipped muzzle.
Items.[\"Fresh Corpse\", \"part\", \"Descripti: The blood is still wet. Never had you regarded wetness as a sort of clock, until now.
Items.[\"Frog Corpse\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Splayed feet and cracked legs are tucked under a flattened body.
Items.[\"Frowning Moon Mask\", \"part\", \"Des: The moon scowls on an unseen jungle, the craters of brow shaded with animal ash and eaten to a natural ridgeline by the venomous breathe of gods.
Items.[\"Fullerite Armet\", \"part\", \"Descri: The stone-dented metal of aging dusk wraps the brain in a second skull.
Items.[\"Fullerite Arrow\", \"part\", \"Descri: A narrow shaft fletched with bird feather is capped by a fullerite head.
Items.[\"Fullerite Boots\", \"part\", \"Descri: Welded bands of aging dusk shield the legs but weigh their wearer to the earth like ore.
Items.[\"Fullerite Flake Armor\", \"part\", \": Flakes shaved off a big wedge of the gravid metal have been heat-fused to some kind of animal leather.
Items.[\"Fullerite Gauntlets\", \"part\", \"De: Hyperdense metal in meteor black was superheated and banged to articulated finger and palm shape.
Items.[\"Fullerite Plate Mail\", \"part\", \"D: Hyperdense metal in meteor black was superheated and banged to the shoulder and chest shapes.
Items.[\"Fullerite Shield\", \"part\", \"Descr: The broad and tall aegis is a halved kite of sunbeam and starless dusk, and painted across her sword-nicked plane is the Holy Rhombus of the Temple.
Items.[\"FulleriteFist\", \"part\", \"Descript: Skeletal hand of jet black metal remains suspended in temporary lifelessness.
Items.[\"FulleriteHandBones\", \"part\", \"Des: Black fullerite merely dents where weak collagen would be smashed to bits.
Items.[\"Fungicide Gas Pump\", \"part\", \"Des: A hand pump slides into a chrome canister with illustrations of rotting fungi etched in relief.
Items.[\"FungicideGrenade1\", \"part\", \"Desc: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with pictorals of withering fungi.
Items.[\"FungicideGrenade2\", \"part\", \"Desc: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. It's etched with pictorals of withering fungi.
Items.[\"FungicideGrenade3\", \"part\", \"Desc: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It's etched with pictorals of withering fungi.
Items.[\"FungusFace\", \"part\", \"EatenAccomp: On =day= of =month=, at a tavern near =landmark.nearest=, =name= met with a group of kippers and, divinely inspired by =spice:elements.entity@elements[random].practices.!random=, cooked and feasted on =this.refname=.
Woe to the vanquished! =name= feasted on =this.an= by the light of the Beetle Moon.
Items.[\"Furs\", \"part\", \"Description\", \": It's a length of salt-sucked skin cut from a goat, or tomb ferret, and it's powdered with the white dust of the dead.
Items.[\"Ganglionic Teleprojector\", \"part\",: A fluted visor is satcheled in strands of tungsten filament. Two antennae coil out the temples in robotic likeness.
Items.[\"Garbage\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Pieces of the old and aching world have been shaved off their timepoint and crushed to the vicinity of the present. A few bits of recognition remain:  lens of glass, serif of ink, acid-ate lug, and ribbon of wire.
Items.[\"Gas Mask\", \"part\", \"Description\": A durable plastic mask has been fitted with a simple filter to protect against noxious gas.
Items.[\"Gas Tumbler\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Dyed crysteel canisters are fitted to a backrack. Their valves pop out of flux pressurizers, and a splay of hoses allow for several input flows.
Items.[\"Gaslight Chisel\", \"part\", \"Descri: Through a bore in the wood grip draws a stout beam of pale light. In motion it heats to steel-melting temperature and whirrs matter away.
Items.[\"Gaslight Dagger\", \"part\", \"Descri: Through a bore in the wood grip draws a crinkled beam of pale light. In motion it heats to steel-melting temperature and whirrs matter away.
Items.[\"Gaslight Sword\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Through a bore in the wood grip draws a long and tapered beam of pale light. In motion it heats to steel-melting temperature and whirrs matter away.
Items.[\"Gauge from the Great Machine\", \"par: A giant clockface is traced with lemniscates to gauge the entheogenic pressures building in abyssal sun cores. The priest of the machine who took its readings and sung the dial left is indebted to the distant colleague whose klatch invented the whistled language 8000 years later.
Berate, Intimidate, and Menacing Stare also confuse per Confusion rank 10.
Items.[\"Gear from the Great Machine\", \"part: Unshafted from its lanterned machine temple orbiting a star some hundred thousand light years away, the great gear looms in stasis. Dust from a hundred neighbored planet-homes tip its fluted teeth, while its bore is slick with amaranth and incense oil cultured over the lifespan of a gardened civilization.
Wielded weapons blocked by this shield have a 10% chance to be disarmed.
Items.[\"GenericFace\", \"part\", \"EatenAccom: On =day= of =month=, at a tavern near =landmark.nearest=, =name= met with a group of kippers and, divinely inspired by =spice:elements.entity@elements[random].practices.!random=, cooked and feasted on =this.refname=.
Woe to the vanquished! =name= feasted on =this.an= by the light of the Beetle Moon.
Items.[\"Gentling Collar\", \"part\", \"Descri: In wool paper and acrylic the pain of experience is smoothed away into the uniform child's cone. Arterial clamps peek out from the interior surface. The cone is fastened by a brass chain, adorned by beads of glass, and branded on the apex with the Holy Rhombus, a sign of the price of innocence.
Items.[\"Gentling Mask\", \"part\", \"Descript: In wool paper and acrylic the pain of experience is smoothed away into the aspect of a child. Neuronal clamps peek out from the concave interior surface. The mask is fastened by a brass chain, adorned by beads of glass, and branded on the forehead with the Holy Rhombus, a sign of the price of innocence.
Items.[\"Geomagnetic Disc\", \"part\", \"Descr: Ions were spun into a euhedral disc on a spinning wheel, and aquamarine was heat-set on the inner ring by deepsea steam.
Items.[\"Ghostly Flames\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Crystalline flames crack and lap at the shimmering air.
Items.[\"GiantHands\", \"part\", \"Cybernetics: You can wield two-handed weapons in one hand.
Items.[\"GiantHands\", \"part\", \"Description: For ages they dreamed, 'the hands must grow'. In the soft luster of a laboratory, the dream was realized.
Items.[\"Gigantic Chassis Plate\", \"part\", \: A gargantuan slab of burned and rolled chrome was unjointed from an earth-mover. It shadows its monstrous wielder like a starsail.
Items.[\"GlitterGrenade1\", \"part\", \"Descri: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It sparkles in soft light.
Items.[\"GlitterGrenade2\", \"part\", \"Descri: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. It sparkles in soft light.
Items.[\"GlitterGrenade3\", \"part\", \"Descri: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It sparkles in soft light.
Items.[\"Glowsphere\", \"part\", \"Description: A phosphorescent opal-like fits in the palm of a hand and glows with the light of auroras absorbed chiliads ago.
Items.[\"Goggles\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Chrome-brass rings and swarths of leather are precisely cut from a tinker's stencil, but the real signature is on the glass: a scatter of speck-sized fractures from the high salt gales.
Items.[\"Gold Nugget\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: A clump of metal shines in the jeweler's hue of bright sunslag.
Items.[\"Gold Trollking Key\", \"part\", \"Des: A warded stave of burning gold copper waits to unturn the right lock.
Items.[\"GolemOperatingManual\", \"part\", \"D: Fine pages of lined parchment are bound into a algebraic codex.
Items.[\"Gourd\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: Collagen was molded into a liquid vessel.
Items.[\"GraftedMirrorArm\", \"part\", \"Cyber:
You gain an extra thrown weapon slot.
When you perform a throw, you throw from all your thrown weapon slots at once.
Items.[\"GraftedMirrorArm\", \"part\", \"Descr: A plastifer arm forks from the scapula and copies instructions issued from nerve to muscle in its grown twin.
Items.[\"Grandfather Horn\", \"part\", \"Descr: It's the hoary, bowing horn of a wizened mangoat, wind-etched and gilded with scarlet tassels.
Items.[\"Grappling Gun\", \"part\", \"Descript: A tension spring shoves a firing pin to bang a barrel of gas and eject a cabled grapnel; then a winch winds it back.
Items.[\"Grassy Yurtmat\", \"part\", \"Descrip: The crocheted leaf and moss-mass that carpets the hot-smoking yurts of goatfolk has been sewn to a leather collar, giving its wearer the appearance of a creeping bush.
Items.[\"Grave Goods\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: To ritualize the passage to Brightsheol or another thin place, several ornaments were interred: coin, manikin, locket, and pipe.
Items.[\"GravityGrenade1\", \"part\", \"Descri: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with a boquet of inward-facing arrows.
Items.[\"GravityGrenade2\", \"part\", \"Descri: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. It's etched with a boquet of inward-facing arrows.
Items.[\"GravityGrenade3\", \"part\", \"Descri: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It's etched with a boquet of inward-facing arrows.
Items.[\"Grease Boots\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Steel bands bearing their prying scars have been riveted to a pair of pleated boar leather boots. Their soles have been smeared with sliding wax swabbed off the hydraulic presses of the Eaters' tomb.
Items.[\"Grenade Launcher\", \"part\", \"Descr: The tick of a firing pin against steel makes the fauna start. A chrome sight eases the arc of the parabola.
Items.[\"GritGateGridKey\", \"part\", \"Descri: A coded rectangle of paper metal can be slid through lock mechanisms to open some types of doors.
Items.[\"GroundingShunts\", \"part\", \"Descri: Carbon fiber shoots out of two electrodermal contact pads.
Items.[\"GunRack\", \"part\", \"CyberneticsBas:
You gain an additional left and right missile weapon slot.
You cannot wear equipment on your back.
Items.[\"GunRack\", \"part\", \"Description\",: The back-mounted gun rack of polished chrome has two slots for pistols to sit over each shoulder or for a single rifle to sit over the shoulder of choice.
Items.[\"Gyrocopter Backpack\", \"part\", \"De: Articulated blades unfold to form an aerial screw that gets blown upward by an air thruster mounted below. On activation, the equipper takes flight.
Items.[\"HE Missile\", \"part\", \"Description: A bright gashead tips the end of the steely death chute.
Items.[\"HEGrenade1\", \"part\", \"Description: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with a bouquet of outward-facing arrows.
Items.[\"HEGrenade2\", \"part\", \"Description: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. It's etched with a bouquet of outward-facing arrows.
Items.[\"HEGrenade3\", \"part\", \"Description: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It's etched with a bouquet of outward-facing arrows.
Items.[\"Hand Axe\", \"part\", \"Description\": An axe edge is dressed with splinter hairs of brinestalk.
Items.[\"Hand Rail\", \"part\", \"Description\: Artisanally carved wood castles a sextet of parallel conductors and a sliding photon armature. The grain is scorched black on the pistol's stock.
Items.[\"HandENuke\", \"part\", \"Description\: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It's etched with a bouquet of explosive arrows and it rattles under its own weight.
Items.[\"Headlamp\", \"part\", \"Description\": A halogen light sits affixed to a leather head strap.
Items.[\"HeatGrenade1\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's hot to the touch.
Items.[\"HeatGrenade2\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. It's hot to the touch.
Items.[\"HeatGrenade3\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It's hot to the touch.
Items.[\"Helping Hands\", \"part\", \"Descript: Gloved prosthetic hands attach to the ends of articulating rods. The control mechanism is housed in a false spine box.
Items.[\"High-Energy Thermo Cask\", \"part\",: A dense mesh of dilated tetraglass tubes convey coolant and antifreeze over the keg-mail's jumbo compressors. Blower motors drone a low hum, and condenser and evaporator coils spin out the shoulders like grandfather trees above the insulation shrub.
Items.[\"High-Powered Magnet\", \"part\", \"De: Iron fragments mottle its cankered surfaces.
Items.[\"High-Voltage Arc Winder\", \"part\",: A spiral crank closes a chrome-encased circuit and ejects immense amounts of charge through two contact tips. Smoke twirls through their white-hot glow.
Items.[\"HighFidelityMatterRecompositer\", \"p:
Activated. Cooldown 50.
You teleport to any explored space on the map.

The flux inside this milliscopic cask can fold space on just a large enough scale to shunt a human chassis nearby. Nonlinear circuitry calculates all possible outcomes and discards those that land the host outside the target area.
Items.[\"HighGradeDermalInsulation\", \"part\":
+9 heat resistance
+9 cold resistance
+9 electrical resistance
+9 acid resistance
Pillowy neutrofoam scales tense around a supporting axis. Once installed, they'll unwind and inflate under the skin.
Items.[\"HistoryofJoppaVol1\", \"part\", \"Des: A loose ledger of brinestalk pulp has been bound to sticks of waxed wood and furled.
Items.[\"HistoryofJoppaVol2\", \"part\", \"Des: A loose ledger of brinestalk pulp has been bound to sticks of waxed wood and furled.
Items.[\"Hologram Bracelet\", \"part\", \"Desc:
A bangle clasp features a bright cobalt button.
"You think this is the real =name=? It is."
Items.[\"HolographicVisage\", \"part\", \"Cybe:
+200 reputation with a faction you choose when you install this implant
You can activate this implant to change the chosen faction.
Items.[\"HolographicVisage\", \"part\", \"Desc: Emulsion slicks on the cheek and laser light evokes pareidolic warmth.
Items.[\"Homoelectric Wrist Warmer\", \"part\": A knitted sleeve warms itself through contact static.
Items.[\"Hooks\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: Iron hooks were fastened to residual leg limbs to provide a graceless, scraping locomotion for their wearer.
Items.[\"Horns Antlers\", \"part\", \"Descript: Bone fractals burst from the dome in broad and stunning display.
Items.[\"Horns Casque\", \"part\", \"Descripti: An addendum of adamantine skull crowns the head in lithophilic regency.
Items.[\"Horns Single\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A gene-sharpened bone spike pierces the crown.
Items.[\"Horns Spiral\", \"part\", \"Descripti: The growth hex of time has sculpted sharp bonestuff in corkscrew tension.
Items.[\"Horns\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: A pair of bone extrusions trenched with grooves race to a symmetrical point above the head.
Items.[\"Hoversled\", \"part\", \"Description\: A toboggan repels above the ground and gently rocks on an ethereal wave. It's encircled by a corona of wafting dust.

Items.[\"Human Corpse\", \"part\", \"Descripti: The forces of slaughter have rearranged parts of the body. You ponder how rearrangement means something different in each of its contexts: pieces on a game board, favored courtiers in a king's hall, and parts on a body.
Items.[\"Humanoid Corpse\", \"part\", \"Descri: A mound of wet hair and rotting flesh puts some elevation to the ground.
Items.[\"HurdyGurdy\", \"part\", \"Description: The torsion of an external crank drags a rosin-slathered wheel against a metal cable, whose protestations emerge from the wooden case in a low, melodic groan.
Items.[\"HyperElasticAnkleTendons\", \"part\",: Banded ropes of hydrogel are bundled into one.
Items.[\"Hypertractor\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A rifled prism refracts and refocuses light to tunnel things toward its wielder. Sophists call it a 'here ray'.
Items.[\"Icy Vapor\", \"part\", \"Description\: Particles of ice rain sail in small and circular ribbons.
Items.[\"InMaqqomYd\", \"part\", \"Description: This large-print volume is made of hand-pulped and pressed brinestalk paper. Its cover preserved with resin.
Items.[\"InflatableAxons\", \"part\", \"Cybern:
Activated. Cooldown 100.
You gain +40 quickness for 10 rounds, then you become sluggish for 10 rounds (-10 quickness).
Items.[\"InflatableAxons\", \"part\", \"Descri: Nanoscopic stents inflate the gossamer brain-threads that restrict the conduction of the will.
Items.[\"IntravenousPort\", \"part\", \"Cybern: The effects of tonics last twice as long.
Items.[\"IntravenousPort\", \"part\", \"Descri: Three catheters imprint the skin from underneath.
Items.[\"Iron Buckler\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A blushing cheek of mined iron was hammered to a wheel for arm defense.
Items.[\"Iron Vinereaper\", \"part\", \"Descri: Wrought iron was moulded to a crescent for scything the rough hides of watervine.
Items.[\"Ironweave Cloak\", \"part\", \"Descri: A silvery flowing cloth moves with the lightness of fabric and then hardens in stillness or under the pressure of contact. A light patina is starting to form on the stitch.
Items.[\"Issachari Banner\", \"part\", \"Descr: Platinum stitch on a field of salt white brings recognition only to the mirage-trained eyes of the Issachari. The banner has been sewn into a scarlet collar.
Items.[\"Issachari Sun Veil\", \"part\", \"Des: Cloth in the sunbanning hue of salt sight is folded snug to the fit of head and neck.
Items.[\"Jeweled Sandals\", \"part\", \"Descri: A shining jewel, container for gigantic melancholies and gigantic mirths alike, is beset inside a strapped sandal of sheyd leather.
Items.[\"JoppaCorpse\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Poking out of a copse of brinestalk are the unbleached bones of a human adult.
Items.[\"Kah's Loop\", \"part\", \"Description: A ribbed cable of tangent needle points squeezes the limb and quickens its biomatter beyond expectation.
Items.[\"Kah's Loop\", \"part\", \"IntProperty: Wearer may take any action while sprinting at no additional penalty.
Items.[\"Kaleidocera Cape\", \"part\", \"Descr: Cerata pendulate on the cape like prism grass of a windy meadow. They mirror rich hues in cerulean, ruby, star orchid, and void; together they shine to resplendent effect.
Items.[\"Kaleidocera Krakows\", \"part\", \"De: Cerata pendulate on the shoe tips like the Beetle Moon curled through fog. They mirror rich hues in cerulean, ruby, star orchid, and void; together they shine to resplendent effect.
Items.[\"Kaleidocera Muffs\", \"part\", \"Desc: Cerata pendulate on the muffs like crystal-mold on a tree ring. They mirror rich hues in cerulean, ruby, star orchid, and void; together they shine to resplendent effect.
Items.[\"Kindrish\", \"part\", \"Description\": Boartooth beads on the ancient charm are worn to nubs by the cartilage of time, but the flexing cable that holds them together is as strong as the day it was woven. Dangling from the bracelet is a figurine of a deer, carved from a mysterious substance that cracks light like crystal but weighs like metal, producing a shaded lifelikeness elsewhere unseen.
Items.[\"Kindrish\", \"part\", \"TakenAccompli: At a tavern deep in the wilds of =terrain.t=, =name= lost =player.possessive= precious bracelet Kindrish to a local thief. =name= murdered the thief =spice:elements.entity@elements[random].murdermethods.!random= and immediately recovered =player.possessive= cherished heirloom.
Through the exhibition of =player.possessive= extraordinary guile, =name= was able to recover =this.refname=, the ancestral bracelet of the hindren, and was conferred thusly the title of Grand-Doe.
You recovered the ancestral bracelet of the hindren, =this.refname=.
Items.[\"Knollworm Skull\", \"part\", \"Descri: A hideous beak cants over the brain cavity and shades the face in the frightening light of a dim and aching sun.
Items.[\"La Jeunesse\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: The hilt was broken and remade, pieced together from iron, jewel, and leather across the prism-scatter of the past and forever becoming something new. The blade bears the scars of techniques forcing it into killing shape time and again.
Items.[\"Large Stone\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: A piece of rock was water-cleaved from its birthing bed and tumbled by time into a large sphere.
Items.[\"LargeBoulder\", \"part\", \"Descripti: It's a large piece of rock, older than every idea.
Items.[\"Laser Pistol\", \"part\", \"Descripti: The pistol is engraved with watervine hemp and encircled in saltstone. On the grip is an image of a nomad and knight in saltstone. The knight is striking down the nomad.
Items.[\"Laser Rifle\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Telescoped cylinders pinch the mirror point, and under them grows a sylph-like stock of sea-ferried nutwood.
Items.[\"Lead Slug\", \"part\", \"Description\: Lead is cast to a cylindric lump shaved to a point.
Items.[\"Lead-Acid Cell\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Inside the insulated cask of the battery, the electromotive apparatus cracks the energy out of acid and converts it to electrical charge.
Items.[\"Leafy Helm\", \"part\", \"Description: Leaves grow over a domed layer of wearable topsoil.
Items.[\"Leafy Vest\", \"part\", \"Description: Goat leather is vertipacked with a stratum of loam and the seedlings are nourished to make a walking bush.
Items.[\"Leather Apron\", \"part\", \"Descript: Boar hide was brined, limed, and put in a tanning drum. It was cut and fitted into an apron, and now it's a brown canvas for knife scars and tong burns.
Items.[\"Leather Armor\", \"part\", \"Descript: Boiled goat leather was cut to a cuirass and fit with straps and iron buckles. It smells of beeswax.
Items.[\"Leather Boots\", \"part\", \"Descript: A cord of gold wire fished from the computing guts of the underearth lace the shoe-tailored leather of a dead boar.
Items.[\"Leather Cap\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: A leather wrap for the skull is stitched in the brimless style for those who prefer fitting into cracks over shading the jeweled eye.
Items.[\"Leather Cloak\", \"part\", \"Descript: A shroud of goat leather is circle-stained by the acids of time.
Items.[\"Leather Gloves\", \"part\", \"Descrip: A hundredth-generation canyoner cut goat hide to the modeling shape of a bone hand that stuck out their workshop wall of ancient lime.
Items.[\"Leather Moccasins\", \"part\", \"Desc: Boar leather vamps are scuffed with little fissures sparking in wind-rasped quartz.
Items.[\"Leather Whip\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Leather was braided through a ring knot to a coiling thong. There are blood stains on the cracker tip.
Items.[\"LeatherBracer\", \"part\", \"Descript: This simple arm brace is crafted from boiled boar leather and tied on with braided lace. The strips of protective hide are designed to redirect glancing blows to the arm and protect poor archers from their own errant bowstrings.
Items.[\"Leyline Puppeteers\", \"part\", \"Des: Channel grooves are cut into the gloves' static-dried palms in the impossible patterns of leyline geometry. The fingers articulate at intersecting radials and spin the latent into being.
Items.[\"Leyline Puppeteers\", \"part\", \"Rul:
Requires 1 dram of neutron flux to function.
Very tiny chance each round neutron flux is consumed.
+10 psychic glimmer
Items.[\"Light Rail\", \"part\", \"Description: Artisanally carved wood castles a sextet of parallel conductors and a sliding photon armature. The grain is scorched black on the rifle's stock.
Items.[\"Light-Obfuscating Lens\", \"part\", \: A torso-length lens haloed in refraction waves is suspended in mid air.
Items.[\"LightCircleAgolgot\", \"part\", \"Des: Minarets of raw bile hue, blackrot, and poison jade wheel about a zeropoint and blur in iridescence to a rainbow of malady.
Items.[\"LightCircleAgolgot\", \"part\", \"Ren: circle of light in the chord of {{agolgot|Agolgot}}
Items.[\"LightCircleBethsaida\", \"part\", \"D: Minarets of viscus hue, hair/nail flax, and bloodclot ruby wheel about a zeropoint and blur in iridescence to a rainbow of lifeslush.
Items.[\"LightCircleBethsaida\", \"part\", \"R: circle of light in the chord of {{bethsaida|Bethsaida}}
Items.[\"LightCircleQas\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Minarets of force potential, lustreless chrome, and greyscale wheel about a zeropoint and blur in iridescence to a hexagonal rainbow.
Items.[\"LightCircleQas\", \"part\", \"Render\: circle of light in the chord of {{qas|Qas}}
Items.[\"LightCircleQon\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Minarets of dazzle paint, abyssal shine, and subconscious fuzz wheel about a zeropoint and blur in iridescence to a rainbow of stupor.
Items.[\"LightCircleQon\", \"part\", \"Render\: circle of light in the chord of {{qon|Qon}}
Items.[\"LightCircleRermadon\", \"part\", \"De: Minarets of auroral gas, electrified emerald, and fused metals wheel about a zeropoint and blur in iridescence to a rainbow of plasma.
Items.[\"LightCircleRermadon\", \"part\", \"Re: circle of light in the chord of {{rermadon|Rermadon}}
Items.[\"LightCircleShugruith\", \"part\", \"D: Minarets of shale dust hue, crushed snail, and sparking marble wheel about a zeropoint and blur in iridescence to a rainbow of mineral.
Items.[\"LightCircleShugruith\", \"part\", \"R: circle of light in the chord of {{shugruith|Shugruith}}
Items.[\"Linear Cannon\", \"part\", \"Descript: Baroque and kite-like volumes of metal are arranged on an axis as a lathe to shave dimensionality off their inner spaces. A giant stock and grip of painted fullerite support their tremendous weight.
Items.[\"Lives1\", \"part\", \"Description\",: A voluminous tome whose pages are bound between two slabs of waxed wood.
Items.[\"Long Sword\", \"part\", \"Description: Scratches checker the length of edged bell bronze, and skin oil dampens the leather grip.
Items.[\"Long Sword2\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Pits mark the length of the blade like craters on an iron edge-world.
Items.[\"Long Sword2th\", \"part\", \"Descript: Pits mark the broad length of the blade like craters on an iron edge-world.
Items.[\"Long Sword3\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Salt and scars form a comet's tail along the length of the azure blade's edge.
Items.[\"Long Sword3th\", \"part\", \"Descript: Salt and scars form a comet's tail along the broad length of the azure blade's edge.
Items.[\"Long Sword4\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Bright metal is polished to a ghost shine. Streaks of shaded blue show where the blade was carbon-folded on the forge.
Items.[\"Long Sword4th\", \"part\", \"Descript: Bright and wide metal is polished to a ghost shine. Streaks of shaded blue show where the large blade was carbon-folded on the forge.
Items.[\"Long Sword5\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: A razored edge of matte and starless alloy lengthens from point to welded shaft of steel.
Items.[\"Long Sword5th\", \"part\", \"Descript: A wide and razored edge of matte and starless alloy lengthens from point to welded shaft of steel.
Items.[\"Long Sword6\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue.
Items.[\"Long Sword6th\", \"part\", \"Descript: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue.
Items.[\"Long Sword7\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue. Casts mottled with dust particles were culled and fed to lithovores, leaving only the perfect hexagonal prisms.
Items.[\"Long Sword7th\", \"part\", \"Descript: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue. Casts mottled with dust particles were culled and fed to lithovores, leaving only the perfect hexagonal prisms.
Items.[\"Long Sword8\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Quark-gluon plasma rapidly cooled and was extinguished on the voidpeaks of the early universe, except where the globules got trapped in 6D kinks of spacetime. There they glided in the slipstream for billions of years until beings discovered them, built machines to extract and cool them, and reheat them in their stellar furnaces.
Items.[\"Long Sword8th\", \"part\", \"Descript: Quark-gluon plasma rapidly cooled and was extinguished on the voidpeaks of the early universe, except where the globules got trapped in 6D kinks of spacetime. There they glided in the slipstream for billions of years until beings discovered them, built machines to extract and cool them, and reheat them in their stellar furnaces.
Items.[\"Longreach Grappling Gun\", \"part\",: A tension spring shoves a firing pin to bang a barrel of gas and eject a long-cabled grapnel at precise range; and then a winch winds it back.
Items.[\"LoveTonic\", \"part\", \"RulesDescrip:
You feel unusually amorous for about half a day, during which time you'll fall in love with the first thing you look at.
If you inject someone else, they'll fall in love with you and follow you around for 3000-3600 rounds. There's a 1% failure rate for every level higher they are than you.
Items.[\"Luminous Mote\", \"part\", \"Descript: Color swirls around a mote of glow dust.
Items.[\"LuminousInfection\", \"part\", \"Desc: Rime-dotted nodules crust over the infected skin, where an algid mist clings. The fungus colony has terraformed the epidermis into what looks like a miniature range of ice-capped peaks.
Items.[\"Mace2\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: A corm of bell bronze is screw-fitted to a scarred wooden shaft.
Items.[\"Maghammer\", \"part\", \"Description\: Bands of aquamarine lodestone tori wrap around the hitting part of a hefty, double-fisted truncheon. On the bottom handle there's a slot for a battery to juice the magnets.
Items.[\"Maghammer\", \"part\", \"LatchesOn\",: Latches onto metal objects for 8-12 rounds.
Items.[\"Magnetic Bottle\", \"part\", \"Descri: Magnetic glass spike-warps the placid ferrofluids contained within.
Items.[\"Magnetic Bottle\", \"part\", \"RulesD: When powered, this container can have neutron flux safely poured into it from any source, and neutron flux may be safely poured from this container into other suitable containers.
Items.[\"MagneticCore\", \"part\", \"Cyberneti: You gain an additional Floating Nearby equipment slot.
Items.[\"MagneticCore\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Laminated metal is bound as concentric spheres, softening magnetic eddies and powering near-field orbits.
Items.[\"Magnetized Boots\", \"part\", \"Descr: From welt to shank under the ink-smudged boot, a thin plate of magnetized nickel force-welds the wearer to the iron loam.
Items.[\"Mangled Corpse\", \"part\", \"Descrip: The forces of slaughter have rearranged parts of the body. You ponder how rearrangement means something different in each of its contexts: pieces on a game board, favored courtiers in a king's hall, and parts on a body.
Items.[\"MatterRecompositer\", \"part\", \"Cyb:
Activated. Cooldown 100.
You teleport to a random, explored space on the map.
Items.[\"MatterRecompositer\", \"part\", \"Des: The flux inside this milliscopic cask can fold space on just a large enough scale to shunt a human chassis nearby.
Items.[\"Mechanical Wings\", \"part\", \"Descr: Force is pushed across bronze spines through an improbable series of flapping motions, whereupon parasols pop open to catch the mercurial wind.
Items.[\"MedassistModule\", \"part\", \"Cybern:
Reduces the action cost of applying injectors by 80%.
Can be loaded with up to 8 injectors, which the medassist module AI will automatically apply when appropriate (at its own discretion) for no action cost.
Items.[\"MedassistModule\", \"part\", \"Descri: Stents and pneumatic applicators are hardwired to an intelligent control unit that dictates the injection of protean dyes into the veins.
Items.[\"MediumBoulder\", \"part\", \"Descript: It's a sizeable piece of rock, older than every symbol.
Items.[\"Mental Aggregator\", \"part\", \"Desc: A crinkle-sheet of papery metal pokes at the angle of repose.
Items.[\"Merchant's Token\", \"part\", \"Descr: A silver shekel was stamped with the vine-swathed scales of the bazaar.
Items.[\"MerchantAdvertisement\", \"part\", \": A loose ledger of vellum has been rolled, bound to umbilici, and sealed with the wax mark of the master maker.
Items.[\"Mercurial Cloak\", \"part\", \"Descri: Movement puts the birds stitched into the soft pleats of cloth into stuttery animation.
Items.[\"Metamorphic Polygel\", \"part\", \"De: Pink slime kneads the inner wall of a glass bottle and starts to take the shape of what's on the other side.
Items.[\"MicromanipulatorArray\", \"part\", \":
You can tinker and repair in combat at the action cost of one turn.
Reduces the action cost of other tinker skills by 40%.
Grants a bonus to identifying artifacts as if your Intelligence score were increased by 8.
+10% chance to recover bits from disassembling artifacts.
A dozen armatures and manipulators splay out from a metal brace that fuses to the metacarpals.
Items.[\"MineShell\", \"part\", \"Description\: Anarchy is wound into stasis by time's virtual antipode and packaged into a metal disc. Only the instruction of movement will direct it to unaccrete.
Items.[\"Miner's Helmet\", \"part\", \"Descrip: A dome of iron and hardened pulp contains its own source of illumination.
Items.[\"Minstrel's Token\", \"part\", \"Descr: An old and platinum shekel has been incised with an image of the Very Old Bird.
Items.[\"Mirrorshades\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Light flecks break themselves on the silver moat and rush back to their place of origin. The signifier becomes the signified; the simulacrum is realized.
Items.[\"Missile Launcher\", \"part\", \"Descr: Grease wets the arming handle and streaks down the wide missile chute toward a welded shoulder rest.
Items.[\"ModuloMoonStair\", \"part\", \"Render: {{W|Modulo Moon Stair and the Tree of Life}}
Items.[\"Moldering Corpse\", \"part\", \"Descr: Here lies a humanoid who'd have never guessed their torso would shelter dust from the gills of tiny mushrooms, but should have.
Items.[\"Molly Netting\", \"part\", \"Descript: An old ropeworking ritual was used to weave a back-worn net of fibrous and supportive straps.
Items.[\"Mortar Tube\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Caked gundust is painted on the inner lune of the mortar.
Items.[\"MotorizedTreads\", \"part\", \"Cybern:
+150 movespeed
+4 to saves vs. forced movement, knockdown, and being restrained
You cannot wear shoes.
This implant can't be uninstalled.
Items.[\"MotorizedTreads\", \"part\", \"Descri: Triangular treads swathe the teeth of giant gears that turn to locomote. Their human has escaped the confines of bipedal motion.
Items.[\"MumblesInfection\", \"part\", \"Descr: Dozens of tiny mouths tessellate the infected skin, their moist lips pursing in asynchronicity and panting out prattle. Every so often, the cacophony harmonizes into sensible speech.
Items.[\"MurmurMask\", \"part\", \"Description: Once-familiar paper, paint, and beads are rearranged to a beastly shape. Pale lights of Spindle color gleam in the eye sockets, and a wicked beak opens in menacing stillness. Across the visage brass chains fasten the pieces of torn innocence that craft the Murmur.
Items.[\"MurmursPrayer\", \"part\", \"Descript: This large-print volume is made of hand-pulped and pressed brinestalk paper. Its cover preserved with resin.
Items.[\"Musket\", \"part\", \"Description\",: A smoothbore barrel of found steel is blackened by pocks of gunpowder mess.
Items.[\"Nacham's Ribbon\", \"part\", \"Descri: A curtain of thrumming cables make a mantle for hunched shoulders. They pitch at neuronal frequencies long dormant.
Items.[\"Nacham's Ribbon\", \"part\", \"Toolbo: When powered, this item grants a 40% chance that a tinkered item will have a random item modification. This may include item modifications that aren't normally tinkerable.
Items.[\"Nanopneumatic Jackhammer\", \"part\",: A pneumatic tube is driven under a ratchet and through a giant drill head. Crenulated air pockets allow for vibrative absorption to create a cascade of pressure, while stabilizing backstraps protect the wielder's contact points from unsafe joggling.
Items.[\"Nanoweave Vest\", \"part\", \"Descrip: The manifold fibers are colorful and have a touching texture like no other fabric. A molecular weft was pulled through shrinking warps on a fractal loom.
Items.[\"NavigationSystem\", \"part\", \"Cyber:
Your chance of becoming lost in ruins is reduced by 30%.
Your chance of becoming lost in other terrain is reduced by 10%.
These effects do not stack with the bonuses of a compass bracelet.
Items.[\"NavigationSystem\", \"part\", \"Descr: Geosocial location data is painted across the glass lune and is underlaid with representations of the living loam that has shifted over earth to take its place.
Items.[\"NectarTonic\", \"part\", \"RulesDescr: You gain either a permanent +1 bonus to a random attribute or one mutation point.
Items.[\"Neuro Animator\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Spurred on by their aspiration for a fully autonomous, climate-controlled banana grove, Research and Development at Hegemonic Fruit devised the neuro animator, which knits a nervous system into the inorganic material of inanimate objects. Originally, full sentience was their product differentiator, but within months cheaper alternates like Spray-a-Brain came to dominate the market.
Items.[\"Night-Sight Interpolators\", \"part\": Ring-molds on the laminated metal frame collect ambient sensory data and use it to augment the viewing frustum.

Grants night vision.
You can see two spaces beyond the first occluding object in your line of sight.
Items.[\"Night-vision Goggles\", \"part\", \"D: Focus-ringed binoculars read the tells of infrared light and produce a textured picture of eye-warm greens.
Items.[\"NightVision\", \"part\", \"Cybernetic: You gain the ability to see in the dark.
Items.[\"NightVision\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Nerve-packed retina scatters incoming radiation and bends light so the irises turn jade.
Items.[\"Ninefold Boots\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Calligraphs are incised in uneven rows and columns that meander across the quarter and back stay of the boot. Their character mass appears to orbit a central statement: "The path is contracted." The rest of the script is etched in a variety of signs and styles that offer competing and composite interpretations of the cryptic proclamation.
Items.[\"NocturnalApex\", \"part\", \"Cybernet:
+10% to natural healing rate during the day.
Once per night, you can Prowl, gaining +6 agility and +10 movespeed for 100 rounds.
Items.[\"NocturnalApex\", \"part\", \"Descript: The metabolic rhythms of the Holy City's denizens are synchronized to their diurnal rituals: during the day, repose in prayer beneath the shade of a fluted ziggurat; during the night, prowl the toxic arboreta for sacrifices.
Items.[\"Normality Gas Pump\", \"part\", \"Des: It's a hermetic cask, hose, and nozzle. Inscribed are the words: 'in case of dimensional emergency, spray'.
Items.[\"NormalityGasGrenade1\", \"part\", \"D: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. The shell is etched with latticework.
Items.[\"NormalityGasGrenade2\", \"part\", \"D: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. The shell is etched with latticework.
Items.[\"NormalityGasGrenade3\", \"part\", \"D: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. The shell is etched with latticework.
Items.[\"Nuclear Cell\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Million-year-old earth rock decays inside the battery box, where the pinged out gamma particles are routed through a junction diode and stored for explosive power use.
Items.[\"Nullray Pistol\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Starless metal on the barrel imbibes light and routes it to the null place. The grip acrylic is patterned after ley lines.
Items.[\"Nylon Bodypack\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Hair of unknown origin sticks to the diamond pattern on nylon hip and shoulder straps. Zippered and buttoned pouches allow for the lugging of all the underearth tools one needs.
Items.[\"Obsidian Kris\", \"part\", \"Descript: Volcanic glass was fished from Fuming God Sea and chipped to shape along the Icepyres.
Items.[\"Ogre Ape Pelt\", \"part\", \"Descript: A mat of coarse and golden hair is splattered with blood in two shades.
Items.[\"Ogre Fur Cloak\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Coarse fur is cut from the thickset pelt of an ogre ape into a broad-shouldered cloak.
Items.[\"Ogre Fur Gloves\", \"part\", \"Descri: Coarse fur is cut from the thickset pelt of an ogre ape into wide-fingered gloves, and giant knuckles sawed to points stick through.
Items.[\"Ogre Fur Hat\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Coarse fur is cut from the thickset pelt of an ogre ape into a tam with earflaps.
Items.[\"Oilskin\", \"part\", \"Description\",: A goat's bladder is knotted at the bottom and suspended by a strap of intestine.
Items.[\"OnHumanMimicry\", \"part\", \"Render\: {{W|On Humanoid Mimicry of Animals and Plants}}
Items.[\"OnboardRecoiler\", \"part\", \"Cybern: You can imprint this implant with a location (cooldown 100) and recoil back to it (cooldown 50).
Items.[\"OnboardRecoiler\", \"part\", \"Descri: A geospatial core is fitted with a bionic tether.
Items.[\"Ontological Anchor\", \"part\", \"Des: Plutonic metal is etched with a two-dimensional projection of the rhombic dodecahedral honeycomb, allowing it to snap onto the ley lines of the local region.
Items.[\"Opal-Pommeled Steel Axe\", \"part\",: Its polished steel glistens on a flat plane, and skin oil stains the straps of its leathery haft. The pommel is capped with a glittering opal.
Items.[\"OpticalMultiscanner\", \"part\", \"Cy:
You gain access to the precise hit point, armor, and dodge values of robotic creatures, biological creatures, and structures.
You automatically identify artifacts.
Staircases and other up/down map transitions are always revealed to you.
Items.[\"OpticalMultiscanner\", \"part\", \"De: A minuscule graphene array that processes optical data against the final ontological and phenomenological ledger.
Items.[\"Otherpearl\", \"part\", \"Description: All-color nacre is hardened into an ontologically perfect shape; the mathematics of spheres are mere approximations. Inside, ribboned patterns of aether are frozen in stasis and cohere as a moonlit vista, a scene somehow tethered to the spacetime point whence you observed it. The meaning of this pairing is unknown and unknowable.
Items.[\"Otherpearl\", \"part\", \"RulesDescri:
+40 psychic glimmer
Objects you find are five times more likely to come from other dimensions.
Items.[\"Otherpearl\", \"part\", \"TakenAccomp: In the month =month= of =year=, a corrupt administrator was appointed minister of a gleaming city with streets of gold and glass. =spice:pronouns.subject.!random|capitalize= outlawed the practice of composing elegies, and =name= was forced to flee.
O! Our hearts turned to stellar remnants when =name= recited an elegy for the unknown girlchild Eudoxia!
You clutched =this.refname= and dressed yourself in the mirror of realities.
Items.[\"Palladium Mesh Tabard\", \"part\", \": Electrodes shine on the lattice across the uuflax weave. Sleeves, widened in fashion, display the gold and cyan heraldic circuitry.
Items.[\"PalladiumElectrodeposits\", \"part\",:
Provides 20 units of compute power on the local lattice.
+2 Intelligence if implanted in a head.
Ionic dust dissolved from palladium facilitates the transfer of computing current.
Items.[\"Panther's Cloak\", \"part\", \"Descri: There is spotted dazzle on the cut hide that brings its bounded strider to pantherine selfhood.
Items.[\"ParabolicMuscularSubroutine\", \"part:
Your throw range is increased by 2.
When you throw something at a target inside your throw range, your throwing accuracy is 100%.
Nerve bundles so arranged to stimulate muscles in the arm along a parabolic slide rule.
Items.[\"Patchwork Coat\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Fabrics from across the plateau -- quilted eiderdown, weave-of-brinestalk, sticky elastyne -- have been dyed and sewn to a jacket of colored chaos.
Items.[\"PaxInfection\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Tapered lobes of cross-dimensional fungus flesh tap a center growth to the sequence of the prime numbers. Inside, sporelife readies for puffing.
Items.[\"PenetratingRadar\", \"part\", \"Cyber: You gain total visibility in a radius of 10 spaces around you, blocked only by force fields and spacetime anomalies.
Items.[\"PenetratingRadar\", \"part\", \"Descr: Picophase transceiver arrays assemble an exquisitely detailed model of one's surroundings.
Items.[\"Pentaceps\", \"part\", \"CyberneticsB: Your Charge range is increased by 4 spaces.
Items.[\"Pentaceps\", \"part\", \"Description\: The quartet of knee joint extensors gain the assistance of a synthetic fifth.
Items.[\"Pestle\", \"part\", \"Description\",: A bulb of stone is dusted by humoric powders.
Items.[\"Phase Cannon\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Astragals demarcate the phasic slits along the frustum's length. Noise is sucked out of time in expectancy of cross-plane fusion.
Items.[\"Phase-Adaptive Scope\", \"part\", \"C: When you fire a missile weapon or throw something, your projectile shifts phase to pass through obstacles and reach your target.
Items.[\"Phase-Adaptive Scope\", \"part\", \"D: A small lune of tetraxenonoglass is curved at Q radius to account for interdimensional parallax.
Items.[\"PhaseGrenade1\", \"part\", \"Descript: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It shifts perspective in low light.
Items.[\"PhaseHarmonicModulator\", \"part\", \: You can interact with both in-phase and out-of-phase objects and creatures.
Inverted tops balance the microstructure of a control unit housed in a bionic disk. Inside, the phases of reality are overlayed and projected outward.
Items.[\"Phial\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: A short channel of glass for keeping precious liquids glints when turned.
Items.[\"Pickaxe\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Its head is a shard of grinded metal, pointed on one end and flat on the other. Dust is stuck in its hairline nicks and shines across the opalescent spectrum of rock possibility.
Items.[\"PlantFace\", \"part\", \"EatenAccompl: On =day= of =month=, at a tavern near =landmark.nearest=, =name= met with a group of kippers and, divinely inspired by =spice:elements.entity@elements[random].practices.!random=, cooked and feasted on =this.refname=.
Woe to the vanquished! =name= feasted on =this.an= by the light of the Beetle Moon.
Items.[\"PlasmaGrenade1\", \"part\", \"Descrip: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It sizzles and swells inside.
Items.[\"PlasmaGrenade2\", \"part\", \"Descrip: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. It sizzles and swells inside.
Items.[\"PlasmaGrenade3\", \"part\", \"Descrip: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It sizzles and swells inside.
Items.[\"PlasticTree\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Fronds are splayed out in a waxy imitation of life. It looks hard and greasy up close, but as you back away its edges burn into softness and it performs the tree function.
Items.[\"Plastifer Bonnet\", \"part\", \"Descr: A hood of gas-caught foam stiffens instantaneously when pressure is applied. Its karst surface is dusted with the colorful abrasions of chiliads and the chemical reactions they produce; the material has careened past the outer rings of its expected lifetime and into the unknowing void.
Items.[\"Plastifer Chem Vest\", \"part\", \"De: A cuirass of gas-caught foam stiffens instantaneously when pressure is applied. Its karst surface is arrayed with tube sleeves and dusted with the colorful abrasions of chiliads and the chemical reactions they produce; the material has careened past the outer rings of its expected lifetime and into the unknowing void.
Items.[\"Plastifer Chem Vest\", \"part\", \"Re: in the energy cost to apply an injector
Items.[\"Plastifer Gloves\", \"part\", \"Descr: Gloves of gas-caught foam stiffen instantaneously when pressure is applied. Their karst surfaces are dusted with the colorful abrasions of chiliads and the chemical reactions they produce; their material has careened past the outer rings of its expected lifetime and into the unknowing void.
Items.[\"Plastifer Jerkin\", \"part\", \"Descr: A cuirass of gas-caught foam stiffens instantaneously when pressure is applied. Its karst surface is dusted with the colorful abrasions of chiliads and the chemical reactions they produce; the material has careened past the outer rings of its expected lifetime and into the unknowing void.
Items.[\"Plastifer Sneakers\", \"part\", \"Des: A pair gas-caught foam sneaks stiffen instantaneously when pressure is applied. Their karst surfaces are dusted with the colorful abrasions of chiliads and the chemical reactions they produce; the material has careened past the outer rings of its expected lifetime and into the unknowing void.
Items.[\"PneumaticPistons\", \"part\", \"Cyber: Your Jump range is increased by 4 spaces.
Items.[\"PneumaticPistons\", \"part\", \"Descr: Compressed gas drives piston rods into musculature powdered with graphite dust and sends the jumper soaring.
Items.[\"Pocketed Vest\", \"part\", \"Descript: A scratchy kirtle was taken to a pocket seamstress and accoutered for cave delving and trinket fishing.
Items.[\"Point-Defense Drone\", \"part\", \"De: It's a robotic eye lidded by a furcate chassis and embellished with antenna lashes. A minuscule barrel pokes out from its pupil and vibrates. The inner lid is articulated, allowing the drone to scan for incoming projectiles and shoot them down with laser light.
Items.[\"PoisonGasGrenade1\", \"part\", \"Desc: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with the crossbones of danger.
Items.[\"PoisonGasGrenade2\", \"part\", \"Desc: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. It's etched with the crossbones of danger.
Items.[\"PoisonGasGrenade3\", \"part\", \"Desc: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. It's etched with the crossbones of danger.
Items.[\"Polished Agate\", \"part\", \"Descrip: The shadows of tiny nebulae are crushed into the contours of a small stone. All its rough edges have been polished to shine.
Items.[\"Polished Amethyst\", \"part\", \"Desc: It spent millions of years tucked into the folds of earthly sediment. Then it was cracked from its cocoon, a brilliant butterfly. All its rough edges have been polished to shine.
Items.[\"Polished Emerald\", \"part\", \"Descr: Impurities in the stone mother verdant things, the pattern of life repeated on a smaller scale. It's rough edges have been polished to shine.
Items.[\"Polished Jasper\", \"part\", \"Descri: The black bellows of the earth are etched into a red egg. All its rough edges have been polished to shine.
Items.[\"Polished Peridot\", \"part\", \"Descr: It hurled through the void impacted in a black rock and slammed, shining and free, on our world. All its rough edges have been polished to shine.
Items.[\"Polished Sapphire\", \"part\", \"Desc: Oceans reflecting the skies of a thousand fractal worlds are tucked into a geometric volume. All its rough edges have been polished to shine.
Items.[\"Polished Topaz\", \"part\", \"Descrip: A thousand sunrays are refracted through the prism of a small stone. All its rough edges have been polished to shine.
Items.[\"Polyhedral Rings\", \"part\", \"Descr: The hoops sport rhombic facets that reflect light at wavelengths between plum and quartz.
Items.[\"Portable Beehive\", \"part\", \"Descr: Bees crawl over the back-mounted slatted rack. A few more dart around nearby.
Items.[\"Portable Wall\", \"part\", \"Descript: Tiny glyphs are inscribed on each exterior face of the handheld box. Though contrarians still puzzle over their meaning, most of Qud's prominent linguist cults have converged on a single interpretation: 'For When Both Nature and Architects Have Failed You'. One brass pull ring separates you from the promise of those words.
Items.[\"Praetorian's Cloak\", \"part\", \"Des: A thousand-thread coverture is given its candescent hue by the bluing ore and the harsh light of the Great Desert's foreign and eastern shelf.
Items.[\"Prayer Rod\", \"part\", \"Description: A long slate rod flares out at the collar to hold capacitors and an electrified corm for searing liturgy to memory.
Items.[\"Precinct Navigator\", \"part\", \"Des: Gridlines and a red dot are painted on the glass lune, and simple rectangles depict the once-ordered streets of chromium that've since burst like gnarled roots through space and time.
Items.[\"Precision Nanon Fingers\", \"part\",: Fullerene finger extensors splay like fashionable court nails. Their girths are shrunk or unshrunk to task requirements by minuscule servos embedded in the webbing.
Your weapons' percentage-based effects are 3X as likely to occur, including the base chance for critical hits.
Items.[\"PrecisionForceLathe\", \"part\", \"Cy:
You fabricate force knives in unoccupied hand or thrown weapon slots.
If you throw a force knife, another one immediately materializes in your thrown weapon slot.
Force knives deal 1d8 damage, have penetration value equal to their target's armor value, and have +6 throwing range.
Force knives disappear after losing contact with you or becoming unequipped.
If you have a force modulator implant installed, force knives can be thrown through forcefields.
Items.[\"PrecisionForceLathe\", \"part\", \"De: A magnetically-shielded headstock holds space in kinetic suspension while a force spindle spins and sharpens it to a point.
Items.[\"Psychal Fleshgun\", \"part\", \"Descr: Raw flesh is stretched on a lump that approximates the shape of a handgun. Pressure smushes a throbbing vein against the underskin and blood-pulp is coughed out of two ribbed metal tubes on a metronome tick. At moments out of sequence, an unseen energy is piped along the psychic leys and into the organ-mess, producing a runny bother.
Items.[\"Psychic Meridian\", \"part\", \"Descr: Airy thoughtstuff was deposited by the pressure of the material realm into a jellified substance and curled into a cirlet. It's bejeweled with crystalline microlife, symbiotes hatched in the thick of the psychic sea.
Items.[\"Psychic Meridian\", \"part\", \"Rules: Failed psychic attacks against you cause the attacker to hemorrhage.
Items.[\"Psychodyne Helmet\", \"part\", \"Desc: Tetraxenonoglass blueshifts light hitting the outer shell. On the inner side, electromagnets excite a lining of star mollusk tissue to create the perfect psychic accoustics.
Items.[\"PuffInfection\", \"part\", \"Descript: Tiny spore-motes flutter down from the fleshy gills that twitch on the striated skin. Trapped inside are another thousand spores waiting to be jostled free.
Items.[\"Puma Chitin Vest\", \"part\", \"Descr: A vest of mingled fungusfill cut from the molt of a chitinous jungle cat has been painted and glazed lucid.
Items.[\"Pump Shotgun\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A nutwood forestock hangs underneath the chrome rib and, when pumped, erupts into ecstatic clicking.
Items.[\"Quantum Mote\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Particles blip off a probabilistic core and appear traced across discrete shells of energy.
Items.[\"Quartzfur Cloak\", \"part\", \"Descri: Prism-studded skin was shorn from a dead monkey and sawed into a cloak.
Items.[\"Quartzfur Gloves\", \"part\", \"Descr: Prism-studded skin was shorn from a dead monkey and sawed into a pair of gloves.
Items.[\"Quartzfur Hat\", \"part\", \"Descript: Prism-studded skin was shorn from a dead monkey and sawed into a hat.
Items.[\"Quills\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Hundreds and hundreds of fossilized hairs crown the body in a protective coat.
Items.[\"Quilted Shawl\", \"part\", \"Descript: Wool of many colors was horse-bought from the dromads and sourced beyond the Pale Sea and its great pan of salt. Once the Issachar spun it to yarn on the wheel, a marsh dweller hand-knotted the tzitzit.
Items.[\"Rainboweave Cloak\", \"part\", \"Desc: Points of discontiguous matter flock in a crescent to a mock wind. Together they bend light across its full spectrum and blur the wearer's torso to a polychrome mess.

Items.[\"RapidReleaseFingerFlexors\", \"part\": Neuronically charged tissue sheaths transmit the will faster than what cell biology had achieved.
Items.[\"ReactiveCranialPlating\", \"part\", \: You cannot be dazed or stunned by kinetic effects.
Carbide plates are molded to skull shape and alloyed with foam that inflates on impact.
Items.[\"ReactiveTraumaPlate\", \"part\", \"Cy: Neutralizes one damage source that would cause a lethal amount of damage or deal at least 50% of your max HP. This implant is destroyed in the process.
Items.[\"ReactiveTraumaPlate\", \"part\", \"De: A contoured, plasteel body-plate absorbs impact shock and disintegrates into the bloodstream.

=subject.Name's= =object.name= =object.verb:burst= outward, destroying =objpronouns.reflexive= to prevent catastrophic damage.
Items.[\"Recycling Suit\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Rubber tubes worm their way through salvaged elastyne filted with filters to recover wastewater from the overworked body.
Items.[\"RelicBook\", \"part\", \"Description\: Light catches on four opaline corner pieces and a raised medallion set in the center of tessellated uuflax. Wonders are woven across the cyclopean tome.
Items.[\"RelicTonic\", \"part\", \"Description: A tube of tetraxenonoglass glass glitters inside with opaline syrup.
Items.[\"RelicTonic\", \"part\", \"RulesDescri: You gain either a permanent +2 bonus to a random attribute or two mutation points.
Items.[\"Repulsive Device\", \"part\", \"Descr: Though it is approximately the size and heft of a human infant, this shiny black device's shape is more akin to a fetus torn early from the womb. Its surface is slick and warm, with a pale pulse breathing somewhere underneath its pitch-black skin. At the end of its tail is an orifice studded with hooked teeth, eternally questing for an anchor point that it never finds.
Items.[\"Rhinox-Skull Maul\", \"part\", \"Desc: Thick and diamond-hard headbone with three horn holes functions as the jumbo head of a bludgeon. A long shaft of shining steel was driven through the maw and welded inside.
Items.[\"Ring Mail\", \"part\", \"Description\: A leather shirt is mantled with sewn-in loops of steel.
Items.[\"Rocket Skates\", \"part\", \"Descript: The finned and wheeled boot had become the sigil of several sects of socionauts by the Late Sultanate. For decades their progenitors careened through the capsule pipelines of the slouching arcology, dismantling it plate by plate, pursued by the constabulary but ferried by their skates to the safety of their moss-skirted hideouts. The metaphor was writ large on the glass guts of the city: Scorch the past. Rocket into the future.
Items.[\"Rough Agate\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: The shadows of tiny nebulae are crushed into the contours of a small stone.
Items.[\"Rough Amethyst\", \"part\", \"Descrip: It spent millions of years tucked into the folds of earthly sediment. Then it was cracked from its cocoon, a brilliant butterfly.
Items.[\"Rough Emerald\", \"part\", \"Descript: Impurities in the stone mother verdant things, the pattern of life repeated on a smaller scale.
Items.[\"Rough Jasper\", \"part\", \"Descripti: The black bellows of the earth are etched into red polish.
Items.[\"Rough Peridot\", \"part\", \"Descript: It hurled through the void impacted in a black rock and slammed, shining and free, on our world.
Items.[\"Rough Sapphire\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Oceans reflecting the skies of a thousand fractal worlds are tucked into a geometric volume.
Items.[\"Rough Topaz\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: A thousand sunrays are refracted through the prism of a small stone.
Items.[\"Rubber Suit\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Blinding light shines off the slick and stretchy suit of vulcanized sap and creates a postpartum amniotic sac.

Items.[\"Ruin of House Isner\", \"part\", \"De: The craftsmanship of this pistol worked in brass and chrome is breathtaking: grips of kingswood call the palm to an airless wrap, the hammer is contoured to the thumb by the microinch, and the sight draws the eye down the barrel like the slipping of silk. The gunslinger-sultan =name= slew each of the seven lords of House Isner with a masterwork revolver and supped over their piled corpses.
You recovered the masterwork pistol and legendary ode to vengeance, the =this.refname=.
Items.[\"Sail from the Great Machine\", \"part: A blooming kitesail of extrasolar flax is knitted on battens to catch the poison air of some faraway swamp planetoid and power an ecumenical cycle. Its clews are stitched with syncretic plethora from across the dreaming gamut.

Items.[\"SalthopperMandible\", \"part\", \"Des: A saw-toothed bladestick of bleached chitin is still stuck to by the gore bits of a dead salthopper's last meal.

Items.[\"Sandals of the River-Wives\", \"part\: A canyon pearl fastens sandal straps embroidered in the syncretic imagery of swiftwater nymphs. Like the glacier flow itself, the veneration of Calypso moved with the mystai down the sundered honeycomb and in through the shale fissures beneath the olive mount. There it fractured into the mysteries of the many-named wives, where the memory of freshwater became more faceted than its smooth surface of origin.
Items.[\"Sandals\", \"part\", \"Description\",: A pair of strapped shoes are cracked on the soles in sinelike patterns of gravel walking.
Items.[\"Scaled Reptile Corpse\", \"part\", \": Broken scales lay in flat tessellation.

Items.[\"Scarlet Shawl\", \"part\", \"Descript: A silk shoulder drape has been cut and dyed with crushed insects shaved from an oak from the Bowl of Iris.

Items.[\"Scrapped Waydroid\", \"part\", \"Desc: Here lies the metallic husk of a defunct waydroid. It's been stripped of its valuables: copper wire, LED lights, and chrome bearings. It beeps and whirs no longer.

Items.[\"Shayna\", \"part\", \"Description\",: What was once merely a carbide axe is now a florid work of art. Curling wires wind around the haft of the weapon as the creeping vine of a rose plant; modules and battery housing are mounted on the flat of its blade where the blossom might rest.

Items.[\"SkybearJetpack\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Two turrets of sun-conducting chrome cap cylinders of burning gas, which straddle a metal trellis of spades girding some sort of guild mark. A 6-helix of fume, signature of the star engine this flier is wrought through, twirls toward the sky.
Items.[\"SkybearJetpack\", \"part\", \"RulesDe:
You may activate this item to start dashing.

 For every three spaces you dash, you get +2 to hit and +2 to penetration rolls.
Items.[\"SkybearJetpack\", \"part\", \"TakenAc: Throughout all of =month=, =name= =spice:commonPhrases.ravaged.!random= the province of Bethesda Susa on =player.possessive= jetpack, =spice:elements.entity@elements[random].ravaging.!random= of =mostHatedFaction.t= and =secondMostHatedFaction.t=. =player.Subjective= became known as the Bethesda =spice:commonPhrases.scourge.!random|capitalize=.

The Sky-Bear flies anew! From the clutches of the frozen past, you recovered =this.refname=.
Items.[\"Slate Frock\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Linen was cut to body shape and put in a dye bath of dicalyptus leaves and iron shavings to achieve a chromish luster.
Items.[\"Slate Mantle\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Cloth was dyed in a bath of dicalyptus leaves and iron shavings to achieve a chromish luster and then tailored to a ruffled shoulder-skirt.

Items.[\"SlogTrophy\", \"part\", \"RulesDescri: You take half damage from poison.
Items.[\"Small Animal Corpse\", \"part\", \"De: A small mound of wet hair and rotting flesh puts a bump in the ground.
Items.[\"Small Sphere of Negative Weight\", \": A sphere of some black pyritic metal succumbs to the negative pressures of gravity and tries to fall upward.
Items.[\"Small Stone\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: A piece of rock was water-cleaved from its birthing bed and tumbled by time into a sphere.
Items.[\"SmallBoulder\", \"part\", \"Descripti: It's a piece of rock, older than every book.
Items.[\"Smiling Sun Mask\", \"part\", \"Descr: The sun beams on soapstone with cheeks made high and proud of ochre and teeth. The shadow of a noon canopy bespeaks a treeline thicker with leaflife than any on the plateau or at all north of Moghra'yi.
Items.[\"Snail Corpse\", \"part\", \"Descripti: An empty shell lies cracked across its spiral and tinctured in dried mucus.

Items.[\"Snakeskin Armlet\", \"part\", \"Descr: A slender cut of brass was forged in a serpentine crucible and painted with the vexing stripes of nature.
Items.[\"Sniper Rifle\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Expert rifling grooved its carbon steel barrel to helical precision. Smudges are printed on the scope glass.
Items.[\"SocialCoprocessor\", \"part\", \"Cybe:

Items.[\"SocialCoprocessor\", \"part\", \"Desc: Around a central processor, neural grafts attach to the brain lobes responsible for the feeling of social warmth.
Items.[\"Solar Cell\", \"part\", \"Description: The photovoltaic cube bakes with the warm of the High Salt Sun and stores it as quickened juice.
Items.[\"Sonnet\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Paper made of brinestalk pulp is covered in a shaky ink scrawl. It looks like it's been crumpled and uncrumpled many times.
Items.[\"Sooty Smock\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: An apron is pocked with carbon craters the color of the light-sucking void, a thing dreamed by sophists who watched the stars race toward their excluded middle.
Items.[\"Space Inverter\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Behind the muzzle, a glass-bound nimbus of unstable spacetime curls around an astral tether. The trigger mechanism cuts the tether and out-vacuums the anomaly to the free world.
Items.[\"Spaser Pistol\", \"part\", \"Descript: Hue-vapored crysteel cocoons the gold/water mechanism that pinches light from wavelength to waveshort.  Plasmon slag bubbles on the crest of the barrel like superheated sludge-life.

Items.[\"StorageTank\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Chrome was molded into a canister and fastened with a brass mounting bracket.
Items.[\"Strength Exo\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Slate tubes assemble to scaffold the human form.
Items.[\"Structural Scanning Bracelet\", \"par: On the wrist mount, echo-shaped models in three dimensions expose the structural irregularities of simple inanimate objects nearby.
Items.[\"Studded Leather Armor\", \"part\", \": Ancient and inscrutable pegs of chrome fished from the trash sea stud thick wedges of boiled goat leather.
Items.[\"Stun Rod\", \"part\", \"Description\": A long slate rod flares out at the collar to hold capacitors and a concussive corm.
Items.[\"Stun Whip\", \"part\", \"Description\: A thong of banded metal jitters with concussive potential. The plastifer handle is slotted on the heel knot with an battery case.
Items.[\"StunGasGrenade1\", \"part\", \"Descri: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. Its cap is lined with sharp edges.
Items.[\"StunGasGrenade2\", \"part\", \"Descri: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. Its cap is lined with sharp edges.
Items.[\"StunGasGrenade3\", \"part\", \"Descri: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. Its cap is lined with sharp edges.
Items.[\"Sun and Moon Mask\", \"part\", \"Desc: Hot fire on soapstone bleeds into damp night at a twilight terminus drawn in blood. The mask wearer assumes this and all dualities.
Items.[\"Swarm Rack\", \"part\", \"Description: A chrome and quartz-dusted honeycomb mounts the viewing plane and threatens obliteration to all. Bar weldings bend to its gigantic weight, and rocketheads peak out of hexagonal hive.
Items.[\"Symbiotic Firefly\", \"part\", \"Desc: A mote of gentle light darts about in the patterns of life.
Items.[\"Symbiotic Firefly\", \"part\", \"Rule:
Emits light in radius 4.
Extinguished permanently when unequipped.
Items.[\"Syphon Baton\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Ring magnets form a cylindric mace-head to bash against objects and syphon their electron juice into a battery slotted on the shaft.
Items.[\"TarBones\", \"part\", \"Description\": Tissue was mineralized while it grew and then snapped off the tree of living things to become an artifact of life. It was then stewed in burnt peat and turned to a hard goo.
Items.[\"TarBones\", \"part\", \"Food\", \"Mes: Far too gooey for your taste.
Items.[\"Tattoo Gun\", \"part\", \"Description: Ink is jetted into and under the skin canvas by a needle and rotary motor.
Items.[\"TauChime\", \"part\", \"Description\": Sharp points are run through with bright and brilliant amethyst and sapphire. The colors remain but smolder to heather in their dying light. The chime is grave-still.
Items.[\"TauDagger\", \"part\", \"Description\: Broken crystal narrows to a hateful razor at the shard seams. It cracked at the resonance curvature of anguish, and fell out of its host rock as a shattered promise.
Items.[\"TauHeadpiece\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Byzantine purple smolders at a medium hue on the sharp and linked prisms of the crystal. It hums with new life and ingenuity.
Items.[\"TauHeadpiece\", \"part\", \"RulesDesc: Grants you Quicken Mind: refresh a random cooldown on use.
Items.[\"TechnologicalIndexer\", \"part\", \"C: You gain access to the precise hit point, armor, and dodge values of robotic creatures and you automatically identify artifacts.
Items.[\"TechnologicalIndexer\", \"part\", \"D: A minuscule graphene array that processes optical data against a repository of robotic lifeforms and artifacts.
Items.[\"Telemetric Visor\", \"part\", \"Descr: The glass lune is showered in information across the electromagnetic channels.
Items.[\"Telescopic Monocle\", \"part\", \"Des: Curved glass caps the narrowest in a series of concentric brass tubes. The widest one is fitted with a leather head-strap.
Items.[\"Telescopic Monocle\", \"part\", \"Too: Grants a bonus to identifying artifacts as if your Intelligence score were increased by 5.
Items.[\"TemplarPhylactery\", \"part\", \"Desc: An wood-carved jewel box opens to a photographic plate and light beamer. Slit in the crystal around the edge is a verse chosen from the rhombic torah.
Items.[\"The Earth Face\", \"part\", \"Descrip: On the countenance, ribbons of alabaster cloud circumscribe a lapis sea and forests of jade. At the median of it all, a Spindle pierces the outer rondure and disappears beyond the composition. A second obstructed spire, what must be the Spindle's shadow, soaks up the light thrown off by the southern sky of crystal white. The inside of the mask is ribboned with burnt tracery from where it was molded on a gallium lathe, then dyed with the milked irises of shedim and set to dry in a pool of warm static.
Items.[\"The Kesil Face\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Shining jewels are scattered across the contours of a galactic visage, and edges drawn between them sketch the outline of a sashed Fool. Far away at the chrome crest, beads of bright and searing light suggest the shape of a medial ewer, and beyond its spout, a vast and timeful structure. The inside of the mask is ribboned with burnt tracery from where it was molded on a gallium lathe, then dyed with the milked irises of shedim and set to dry in a pool of warm static.
Items.[\"The Kesil Face\", \"part\", \"RulesDe:
+1 to all mutation levels
+6 to cybernetics license tier
Items.[\"The Levant Face\", \"part\", \"Descri: Jasper rocks break on the edges of the mask and hem in a pale sea of milky quartz. The Spindle bisects the wide Face, and symmetry blooms beneath it. The inside of the mask is ribboned with burnt tracery from where it was molded on a gallium lathe, then dyed with the milked irises of shedim and set to dry in a pool of warm static.
Items.[\"The Nil Face\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A bowed lune is cracked from where it was smashed off the gallium lathe. The shedim had no eyes left to color the dim and final Face, and it lay too long discarded in a pool of warm static. The sultanate is broken.
Items.[\"The Olive Face\", \"part\", \"Descrip: A single mount of inlaid basalt and malachite splays open; an image of the Spindle blossoms from its center and dominates the festooned aspect. The inside of the mask is ribboned with burnt tracery from where it was molded on a gallium lathe, then dyed with the milked irises of shedim and set to dry in a pool of warm static.
Items.[\"The Shemesh Face\", \"part\", \"Descr: Burning rubies, carnelians, and garnets are arranged as a warm and giving sun. Diminutive rocky orbs pass by in the near space of the visage, and in the far space a prism of freight lengthens into a wider void. The inside of the mask is ribboned with burnt tracery from where it was molded on a gallium lathe, then dyed with the milked irises of shedim and set to dry in a pool of warm static.
Items.[\"Thermo Cask\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Tetraglass tubes of coolant and antifreeze snake their way over the keg-mail's compressors, and condenser and evaporator coils spin out the shoulders like grandfather trees above the insulation shrub.
Items.[\"Thermoelectric Cell\", \"part\", \"De: Inside the insulated cask of the battery, the electromotive apparatus cracks the energy out of lava and converts it to electrical charge.
Items.[\"ThrowingAxe\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: A salt-scratched blade head is fit to a splintered handle with a wood wedge.
Items.[\"TibularHydrojets\", \"part\", \"Descr: Planate chutes conduct the myoelectric force and push the body through water.
Items.[\"TimeDilationGrenade1\", \"part\", \"D: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. Its lug is ringed with dial ticks.
Items.[\"TimeDilationGrenade2\", \"part\", \"D: A metal shoal of waffled hexagons is clamped by a chrome lever. Its lug is ringed with dial ticks.
Items.[\"TimeDilationGrenade3\", \"part\", \"D: A thick metal jacket encases the explosive and is clamped to a quick-release lever. Its lug is ringed with dial ticks.
Items.[\"Timecube\", \"part\", \"Description\": A cube with a mere four corners. Facet pictographs for sun-up, mid-day, sun-down, and mid-night insist on a new division of days. It's carved with fanciful depictions of broken clocks.
Items.[\"Tonic\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: A glass tube and hype needle deliver a tonic directly to the bloodstream.
Items.[\"Torch\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: A length of brinestalk is wrapped in oil-sodden cloth.
Items.[\"TornGraphPaper\", \"part\", \"Descrip: A sheet of loose leaf is divided by coordinate lines in cyan. It seems to have been torn from a binder.
Items.[\"Transkinetic Cuffs\", \"part\", \"Des: A dial clicks at right intervals on the metal wrist, and mercurial silver courses through tubework along the plastifer sleeve.
Items.[\"TranslucentSkin\", \"part\", \"Descri: The diaphanous dermis throws the circulatory, muscular, and nervous networks into silhouetted relief.
Items.[\"TransparentSkin\", \"part\", \"Descri: The new flesh is as ghost film, cloaking none of the machinery of life.
Items.[\"Tread Guard\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Metal frames are mounted on treads to protect against wheel-cramming detritus.
Items.[\"TreeSkillsoft\", \"part\", \"Cybernet: You gain access to a whole skill tree.
Items.[\"TreeSkillsoft\", \"part\", \"Descript: Encoded on this chip are the neural patterns of a particular skill tree.
Items.[\"Tri-Hologram Bracelet\", \"part\", \": Bars partition the bangle clasp into three bands; a cobalt button summons the rest of the quartet.
Items.[\"Turbow\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Servos click on the wheeling groves and a miniature air turbine exaggerates the pull of the bowstring.
Items.[\"Turbow\", \"part\", \"RulesDescriptio:
This weapon increases the base penetration of its ammo by 4.

Items.[\"Two-Handed Sword\", \"part\", \"Descr: Scratches checker the broad length of edged bell bronze, and skin oil dampens the double-handed leather grip.

Items.[\"UltraElasticAnkleTendons\", \"part\",: Neutrafoam ropes are banded and bundled into a fluted column.
Items.[\"Umber Frock\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Rough and itchy flax was coarsely threaded, cut to shape, and cinched by a hemp rope.
