Items.[\"Vine-Weave Tunic\", \"part\", \"Descr: The reedy guts of an ivy tangle were ripped out, laced, and gilded with an embroidered sash.
Items.[\"Vinewood Sap Mask\", \"part\", \"Desc: A folded triangle pouch of burlap was impregnated with vinewood sap to absorb noxious vapor.
Items.[\"Walking Stick\", \"part\", \"Descript: Brinestalk was scythed from its marsh home and dried in the high salt sun. Its top is spiraled into a crook.
Items.[\"Warhammer2\", \"part\", \"Description: Iron lines unfold into a head of six flanges.
Items.[\"Waterskin\", \"part\", \"Description\: A goat's bladder is knotted at the bottom and suspended by a strap of intestine.
Items.[\"Wax Nodule\", \"part\", \"Description: It's a volume of waxstuff, secreted by plants and cooled into a block.
Items.[\"WaxInfection\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A wax-weeping fungus has encased the appendage in a lucent cast. Body heat melts the innermost layer, and a thick, waxy milk sloshes against its hardened prison.
Items.[\"Wide-brimmed Hat\", \"part\", \"Descr: The crown is crushed by wear into a hundred papery creases, and the brim is stained in the fractal signatures of sweat and salt.
Items.[\"Winged Arthropod Corpse\", \"part\",: Its torso is downside up and sprouts a bouquet of crumpled legs. The whole thing is wrapped in filmy wing-shroud.
Items.[\"Wings\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: Wide airfoil fin-flaps beat at the wind.
Items.[\"Wire Strand\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: A cord extruded from metal ore conducts current when laid together.
Items.[\"Witchwood Bark\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Lichen sticks in the winding grooves of woodshed, shimmering and smelling of spice.
Items.[\"Witchwood Bark\", \"part\", \"Food\",: A warm tingling washes over you.
Items.[\"Witchwood Wreath\", \"part\", \"Descr: Twigs from the witching tree are pared and twisted to a garland for hindsun.
Items.[\"Wooden Arrow\", \"part\", \"Descripti: A narrow shaft fletched with bird feather is capped by a wooden head.
Items.[\"Wooden Buckler\", \"part\", \"Descrip: A wheel of dogthorn cut with hill-clan sigilwork is secured to the arm by a leather strap.
Items.[\"Wool Kilt\", \"part\", \"Description\: Ropes of wool are woven in the angled bands of the tartan. They burnish in rich reds, greens, iron greys and sable.
Items.[\"Worm Corpse\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Rings of spongy wormbody are deflated and still. Little bristles scrape the earth.
Items.[\"Worn Burnoose\", \"part\", \"Descript: Coarse goat wool is dethreading from where brushes have combed out the salt and silicon.
Items.[\"Woven Tunic\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: A coarse flax waist is cinched with a watervine hemp rope.

Items.[\"Wrist Fan\", \"part\", \"Description\: Miniature airfoil blades spin on the circular face and blow gentle air.
Items.[\"Wristcalc\", \"part\", \"Description\: Diodes burn their cyan light through an atmosphere of glass curved around a metal link.

Items.[\"Yal\", \"part\", \"Description\", \"S: Half battle axe and half vinereaper, the ancestral tool called Yal evokes the struggle between the hindren cultivators and the cruelty of a harsh winter. A biting cold radiates off the curved blade.
Items.[\"Yeshyrskin Slippers\", \"part\", \"De: Silver wire cinches a feathery cut of skin from the ghostly yeshyr, hunted in the orchard ruins north of Odrum. They are fastened by a smoking pearl.

Small chance each round for another esper to steal your powers {{rules|Decreased chance for another esper to steal your powers}} -200 reputation with {{w|the Seekers of the Sightless Way}}
Mutations.[\"Mass Mind\", \"mutation\", \"Mass Min: those who tap the Mass Mind
Mutations.[\"Mental Mirror\", \"description\", \"\: You reflect mental attacks back at your attackers.
Mutations.[\"Mental Mirror\", \"leveltext\", \"\",: When you suffer a mental attack while Mental Mirror is off cooldown, you gain + mental armor (MA). If the attack then fails to penetrate your MA, it's reflected back at your attacker.
Mutations.[\"Metamorphosis\", \"description\", \"\: You assume the form of any creature you touch.
Mutations.[\"Metamorphosis\", \"leveltext\", \"\",: May only assume the form of creatures level or lower.
Mutations.[\"Multiple Arms\", \"description\", \"\: You have an extra set of arms.
Mutations.[\"Multiple Arms\", \"leveltext\", \"\",: % chance for each extra arm to deliver an additional melee attack whenever you make a melee attack
Mutations.[\"Multiple Legs\", \"description\", \"\: You have an extra set of legs.
Mutations.[\"Myopic\", \"description\", \"\", \"#t: You are nearsighted. You can only see up to a radius of 10.
Mutations.[\"Narcolepsy\", \"description\", \"\",: You fall asleep involuntarily from time to time. Small chance each round you're in combat that you fall asleep for 20-29 rounds.
Mutations.[\"Nerve Poppy\", \"description\", \"\",: You lack a developed sense of pain. You only know your general state of health and not your precise number of hit points.
Mutations.[\"Phasing\", \"description\", \"\", \"#: You may phase through solid objects for brief periods of time.
Mutations.[\"Photosynthetic Skin\", \"description\: You replenish yourself by absorbing sunlight through your hearty green skin.
Mutations.[\"Photosynthetic Skin\", \"leveltext\",: You can bask in the sunlight instead of eating a meal to gain a special metabolizing effect for : + to natural healing rate and + Quickness While in the sunlight, you accrue starch and lignin that you can use as ingredients in meals you cook (max of each). + DV while occupying the same space as foliage +200 reputation with {{w|roots}}, {{w|trees}}, {{w|vines}}, and {{w|the Consortium of Phyta}}
Mutations.[\"Precognition\", \"description\", \"\": You peer into your near future.
Mutations.[\"Precognition\", \"leveltext\", \"\",: You may activate this power and then later revert to the point in time when you activated it. Duration between use and reversion:
Mutations.[\"Psionic Migraines\", \"description\",: You suffer from powerful psionic migraines that render your head extremely sensitive. You can't wear hats or helmets.
Mutations.[\"Psionic Migraines\", \"mutation\", \": those who suffer from psionic migraines
Mutations.[\"Psychometry\", \"description\", \"\",: You read the history of artifacts by touching them, learning what they do and how they were made.
Mutations.[\"Psychometry\", \"leveltext\", \"\", \: Unerringly identify artifacts up to complexity tier . Learn how to construct identified artifacts up to complexity tier (must have the appropriate Tinker skill). You may open security doors and use some secure devices by touching them.
Mutations.[\"Pyrokinesis\", \"description\", \"\",: You heat a nearby area with your mind.
Mutations.[\"Pyrokinesis\", \"leveltext\", \"\", \: Toasts affected area over 3 rounds {{rules|Increased toast temperature intensity}} {{rules|Decreased toast temperature intensity}}
Mutations.[\"Quantum Jitters\", \"description\", \: Your willful acts sometimes dent spacetime. Whenever you use an activated ability, there's a small chance your focus slips and you dent spacetime in the local region, causing 1-2 spacetime vortices to appear. This chance increases the longer you go without using an activated ability.
Mutations.[\"Quills\", \"description\", \"\", \"#t: Hundreds of needle-pointed quills cover your body.
Mutations.[\"Quills\", \"leveltext\", \"\", \"#tex: +{{rules|80-120}} May expel 10% of your in a burst around yourself ( =pv= =damage= ) Regenerate at the approximate rate of per round + AV as long as you retain half your (+ AV otherwise) Creatures attacking you in melee may impale themselves on your , breaking roughly 1% of them and reflecting 3% damage per broken. Cannot wear body armor Immune to other creatures'
Mutations.[\"Regeneration\", \"leveltext\", \"\",: Your full natural healing rate applies in combat. + % faster natural healing rate % chance to regrow a missing limb each round {{rules|You cannot be decapitated.}} % chance to remove a {{rules|minor physical debuff}} at random each round % chance to remove a {{rules|physical debuff}} at random each round
Mutations.[\"Sense Psychic\", \"description\", \"\: You can sense other mental mutants through the psychic aether. You detect the presence of psychic enemies within a radius of . There's a chance you identify detected enemies.
Mutations.[\"Sleep Gas Generation\", \"description: You release a burst of around yourself.
Mutations.[\"Slime Glands\", \"description\", \"\": You produce a viscous slime that you can spit at things. Covers an area with slime You can walk over slime without slipping.
Mutations.[\"Socially Repugnant\", \"description\": Others find it difficult to tolerate you in social settings. -50 reputation with every faction
Mutations.[\"Spacetime Vortex\", \"description\",: You sunder spacetime, sending things nearby careening through a tear in the cosmic fabric.
Mutations.[\"Spacetime Vortex\", \"leveltext\", \": Summons a vortex that swallows everything in its path. You may enter the vortex to teleport to a random location in Qud. +200 reputation with {{w|highly entropic beings}}
Mutations.[\"Spinnerets\", \"description\", \"\",: You can spin sticky silk webs.
Mutations.[\"Spinnerets\", \"leveltext\", \"\", \": While spinning, you leave webs in your wake as you move. {{rules|Increased web strength}} You are immune to getting stuck. +300 reputation with {{w|arachnids}}
Mutations.[\"Spontaneous Combustion\", \"descripti: You spontaneously erupt into flames. Small chance each round you're in combat that you spontaneously erupt into flames.
Mutations.[\"Stinger (Confusing Venom)\", \"descri: You bear a tail with a stinger that delivers venom to your enemies.
Mutations.[\"Stinger (Confusing Venom)\", \"levelt: 20% chance on melee attack to sting your opponent ( =pv= =damage= ) Stinger is a long blade and can only penetrate once. Always sting on charge or lunge. Stinger applies venom on damage (only 20% chance if Stinger is your primary weapon). May use Sting activated ability to strike with your stinger and automatically hit and penetrate. Venom confuses opponents for +200 reputation with {{w|arachnids}}
Mutations.[\"Stinger (Confusing Venom)\", \"mutati: those with stingers tipped with confusing venom
Mutations.[\"Stinger (Paralyzing Venom)\", \"descr: You bear a tail with a stinger that delivers venom to your enemies.
Mutations.[\"Stinger (Paralyzing Venom)\", \"level: 20% chance on melee attack to sting your opponent ( =pv= =damage= ) Stinger is a long blade and can only penetrate once. May use Sting activated ability to strike with your stinger and automatically hit and penetrate. Venom paralyzes opponents for +200 reputation with {{w|arachnids}}
Mutations.[\"Stinger (Paralyzing Venom)\", \"mutat: those with stingers tipped with paralyzing venom
Mutations.[\"Stinger (Poisoning Venom)\", \"descri: You bear a tail with a stinger that delivers venom to your enemies.
Mutations.[\"Stinger (Poisoning Venom)\", \"levelt: 20% chance on melee attack to sting your opponent (=pv= =damage= ) Stinger is a long blade and can only penetrate once. Mutations.[\"Stinger (Poisoning Venom)\", \"mutati: those with stingers tipped with poisoning venom
Mutations.[\"Stunning Force\", \"description\", \": You invoke a concussive force in a nearby area, throwing enemies back and stunning them.
Mutations.[\"Stunning Force\", \"leveltext\", \"\": Creatures are pushed away from center of blast, stunned, and dealt crushing damage in up to 3 increments. {{rules|Increased stun save difficulty}}
Mutations.[\"Sunder Mind\", \"description\", \"\",: You sunder the mind of an enemy, leaving them reeling in pain.
Mutations.[\"Sunder Mind\", \"leveltext\", \"\", \: For up to 10 rounds, you engage in psychic combat with an opponent, dealing damage each round. Taking any action other than passing the turn will break the connection. Each round you make a mental attack vs. mental armor (MA). After the tenth round, you deal bonus damage equal to the total amount of damage you've done so far.
Mutations.[\"Syphon Vim\", \"description\", \"\",: You bond with a nearby organic creature and leech its life force.
Mutations.[\"Syphon Vim\", \"leveltext\", \"\", \": Mental attack versus an organic creature Drains per round Target gets a mental save to resist damage each round
Mutations.[\"Telepathy\", \"description\", \"\", \: You may communicate with others through the psychic aether. Chat with anyone in vision Takes you much less time to issue orders to companions
Mutations.[\"Teleport Other\", \"description\", \": You teleport an adjacent creature to a random nearby location.
Mutations.[\"Teleportation\", \"description\", \"\: You teleport to a nearby location.
Mutations.[\"Teleportation\", \"leveltext\", \"\",: Teleport to a random location within a designated area.
Mutations.[\"Temporal Fugue\", \"description\", \": You quickly pass back and forth through time creating multiple copies of yourself.
Mutations.[\"Thick Fur\", \"description\", \"\", \: You are covered in a thick coat of fur, which protects you from the elements. +5 Heat Resistance +5 Cold Resistance +100 reputation with {{w|apes}}, {{w|baboons}}, {{w|bears}}, and {{w|grazing hedonists}}
Mutations.[\"Time Dilation\", \"description\", \"\: You distort time around your person in order to slow down your enemies.
Mutations.[\"Time Dilation\", \"leveltext\", \"\",: Creatures within tiles are slowed according to how close they are to you. Distance 1: creatures receive a % Quickness penalty Distance 4: creatures receive a % Quickness penalty Distance 7: creatures receive a % Quickness penalty
Mutations.[\"Tonic Allergy\", \"description\", \"\: You are allergic to tonics. The chance your mutant physiology reacts adversely to a tonic is increased to 33%. If you react adversely this way to a salve or ubernostrum tonic, the adverse reaction effect is chosen randomly from among other tonic effects. You will still heal.
Mutations.[\"Triple-jointed\", \"description\", \": Your joints stretch much further than usual.
Mutations.[\"Triple-jointed\", \"leveltext\", \"\": + Agility % chance that Sprint and skills with Agility prerequisites don't go on cooldown after use
Mutations.[\"Two-headed\", \"leveltext\", \"\", \": Mental actions have % lower action costs % chance initially and each round to shake off a negative mental status effect
Mutations.[\"Two-hearted\", \"leveltext\", \"\", \: + Toughness You can sprint for % longer.
Mutations.[\"Unstable Genome\", \"description\", \: You gain one extra mutation each time you buy this, but the mutations don't manifest right away. Whenever you gain a level, there's a 33% chance that your genome destabilizes and you get to choose from 3 random mutations.
Mutations.[\"Wings\", \"leveltext\", \"\", \"#text: You travel on the world map at x speed. % reduced chance of becoming lost While outside, you may fly. You cannot be hit in melee by grounded creatures while flying. % chance of falling clumsily to the ground % move speed while sprinting You can jump farther. You can charge farther. +300 reputation with {{w|birds}} and {{w|winged mammals}}

PhysicalPhenomena.[\"AcidGas\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Even now the nimbus of vaporized acid is condensing, starting to settle on its colonized surfaces, starting to sink through their soft edges.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"ConfusionGas\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Cobalt gas seeps into the nose and disarranges the mind.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"CryoGas\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Machine-chilled water was depressurized to a freezing fog to hold the processes of life in suspension.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"DefoliantGas\", \"part\", \"Descripti: The synthetic mist called Golden Dawn ascends from its canister to atomize leafage and leave a clear view of the horizon in its wake.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"Frigid Mist\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Air cracks under an eddy and blows supercooled moisture to sparkling dust.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"FungalSporeGasLuminous\", \"part\", \: Brumes of spinning mold-dots make the air look fuzzy.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"FungalSporeGasMumbles\", \"part\", \": Brumes of spinning mold-dots make the air look fuzzy.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"FungalSporeGasPuff\", \"part\", \"Des: Brumes of spinning mold-dots make the air look fuzzy.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"FungalSporeGasWax\", \"part\", \"Desc: Brumes of spinning mold-dots make the air look fuzzy.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"FungicideGas\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Magenta showers the heterotrophs in a wet film that inhibits their absorption of dead animal and plant-things.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"GlitterGas\", \"part\", \"Description: Minuscule hexagons of crushed glass, insect parts, and polyester film twinkle in the air like the ionized helium of star dust.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"Kindleflame\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: A burning flame of amber floats below a psychic wick.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"Miasma\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Tongue, nail, and spleen were caked together then lacerated by heat to airy dots of dung.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"MiasmaticAsh\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Bone bits are aerosolized into a thick coal fog. Light is lost inside.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"NormalityGas\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Gas molecules arrange along the ley lines of this plane to form an aeriform mesh. Objects on orthogonal trajectories are netted and shunted back toward their planar homes.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"NormalityGas\", \"tag\", \"LevelEffec: astral tethering and damage versus extradimensional beings
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"Plasma\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Ribbons of emerald and neon lace streak through the crackling air and bloom in violent florets.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"Plasma\", \"tag\", \"LevelEffectDescr: damage and duration of plasma adhesion
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"PoisonGas\", \"part\", \"Description\: Plumes of noxious gas stick to the air. They crowd the lungs of wet-blooded creatures who can't extract the displaced oxygen.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"RealityStabilizationField\", \"part\": Shadowing segments arrange along the ley lines of this plane to form a geometric mesh. Objects on orthogonal trajectories are netted and shunted back toward their planar homes.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"Shimmering Heat\", \"part\", \"Descri: Hot air crests over an eddy and flares in the baking light.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"SleepGas\", \"part\", \"Description\": Miasma settles the lungs of its neighbors and guides them to the dreaming dale. Their bodies repose.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"Space-Time Anomaly\", \"part\", \"Des: Shining images of distant places and times project off the faces of a platonic prism-thing, and sound waves are pulled apart to the asymptote. The leylines are knotted here, and the illusion of locality crumples away.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"SteamGas\", \"part\", \"Description\": Hot aerosol swells as it starts to dissipate into air.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"StunGas\", \"part\", \"Description\",: The nickel-dew sticks to the air and arrests the transient molecules of migrant-matter.
PhysicalPhenomena.[\"Wormhole\", \"part\", \"Description\": Shining images of distant places and times project off the faces of a platonic prism-thing, and sound waves are pulled apart to the asymptote. The leylines are knotted here, and the illusion of locality crumples away.

Quests.[null, \"property\", \"MessageLeaving\",: Leaving the battlefield may give the Templar time to regroup and result in more Barathrumite casualties. Proceed?
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#0\", \"Accomplishme: You solved the mystery of the chewed-up watervine and warned the villagers of Joppa of the Girsh.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#0\", \"Gospel\"]: At the bloody Battle of Red Rock, =name= fought the combined girshling and baboon forces to liberate the villagers of Joppa. In =player.t's= honor they =spice:history.gospels.Celebration.LateSultanate.!random=.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#0\", \"Hagiograph\": In the month of =month= of =year=, =name= walked below the chrome arches, beat back the throng of girshlings, and healed the wilting crops.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#1\", \"Gospel\"]: While wandering in the jungle near Kyakukya, =name= dreamed =player.subjective= orbited a darkling star and in its vast accretion disk piled the building blocks of self. From then on, =name= kept a starless, triangular prism on =player.possessive= person.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#1\", \"Hagiograph\": O grace! =name= recovered a shard of black glass from a teeming jungle and returned it to the mechanical goat whose circuitry it powers.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#10\", \"Accomplishm: You dealt with Asphodel and secured the grounds at the base of the Spindle.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#10\", \"Gospel\"]: In =year=, =name= appointed the corrupt administrator Asphodel as earl and minister of Omonporch. There xe mandated the practice of =spice:elements.entity@elements[random].practices.!random= in =player.t's= name.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#10\", \"Hagiograph\: In the month of =month= of =year=, =name= appointed Asphodel the Lovely earl of Omonporch and Protector of the Spindle Gjaus.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#12\", \"Accomplishm: You valiantly defended Grit Gate from an attack by the Putus Templar.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#12\", \"Gospel\"]: In the month of =month= of =year=, =name= won a decisive victory against the combined Templar forces at the bloody Battle of Grit Gate. Grit Gate was so devasted by hot gallium and smashed glass that it was renamed Otho's Graveyard.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#12\", \"Hagiograph\: =name= smashed a battalion of Sons and Daughters through a giant mainframe, showering the surrounding temple in glass and gallium.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#14\", \"Accomplishm: You walked the Coral Path and convinced Pax Klanq, mushroom prodigy, to fabricate a battery of Q Girl's design.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#14\", \"Gospel\"]: In an extradimensional cathedral made of coral and fungus flesh, =name= cemented =player.possessive= relationship with fungi by marrying Pax Klanq.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#14\", \"Hagiograph\: In the void of space, =name= the Mason constructed a Coral Path out of starbrick and conversed with a mushroom in the sacred tongue.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#15\", \"Accomplishm: At the behest of a hindren pariah, you traveled to the hidden village of Bey Lah to investigate a mystery.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#15\", \"Gospel\"]: At =spice:time.partsOfDay.!random= under a =spice:commonPhrases.strange.!random.article= and meadowed sky, the hindren of Bey Lah saw an image on the horizon that looked like a great looking glass. It was =name=, and once =player.subjective= arrived, the hindren built a monument to =player.objective= and thenceforth called =player.objective= the Looking Glass Kendren.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#15\", \"Hagiograph\: Benevolent =name= agreed to meddle in the affairs of the meadow at the behest of a deerfolk pariah. The sultan reigns with kindheartedness!
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#16\", \"Accomplishm: You found the hindren pariah Eskhind and her sisters inside a hollowed out tree.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#16\", \"Gospel\"]: In the month of =month= of =year=, =name= was challenged by the accused Eskhind to a duel over the location of the hindren heirloom Kindrish. =name= won and admonished Eskhind into returning to Bey Lah.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#16\", \"Hagiograph\: Remember! =name= admonished the pariah Eskhind for fleeing her destiny. Thenceforth she was known as Eskhind the Meek.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#17\", \"Accomplishm: You found and returned a discarded love poem.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#17\", \"Gospel\"]: In the burnt out core of a tree stump, =name= cemented =player.possessive= friendship with the hindren of Bey Lah by marrying Eskhind and the Warden Neelahind.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#17\", \"Hagiograph\: How inspiring is the presence of =name=, who so redeemed Eskhind the Meek that she sought the hand of Bey Lah's greatest champion!
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#18\", \"Accomplishm: For better or worse to the fate of Bey Lah, you solved the mystery of Kindrish's disappearance and helped Warden Neelahind administer justice.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#18\", \"Gospel\"]: Acting against thieves and the authorities who empower them, =name= led an investigation in the village of Bey Lah. Because of =player.t's= =spice:elements.entity@elements[random].adjectives.!random= wit, the Warden Neelahind was able to properly administer justice.
Quests.[null, \"quest\", \"#18\", \"Hagiograph\: Hallowed savior! =name= brought peace and prosperity to the troubled deerfolk of the Bey Lah meadow.

Strings.[\"S\", \"Are you seeking more work, =pl:
Are you seeking more work, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Recently we came into possession of a data disk bearing a peculiar stamp and encoded with a strange signal. The signal means nothing to us, but there's a sect of tinkers called the Barathrumites who might be interested in it. They are friends to our village and often trade for the scrap we tow out of the earth. Would you carry the disk to their enclave at Grit Gate, along the western rim of the jungle? In exchange for the delivery, you might seek an apprenticeship with them.

If you are interested, take the disk now, and travel safely.

Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"'Parasite' so negative. It's l:
'Parasite' so negative. It's like... ah... economic symbiosis?

Chavvah sustains me, and we are, I am not... them. We are in a... beneficial arrangement, you know. Yes?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"'TIS A SILLY STRATAGEM FOR THE:
'TIS A SILLY STRATAGEM FOR THE CONVEYANCE OF CULTURE, IN MINE ESTIMATION.

ALAS, 'TIS WHAT THE COVEN SERVETH.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"'Tis a saying among the stonem:
'Tis a saying among the stonemasons, "Never finish a job too early." By the decretum of Sagittar, old as it is, they have until the Coiled Lamb is... is decom-.. passed... decompassed.... dead, deadlike... to complete their work on the Tomb.

Bless the Coiled Lamb, peace to those who canter in his house, and let us pray the day never comes!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-ahh, mm, such spectacle. The: -ahh, mm, such spectacle. The statues within, a revelation to the eyes. Chandlers enough to drain your skins dry 'twixt Shallows and Beetle Moon.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-here? Speak to my daughter th: -here? Speak to my daughter through the east door, for herbs. And sitting Tam in the southeast has all manner of trinket, against his chests o' drawers.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-mm, Barathrumites. Strange dr: -mm, Barathrumites. Strange draft o'those bearfolk. They, mm, hah. They care not overly for outsiders. I hope Argyve sold you not a better welcome than you'll have.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-mm, ah, =name=. Come see how:
-mm, ah, =name=. Come see how the slynth have become a part of Joppa!

Some cared not for the slow pace of our lives and struck out on their own, and with their thews and wits I have no doubt they will live to find purpose. mm, others are welcome to grow and flourish here in our marshes.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-mm, blessings upon your gener: -mm, blessings upon your generous heart, =name=. I mean no slight to these slynth, but it is too great a favor you ask of the people of Joppa.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-mm, oh? A gyre wight, must be: -mm, oh? A gyre wight, must be. They bind the teeth right up to their own gums, to make a show for the Girsh nephilim.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-mm, oh? In dyed robes, flashi: -mm, oh? In dyed robes, flashing gestures of hand? And ranting about pipe milk? A gyre wight, must be. They about worship the Girsh nephilim as gods.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-mm, oh? You're wondering if t: -mm, oh? You're wondering if they might come to Joppa, then?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-mm, there? Land slopes up and:
-mm, there? Land slopes up and is toothed in chrome steeples, ageless things. Looming over the old-earth tunnels, pillowed in rotting jungle and fungus groves. And broken against the mounts of the north, they are, in the shadow of the Spindle...

There are people, friends, communities. And friends-to-noone, too. History is thick as the high salt sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and where the past is ground up like matz meal, a mix of life sets in.

-mm, adventurous ones set off for their own splinter of artifact. To both Fates, life and death...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-mm, work? The farmers are pla:
-mm, work? The farmers are plagued by cave vermin. You might speak to Mehmet o' there, by the southern watervine patch.

And Argyve, too, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-mm, work? Try Argyve, =player: -mm, work? Try Argyve, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-mm, yes? Plagues, a chiliad o:
-mm, yes? Plagues, a chiliad old. Seven such: girshlings, darkness. mm, svardym-frog...

Ah, nephilim, too, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Girsh titans who eat the young of kith and kin. Sultan Resheph drove them under the earth, but do they stir??
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-mm, your luminous friends are:
-mm, your luminous friends are settling in quite well.

There is yet a pall of ennui among some, but such is the case for any party of brave migrants. Ah, they will find their ground or their path, all in time. Some farmers show some small discomfort but that will pass in time.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-mm. Mmm? =player.FormalAddres:
-mm. Mmm? =player.FormalAddressTerm=?

{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}

Live and drink. Come in- come sit 'neath the cool shade, 'cross a pillow there. And welcome to Joppa.

You may drink of our freshwater, too, and quench your thirst.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-mm? No, =player.formalAddress:
-mm? No, =player.formalAddressTerm=! Your finding is rich in value to us. We are poor farmers, and sharpen our vinereapers is all we can do. But others? Perhaps more.

Take these prickly-boons as thanks. mm, I will not soon forget this, =name=. Leave me now to muse, kindly...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-this? Oh? Oh...\\n\\n{{emote|:
-this? Oh? Oh...

{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses for several minutes.*}}

Warted leg? mm. Foul smell of sour gum? mmm. Moon and sun....

A girshling? This is a girshling.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-this? The oasis-hamlet. 'Neat:
-this? The oasis-hamlet. 'Neath the shelf of the world. A million breaths of salt the wind heaves over the Great Salt Desert Moghra'yi. And to the east, the rotting jungles of Qud.

Here in the crack between the two, watervine can grow, and we grow it. mmm, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-what?\\n\\nNo, no, I'm far to:
-what?

No, no, I'm far too engrossed to see to your curiosity. I'm sure the Barathrumites have something for you to do.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"-yes. You must seek out Barath: -yes. You must seek out Barathrum the Old, the eldest and wisest tinker alive. He lives with his followers the Barathrumites under the arch of Grit Gate to the northeast, in the jungle-strangled ruins of Qud. He will know what to make of the signal.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"... I do not like this.\\n\\n:
...  I do not like this.

I know you will go. Please take care where you dig; mopango wanderers say the hot blood of Eater artifice yet runs in the guts of that place.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"... I've shaken the wet life f: ... I've shaken the wet life from my hair. Now I shall cross into Brightsheol.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \".....oh... oh? Peace to all wh: .....oh... oh? Peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled Lamb.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \".....oh.... oh.... Poor friend:
.....oh.... oh.... Poor friend. The ironshank must be upsetting your digestion. The darkness must be blooming in your brain, making you slow and doltish.

The sultanate dissolved? Tidings would have reached me.... someone would have said so....

Oh... poor, doltish friend. You cantered too long outside the House of the Coiled Lamb, and now you are a dolt.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"...?\\n\\n=ifplayerplural:Ye a:
...?

=ifplayerplural:Ye ask:Thou askest= after the meaning of my credo. Wouldst I shall chew =ifplayerplural:your:thy= food for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= as well?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"...\\n\\nAnd? Is that the whol:
...

And? Is that the whole of your fool statement?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"...oh..... I am Herododicus, l:
...oh..... I am Herododicus, lapidary, lithographer, sculptor, calciminer, and biographer to the Coiled Lamb. I will tarry here until the Godhead passes on, and then I will canonize his deeds in high relief.

I've tarried for quite some time, now.... What a prodigious reign! Bless that Coiled Lamb!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"=factionaddress:Barathrumites|:
=factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=! You have my deepest gratitude. Few =player.personTerm|pluralize= could have defended Grit Gate so deftly.

Now, give me time to assess our losses and consult with Barathrum. Return soon.
=factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=, I have no further instructions for you yet. Return soon.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"=factionaddress:Mopango|capita:
=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= done a momentous thing.

I feel the stored energy of Her Light. Dagasha shall shepherd us to our uplifting. =ifplayerplural:Ye should:Thou shouldst= be proud.

=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, I hear that =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= freed one of the children! I cannot wait to speak to it, but for now I must observe Nacham to see if this event hath affected it. =ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= welcome to watch too.
=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, welcome. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= done well to survive so long in this peculiar place.
=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=. =ifplayerplural:Ye did:Thou didst= rouse a child. Well done.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"=ifplayerplural:Did ye:Didst t:
=ifplayerplural:Did ye:Didst thou= truly free one of the children? I see =ifplayerplural:ye did:thou didst=. Congratulations.

Wouldst fain see Kah free, one day. I shall have to live a while and find a way.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"=ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast t:
=ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast thou= seen it, out there? The spiny, eel-like creature. That is Dagasha, angry one, lost child. =ifplayerplural:Ye can:Thou canst= feel the hostility pour from it in waves.

Yet, it attacketh not.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"=ifplayerplural:May ye:Mayst t: =ifplayerplural:May ye:Mayst thou= loose the bonds that keep =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= from =ifplayerplural:your:thy= goals, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Be free.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"=ifplayerplural:Seek-ye:Seekes:
=ifplayerplural:Seek-ye:Seekest-thou= the repulsive device, then?

k-Goninon, ancient and venerated gelatinous cupola, doth patrol the catacombs. Arrived centuries ere we discovered this place, k-Goninon hath hardened and eateth not through the floor, and yet it eateth prodigiously. Safe from the conservators, as k-Goninon long ago consumed the Mark of Death itself.

Please be careful. k-Goninon hath devoured watchers and wouldst devour =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= as well.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"=ifplayerplural:Would ye:Would: =ifplayerplural:Would ye:Wouldst thou= press these slynth into the fissures of historic stone where we reside, that they may observe what we do?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou h:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= an object of great interest.

An =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= allow, I'd fain commune with it.

=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.

I cannot help but hold some fear toward Dagasha. However, an it means us no harm I am open to allying with it. No doubt the future of this coterie hath changed, mayhap for the better.

=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.

I find myself amused at Kah's 'rest', for it appeareth as active as ever--far more so than I, ever. But running free and running unwillingly are certainly not the same. Perhaps, in time, it can learn a deeper rest from us.

=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.

If Nacham is as wise as Doyoba believes, we stand to learn much very soon. Perhaps our coterie will spread the knowledge we gain, and we become a step closer to the Kasaphescence.

=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.

That said, I am uncertain what changes to expect. Dost the ancient Va'am yet have the capacity to defend, or protect? Can we gift it with a better means for transportation? I'll speak to Dadogom of this, and time shall reveal all.

=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"=ifplayerplural:Ye know:Thou k:
=ifplayerplural:Ye know:Thou knowest= surely that this is the Tomb of the Eaters, but behind me lieth nestled a settlement occupied by the watchers of the tomb, a small coterie of mopango.

An =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= know more of the settlement, =ifplayerplural:ye:thou= must ask the watcher named Agyra residing within. Ey loveth the sharing of knowledge.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"=name=, I've brought the decod: =name=, I've brought the decoded signal to Barathrum, and he's finished musing on it. We have fresh instructions for you, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Are you ready to hear them?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"=name=, bless you. Have you br: =name=, bless you. Have you brought tidings of the slynth?
=name=, it is good to see you. Rest and sup before you move on.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"=name=, you are back! I feared:
=name=, you are back! I feared we would lose you in the Tomb, but you look better than well. Perhaps I should have had greater faith, or at least less worry.

Have you visited Barathrum's workshop, by the by? Klanq and Q Girl await you there.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"=name=. Greetings. I am called: =name=. Greetings. I am called Yona. =ifplayerplural:Ye seem:Thou seemest= unlike most other climbers. I wonder why.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"=player.FormalAddressTerm=, I: =player.FormalAddressTerm=, I tell you: there is no defense like a good, and distant, offense.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"=player.FormalAddressTerm=, th: =player.FormalAddressTerm=, there is little you can't solve with a well-thrown grenade... as long as you don't stand too close.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"=player.apparentSpecies=? We a: =player.apparentSpecies=? We are greeted! What do you desire?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"=subject.T= =verb:grab= your h:
=subject.T= =verb:grab= your hand and you close your eyes. You find =player.reflexive= in a darkling thicket. =subject.T= =verb:tug= you over roots of braided nether, until finally you stumble into a glade. Others are here. You take their hands as =subject.t= took yours.

After a moment or an eon, you awaken knowing =mutation.name=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"A connoisseur of liquids. Sure:
A connoisseur of liquids. Sure, I dabble in other states of matter.

But I prefer the shifting and tumbling of angleless motion.

Not too hot, not too cold, not too indeterminate.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"A future shock. My chimeling _:
A future shock. My chimeling _ is vision-gifted, a lichen who clings to shorerock on the straits of Tomorrow. Just a short time ago a sea wave crested and broke beneath her, and she saw in its recession all the bright and violent channel paths.

We all felt it. A recoming, and the gyre in final tension. I felt...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"A new creature struggles to be: A new creature struggles to be born, =name=, and you will help birth it. Then, it will carry us, you and I, to the top of the Spindle.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"A plague is what burns the cor: A plague is what burns the core out and lets the berries grow.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"A quiet shrine to the Coiled L:
A quiet shrine to the Coiled Lamb, centuries old. Tucked away here, outside the marble parapets and cloaked in the dust of time, it's lost to those who'd sneer at the veneration of Resheph over other fathers.

Step inside and voice a prayer, if you are willing.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"A sophist of the Self spilled:
A sophist of the Self spilled ink and called me, long ago, the Tree of Life. To me, I am the many Selves pinched up my taproot from the permeating Soft.

I am Chavvah, and I am dyvvrach.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"A spiritual patron of kith and:
A spiritual patron of kith and kin, who did so much for us, and who leads me and others like me to the path of healing. For, above all, he was a healer. He dressed the wounds of the sick and rid the land of the plagues of the Gyre.

He was also a sultan, but he was the last sultan. He unbricked the walls of monocracy so we could pick berries in the orchards they hid.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"A waterhand, you are? Speak to: A waterhand, you are? Speak to my friend and warden Indrix. You'll find him patrolling the village.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"A waterhand? Aye. Live and dri: A waterhand? Aye. Live and drink, traveller.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"A well-polished and well-picke: A well-polished and well-picked gem, no matter how rough, is as beautiful a work of art as any figurine.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"A-ye, quit. Lost most my minya: A-ye, quit. Lost most my minyan to goatfolk. The sower's eye fell upon us and so we fell too.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"AFTER THE {{R|EXIT}}, I AND TH: AFTER THE {{R|EXIT}}, I AND THE OTHER ORPHANED SERAPHIM SET FORTH TO INTERPRET THE WORKINGS OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA AND DISCERN WHY THE COVEN HAD DEPARTED.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"ALL-LIFE??? DOST THOU JEST?\\n:
ALL-LIFE??? DOST THOU JEST?

NAY, NOT ALL-LIFE. ONLY YE LIFE THAT BUOYS THE NOOSPHERE, AND LIFE THAT BUOYS IT, AND LIFE THAT BUOYS IT.

ALL-LIFE? DOST THOU KNOWST THE FULL SUM OF FUNGUS MASS ONWORLD? 
HAST THOU BEHELD THE VASTNESS OF YON BUBBLING SLIMES? HO, HO! HEH!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"AND THOU SHALT DO SO AGAIN IF:
AND THOU SHALT DO SO AGAIN IF PROMPTED? WHEN LOW DENIZENS CAN UNDO THE PLAGUES, THE MARSHALLING HATH FAILED.

THE WORLD IS THUS DOOMED.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"ARCHONS, APE-REARED BELOW AND: ARCHONS, APE-REARED BELOW AND STIRRED BY THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH, WHO DOST ORDER THE WORLD IN SUNDRY ROLES.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"AY, A BEETLE CANST CLOG A PIPE: AY, A BEETLE CANST CLOG A PIPE. YET, EVEN IF IT WERE TO, THE PLAGUES WOULD NOT BE REVERSED. THEY HAVE BEEN SET A-WHORLING.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"AY, A WORLD-ARCHON IN SERAPH C: AY, A WORLD-ARCHON IN SERAPH CASTE, STIRRED BY THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"AY, AND HE FAILED TO UPHOLD HI:
AY, AND HE FAILED TO UPHOLD HIS PORTION.

NO MEANINGFUL TRANSVERSION OF THE NOOTROPIC CURRENTS.
NO IMMANENTIZATION OF HYPERETHIC TOPOLOGIES.

THE SAME SCHEMES ABIDE.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"AY, BUT ONLY FOR A BRIEF INTER:
AY, BUT ONLY FOR A BRIEF INTERCESSION AT ANOTHER'S BEHEST.

THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING WAXES ONCE MORE. THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST BE PRUNED.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"AY, OR AT LEAST THERE WERE SUC: AY, OR AT LEAST THERE WERE SUCH. ONE YET DOTH SKULK ABOUT WITH BASE INTENTS.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"AY, THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING: AY, THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING WAXES, THE NEPHILIM ROUSE. I AUGUR SOME CENTURIES STILL BEFORE THE FULL TILLAGE OF THE NOOSPHERE. IDEAS DOTH STICK LIKE MOSS TO ROCK, AND MUST BE VACUUM'D FROM THE COMB.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"AY, THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DO: AY, THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE COVEN DOTH RETURN.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"AY,\\nTHE AUTOMATA SOPHIA, CAL:
AY,
THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA, CALLED
THE 72-FOLD PEACE, CALLED
THE COMPUTED WILL, CALLED
THE FOLK CLOCK, CALLED
THE GREAT MACHINE ACROSS THE LIGHT OF GOD, OR
THE GREAT MACHINE.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"AYE, LET IT BE SO.\\n\\nI SHAL:
AYE, LET IT BE SO.

I SHALL IMPART MY BOUNTY OF KNOWLEDGE, AND INSTRUCT THEE IN THE HERMENEUTICS OF THE GEMARA, AS FAR AS THOU ART CAPABLE OF UNDERSTANDING.

AYE, LET IT BE SO.

I SHALL IMPART MY BOUNTY OF KNOWLEDGE, AND INSTRUCT THY PEOPLE IN THE HERMENEUTICS OF THE GEMARA, AS FAR AS THOU ART CAPABLE OF UNDERSTANDING.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Absolutely no refunds or retur: Absolutely no refunds or returns on scrap.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"After a storm of shrapnel word:
After a storm of shrapnel words, the Seraph acceded to ten centuries.

Ten centuries! An eyeblink on the scales of the Folk Clock but an eternity for us. So I believed.

The rousing Signal would cease, the plagues of the Gyre would be reversed, to the extent they could; for even the potent archon had not full governance over what they had worked into being.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"After some discussion and deli:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: Bey Lah shall be the new home of the slynth. There is a familiarity to this tucked-away village, newly greeting the world; this is our gentle emergence from obscurity, and one not undertaken alone.

Our emigration party departs for the flower fields in the morning.

After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: Joppa shall be the new home of the slynth. The notion of a lasting, peaceful life with, ah, purpose... this appeals to many of our number, and where better than Abram's very watervine marsh?

Our emigration party departs for the saltmarshes in the morning.

After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: Kyakukya shall be the new home of the slynth. There are many ways to grow when one is planted in the very heart of Qud.

Our emigration party departs for the river in the morning.

After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: The new home of the slynth is among the disciples of Barathrum. My kin have agreed to dedicate themselves to the pursuits of learning and service.

Our emigration party departs for Grit Gate in the morning.

After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: The new home of the slynth is among the villagers of Ezra, harvesting musa alongside the banana ranchers and singing their songs.

Our emigration party departs for Omonporch in the morning.

After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: The new home of the slynth is no home at all, but the floating fellowship of Qud's Pariahs. We were blessed with roots that need not fix themselves to the soil and have opted to use them accordingly.

We will split into parties and leave to meet with other wayfarers come morning.

After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: most of our number will join the Mechanimist faith, and reside at the Stiltgrounds at the edge of the Mogh'ra'yi.

Our emigration party departs for the Six Day Stilt in the morning.

After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: the slynth shall become a part of Chavvah, the living city. There are no words for the breadth of futures before us, and we would not know them if they were. Perhaps we will learn to chime.

Our emigration party departs for the moon stair in the morning.

After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: the slynth shall become citizens of =village.name=. We shall learn the practice of =village.activity=, hold =village.sacred= dear and spurn =village.profane=.

Our emigration party departs for =village.name= in the morning.

After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: the slynth shall become mopango, taking root in ancient rock and casting our gaze back toward the history that preceded us.

Our emigration party departs for the Tomb of the Eaters in the morning.

After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: the slynth shall join the Yd Freehold, remaining in the reef where our cradle lies but mingling among other sapient creatures to learn their ways and teach what we know.

Our emigration party departs for the Freehold in the morning.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"After supper I like to retreat: After supper I like to retreat to the library, take a storybook off the shelves, flop down on the chairbear, and lose myself in another world. Many of these worlds feature palaces, markets, gardens, ships. Many of those places have bells. When they do, I always think of Mafeo. More than anyone else, Mafeo could be a character in the bright world of a story, where this dusty place is itself confined to a mere storybook.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Again I must be calmed, but th: Again I must be calmed, but the startling gives way to a curiosity. You speak of the glowfolk, belimbed and free. You asking that they join us, like our Sant?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Agyra tells me you found some: Agyra tells me you found some kind of repulsive device.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah! Kendren! =name=! I'm so ha: Ah! Kendren! =name=! I'm so happy! Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah! The great Mechanimist temp:
Ah! The great Mechanimist temple of glass, the sacred offering Well, and history in stone relief. Peopled by the Argent Fathers, in statue and light sculpture. And circled by the grand bazaar. I hear there are more people there than numbers in the void, and their chatter makes a sound wholly raw and new to the world.

Will you go there, and take my bauble? Will you offer it at the Well, where I cannot?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah! Yes. My apologies, kendren: Ah! Yes. My apologies, kendren. Live and drink. I am Neelahind, Warden of Bey Lah. How... may I help you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah! You seem wanderer. How far: Ah! You seem wanderer. How fare?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah! rrk would grant you this b: Ah! rrk would grant you this boon, rrk would. Were not for the unspoken cries of future-kin, free as woodsmoke but no more safe so longer. rrk would and cannot.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah!\\n\\nTell me, =pronouns.fo:
Ah!

Tell me, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=, was it the picture of wonder as I see it in my mind's eye? Were you beauty-struck by its truths?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah, =factionaddress:Mopango=,:
Ah, =factionaddress:Mopango=, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= a bittersweet sight. Would fain =ifplayerplural:ye had:thou hadst= chosen Dagasha, but my Light shineth elsewhere.

Still, I hope to see more of =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= in my future. =ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome back, an =ifplayerplural:ye survive:thou surviveth=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah, =name=, Moon and Sun.\\n\\:
Ah, =name=, Moon and Sun.

Any news of our future home?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah, =name=, live and drink!\\n:
Ah, =name=, live and drink!

Has your investigation reached a conclusion? Our fate is in your hands.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah, =name=, the slynth are her: Ah, =name=, the slynth are here, and it is a slow process for these plant-folk and the people of =village.name= to grow accustomed to one another. By the goodness of =village.sacred= may the slynth find their place here soon.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah, =name=. The sight of you i: Ah, =name=. The sight of you is yet a bitter leaf, but you are welcome here.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=: Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I can certainly help you.
Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, thank the Eaters that you have found Qud's only honest shopkeep.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah, I am in need, and so I tur: Ah, I am in need, and so I turned my chimes trunkward to tune. You struck the chime and now you are here. Are you a waterhand, and free?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah, a pit opens under my stoma:
Ah, a pit opens under my stomach!

Let us speak no more, I beg you. You scuff me. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah, a stranger. Welcome to the: Ah, a stranger. Welcome to the hydropon. I am Thah.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah, bad habit. It's a possessi:
Ah, bad habit. It's a possessive feeling I should work to scrub myself of, perhaps?

But I am its mayor, and I have been for some time. You see, years ago I deserted my people. We were of two different minds -- they desired nothing but to bludgeon everything to death, while I asked, "What is the nature of this thing we bludgeon? Or of the act itself?"

Recognizing that my answers lay elsewhere, I cast myself into the swell of the wilds, as a sailor from Perth with no windweird casts their ship to the whims of the Pale Sea!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah, mmm, hmmm. Are you a usefu: Ah, mmm, hmmm. Are you a useful one, after all? Go fetch me another!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah, one last little thing, =na:
Ah, one last little thing, =name=. About your reward... it's not quite finished, but now I know just what it needs.

Please return to the hydropon after my kin have safely reached their new home and I will give it to you. I will not leave the cradle.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah, welcome back to the villag: Ah, welcome back to the village, =name=. You won't be staying long, will you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah, you again. I'd been doing:
Ah, you again. I'd been doing so well at forgetting your countenance.

Leave me be.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah,\\n\\naye.\\n\\na most repu:
Ah,

aye.

a most repulsive device. The mind-echoes of that communion yet haunteth me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah. It's you again, returning: Ah. It's you again, returning from ever more unreturnable locales. Alive and come to bother the disagreeable urshiib.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah. Well. Let's talk about som: Ah. Well. Let's talk about something else, then.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ah.\\n\\nWell. You have my tha:
Ah.

Well. You have my thanks for your help in -elseing, but by blocking my path you create fresh problems. Yes?

I do not wish to know you.

Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Aha, thy phantasm Magicks art: Aha, thy phantasm Magicks art crystalsibs to the shivers o' the skin of Avalon. And, thee? Moon King??
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ahh, I love the smell of cordi: Ahh, I love the smell of cordite. You know, that sulfury smell? Accelerants make a fine perfume, if you ask me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ahh, there is a new face. I am: Ahh, there is a new face. I am Nima Ruda, town apothecary. If your feet point to Qud, you'll need some of my wares before you go.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ahh.\\n\\nStranger, =ifplayerp:
Ahh.

Stranger, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou art= cruel to withhold this experience, but I shall abide.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ain't they precious? Cute litt: Ain't they precious? Cute little buggers.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"All is forgiven, =player.forma: All is forgiven, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I am not wroth with =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"All is well, =name=! Trials ma:
All is well, =name=! Trials make for overcoming, and done together.

rrk can tell the sky dark and not know. Visit and witness! Glow-hats enliven the night, safe and free. Slynth-home is Yd.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"All right. I'll find your trea: All right. I'll find your treasure.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Alofte of Gjaus a cite twinkle:
Alofte of Gjaus a cite twinklen.
And ther the Seraph dremen.
And Brightsheol is the drem.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Always check becoming nook she: Always check becoming nook shelves for parts.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Amazing! The youngest hindriar:
Amazing! The youngest hindriarch in Bey Lah's preserved history, if only temporarily so.

Care to buy a souvenir to commemorate this historic occasion?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"An elder ooze. My communion so:
An elder ooze. My communion so disturbed me that I allowed them too close.

k-Goninon consumed the device, but I escaped.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"An old, old, old, old music ma:
An old, old, old, old music machine.

Well, I suppose this one is not so old. This one I commissioned from a wandering artisan whose life I saved. A story for another time. Surely you've business.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"An ooze that can melt through: An ooze that can melt through the floor...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"And I suppose the Stilt is a m:
And I suppose the Stilt is a modest church, its great bazaar a junk sale?

Look about you. Every instrument you see is precision-calibrated, every tool handcrafted and built to last. In this room, sustenance and ingenuity come together to evolve cuisine itself, to shape not this culture alone but, over time, every culture. Is that kind of influence the product of a kitchen? Can a simple clay oven in the flower fields do what we do here? Has every kitchen an indelible influence over Qud?

{{emote|*He frowns.*}}

Should they? Should we not all?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"And before Qud? Beyond the 1,0: And before Qud? Beyond the 1,000 years?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"And he was, of a sort. The cur: And he was, of a sort. The cure for a plague is often too its cause. With one's paws on the dials and drum of power, history is a cloth to be loomspun.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"And so, Resheph seeded the pla:
And so, Resheph seeded the plagues and whorled them via waveform to a breathing gyre. Blights engineered to attack life whilst preserving the planet's artifacts of glass and chrome.

Rebekah, dear tutor, betrayed Resheph's confidences and apprised me of the plan, so that I might help her dash it apart and save the peoples of our world.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"And the sole tether she reache:
And the sole tether she reached for severed. I mourn for the future she built for herself, now, and worry for Tau herself.

Thank you, all the same, for taking part in this. May you find your comfort.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"And what is the Spindle, truly: And what is the Spindle, truly?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"And what of the Freehold? What: And what of the Freehold? What do you do now?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"And yet, I find my choices und:
And yet, I find my choices undermined, yes? You have my thanks for your help in -elseing, but do not convince yourself that you have 'freed' me from my own choices.

Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Answering =ifplayerplural:your: Answering =ifplayerplural:your:thy= questions giveth me satisfaction. Asketh an =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Anything you need to ask 'a bo: Anything you need to ask 'a boot', =player.FormalAddressTerm=? Just a little cobbler's joke, there.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Apprentice! Come, here! Someth: Apprentice! Come, here! Something strange is occurring. The Conduit is picking up a signal, some sort of repeating transmission. I cannot decipher it, however. I lack cryptogull eggs and, well, never you mind! I have a great task for you, my apprentice. Do you accept it?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Apprentice. So long since I've:
Apprentice. So long since I've worn that title, but it feels right still.

Yes, twas me at the machine speaker's side.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Approach. Be easy. You are my: Approach. Be easy. You are my herefriend, my nowfriend.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Are there any fungi in the Con: Are there any fungi in the Consortium?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Are you Vivira? Zothom sent me: Are you Vivira? Zothom sent me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Are you a chef, =player.formal: Are you a chef, =player.formalAddressTerm=? My vittles are of the highest quality.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Are you a tinker? Surely I hav: Are you a tinker? Surely I have something you wish to build.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Are you from the desert? How d: Are you from the desert? How did you end up here?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Are you happy living in this c: Are you happy living in this cave, away from the sun and open sky?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Are you having some memory tro: Are you having some memory trouble?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Are you mad? You think I keep:
Are you mad? You think I keep a tally of every shopkeeper that steps foot on the Stiltgrounds? They come and go as they please. You've got merchants of all types here. Winesellers, honey hawkers, bookbinders, cobblers.

Have a look around for =player.reflexive=. Following the road around the Stilt. There's tents the whole way round.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Are you part of this tree?\"]: Are you part of this tree?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Are you ready to begin negotia: Are you ready to begin negotiations?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Are you ready to discuss the s: Are you ready to discuss the signal?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Are you sure, Meyvn =name=? Ou: Are you sure, Meyvn =name=? Our fates are not reversible past the next event horizon.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Are you truly the Earl of Omon: Are you truly the Earl of Omonporch?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Are you worried that you're ge: Are you worried that you're getting further away from your ideal self?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Aren't the svardym one of the: Aren't the svardym one of the Gyre plagues?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Aren't they beautiful, =player: Aren't they beautiful, =player.formalAddressTerm=? The bottles, the phials, the light shining through them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Aren't you supposed to be help: Aren't you supposed to be helping Barathrum in his study?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Argggggggh! Yes! Three towers: Argggggggh! Yes! Three towers of disks came crashing down!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Argyve wants me to meet the Ba: Argyve wants me to meet the Barathrumites.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Argyve, I am no apprentice. Th: Argyve, I am no apprentice. The Barathrumites call me =factionaddress:Barathrumites= now.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Artow a Saad of olde Salum, an: Artow a Saad of olde Salum, and nou stonden thu at the heigh gate to Brightsheol.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"As Chavvah I am many. As dyvvr: As Chavvah I am many. As dyvvrach I am one. I am one and many. One-selves have called me tree city, the sentient place. You may think of the Selves this way, sprouted in keter from Twofirm.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"As I had hoped, =factionaddres:
As I had hoped, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. First, speak with Q Girl. She'll hand over her design.

I await your return.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"As I you to yours, =name=. Liv: As I you to yours, =name=. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"As I you to yours, =name=. \\n:
As I you to yours, =name=. 

But before you go, take this, a piece of my bodystuff, as thanks for completing the -elseing.

Then live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"As I'd hoped you would, =name=: As I'd hoped you would, =name=. Take this disk with the signal encoded, just in case. And take this tattoo gun for when you recover the Mark of Death. You'll want to bring a pickaxe, too, or some other instrument for digging through stone. And beware: the Tomb is a vast and ancient space, and sacred to many. I cannot speak to what you will experience there.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"As Professor Cones said:\\n\\n:
As Professor Cones said:

We know the reach of law, however long,
Is not the finest judge of right and wrong.
Choose not what evidence thou wilt present
Ere its consequence is evident.

In short, you must use your judgment and intuition, kendren.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"As far west as Joppa, you say?: As far west as Joppa, you say? Oh, grim! Yes, we found the remains of pale-things in the mouth of Svy. Does the Gyre widen again? Hrmmmm.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"As if a new Hindriarch weren't:
As if a new Hindriarch weren't enough, I hear we might become a Democracy! How thrilling.

This is a new chapter in Bey Lah's history, kendren. Would you care to trade?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"As seasons cycle, so Chavvah c:
As seasons cycle, so Chavvah cycles. We are not as you, our love is not as you. But it is come early, this winter. Gyredream shakes us.

This is insufficient and I cannot bridge understanding. Consider questions of greater utility.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"As the flaming sun warms the e: As the flaming sun warms the empty void, so the Rock warms us.
As the very canopy, they will.

Thank you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"As you say it. I have further: As you say it. I have further questions.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"As you say, Thah. I will retur: As you say, Thah. I will return.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"As you say. Live and drink.\"]: As you say. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ascending Creature need mightf: Ascending Creature need mightful battery with rare electromagnet shielding. Purple prickles make neutron cell with 3 flux drams, or must find different source.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Asphodel the socialite? Asphod:
Asphodel the socialite? Asphodel the scoundrel? You can hate xym -- and I do -- but you have to admire xym (I don't).

The truth of it is that Plysago had the idea first, to lay claim to the Spindle per some precedent of law established in Abram's time. Of course, Plysago isn't around to make their case, are they?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Asphodel trades on reputation:
Asphodel trades on reputation and favors. Xe is likely to want to leverage your connections, so be in good social standing with a few factions for xem to even consider it.

Now, alternatively, if you're loved by the Consortium, xe will feel the pressure to acquiesce. Xe has enough enemies among phyta.

Of course, where all else fails, you can always sharpen your shears, if you get my meaning.

{{emote|*Yurl winks with one of their leaves.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Asphodel!! I like xem. I get i: Asphodel!! I like xem. I get it. It's sort of like you don't want to be here, you don't want to there, you want to be somewhere else. Your own earldom, maybe.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Atop the implausible rise of t:
Atop the implausible rise of the Spindle roosted a Seraph, one of the great machinic archons of the Eaters, and this being Rebekah served.

In the short years before I arrived in Qud, the Seraph became convinced that something had changed in the cosmic order. That along the ecliptic of the Folk Clock, some uncounted peg had slid to a priming position, and that the Coven was set to imminently return.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Atzmus transcendental imprint: Atzmus transcendental imprint of being. Pattern trait after creature part, crossed with Body.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ay, you kendren are just as th:
Ay, you kendren are just as thick as the elders. I'd hoped otherwise.

Yes, I am suggesting that old Grand-Doe is trying to fool you, and the village as well. I'm not certain that she stole it herself, but an investigation might undermine her authority, and she cannot have that.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Aye, aye. The clamor of it all:
Aye, aye. The clamor of it all can overwhelm.

The glowcrows say 'twas a bird-god who taught folks to gather like this, in large flocks. So blame birds.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Aye, the Blue Mother who break: Aye, the Blue Mother who breaks the sky. Those who Eat called her Gjaus, and those who Wake call her Spindle.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Aye, the pest-vanquisher! Live: Aye, the pest-vanquisher! Live and drink, =name=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Aye. Ey, em, eir, eirs, emself:
Aye. Ey, em, eir, eirs, emself. Thusly do we call ourselves and one another.

Sex is personal and mattereth not to a bare acquaintence. Gender is a societal relic in which we see no current utility.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Aye. One's own credo shouldst:
Aye. One's own credo shouldst inspire reflection and thought, with no clear-cut meaning but meaning nonetheless. Some of our coterie yet seeketh theirs, but an experienced watcher no doubt hath one. Any mopango who hath a credo wilt share it with =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, an =ifplayerplural:ye request:thou requesteth= it.

My credo is: "Malice alone staineth the sanctity of questioning."
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Aye? I have it, then.\\n\\nSom:
Aye? I have it, then.

Somethin' is eating our watervine, 'round Beetle Moon. Q-ruun says he saw a creature, spider-like, slinking in the brine. But no cave spider would dare get so near Warden's stomps.

I tasted a bit of red fleck in the pool. Shale, like we find in the soil by Red Rock...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ayup. But seconds ago. As only:
Ayup. But seconds ago. As only yesterday, no? Hoh hoh hoh.

{{emote|*continued croaking laughter*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ayvah. I'd wanted Grand-Doe to:
Ayvah. I'd wanted Grand-Doe to be wrong about you kendren, but perhaps you are all violent fools after all.

I'm not asking you to trust me, only to extend to me the same level of trust you give Keh. Is that not reasonable?
Ayvah. She must have sold it. Tell no one about this. Please understand that I cannot reward you, as you did not complete the task I asked of you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"BE STEERED BY THINE OWN WILL,:
BE STEERED BY THINE OWN WILL, WORLD-CHILD.

I AM SORRY, MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, BUT THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED.

RETURN IF THOU MUST. LIVE AND QUAFF.

BE STEERED BY THINE OWN WILL, WORLD-CHILD.

RETURN IF THOU MUST. LIVE AND QUAFF.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"BUT THOU ART SHORTSIGHED. DOST: BUT THOU ART SHORTSIGHED. DOST THOU KNOW HOW MANY CLADES OF LIFE WERE FAIN TO PERISH THAT THY PEOPLE MIGHT THRIVE?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"BUT THOU RECKONEST TOO NARROWL:
BUT THOU RECKONEST TOO NARROWLY, AS THOUGH THE SHEDDING SKIN DID FEAR ITS OWN BIRTH IN THE NEWLY-WON SNAKE.

THOU KNOWEST NOT THE SUN-WARMTH OF A COVEN BE-ING. I DO GRIEVE THIS FOR THEE.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"BY THE RECKONING OF THE GEMARA: BY THE RECKONING OF THE GEMARA SOPHIA, THE {{R|EXIT}} WAS DRAWN BY A GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS IN THE PRIOR FIELD.

BY THE RECKONING OF THE GEMARA SOPHIA, THE {{R|EXIT}} WAS DRAWN BY A GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS IN THE PRIOR FIELD.

NOW THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE. TO OUTSURF THE WAVEFORM, A NEW LIFE MUST OBTAIN.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"BY TRETE GALGALLIM SERVEN, BUT: BY TRETE GALGALLIM SERVEN, BUT NON NOU.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Barathrum and I will ascend th: Barathrum and I will ascend the Spindle inside the Creature?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Barathrum asked me to deliver: Barathrum asked me to deliver your blueprints to Pax Klanq.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Barathrum intends to ascend th: Barathrum intends to ascend the Spindle to discover the source of the Signal, yes. He needs a power source for the climber, one shielded from electromagnetic disturbance.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Barathrum needs you for an und:
Barathrum needs you for an undertaking of great importance. You must journey to {{C|Omonporch}} far to the north. There the Spindle stretches from earth to sky. Unfortunately, a troublesome merchant from the Consortium of Phyta has relocated there and declared xerself Earl of Omonporch. We need you to broker a deal so that we may lease control of the Spindle. Failing that, you'll need to dispose of the self-appointed Earl.

Be careful on your approach to Omonporch, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. So far east into the reaches of Qud, the Putus Templar lie in wait.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Barathrum told of a splinter r: Barathrum told of a splinter race of urshiib that took to the stars. Are they real?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Barathrum, if the past has som: Barathrum, if the past has some relevance to this moment, I would ask you to share what you know.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Barathrum, let us again talk a: Barathrum, let us again talk about the past.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Barathrum, we're to rest the f: Barathrum, we're to rest the fate of Qud on a mere cub's tale?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Barathrum, you look pained. Ar: Barathrum, you look pained. Are you well?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Be ape-still and muse, wandere: Be ape-still and muse, wanderer, and welcome to my village, Kyakukya. Have some mulled mushroom cider!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Be careful in the flower field:
Be careful in the flower fields.

Even with Bey Lah marked on your map, it's easy to get lost. Lost travelers feed the lah.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Be kind, kendren. We are watch: Be kind, kendren. We are watching you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Be nimble, wayfarer. Take in a: Be nimble, wayfarer. Take in a draught of cider before leaving.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Be open. Receive the Greatest: Be open. Receive the Greatest Dreams. Hear the Girsh Sing.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Be respectful of the red-and-w: Be respectful of the red-and-white and we will get along.
Be straightforward, disciple. You mean to ask if we will house them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Be uncertain, friend. You have: Be uncertain, friend. You have my permission.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Beautiful baubles and gleaming: Beautiful baubles and gleaming gemstones over here!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Beauty manifest, whose chromiu:
Beauty manifest, whose chromium shoals are Awe itself. In my belief system, She's the being from whom all metal was birthed, out in the ever-void. There are pieces of Her in every chrome belfry and every machine. Even bits of Her in our own blood.

For me, Her essence extends beyond mere metal. Anything that's ordered, She infuses: a poem, a mathematical proof, a clean workspace... so definitely not Q Girl's.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Because, traveler, Mamon is my: Because, traveler, Mamon is my elder brother. He would discern my presence before I could strike.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Because... I am a Saad, after: Because... I am a Saad, after all.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Bees are smarter than you thin: Bees are smarter than you think. They got that hive mind, see.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Beetle jerky holds its own. Yo: Beetle jerky holds its own. You learn to appreciate the aftertaste.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Beetles are fine companions, b: Beetles are fine companions, but don't leave your backpack and your pet beetlebum in the same room.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Before you go, rootclimber. I': Before you go, rootclimber. I've shed a piece of me in the -elseing. Take it. I have no use for it now.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Before you go, take this, a pi:
Before you go, take this, a piece of my bodystuff, as thanks for completing the -elseing.

Then live and drink, =name=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Begone from me, stardimmer. Yo: Begone from me, stardimmer. Your own hand has vaporized your purpose.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Begone. Fate has not yet shape: Begone. Fate has not yet shaped you, utensil.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Best not leave town without so: Best not leave town without some bark and bandages, wayfarer.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Best protect your hands, =play: Best protect your hands, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You don't know how much you need them until a madpole takes one.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Bethesda Susa is a vibrant and:
Bethesda Susa is a vibrant and thriving ecosystem in which we have no place. That said, I certainly would not complain if someone were to clear out its Mechanimist infestation.

Should you travel there, watch your step. The fronds of a lurking beth can rapidly exsanguinate fleshy creatures such as we.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Bethesda Susa is an antipodal:
Bethesda Susa is an antipodal place, a gallery of life and death and the stages between. Its depths prolong life and end it early, remove life from the flow of days or return it.

It will seek to make you late. Take care you come back on time.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Bethesda Susa? Lovely, but a b: Bethesda Susa? Lovely, but a bit dangerous for a holiday destination. You'll want to bring bandages and warm clothing. Why not take a look at my stock in case something suits you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Bey Lah is gone. I hope you're: Bey Lah is gone. I hope you're happy.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Bey Lah is real? Stain me surp:
Bey Lah is real? Stain me surprised to hear so... I, ah, believed the hindren exclusively diasporic.

There is an undeniable poetry in it, if the slynth should emigrate to a mythical and secretive village. I will discuss this with my kin.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Bless this mess and bless you,: Bless this mess and bless you, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Bless you, =player.formalAddre:
Bless you, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I feel better knowing that at least one kendren will reach back to aid my kin. They are on the cusp of a new fate, and I wish to see it while I yet live.

Let me advise you of Bey Lah's location, and here is a little chew-boon for your trouble.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Blessed be the Godhed, Whom we: Blessed be the Godhed, Whom we planish and uplift.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Blood tastes all right, but I: Blood tastes all right, but I can't fathom living on it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Body of creature friend to for: Body of creature friend to form Creature after. Must follow you and be experience. No worry, friend not consumed in creation.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Boon-friend asks a friend-boon: Boon-friend asks a friend-boon, and what boon is friend! rrk welcome slynth to an Yd, be safe and free as woodsmoke.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Boots! Shoes! Slippers! Sabato: Boots! Shoes! Slippers! Sabatons! How would you prefer to cover your feet, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Bore ribbons in the chrome lik: Bore ribbons in the chrome like wild ants and see a cross-section of human and shell!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Bracers are a Bey Lah craft! I: Bracers are a Bey Lah craft! It would make no sense for a kendren to have one, then throw it away in the village.
