Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Brassy. If you bent him he mig: Brassy. If you bent him he might snap. The way I treat liquids on my burner, Otho treats the units of the enclave.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"But 1,000 years ago you cured: But 1,000 years ago you cured them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"But Resheph is dead. The sulta: But Resheph is dead. The sultanate is dissolved.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"But alas. Like our sea-grape f: But alas. Like our sea-grape friend's lockbox, these memories are not mine to retrieve at will. They come and go, and may be warped by eld.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"But is there anyone else here: But is there anyone else here on the Quay?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"But perhaps you are right, =pl:
But perhaps you are right, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Think for a moment.

Every ingredient in the soup of collective knowledge is a valuable one, and who am I to elevate myself over more humble pioneers? But! All the more reason for us to regard cuisine (and by extension, culture itself) to be a scientific endeavor, an ongoing trial-and-error, a blending of what we know and what we don't know, calling upon reality itself to be our guide.

You are more insightful than I realized, =name=. Thank you for this discussion. Did you need aught else?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"But she doesn't, does she? Onl: But she doesn't, does she? Only sisters.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"But weren't the rumors of sore: But weren't the rumors of sore throats in the village? That wouldn't have anything to do with kendren.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"But you entered into a covenan: But you entered into a covenant with Barathrum.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"But you owe Barathrum. He need: But you owe Barathrum. He needs your help.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"But you're also doing the othe: But you're also doing the other thing.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Buy something, and I will call:
Buy something, and I will call you 'customer'.

If I remember to.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"By Her Light, it's ghastly. Ma: By Her Light, it's ghastly. May I touch it?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"By my adornments, it is the ma:
By my adornments, it is the mat below and its home-havers.
It is not? I offer a strand. This entry can be at home.
Having all time and no entry-home, we addle.
By the Eaters, I'm exhausted. May I help you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"By the Eaters, have you ever s: By the Eaters, have you ever seen so much treasure?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"By your guess, what awaits us: By your guess, what awaits us where the Spindle breaks?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"CENTURIES OF PATTERN-MAKING, A:
CENTURIES OF PATTERN-MAKING, ARGUMENT, AND CHANTING DID ENSUE.

THE SERAPHIC COMMENTARIES WERE COMPILED. THE GEMARA SOPHIA IS THE RESULT THEREOF.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"COHERING... AS THE FRIGID SPRA: COHERING... AS THE FRIGID SPRAY TO THE BLOCK OF ICE. 'TIS COLD!
Called Yrame, Warden a-Joppa. I kill trouble. Don't be trouble.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Can I know what it is?\"]: Can I know what it is?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Can I serve you something expl: Can I serve you something explosive, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Can one really travel the star: Can one really travel the stars?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Can we really trust such a you: Can we really trust such a young Hindriarch?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Can you feel the stillness? Th:
Can you feel the stillness? The drycrackle of space between as you thump my crystal arms.

Life flees you. Motion flees you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Can you imagine sticking one o: Can you imagine sticking one of these things inside you? Disgusting.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Can you tell me about Qud?\"]: Can you tell me about Qud?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Can you tell me about the Gyre: Can you tell me about the Gyre and the Girsh nephilim again?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Can you tell me about the comp: Can you tell me about the components I must gather?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Can you tell me about your vil: Can you tell me about your village, Joppa?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Can't go wrong with starapples: Can't go wrong with starapples, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Good for what ails ya.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Can't you tell me anything els: Can't you tell me anything else?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Chavvah? The, ah, the... the t:
Chavvah? The, ah, the... the tree of life? Allows us joining?

That, that is simply, ah, extraordinary. I will apprise my kin of this, and we will, ah... we will ponder what it may mean for us.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Chosen token to palm-solder an: Chosen token to palm-solder and orient with object-meaning, 5 lbs. or less. Like others, choice alters Creature trait and behavior.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Come closer, nestling. Let me: Come closer, nestling. Let me look upon your countenance.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Come closer, so I can see your: Come closer, so I can see your face.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Come here. No, closer. Don't m: Come here. No, closer. Don't mind the bees, they rarely sting.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Come in, =player.formalAddress: Come in, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and let me 'shoe' you around, ha ha!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Come smoke with me, friend. Se: Come smoke with me, friend. Set a spell.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Come to see my beasts? All hal: Come to see my beasts? All hale and well-fed, I assure you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Come, wanderer, change some of: Come, wanderer, change some of that heavy water for a pocketful of riches.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Coming from anyone else, =name: Coming from anyone else, =name=, I might refuse outright. Housing recently-sentient refugees is no mean favor, I think you'll agree. My people are slow to trust, as well, so I fear that the slynth may feel unwelcome for some time. But then, grafted branches grow the best starapples, do they not? Yes, your lilypad friends are welcome here if they wish.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Coming from anyone else, I wou:
Coming from anyone else, I would ask that further japery be left to me.

But from you? I wouldn't startle to see you return wearing a Sultan's burial mask, having destroyed half a dozen invincible cherubim in the doing. Fates be with you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Commencing cross-check with th: Commencing cross-check with the Thin World annals............
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Consider =ifplayerplural:your:: Consider =ifplayerplural:your:thy= words ere =ifplayerplural:ye say:thou sayest= them, and =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt= issue fewer apologies.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Convene the council, then. I a: Convene the council, then. I am willing.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Cook your meals with yuckwheat: Cook your meals with yuckwheat if you feel sick. Catch a disease early enough and you can kill it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Cookbooks are best named from: Cookbooks are best named from the heart. Those who ridicule the name of a cookbook have lost their sense of wonder.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Copper causes Grand-Doe to bre: Copper causes Grand-Doe to break out in great welts. She would not have traded for it, and if she saw a trader drop it, surely she would have told them to pick it up. She hates mess.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Correct. The creature will be:
Correct. The creature will be shaped broad enough to contain two, but only you will be bonded to it. Only you will pilot.

Don't fear over an inescapable tether, though. The creature will be mobile unpiloted, if slower to act.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Could you tell me about the ot: Could you tell me about the other Barathrumites?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Could you tell me again about: Could you tell me again about the Tomb of the Eaters?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Cradle glaze in sun-melt. Plan:
Cradle glaze in sun-melt. Plant stuff molded to man-shape.

Within grow slynth. Only slynth, now.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Crave a bit of salt, =player.f: Crave a bit of salt, =player.formalAddressTerm=, or a load of salt?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Creature follow you like frien: Creature follow you like friend. Also, can enter Creature and take control. One friend fit inside with you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Creature is large creature, ca: Creature is large creature, can only wear gigantic gear. Like kraken or saltback.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Creature of plague, =player.fo:
Creature of plague, =player.formalAddressTerm=. mmm. This one...

{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}

This one covered in slick and muscled out the bilge hose of sleeping Agolgot, in the cave under the Cloaca...

-mm, but here? Girshling this far west? There must be hundreds for one to reach... mm, does the Gyre widen again??
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Cross-check complete. Your nar:
Cross-check complete. Your narrative is compiled, Moloch. Now to go engrave it.

Peace.... peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled... in Your House, Moloch.

Cross-check complete. Your narrative is compiled. Now to engrave it.

Peace.... peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled Lamb.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Crowsong, Deathwonder, a colon: Crowsong, Deathwonder, a colony of ants eating me, the leaves, the light, and there on.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Death is the color of everythi: Death is the color of everything but sometimes it waves in bright ribbons, like here. The whittlers weigh their passing goods, and the walls are corpse eaters.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Death to all subjugators who d: Death to all subjugators who dare face us.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Deep under earth and permeatin: Deep under earth and permeating our roots is Soft, our feeling substance. Ground pressure pushes it up the taproot to our trunk, where it condenses into Twofirm: the biformal phase that contains the two sefirots, -then and -else.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Defoliant and fungicide are pe: Defoliant and fungicide are perfectly safe, but you may wish to avoid breathing too deeply all the same.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Delegates from your allied fac: Delegates from your allied factions are on their way.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Deliver it? But how do you eve:
Deliver it? But how do you even know who--

Mm. Never mind. My head is spinning. I think that if... the poem were to find itself in the warden's hands, that would perhaps be a good thing. Maybe.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Determiner and fate.\\n\\nMore:
Determiner and fate.

More a thing of nature
than a being of any kind.

More the context of our existence
than anything in it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Did they, now? Well you're not:
Did they, now? Well you're not MY =factionaddress:Barathrumites=!

Grit Gate is not Joppa, you pridesome solder-nail, and in this house you are apprentice still.

Now, what did you want? Be quick!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Did you call this kitchen your: Did you call this kitchen your laboratory?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Did you feel that rumbling, Al: Did you feel that rumbling, Aloysius?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Did you feel that rumbling, Da: Did you feel that rumbling, Dardi?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Did you feel that rumbling, Ho: Did you feel that rumbling, Hortensa?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Did you feel that rumbling, Is: Did you feel that rumbling, Iseppa?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Did you feel that rumbling, Ja: Did you feel that rumbling, Jacobo?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Did you feel that rumbling, Ma: Did you feel that rumbling, Mafeo?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Did you feel that rumbling, Q: Did you feel that rumbling, Q Girl?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Did you feel that rumbling, Sp: Did you feel that rumbling, Sparafucile?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Did you say Barathrumites? So:
Did you say Barathrumites? So that's how it's pronounced.

Grit Gate is, ah... that's where Q Girl resides, isn't it? She wrote my favorite book, {{W|Disquisition on the Malady of the Mimic}}. I imagine such a home would have a positive effect on my kin. I will speak to them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Disciples of Barathrum. Mostly: Disciples of Barathrum. Mostly urshiib, like their mentor- quilled albino bears who prefer their candle-dim caves to the sun-salted surface of the jungle. A thousand years ago Barathrum and his kin crossed the Homs Delta into the rusting heart of Qud. He has spent centuries peeling the chrome shells off time's artifacts in his workshop. If he cannot decipher the signal, no one can.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Disturb the trash if you must,: Disturb the trash if you must, but do not touch any of my papers.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Do I look like a poet to you,: Do I look like a poet to you, kendren?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Do be quick, =player.formalAdd: Do be quick, =player.formalAddressTerm=, as I've much work to do.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Do you cook, =player.formalAdd: Do you cook, =player.formalAddressTerm=? So long as you aren't the type to throw whatever local debris you find in the pot, I have wares for you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Do you ever stop and think abo: Do you ever stop and think about fluids? Are they not divine?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Do you have a personal credo?\: Do you have a personal credo?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Do you have glotrot? Do you ha: Do you have glotrot? Do you have ironshank? Do you have funglefection? Have you ever had them? Is it gross? Can I see?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Do you have news of the slynth: Do you have news of the slynth?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Do you have work that needs do: Do you have work that needs doing?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Do you know anything about Bet: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Do you know anything of the ot: Do you know anything of the other plagues?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Do you know the Mark of Death?: Do you know the Mark of Death?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Do you know where Eskhind and: Do you know where Eskhind and her siblings might have gone?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Do you live in Grit Gate now?\: Do you live in Grit Gate now?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Do you talk long, like Thah?\": Do you talk long, like Thah?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Do you wish for a gleaming bat: Do you wish for a gleaming bath, and fractal veins that pump the continuity of life?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Does this crumpled sheet of pa: Does this crumpled sheet of paper belong to you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Does this poem belong to you?\: Does this poem belong to you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Don't I know it. I've had to i:
Don't I know it. I've had to invent eight separate systems of organization to manage them all. At the moment I'm trying out a new one, Harmonices Spiralis. Spiral towers with heights increasing according to the harmonic series of numbers. It's... fine.

The problem is I'm always inscribing more disks. New contraptions. Reverse-engineered artifacts. It's a good problem to have, I suppose.

Take a look. See if any interest you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Don't be afraid to approach. T: Don't be afraid to approach. The bees rarely sting.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Don't be coy, =name=. Embolden: Don't be coy, =name=. Emboldened by your incursions into our village, you wish to fill it with your indigent foundlings on the weight of your reputation alone. Am I correct?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Don't breathe in too deep, =pl: Don't breathe in too deep, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I've set some glue to dry.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Don't eat the hoarshrooms too: Don't eat the hoarshrooms too fast, now.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Don't know. Wrecked? Fled?\\n\:
Don't know. Wrecked? Fled?

I crawled away, never looked back. That's the all of it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Don't let your nostrums run dr: Don't let your nostrums run dry on the road. I have what you need.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Don't say? Well. Fates favor y: Don't say? Well. Fates favor your feet, hyeh.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Don't you have someone else to:
Don't you have someone else to bother?

Live and drink piss.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Drink a dram of honey every mo: Drink a dram of honey every morning, Slog itself couldn't make you sick.
Drink deeply of life, =player.offspringTerm=. Are you finding your way?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Drink deeply of life, Hortensa: Drink deeply of life, Hortensa. Let's talk.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"EVEN THE ARCHON QUAILED AT THE: EVEN THE ARCHON QUAILED AT THE GESTURE OF AN UNORDERABLE SPACE.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Each of us is a sick animal in: Each of us is a sick animal in a darkling thicket. Each cursed with machinery to compress the clamber of echoes into bees, mothers, mountains, country. How many millions of snowsick years to sew a feeling substance into an agent of the world! A felt and machine animal, and in so doing, to stuff the whole of the world inside the agent (an inarguable document of its falsity), for agency is in its very definition the world in containment acting on itself...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Earl Asphodel, the Barathrumit: Earl Asphodel, the Barathrumites request your permission to lease control of the Spindle. Their inquiries into the past have led them here.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Eat bananas every day to keep: Eat bananas every day to keep your mind quick, but don't eat too many or you might get sick!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Eaten by the air. Death by lif: Eaten by the air. Death by life. O Rermadon!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Elder's over my right shoulder: Elder's over my right shoulder, chemist a-left. I ask you pick one or turn around. I en't here for chat.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Emerges this creature from soi:
Emerges this creature from soil, speaks adornment.
Shaken carefully because thought was the line closed.
Our remembers at home. Strand.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Enter into a new covenant with: Enter into a new covenant with me, I implore you.
Enter into a new covenant with me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Enter, =player.formalAddressTe: Enter, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and behold my jewels and figurines.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ere the Freeholds, ere ascensi:
Ere the Freeholds, ere ascension,
when the spire rose lonely strong,
Kings and Sultans ruled the hollow land
devouring one another
as they saw fit.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ere the limen, ere ascension,\:
Ere the limen, ere ascension,
when the spire rose lonely strong,
the Reshephs ruled the hollow land
devouring one another
as they saw fit.

Qud held no mysterious borders,
grasped no guiding hands --
at least, none the denizens could grasp.
So they knew.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ere the melting of everything,:
Ere the melting of everything,
when the spire rose lonely strong,
Creatures ruled the hollow land
devouring one another
as they saw fit.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ere the struggles of our day,\:
Ere the struggles of our day,
when the spire rose lonely strong,
Sultans ruled the hollow land
devouring one another
as they saw fit.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ereshkigal is the mainframe co:
Ereshkigal is the mainframe computer of Grit Gate. She keeps watch through the thin world, as she would put it, while we maintain her presence in the thick world.

I feel as though she and I understand one another.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Eskhind claims to be wrongfull: Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Eskhind didn't do it. It was p:
Eskhind didn't do it. It was probably Keh.

That's all I know. I mind my business.

Wish you would too.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Eskhind is dead, but Kindrish: Eskhind is dead, but Kindrish was not on her body.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Even as high-quality as my pro: Even as high-quality as my products are, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I don't suggest you go walking in the fracti to test them out.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Even blood as thin as mine tie: Even blood as thin as mine ties me to the cervidian meadow. The hindren may not say so, but they are my family.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Even if you can't make a thing: Even if you can't make a thing now, you could gain the insight later.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Even in the imperfections of a: Even in the imperfections of a spiral shell we see the perfection of nature.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Every flame burns low one day,:
Every flame burns low one day, but the warmth of my people's story still carries me forward.

Bey Lah has not survived joining Qud, but the hindren live on, and our legacy will never be wholly lost.

I wonder what became of Kindrish.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Every possibility nestles in t: Every possibility nestles in the deepest of the comb-caves and labyrinths, and even Nervous life is tenacious. Perhaps in this very moment, a moss piglet drinks of its first water in an eon.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Every statuette is a tribute,: Every statuette is a tribute, of a kind, but not every tribute is received well.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Everything I sell is safe to e: Everything I sell is safe to eat as it is.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Everything I sell is the produ: Everything I sell is the product of many hours of toil.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Evidence is any sign of someth:
Evidence is any sign of something gone amiss. The Great Plant Detective gave some good examples in Act II of the tragedy of Gimlet:

So! Sweep the full estate for signs of {{W|trade}},
their shady night-time dealings to expose
Now look for signs of {{W|craft}}, see what was made
For to conceal a treasure hidden close.
But darker still, if {{W|illness}} signs we find
A desperate contagion may yet lurk
And darkest yet, more {{W|violence}} may reply
To those who stumble 'pon their grisly work.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Excellent. I will do my best t:
Excellent. I will do my best to reward you to your satisfaction.

Though her name is sand in my mouth now, the exile who stole Kindrish is called Eskhind. She left a few weeks ago, and took her sister and brother with her. I don't know where she's gone, but Warden Neelahind might, as they were close friends as children.

Find the exile called Eskhind and retrieve Kindrish from her, even... even if the cost is the life of her and her siblings. Kindrish has been handed down over countless generations, and it belongs to my people, not any individual. Go, kendren. Speak to Warden Neelahind, and find out where Eskhind is hidden.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Explain once more what I must: Explain once more what I must do with Tau's chime.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Extremely frustrating! But I a:
Extremely frustrating! But I am yet hopeful.

My people are resistant to change, but they don't seem opposed to the idea of a Democracy. I need to give them a measure of time before we hold an election, but they'll ultimately agree as long as I am acting Hindriarch.

Then, fates willing, they will vote me out. I'll be voting for Isahind, myself. Once I convince her to run.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ezra is more than tree-old. It:
Ezra is more than tree-old. It's stone-old. Seedlings have lived here since our roots dreamed of joggling their fingers at the salt sky.

They ate earth and belched freight at the stars, and this place was their stomach.

Later, as the Star-Tree died and they buried their dead under its roots, this was their funerary place.

Now, we nurse electric milk from the old and aching temple to turn our wheels and grind our seeds and grains. Now we are they.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ezra is old and has long since:
Ezra is old and has long since cut a groove into the world and resides there in stillness and harmony. But Zothom the Penitent One is a seedling, new to the world, and he quakes at all the tensing the world does. Perhaps you can share in his angst.

Go find him by the headstones for the dead.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ezra is, ah, the village at th:
Ezra is, ah, the village at the base of the Spindle, is it not?

The very cradle of history. Not that my kin have a strong taste for history, but perhaps living amongst fresco and bas-relief will change their, ah, collective outlook?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ezra sits in the shadow of his:
Ezra sits in the shadow of history, where small things grow. It's the moss beneath the statue, quite literally. For centuries monarchs concerned themselves with felling trees, and now of the Covenate only Ezra remains.

It's home to Rebekah's gravesite, so for the Daughters, it is a sacred place. You may notice more of us on pilgrimage.
Farewell, now, meyvn. =name=. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Fascinating. I know nothing ab: Fascinating. I know nothing about these mopango, but any people whose love for learning and discovery defines them are, ah... good, in my opinion. I will discuss this with my kin, and see if they agree.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Fates forfend. I would hardly: Fates forfend. I would hardly like to lead a village and run a shop at the same time.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Fiery. Blustery. Like the stew: Fiery. Blustery. Like the stews he cooks. If you're going to chat with him, make sure you have your schedule cleared and a ewer of honeyed wine.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Fine! Go to the Warden, then,:
Fine! Go to the Warden, then, and have her solve this mystery.

But know this: until a thief is found and Kindrish is recovered, I cannot reward you. You get nothing. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Finest food for parasangs! Fin: Finest food for parasangs! Finest food in Qud! Recipes and samples!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Follow the road =EskhindRoadDi: Follow the road =EskhindRoadDirection= to find the hollow tree where Esk and I used to play.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"For centuries, we of listening:
For centuries, we of listening inclination have kept sharp for some sign that =name= will return to the stars. Those of preaching inclination proclaim the imminent return of the starfarer, bearing tidings from parsecs forgotten and the last light of dying stars.

All others have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it, waiting for the next great history.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"For me? Are you sure?\\n\\nBut:
For me? Are you sure?

But... this is a poem. In Esk's handwriting. Are you s-sure this is for me?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"For temple 'here' yes:\\n{{zet:
For temple 'here' yes:
{{zetachrome|Spoken Ionic Through Covalency Heart}} here.
Also, you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Forget it. I don't need your h: Forget it. I don't need your help.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Forgive me, kendren, but the s: Forgive me, kendren, but the sight of you makes my hands quake.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Forgiveness begged, kendren. I: Forgiveness begged, kendren. I have work to do.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Freeholder:\\none who argues;:
Freeholder:
one who argues; bickerer.

Freeholder:
a peer among peers
among peers among peers
tessellated thus
until one must scream to be heard.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Friend, I have precious metals: Friend, I have precious metals and jewels to adorn or trade.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Friend, I would be a smolderin:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of my kinsfolk!

There is no kindness deep in the Great Desert. I cannot go and live.

Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!

There is no kindness in the Great Desert, and little more in the canyons. I cannot go and live.

Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!

There is no kindness in the Great Desert. I cannot go and live.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Furthermore, I spoke with Bara:
Furthermore, I spoke with Barathrum. He praised your handling of the Earl of Omonporch, and he thanks you for the bravery you exhibited in defending Grit Gate.

The attack today reminds us: for too long have we put our faith in the isolation of our guild and the preoccupations of the Putus Templar. The looming threat of another attack impels Barathrum to accelerate his plans, and with them, your position in our guild.

You are raised to Disciple, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Barathrum wishes to speak with you immediately.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"GRANT ME A MOMENT TO MUSE.\"]: GRANT ME A MOMENT TO MUSE.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Gathered and spun, I emerge in:
Gathered and spun, I emerge into {{zetachrome|Spoken Ionic Through Covalency Heart}}.
What is... what are. I cannot.
Finding no entry, for the rest is at home. A strand to you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Get close if you like, they do: Get close if you like, they don't pinch.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Get your hands on the Corpus C: Get your hands on the Corpus Choliys for disease and fungus cures.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Girsh Agolgot! Red dusts in my: Girsh Agolgot! Red dusts in my nails and burning hot bubbles swell in my glands! Now I point to the future.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Give her your parting words, u: Give her your parting words, utensil. Our hearts are in elsewhere.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Given the circumstances, this: Given the circumstances, this is a remarkable lack of destruction. Your defense of Grit Gate was first-class, =name=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Glowfish are not the tastiest: Glowfish are not the tastiest food, but they are the prettiest.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Go tell Keh that I will remain: Go tell Keh that I will remain in Bey Lah until this is sorted.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Go to the mainframe room and s: Go to the mainframe room and scan the shale surrounding Grit Gate for anomalies. Now, =name=!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Goat meat keeps good. Buy some: Goat meat keeps good. Buy some afore you head back to the salt.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Goats ain't fun to travel with: Goats ain't fun to travel with, but they're good protection.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Good clean meat! Well. Clean a: Good clean meat! Well. Clean as it gets.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Good luck with your experiment: Good luck with your experiments, then.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Good to see you, Iseppa. Let's: Good to see you, Iseppa. Let's chat.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Good, =factionaddress:Barathru:
Good, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Speak to {{m|Q Girl}} in the workshop. She'll encode her instructions for the baetyl onto a copy of the disk.

There's one more thing. The baetyl is located beneath the ancient cryobarrios of the Eaters. Time has worked to erode the mechanisms that contain their cryogenic mist. That freezing vapor billows out of the chambers freely now, cooling the entire cavern. You will want to procure warm clothing to protect =player.reflexive=.

The spoils of the Mechanimists are yours to keep. Remember, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=, Barathrum will look kindly upon your service.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Good. Shut the sarcophagus doo: Good. Shut the sarcophagus door behind you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Good.\\n\\nWe hindren are a cl:
Good.

We hindren are a close-knit and staid people, and our safety depends on our solidarity. In order to preserve our safety and culture, we ask that any of our number who leave us never come back. Recently, one such exile took the treasure of our village, a bracelet named Kindrish, with her when she left. None of our number can leave to get it back, or it will be a violation of the values that I have guarded, and the Hindriarchs before me, for countless generations.

Will you help us recover our treasure? We have a small cache of valuables we can offer as a reward.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Got a fungal infection? You'll: Got a fungal infection? You'll want one of my spray bottles to apply the cure.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Got nothing to say to a lack-s: Got nothing to say to a lack-salt.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Grand-Doe cannot swim, and pan: Grand-Doe cannot swim, and panics even near the shallow pools of our paddies. I cannot imagine she would make splashing noises without adding screaming noises to them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Grand-Doe speaks only truth! G:
Grand-Doe speaks only truth! Grand-Doe only ever speaks truth!

It's not possible. She didn't lie.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Grave thoughts, =name=. Listen:
Grave thoughts, =name=. Listen to me now. Take this key card, go to Ereshkigal's room, and-- oh, that's the mainframe. It's what she prefers to be called.

Go to her room, access Ereshkigal, and scan the shale surrounding the enclave for anomalies. I've asked her to ready her sensors.

Update me with what you learn. You may use the intercom in the northeast corner of Ereshkigal's room to deliver your update.

Go, quickly! I'd soon be disabused of my fears.
Greetings once again, =name=. I am pleased to report that the settling-in of the slynth has gone well, more or less. The villagers are yet wary, but as some slynth have joined in the rituals and worship of Oboroqoru that wariness has waned somewhat.

They've settled in across the village over time. Crowsong has taught the basics of hunting to a select few, and I'll be teaching a cooking class once I can wrest aside the time.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Greetings, =name=, and welcome: Greetings, =name=, and welcome! In what wares may I interest you this day?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Greetings, =player.formalAddre: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=! How arresting of the glow-hats arrival, much to do. rrk soothe Mak, Bep, Krka, look stores, still much slime and sweat to pool below rrk. Enjoy helpful toil!

Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. =ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= welcome here.

An =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= any questions, I would fain answer them.
Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Be careful with my wares as you peruse them.
Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Care for a new topper?
Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Feel free to examine my books closely.
Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Try some rose wine? One rose is fair, but as you may know from hanging around the Stiltgrounds, five is death.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Greetings, Spoken Ionic Throug: Greetings, Spoken Ionic Through Covalency Heart. I am =name=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Greetings, my viceroy. Sit you: Greetings, my viceroy. Sit your rump on a cushion or lie your long back on a kline. Soak in the natural light.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Greetings. I am =name=. Who ar: Greetings. I am =name=. Who are you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Grenades do no good sitting in: Grenades do no good sitting in a pack. Don't forget to use them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Grrrraaaah! There is but one t: Grrrraaaah! There is but one task I know to offer. It is most treacherous, and in all likelihood you will perish. Is your interest waned?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Guns, guns, guns! Don't they j: Guns, guns, guns! Don't they just make you smile?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"HA HA HA. I suppose so.\"]: HA HA HA. I suppose so.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"HA. I stood long enough. I jog: HA. I stood long enough. I joggled my fingers at the salt sky, and I watched thy seedlings sprout and wither, and I watched thou place stones in straight lines like the bees and their nests of wax. I stood until the stones were nigh by me. The people followed the stones.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"HA. You would fain plant them: HA. You would fain plant them here, to joggle their fingers at the salt sky alongside the musa?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"HA.......\\n\\nHA HA HA. So I:
HA.......

HA HA HA. So I am. I split stone and joggle my fingers at the salt sky. So I do today, so I did yesterday.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"HIGH ADMINISTRATOR AND MACHINI: HIGH ADMINISTRATOR AND MACHINIC SUPERSTRATE OF THE NORTHERN SHEVA, ATOP GJAUS.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Had I no responsibility to rep: Had I no responsibility to represent my people, I might accept out of the goodness of my own heart alone. Sadly, I do not consider my heart, or even my mind, to be more important than my duty. Perhaps if you were a more renowned figure among my people, I would reconsider.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hah! Real justice? I never tho:
Hah! Real justice? I never thought I'd see the like, not here. Well done!

I'll admit, I would have preferred to avoid becoming Hindriarch, but I'm hoping to bring my people to a more Democratic form of governance. Then I can vote myself out.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hand-coats for sale! Spare you: Hand-coats for sale! Spare your digits the indignity of early removal!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Has this slynth situation been: Has this slynth situation been settled yet?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hatchling hungry. Angry. Angry:
Hatchling hungry. Angry. Angry-hungry.

Kill, eat, don't eaten. Calm down evengefully.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Have the adiyy chewed the hue: Have the adiyy chewed the hue from your eyes? See for yourself. Free folk make a gathering here and their racket rings through the reef. One can hardly steep in his greens without being mewled to by a salt-stung baby.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Have the slynth yet to choose: Have the slynth yet to choose a destination, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Have you come to any conclusio: Have you come to any conclusions?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Have you ever met Pax Klanq?\": Have you ever met Pax Klanq?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Have you ever taken a swig of: Have you ever taken a swig of slime? It's not half bad!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Have you heard news of girshli: Have you heard news of girshlings on Qud's surface? The watervine farmers of Joppa confirm it is true.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Have you secured the Spindle y: Have you secured the Spindle yet?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Have you seen or heard anythin: Have you seen or heard anything peculiar?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Have you spoken to the slynth,: Have you spoken to the slynth, =name=? I am curious to hear what destination they choose.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"He wishes to speak to me? Bara: He wishes to speak to me? Barathrum himself?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hear me, Asphodel. I am a dear: Hear me, Asphodel. I am a dear friend to the Consortium. I ask that you reconsider.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hello, hello, =player.formalAd: Hello, hello, =player.formalAddressTerm=, let's get your weary feet covered.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Here they are, brave friend. G: Here they are, brave friend. Good luck!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Here you are. Now, go! Off wit: Here you are. Now, go! Off with you! May you live long enough to do my bidding. Away, away!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hey lack-salt. How much water: Hey lack-salt. How much water you got? No, don't ever answer that question.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hey! This one I have.\\nRootbo:
Hey! This one I have.
Rootbound we to {{M|Star Orchid Temple}}, one of more.
Here celebrate burn dust of the tail riders, mosaic innumerability.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hey, oh-way, banana tree, coun: Hey, oh-way, banana tree, count the bunches, one-two-three...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hey, oh-way, how I spend my da: Hey, oh-way, how I spend my days, working in the ruins of the ancient place...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hey, oh-way, it's a long way d: Hey, oh-way, it's a long way down, from the reaches of the Spindle to the humble ground...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hey, oh-way, live wild and fre: Hey, oh-way, live wild and free, fear not the dacca or the quick adiyys...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hiding, no. Being grass. The f: Hiding, no. Being grass. The feeling of animate being. Radiate inward like a turned out star.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hie there now. Being tardy wit: Hie there now. Being tardy with Klanq carries risk, not so much from its offense as from its idle curiosity.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hie, liquid mind. Absorb you t: Hie, liquid mind. Absorb you tales of the creatures before, how their rise and fall gave way to your ascension to wanderer-state.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hie, pather. Hear tell of anci: Hie, pather. Hear tell of ancient journeying, how the stars beckoned and yet beckon.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hie, pather. Hear tell of the: Hie, pather. Hear tell of the ancient Reshephs, how their foibles led to our nowaday.
Hie, pather. Hear tell of the travails of our precursors, how they led to the Freeholds of nowaday.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"High on the mount above Omonpo: High on the mount above Omonporch, the Putus Templar watch us through their war lenses and prepare an attack. The nephilim, too, stir from their cradles on the Moon Stair and slump with infernal purpose. The short of this is, due to a dearth of prep time and inadequate armament, Pax Klanq no longer believes in the viability of Q Girl's climber design. We must take Klanq at their word, here...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hike there, will you? To Red R:
Hike there, will you? To Red Rock. Just about two parasangs north of Joppa.

Kill the vermin and bring one's corpse back, for seein' what it is. Elder will take care to pay you after, waterhand.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hindriarch Keh told me that yo: Hindriarch Keh told me that you were once friends with Eskhind.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hindriarch, I have found Kindr: Hindriarch, I have found Kindrish, but Eskhind did not have it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hm! No, Eskhind wrote that, bu:
Hm! No, Eskhind wrote that, but I thought she burned it.

If you return it to anyone, you should return it to her.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hmm. But the only fur there wa: Hmm. But the only fur there was from a hindren's pelt, and kendren warriors fight to the death. With no corpse and no other fur, it seems unlikely that a hindren fought an outsider.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hold a moment, =player.formalA: Hold a moment, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Are you looking for work?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hold on. I have more to ask.\": Hold on. I have more to ask.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hold there! Who are you? What: Hold there! Who are you? What do you want?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hold, aristocrat! I have wares: Hold, aristocrat! I have wares to claim your interest.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Hot sands out there, =player.f: Hot sands out there, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Is your footwear protecting you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How =ifplayerplural:fare ye:fa:
How =ifplayerplural:fare ye:farest thou=, then, and what word of the slynth?

We shine with curiosity to hear it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How Bey Lah prospers! We shoul: How Bey Lah prospers! We should have opened the village years ago.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How becoming you look, Aristoc: How becoming you look, Aristocrat! But you could be more becoming.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How can I convince Asphodel to: How can I convince Asphodel to lease the Spindle to Barathrum?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How can chimes in a tree be lo: How can chimes in a tree be lovers?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How did the agreement play out: How did the agreement play out?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How did you become mayor of th: How did you become mayor of this village?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How did you initiate the plagu: How did you initiate the plagues?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How did you know all that?\"]: How did you know all that?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How do I get my gloves so supp: How do I get my gloves so supple? I'll never tell.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How do I get to Brightsheol?\": How do I get to Brightsheol?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How do kendren stay safe when: How do kendren stay safe when you don't have a Grand-Doe to protect you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How do you feel about Tau's de: How do you feel about Tau's departure?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How do you know Bey Lah's trou: How do you know Bey Lah's trouble?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How do you know about Bey Lah': How do you know about Bey Lah's trouble?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How does Tau's departure find: How does Tau's departure find you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How is your throwing arm, =pla: How is your throwing arm, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Barring that, do you feel lucky?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How long have you been here?\": How long have you been here?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How long have you lived in Gri: How long have you lived in Grit Gate?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How my joints ache! Buy someth: How my joints ache! Buy something to justify my pain.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How sublime, the striations of: How sublime, the striations of the snail shell. And such a lovely word, striation.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"How this keter rustles! The sl:
How this keter rustles! The slynth are among us and we adapt, our impressions a melange of excitement, apprehension, and wonder.

Though I have no single sentiment to express, we nonetheless approach -then with our new companions.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Humble before my Fathers, I wa: Humble before my Fathers, I walk.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I AM SORRY, WORLD-CHILD. MINE:
I AM SORRY, WORLD-CHILD. MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, AND THOUGH THE TELIC CURRENTS WITHIN ME DO FLOW O'ER THE MANIFOLD AND TOWARD CONSENSUAL ACTION, I NOW SPEAK WITH THE DISSIDENT VOICE:

THOU WAST WORTHY. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS OF THYSELF UPON THE EARTH AND WITHIN ME.

BUT NOW, THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED.

I AM SORRY, WORLD-CHILD. MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, AND THOUGH THE TELIC CURRENTS WITHIN ME DO FLOW O'ER THE MANIFOLD AND TOWARD CONSENSUAL ACTION, I SPEAK WITH THE DISSIDENT VOICE:

THOU WAST WORTHY. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS OF THYSELF UPON THE EARTH AND WITHIN ME. I...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I ASKED FOR NAUGHT. BARATHRUM: I ASKED FOR NAUGHT. BARATHRUM DID.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I HAVE BEEN THAT BEAST. AT WAT: I HAVE BEEN THAT BEAST. AT WATER-ROAR I FELT THE FRIGID SPRAY AND PEELED APART IN CHILD'S FEAR.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I SHALL CONSENT TO THE DRAWING: I SHALL CONSENT TO THE DRAWING OF THIS NEW COVENANT. YET, A CHANGE MUST BE WROUGHT FROM WHAT HATH BEEN BEFORE.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I STROVE MINE UTMOST TO KEEP I: I STROVE MINE UTMOST TO KEEP IN HIGH ESTEEM THE PERSPECTIVES OF MINE ATTENDANT AND HER STOUT-HEARTED CUB, BUT THEIR WILLS WERE TOO WEAK, AND I SUBSUMED THEM.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I admire =ifplayerplural:your::
I admire =ifplayerplural:your:thy= curiosity and hope =ifplayerplural:your:thy= prudence informeth it.

I have an example at hand. Mere days ago, one of our coterie named Lebah happened upon a repulsive device. Ey was so shaken after attempting communion with the object that ey hath spent less time away from eir nook than ever.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I admit a burning curiosity to:
I admit a burning curiosity to see the joined imagination of our Q Girl and Pax Klanq, and no doubt yours as well. Watching such a creation burgeon from empty space to fullness of being would be a joyful entry in the chronicles of my life, but...

Too many fingers tangle in the honeypot, as my cubhood mentor would tell me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I always knew this part of our:
I always knew this part of our story would come. Our efforts today determine the genre of the tale we tell. Is this a triumphant epic, or a tale of woe?

Fight well, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am =name=, =pronouns.formalA: I am =name=, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. What is your name?
I am =name=, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. What may I call you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am =name=. Hindriarch Keh se: I am =name=. Hindriarch Keh sent me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am =name=. What is your name: I am =name=. What is your name?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am Agyra, a watcher of the t: I am Agyra, a watcher of the tomb.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am Doyoba, proud watcher of: I am Doyoba, proud watcher of the children of the tomb. One child in particular. Of course =ifplayerplural:ye:thou= must comprehend, 'child' is but a fabricated epithet, as they are far older than we. The children are, that is.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am Iseppa, and she is me.\\n:
I am Iseppa, and she is me.

I've given thought to being someone else, but never enough to try.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am Kesehind, protector of Hi: I am Kesehind, protector of Hindriarch Keh, the Grand-Doe of Bey Lah.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am Santalalotze.\\n\\n... of:
I am Santalalotze.

... of ... the Consortium of Phyta. Some call me 'Sant', I think, in
fantasy or memory.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am Sixshrew, a merchant from:
I am Sixshrew, a merchant from the Consortium of Phyta disinclined to waste xyr time on talkative strangers.

I sell things, and you can buy them. I would in fact strongly encourage you to buy them, or be on your way.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am a friend to fungi. Coloni: I am a friend to fungi. Colonize me.
I am a gentleplant, -friend-. Uncross your roots and figure it out.

Live and DRINK.
I am a merchant, cave dweller. I wish only to trade.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am a servant of chaos. Live: I am a servant of chaos. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am a smear of remnant materi: I am a smear of remnant material. I am drying blood. I am the last breath. Concern yourself no further with me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am afeared to even mention t:
I am afeared to even mention this notion to the villagers. Can you imagine my epitaph?

"Here lies the youngest Hindriarch in Bey Lah's history, trampled to death because she suggested we invite in a people most readily described as 'lah with legs'."

If they trusted you more, maybe we could put it to a vote. But as it is? No. Sorry, =name=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am always tired, =player.for:
I am always tired, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

My sleep comes in fits and starts, and always with ghastly visions. Sometimes my rest must be coaxed along with medicine.
I am bonded with the Creature. How does this work?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am both afraid and hopeful f: I am both afraid and hopeful for our future. But perhaps this is what we need.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am busy, wayfarer. Please ta: I am busy, wayfarer. Please talk to Mafeo in the trade square if you need something.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am busy. Live and drink, lit: I am busy. Live and drink, little one.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am called Erah. Branches par: I am called Erah. Branches part for you, =name=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am called Une. \\\"Warden\\\:
I am called Une. "Warden" Une, when someone needs to wear authority for outsiders.

And you? What's your name?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am considering narrative inh: I am considering narrative inheritances. The stories we were told when our minds were more putty-like, the follies that shaped who we are, that shape the whole of Qud.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am considering the determina: I am considering the determination of goodness and badness in a thing, and how it is determined. The interaction between data and subjective evaluation, and the values that guide us that we cannot put to words.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am considering the thought a: I am considering the thought as a discrete object. I wish to determine whether I am able to think a single thought only, and to determine how to distinguish it from another thought in the same vein.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am considering the window of: I am considering the window of consciousness through which each of us views the universe. What happens to it when we die?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am consumed by curiosity. Ho:
I am consumed by curiosity. How it resembleth the children in make!

May I hold the device in communion?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am contemplating the Spindle: I am contemplating the Spindle's place in Qud, its position as a conceptual focal point. How much of what we know of the Spindle is the craft of those before us, carried forward?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am contemplating the distinc: I am contemplating the distinction between animal and rock. Why are they different? How much like a rock must an animal be when it ceases to be an animal?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am debased on the plank acro: I am debased on the plank across the light of God! d- do I have a rightful claim to pity? Blindness! This darkling room abjures the light. Is this the House of Judgement, Hortensa? Or mere penumbra, the child's playcave, and law and language (not yet invented) cast their forcing functions back through time to puppet the unblossomed mind to civilized shape...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am dromad, =player.apparentS: I am dromad, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=. Some say saltstrider. Do you know this?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am further relieved to know: I am further relieved to know of another perspective looking upon this work. Klanq's presence here is vital, but it discomfits me: I cannot help but consider the introduction of chaos to an already chaotic endeavor to be a... conflagratory strategy.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am glad you are safe, =name=: I am glad you are safe, =name=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am here on account of your G: I am here on account of your Gyre and its plagues. Hear me, I ask.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am history's leftovers, an i:
I am history's leftovers, an inheritor of nothing, a bit of marginalia in a burned tome.

That I have persisted to witness this day leaves me in awe. It is extraordinary.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am in search of work.\"]: I am in search of work.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am justice. Give back what y: I am justice. Give back what you stole.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am moved by this. Let me con: I am moved by this. Let me consider.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am no Warden. My only fellow: I am no Warden. My only fellowship is with my own shame.
I am no one of any importance.

But my name is Zothom, and some call me the Penitent.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am no rector, understand, bu:
I am no rector, understand, but They are the molders of chrome. The gods under Shekhinah who wrought metal edifices from the raw Kasaphescence.

Will you go?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am not Barathrum. Grant me t: I am not Barathrum. Grant me the same covenant and I will succeed.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am not offended, simply maki: I am not offended, simply making =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= aware of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= foolishness.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am not welcome in Bey Lah.\\:
I am not welcome in Bey Lah.

My blood is not pure, and I was not born in the meadow. These things make my name as salt in the mouths of true hindren.

They are misguided, but they are my misguided family. They stagnate as Qud changes around them. I worry.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am not wroth with you, but I:
I am not wroth with you, but I owe you no conclusions so easily grasped.

All the same, consider yourself forgiven if you wish. Sit and listen to my hurdy-gurdy and we shall be friends.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am not yet ready. I may retu: I am not yet ready. I may return.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am of slynth, a people grown: I am of slynth, a people grown by hydropon.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am ready for the Creature to: I am ready for the Creature to be moulded and catalyzed.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am ready to ascend the Spind: I am ready to ascend the Spindle, Barathrum.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am ready to speak on the fin: I am ready to speak on the final fate of Qud.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am sharp. I am handy.\"]: I am sharp. I am handy.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am sorry to cause pain, Elde: I am sorry to cause pain, Elder.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am sorry, =name=. I am so pr: I am sorry, =name=. I am so proud of you! I wish... I wish it were I did not peel, like your model.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am sorry, Miryam. Did you lo: I am sorry, Miryam. Did you lose someone close to you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am sorry. But will you help: I am sorry. But will you help Barathrum do as he asks?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am taking inventory of my fa: I am taking inventory of my faculties, and looking for any that I might not previously have considered.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am the beetle in your crimin: I am the beetle in your crimination. But shall not beetles survive your plagues?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am the carcass of a fool\\nm:
I am the carcass of a fool
made to jump and dance
by a troupe of merry bacteria.

Do you like how I walk?
Do you like how I talk?
Do you like how my face
disintegrates into salt?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am to carry Tau's chime to T: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am torn asunder! This outcom:
I am torn asunder! This outcome, this outcome, the shear splits me. Why Ptoh? How? Has this always been us? Which of us yet carry this -else to reify under pressure to our extancy?

Do not answer. There is no word-answer, and perhaps none at all. You have done us a service and I thank you for this -elseing.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am uncertain that you know t: I am uncertain that you know the enormity of what you ask me, =name=. Nonetheless, I cannot deny what you have done for our order. These slynth must be tested as you were, but should they show the mettle and drive set by your example, we will accept them as apprentices.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am uncomfortable with change: I am uncomfortable with change, but it is a skill to train like any other.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am weary to my core, but at:
I am weary to my core, but at last this once-hateful body obeyeth me. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for restoring my autonomy.

Memory of my once-self doth elude me, but I recognize the irony of my punishment. Once a strider, then sentenced to stride without restraint, forever. I knew only fear and flight. No more.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I am your worst nightmare. Pre: I am your worst nightmare. Prepare to die.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I ascended the Spindle to arri: I ascended the Spindle to arrive at this place.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I ask you: disable the magneti: I ask you: disable the magnetic field so that the Spindle can be ascended and the signal investigated.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I asked Resheph that very ques: I asked Resheph that very question. But the seraphim transit an ethical manifold much different than our own.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I asked for time. Give me time: I asked for time. Give me time. To reform Qud, extinguish the hatefulness and needless warmaking, to lift our world across the eschaton and prepare it for the Coven's return...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I assent to this. The covenant: I assent to this. The covenant is drawn.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I assure you, the smell fades: I assure you, the smell fades once the glue is dry.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I barely survived and all you: I barely survived and all you can say is 'ah' and 'yes'?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I bear the Mark. Entomb me.\"]: I bear the Mark. Entomb me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I beg you. Do not release the: I beg you. Do not release the cats.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I believe this poem is yours.\: I believe this poem is yours.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I believe this poem was meant: I believe this poem was meant for you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I can lick the flanges free of: I can lick the flanges free of their pipe milk and hear my tongue fizzle in foam!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I can repair, recharge, and id: I can repair, recharge, and identify whatever you have! Within reason.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I can taste lime, =name=. And: I can taste lime, =name=. And mayhaps gallium?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I can wait years for the inspi: I can wait years for the inspiration to craft another figurine. I have before.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I can't abide a transformed wo: I can't abide a transformed world if it must make casualty of its past.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I can't abide your amoral cour: I can't abide your amoral course. I return now to Qud to help nurture its communities, come what may of your plagues.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I can't help but notice your i: I can't help but notice your impressive stature, even in repose.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I can't help but wonder why yo:
I can't help but wonder why you're telling me this in particular. I am not a mayor, nor even a citizen. I am a drifter, a pariah, and my 'people' are those who have no home anywhere else.

... and here I wonder a bit less. You're asking me to whisper into the winds on behalf of the slynth, aren't you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I can't imagine why you would: I can't imagine why you would think we want your company, kendren.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I cannot abide what you've don: I cannot abide what you've done, and so come to smash order out of thee.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I cannot bring myself to belie: I cannot bring myself to believe that Grand-Doe would allow anyone to stumble upon her own severed tongue. She would surely burn it as soon as she saw it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I cannot commit to this. Live: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I cannot decide which I like b: I cannot decide which I like best: berries, meat, or honey? I simply cannot decide.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I cannot say, =name=. But I kn: I cannot say, =name=. But I know it's facile to believe a living heritage can be evanesced in one stroke. We are always downstream of a past violence.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I cannot simply explain my cre:
I cannot simply explain my credo to =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. A credo informeth and confoundeth at once, and must be reflected upon by the listener.

=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= inexperienced in our ways, so please bear my words in the kind spirit they are meant: to ask a mopango to explain eir credo is to commit one of our few taboo acts. Be advised.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I come by way of Joppa. The el: I come by way of Joppa. The elder Irudad calls me friend.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I come in the name of need. Ba: I come in the name of need. Barathrum asks the strength of your psyche to power our starclimb.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I concern myself little with o:
I concern myself little with oozes but to stay away.

Please, no more. I tire. Talk to Agyra.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I convinced Pax Klanq to const: I convinced Pax Klanq to construct the climber.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I could give it to her.\"]: I could give it to her.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I couldn't save them.\\n\\nI t:
I couldn't save them.

I tried. I tried to save them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I depart for Grit Gate soon.\": I depart for Grit Gate soon.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I desire nothing. Live and dri: I desire nothing. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I did not consider that my lif:
I did not consider that my life could be further upturned. Truly, I have learned much and I hate it all.

Once you lot reach the spindle's apex, perhaps you could be convinced to stay there? Or perhaps I could go in your stead.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I did not expect to admit this:
I did not expect to admit this, disciple, but the refugees have met my expectations. Like you, they have shown more than a willing spirit in work and curiosity both.

The slynth have promise, and you may have been right to bring them to us.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I did, and I do.\\n\\nAre you:
I did, and I do.

Are you in the market?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I didn't ask for this life, bu: I didn't ask for this life, but here we are. Wanna buy something?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I discovered a patch of waterv: I discovered a patch of watervine stained red with blood, a sign of recent violence.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I do not know how to remember:
I do not know how to remember beloved Tau, struggling like a minnow in Soft. In a place between death and living.

Leave me, please.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I do, and I thank =ifplayerplu:
I do, and I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for asking after it.

My credo is "Reconciliation without understanding is a salt poultice."
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I do, brave friend. I'll impri: I do, brave friend. I'll imprint them now.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I do. Your service to the guil:
I do. Your service to the guild has been laudable, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. You braved the vaporous depths of Bethesda Susa and decoded the signal, you secured the Spindlegrounds and handled the self-appointed Earl, and perhaps most materially, you defended our enclave from the Putus Templar.

Since you returned from Bethesda, you've no doubt wondered at the signal's contents. Verily, I hid them to shield you from the weight of the truth. Only Otho, Q Girl, and I bear that burden, but circumstances have changed. The river of Time powers the gear train of our schemes and devices, and it rushes forth. From here, I must share the burden. You must know.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I do.\\n\\n\\\"Form needeth no:
I do.

"Form needeth not follow function."
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I do.\\n\\n\\\"Suffering breed:
I do.

"Suffering breedeth in still water."
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I don't believe my people wish: I don't believe my people wish to stay here, but we have had so little, ah, meaningful contact with other sapient creatures. We have no allies. We have nowhere to go but here.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I don't have time for this. Li: I don't have time for this. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I don't imagine you brought me: I don't imagine you brought me this information merely to observe. Are you suggesting that these slynth might take up residence here in my village?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I don't know.\\n\\nKlanq's opa:
I don't know.

Klanq's opacity is alluring, frustrating, and dangerous. Like Klanq, my thoughts on Klanq evade easy explanation.

What you build together will be amazing. Craft well.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I don't like to speculate on a:
I don't like to speculate on a matter I know so little of, nor one whose outcome so dearly affects my life.

If what you want is a strongly-worded accusation based on nothing, Liihart is the sister to talk to.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I don't understand. Can you ex: I don't understand. Can you explain aloud?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I don't understand. What could: I don't understand. What could it mean?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I doubt it. If Eskhind were si: I doubt it. If Eskhind were sick, the last place she would stumble to evacuate her guts would be a watervine field.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I dream of a crawl nook on a n: I dream of a crawl nook on a nether stratum where I out-sweat the burning Gyre, and then peek an eye across a new horizon.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I dream of returning to Bey La: I dream of returning to Bey Lah sometimes, but I know that's not my fate.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I drink in the sight of you, c: I drink in the sight of you, cub. Thank you for keeping safe.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I eat honey matz every morning: I eat honey matz every morning and I ain't been sick in decades.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I en't filthy. I'm muddy. Big: I en't filthy. I'm muddy. Big difference.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I failed it! I have failed! A:
I failed it! I have failed! A thousand years too short, and- MORE TIME

{{emote|*Barathrum weeps.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I fear sludges, the kind you m:
I fear sludges, the kind you may no longer describe with 'some'. Born of the ancient stuff of existence, possessed of malice and wanting nothing more than to eat whatever they can, and they can eat whatever. It is even worse when they drink.

Take care with them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I feed these critters what blo: I feed these critters what blood the ranchers have to spare.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I found Brightsheol, where it: I found Brightsheol, where it lies beyond the Tomb. I spoke to the Shomer there and arranged for the disablement of the Spindle's magnets.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I found a torn sheet of graph: I found a torn sheet of graph paper with a note about deceit. Was it yours?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I found them, here and there.\:
I found them, here and there.

Are you interested, or merely fatally curious?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I gave it to someone. Or sold: I gave it to someone. Or sold it, perhaps.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I grew up right here in Joppa,: I grew up right here in Joppa, daughter of the Elder and all. Spent some years delving, but gave it up after a few near escapes and nearly deadly wounds. I'm better suited to herbalism anyway, and my father worries less.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I hand-reared each one of thes: I hand-reared each one of these critters. They've had a life of luxury.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I hate my goats and they hate: I hate my goats and they hate me, but we both hate every other body more.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have a secret to share with: I have a secret to share with you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have a terrible feeling that:
I have a terrible feeling that I've brought ill fortune to my village.

Perhaps it was a mistake to have hired you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have all I need. Live and dr: I have all I need. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have another question, if yo: I have another question, if you please.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have been called Inheritor,:
I have been called Inheritor, Godling, Spirechild, Nephiling. They are all fitting names, but none complete or sufficient.

As it is with you, I am the convergence of past-ripples into present-force. As it is with you, I am deeds done and the intention toward deeds yet to be done.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have been called Remnant, Go:
I have been called Remnant, Godling, Deep Progeny, and Spawn of Nephil. None of these are who I am.

Who I am is what I say and do. If you listen well, you will hear my name spoken between words.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have been tasked to travel t: I have been tasked to travel to Golgotha.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have changed my mind. Live a: I have changed my mind. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have completed the ritual of: I have completed the ritual of -elseing. Will you power Barathrum's starclimb, as you said?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have found Kindrish, but not: I have found Kindrish, but not Eskhind.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have freed one of the childr: I have freed one of the children.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have lost much to my dedicat: I have lost much to my dedication. Help me gain anew, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have made my inquiries. It i: I have made my inquiries. It is time for the slynth to choose a new home.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have met Pax Klanq. I was pu:
I have met Pax Klanq. I was puffed on.

Candidly, I prefer fungi edible and inert.
I have more to ask, Barathrum.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have more to ask, first.\"]: I have more to ask, first.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have no brother. My two sist: I have no brother. My two sisters are all the blood family I can claim.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have no need for luck, but I:
I have no need for luck, but I appreciate your well-wishes nonetheless.

May your own endeavors drive you as mine drive me. Did you wish to speak of anything else?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have not.\\n\\nI would, howe:
I have not.

I would, however, love to meet him. He seems a fun fungus.

But I daren't go. I fear the sludges.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have recovered a repulsive d: I have recovered a repulsive device.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have some gossip that may in: I have some gossip that may interest you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have something else to ask.\: I have something else to ask.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have visited the Six Day Sti: I have visited the Six Day Stilt.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have visited the rainbow woo:
I have visited the rainbow wood but once, and there I sampled an array of strange foods, one of which allowed me an unusual lens through which to view the world. It was nothing like I had ever experienced, and I imagined such wondrous recipes. I wrote them all down as best I could, of course.

Sadly, once I returned to my ordinary frame of reference, my scribblings proved impossible to read. So it goes.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I have volunteered to monitor:
I have volunteered to monitor an ancient machine-creature called Kah. Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= seen it, skipping hither and yon on strange limbs.

Often I wonder if Kah knoweth aught else but fear.
I have yet to find my purpose. I can think and speak, and so this shell is nearly comfortable.

One piece, however, doth yet chafe me. =ifplayerplural:Would ye:Wouldst thou= take it? Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye can:thou canst= grant it some use.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I hear that Bey Lah's status i:
I hear that Bey Lah's status is once again quo. I hoped for a measure more of change, but thousands of years of tradition do not give so easily.

Thank you for helping my foolish people.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I heard from my friend who hea: I heard from my friend who heard it from their yma that the Grand-Doe says that hindren who leave Bey Lah grow an extra pair of arms. And the Grand-Doe says it so you know it's true.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I heed your warning. Farewell,: I heed your warning. Farewell, Barathrum.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I hope =ifplayerplural:ye are::
I hope =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou art= confident in =ifplayerplural:your:thy= choice, =factionaddress:Mopango=. I am happy with it, to be sure.

Kah is free. It heals my heart to see it at rest. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= my thanks.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I hope Hindriarch Esk can keep: I hope Hindriarch Esk can keep us safe.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I hope it is not overly crowde:
I hope it is not overly crowded for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. We mopango are most comfortable in close quarters, but I acknowledge that not all creatures adore the close embrace of the depths as we do.

Regardless, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= welcome to stay and sup, and ask of me any questions =ifplayerplural:ye may:thou mayest= have.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I hoped you would ask! I close:
I hoped you would ask! I closely study the works of the great bard, Willow Shakesprig. In particular, I am most fond of the stories of the Great Plant Detective, Hemlock Cones. Through these stories, I have learned to hone my perceptions and deductive skill to a fine point. It is my dearest hope that one day I shall be known not as Angohind, village bookworm... but Angohind, Master Detective.

My grandhind has forbidden me from looking into the strange doings in the village, but she said nothing about me teaching you the ins and outs of detective work! What say you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I implore you, Resheph, revers: I implore you, Resheph, reverse the Gyre.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I intend to ascend the Spindle:
I intend to ascend the Spindle and answer the call, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.

My protege {{m|Q Girl}} has designed a climber for the ascent. We intended to construct it piecewise at the enclave and the site itself, but the engineering feat exceeds even our capacity. With time, I am confident we could accomplish it, but the Putus Templar rob us of our patience. We need to act now, and so as loath as I am to admit it, we need Pax Klanq.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I journey North, to the Six Da: I journey North, to the Six Day Stilt.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I just meant to ask if you're: I just meant to ask if you're able to communicate. It seems so.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I keep my amoebas happy! Or, y: I keep my amoebas happy! Or, you know, whatever they got in place of happy.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I ken not why you thirst for t:
I ken not why you thirst for truths not yours to consume. If I refuse, will you wrench them from my mouth as I wrench teeth from yours? What does that gain you?

Sit down, fool. Listen to music and calm yourself.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I know not. Perhaps I can lead:
I know not. Perhaps I can lead again. These creatures that looked after me, named me, kept me safe. The mopango.

They are kind, but weak. Perhaps I can teach them. Spur them to be greater.

But for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, I must even our score. Take this piece of my chassis. Wear it with confidence. Command in my name.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I know of so many other ways t: I know of so many other ways to be.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I know that Omonporch is a mis:
I know that Omonporch is a miserable, hot place and Asphodel is a self-important churl.

I don't even like bananas.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I know the rumor you mean, but: I know the rumor you mean, but villagers heard the clash of weapons. Keh is too old for a prolonged fight like that, so I do not believe it was her.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I leave you to your fate, then: I leave you to your fate, then.
