Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I live, but do I drink?\"]: I live, but do I drink?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I mean no slight to these slyn: I mean no slight to these slynth folk, =name=, but the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees before and it is a substantial burden upon our stewards. Our resources and space are scant, and I must request that you find another home for them. May the Kasaphescence shine upon them, and you, in this endeavor.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I might be willing to trade.\": I might be willing to trade.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I must admit, =name=, that I c:
I must admit, =name=, that I can think of few notions more challenging to my people than to welcome a flower-people into our town. Some will see them as no better than walking lah.

But if the notion came from you, they might consider putting it to a vote, at least. If you'll stand by, I will call a referendum.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I must ask you to decipher thi:
I must ask you to decipher this enigma, find Pax Klanq, and convince them to construct the climber. Remind Pax of the debt they owe us.

It strikes me as likely for this 'rainbow' to refer to the Rainbow Wood, where Klanq's kin consort, so I suggest you start there.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I must be mistaken. Live and d: I must be mistaken. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I must bring the decoded signa: I must bring the decoded signal to Barathrum immediately. Return in a few hours. By then I'll have discussed our next course of action with Barathrum and will have further instructions for you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I must enter Brightsheol throu: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I must insist; why are you cal: I must insist; why are you called "pariah"?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I must offer a strand to you.\:
I must offer a strand to you.
Having not this entry, for I left it at home.
At smallest... more than one hundred Codex cycle. Less than ten thousand.
Big span. I offer you strands for this.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I must talk with the shaman Ma: I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I must think on this further.\: I must think on this further.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I must think on this task.\"]: I must think on this task.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I must weigh everything you've: I must weigh everything you've told me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I need time and space from thi: I need time and space from this.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I need time on my own first.\": I need time on my own first.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I need to enter the Tomb of th: I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I noticed the creature has had: I noticed the creature has had its fangs removed.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I offer you this repulsive dev: I offer you this repulsive device, unique one.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I once traveled over a mountai: I once traveled over a mountain, believing I would see something that I had not seen before once past the summit. I was disappointed to find that the other side of the mountain bore a striking resemblance to the one I'd just left. What is the purpose of mountains?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I promise not to bother you ag: I promise not to bother you again, =hermit=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I propose an accord, =factiona: I propose an accord, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=: You remove =player.reflexive= from my sight immediately, and I will refrain from asking that Ereshkigal reduce you to your component atoms.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I read a history once that men:
I read a history once that mentioned =village.name=, taking note of their reverence for =village.sacred= and equal loathing of =village.profane=.

Will my kin accept a life of =village.activity=? I will consult with them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I recommend everything I carry: I recommend everything I carry. Not all at once, of course.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I remain wary, but there is no: I remain wary, but there is no question that Bey Lah thrives, even with open borders.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I require entrance to the city: I require entrance to the city.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I require no further informati: I require no further information. I will go.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I resent what has befallen me,:
I resent what has befallen me, but I am yet embodied. You have still helped me live, yes?

I forgive you, but I don't wish to know you. Live and drink.

I resent what has befallen me, but I am yet embodied. You have still helped me live.

My future is free. My future is murky, and I am freshly tender from the burn of your hand. I feel I had rather not encounter you for a time. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I said I ranch these here beau:
I said I ranch these here beauts.

The Freeholders en't much for letting a body lay claim to land. En't what I'da wished for, but as the Issachari say: "Should your compass lead you to the Six Day Stilt, throw it in the well."
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I said, may I ask you some que: I said, may I ask you some questions?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I saw only empty spectacle. Wh: I saw only empty spectacle. Who can worship a hole in the ground?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I see my wares catch your eye,: I see my wares catch your eye, =player.formalAddressTerm=. They can be yours.
I see the slynth have arrived. How are they faring?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I see, thank you. Live and dri: I see, thank you. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I see. I have further question: I see. I have further questions.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I see. In that case, rest and:
I see. In that case, rest and speak a bit with me, won't you? My worries can wait another day.

That said, if you change your mind, you'll come find me, won't you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I see. Live and drink, Yurl.\": I see. Live and drink, Yurl.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I see. May I ask about somethi: I see. May I ask about something else?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I seek a use for this repulsiv: I seek a use for this repulsive device.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I shall enjoy my free mobility:
I shall enjoy my free mobility freely, for a time. After that, I know not. I may speak to these mopango creatures that named me, and find a purpose with them. I cannot ever repay their care, but perhaps I may repay =ifplayerplural:yours:thine=.

I wouldst fain offer =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= a fragment of this form come loose. =ifplayerplural:May ye:Mayst thou= ever run free.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I shall leave you to it. Live: I shall leave you to it. Live and drink, contemplatrix.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I shall remain here, but I hav: I shall remain here, but I have one demand.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I shiver at a magnanimity long:
I shiver at a magnanimity long since worn! Decorate you, decorate.
Your adornments fascinate also, hey!
Span of time across stars shines through it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I should be wary of you, yes?: I should be wary of you, yes? You have helped me to my -else, but I find my chosen path blocked.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I should go. Live and drink.\": I should go. Live and drink.
I should have kept them apart.

I should have kept all of you apart.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I should return to my investig: I should return to my investigation. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I should take my leave. Live a: I should take my leave. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I should... go. Live and drink: I should... go. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I spent so long preparing for:
I spent so long preparing for the eventuality that my home might be breached.

I was not ready. This sense of violation burns like electrocautery.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I spoke with Barathrum. He pra:
I spoke with Barathrum. He praised your handling of the Earl of Omonporch, and he thanks you for the bravery you exhibited in defending Grit Gate.

The attack today reminds us: for too long have we put our faith in the isolation of our guild and the preoccupations of the Putus Templar. The looming threat of another attack impels Barathrum to accelerate his plans, and with them, your position in our guild.

You are raised to Disciple, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Barathrum wishes to speak with you immediately.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I start at this but Tikva sett: I start at this but Tikva settles me. I remember now: from a cub I've known Barathrum to be weak in telling but bold in asking. A starclimb? You mean, an ascent to the long chiming rock?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I startle, and the roiling is: I startle, and the roiling is felt before the calm. I cannot find a consensus for the housing of these beings, =name=. I am sorry.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I suppose I'll be leaving, the: I suppose I'll be leaving, then.
I suppose not. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I talked to a strange figure n: I talked to a strange figure next to the girshling.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I tally so many autumns, but u: I tally so many autumns, but until I am black with rot, I cannot be ring-right. The etching on my undertrunk places my seed-date to the reign of =sultan:4=, so I am told.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I tell you, =player.formalAddr: I tell you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, my recipes come from years of experience. There's none the like.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I thank you. Live and drink.\": I thank you. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I think I got all the puddles,: I think I got all the puddles, but watch for slime all the same.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I think often upon the gyre, f: I think often upon the gyre, from Resheph's gospels. Why do you imagine it is so named?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I think this poem is yours.\"]: I think this poem is yours.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I thought the Nervous Ones ext: I thought the Nervous Ones extinct.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I used to be a wayfarer like y: I used to be a wayfarer like you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but old wounds slow you down. Cherish the time while you have it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I want salt in my mouth, dead: I want salt in my mouth, dead eyes in radiating darkness, and a frog for a friend.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I want to ask something else.\: I want to ask something else.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I want to ask you something el: I want to ask you something else.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I was once a vile graverobber,:
I was once a vile graverobber, the lowest of the low. Years ago I sought to plunder the Tomb of the Eaters, and set off to do so with a pair of confederates. I watched both of them die, slain by ancient artifice and entombed with the ancient dead.

I would have shared their fate, but for a coterie of mopango nesting in the catacombs. They kept me safe and fed me while I treated my wounds. It is in their honor that I seek a credo now.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I was trying not to think too:
I was trying not to think too hard about any of this until you found my poem, so... I can't say.

But I can't ignore this sign of my cowardice, not after you found it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I watch over Va'am. It watchet:
I watch over Va'am. It watcheth over me. Together, we watch.

=ifplayerplural:Ye should:Thou shouldst= as well, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Sit. Watch. Consider how =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= fare under a dome of adamant carapace.

Safe, undying, alone.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I watch over the Grave of Rebe: I watch over the Grave of Rebekah to atone for my deeds, and to find my credo.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will admit, Hindriarch Esk l: I will admit, Hindriarch Esk leads well.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will be careful, thank you.\: I will be careful, thank you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will be careful. Live and dr: I will be careful. Live and drink.
I will bond with the Creature. How does this work?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will cherish it. Live and dr: I will cherish it. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will convene a council. The: I will convene a council. The First Council of Omonporch. Send word to four of your allied factions. Have them send delegates. Together, perhaps, you can appease me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will do as you ask.\"]: I will do as you ask.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will do my best to be civil: I will do my best to be civil with you, kendren, but we hindren are bred into wariness.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will enter the Tomb of the E: I will enter the Tomb of the Eaters as you ask.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will exercise my best judgem: I will exercise my best judgement. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will find Pax Klanq and deli: I will find Pax Klanq and deliver Q Girl's design.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will give you a moment.\"]: I will give you a moment.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will leave you to it. Live a: I will leave you to it. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will leave you to your grief: I will leave you to your grief. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will ponder this. Live and d: I will ponder this. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will power his starclimb. If: I will power his starclimb. If you take Tau's chime to taproot, for her to walk away. If you finish the ritual of -elseing.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will ravage your nubile hear: I will ravage your nubile heart!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will return when I have ques: I will return when I have questions... or an accusation.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will return with the data, S: I will return with the data, Steward.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will return with your knickk: I will return with your knickknack.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will secure the Spindle for: I will secure the Spindle for Barathrum.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will seek to retrieve it, th: I will seek to retrieve it, then.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will share my food-secrets w: I will share my food-secrets with you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, if you're willing to make it worth my while.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will think further on this.\: I will think further on this.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will think on this... live a: I will think on this... live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will trouble you no further,: I will trouble you no further, then.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I will, Barathrum. Live and dr: I will, Barathrum. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I wish I could allow you to te: I wish I could allow you to test my wares in the shop, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but walk a parasang in any direction and you'll find a target.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I wish the same for you, =name: I wish the same for you, =name=. Live and drink.

I wish the same for you, =name=.

Before you go, take this, a piece of my bodystuff, as thanks for completing the -elseing.

Then live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I wish to ask about something: I wish to ask about something else.
I wish to know more about you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I won't denigrate them, =name=:
I won't denigrate them, =name=, or presume to speak for what's in their hearts. But I can direct you around the contours of the impressions they've left on me.

Who would you like to hear about, =player.offspringTerm=?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I wonder how it must feel to b:
I wonder how it must feel to be =name=, so loath to see the pen of fate in another's grasp that you see fit to wrench it away. Does it bring exultation of control, or relief from a gnawing insecurity?

Do not answer. I will not be calmed. Ask if asking.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I wonder if the distributed co: I wonder if the distributed consciousness of a fungal entity is similar to that of a distributed machine mind. I shall ask Father when he is not so busy.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I would ask you make an offeri: I would ask you make an offering at the sacred Well of my bauble. Moon and sun, I beg you!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I would ask you to join me, =s: I would ask you to join me, =subject.waterRitualLiquid=-=pronouns.siblingTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I would like a moment, Barathr: I would like a moment, Barathrum.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I would like to ask some quest: I would like to ask some questions about the large creature.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I would prefer not to interrup: I would prefer not to interrupt this task long.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'd like to ask about somethin: I'd like to ask about something else.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'd like to ask you about some: I'd like to ask you about something else.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'd like to ask you something: I'd like to ask you something else.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'd like to meet these mopango: I'd like to meet these mopango.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'll be on my way. Live and dr: I'll be on my way. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'll buy your shiniest things,: I'll buy your shiniest things, if you'll sell them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'll do my best to defend Grit: I'll do my best to defend Grit Gate.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'll have Warden Neelahind gat:
I'll have Warden Neelahind gather everyone as soon as they can spare the eyes and ears for it.

{{emote|*Hindriarch Esk canters away, voice already raised.*}} Hey, Warden!
I'll have to be careful of... glass tubes?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'll leave you to it, then.\"]: I'll leave you to it, then.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'll look into this, but you'd: I'll look into this, but you'd better not go missing.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'll skip to the last part. Li: I'll skip to the last part. Live and drink, rude one.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'll still take parts you ain': I'll still take parts you ain't washed off, it's fine.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'm Yurl, chandler and Consort: I'm Yurl, chandler and Consortium notary. As for my story, I've been growing out of this pot for a while now. Before that, I was in another pot.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'm a cat herder. My parents w: I'm a cat herder. My parents were cat herders. Their parents were cat herders, and their parents. I don't understand why we do what we do but it is all I know.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'm afraid that Eskhind has no: I'm afraid that Eskhind has no idea how to use proper leatherworking tools, much less pay for a set so fine. This surely isn't hers.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'm afraid that makes no sense: I'm afraid that makes no sense. Why would an outsider invite a trader to our village, when they could simply meet one outside of Bey Lah?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'm afraid that well is poison: I'm afraid that well is poisoned due to your false accusation: =thief.name|strip= isn't the culprit.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'm all set. Live and drink, r: I'm all set. Live and drink, rude one.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'm back from Red Rock with th: I'm back from Red Rock with the corpse of a pale spiderling. Elder, would you examine it?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'm fine, thank you. Live and: I'm fine, thank you. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'm glad you are safe, Shem.\": I'm glad you are safe, Shem.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'm here to collect a debt for: I'm here to collect a debt for the Barathrumites.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'm like to faint from this he: I'm like to faint from this heat.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'm so excited.\\n\\nMany than:
I'm so excited.

Many thanks for releasing Nacham, =factionaddress:Mopango=. I believe that its presence here will provide a great mutual boon.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'm still not completely certa: I'm still not completely certain. Let me ponder it more.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'm to pilot the creature? And: I'm to pilot the creature? And bond with it?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'm trying to exonerate your s: I'm trying to exonerate your sister. Can you help?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I'm uneasy. What is this mount: I'm uneasy. What is this mounting dread? I cannot talk now.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I've a bad feeling about all t: I've a bad feeling about all this.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I've a glimmer of light for sa: I've a glimmer of light for sale if you need one, wanderer.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I've been crafting a kind of a: I've been crafting a kind of a relic, a piece of art that serves a purpose and that you can carry on your, ah, your person. I finally finished building it while you were away, and the opportunities you offered us inspired the finishing touches. I'd like you to have it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I've books for trade, if you'r: I've books for trade, if you're interested.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I've come from the Thick World: I've come from the Thick World with a mission: to disable the Spindle's magnetic field. Can you do this for me?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I've got my eye on you.\"]: I've got my eye on you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I've heard that the youngest H:
I've heard that the youngest Hindriarch in history now leads Bey Lah, and their warden aims to join the Quetzal Caucus. You've worked wonders, kendren.

I can't wait to see what happens next.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I've instructed Neek since the: I've instructed Neek since they were a lil' cub. What a strange one! Bouncey. Full of smiles. But brilliant in their own way. My favorite book in all the world is Neek's "Spiderwebs on Hoversleds". Who would have ever thought?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I've misled you, biographer. I: I've misled you, biographer. I have another question.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I've mused on your words and h: I've mused on your words and have joined you at your vantage point. The plagues of the Gyre are the only way to prepare for the Coven's return. Resume your plan.
I've mused on your words and have joined you at your vantage point. The plagues of the Gyre are the only way to prepare for the Coven's return.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I've never seen a frog of your: I've never seen a frog of your stature.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I've plenty water if you've go: I've plenty water if you've got implants to sell.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I've reunited Tau with her chi: I've reunited Tau with her chime.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I've shared my honey with that: I've shared my honey with that prickly troglodyte for more years than I can count. I can't help but like him, and while he won't admit it, he feels the same about me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I've the cure for what ails yo: I've the cure for what ails you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I... I don't know. Grand-doe u:
I... I don't know. Grand-doe usually resolves Bey Lah's disputes. I am present to defuse violence, or keep the peace through the threat of it.

What do you think?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I... \\n\\nNo matter. The will:
I... 

No matter. The will can break the wheel, too. We go. Pray, the weightloss of the rise might do good for me. Past the shell of the world, I'm to understand one's burdens can no longer pull them down...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I... have more to ask you.\"]: I... have more to ask you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"I... wish to speak of other th: I... wish to speak of other things.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"IN A SENSE, THE LOW SHOMER SPE: IN A SENSE, THE LOW SHOMER SPEAKETH TRUE. I AM THE SUPERSTRATE AND NINHURSAG THE SUBSTRATE; THAT THIN ORBIS DOTH SPIN BETWIXT THE TWO.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"IN AWE I GULPED AS SORCERESS S: IN AWE I GULPED AS SORCERESS STRIPES ARROWED UP A WORLD-SKIN, ALIGHT THE MARBLED MOON.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"IN SEVERAL MANNER. THE FIRST F: IN SEVERAL MANNER. THE FIRST FROGS WERE REARED IN TERRARIA. THE NEPHILIM, GRAFTED AND LIGHT-SMELT IN STAR ORBIT, THEN SET TO INCUBATE UPON THE CRYSTAL STAIR.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"INWITH THE FLUIDIC MANIFOLD OF: INWITH THE FLUIDIC MANIFOLD OF LOCAL SAPIENCE, BEINGS THINK AND FEEL, CURRENTS DOTH FORM, AND KINESIS IS BEGOTTEN.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"IT SHALL TAKE TIME, HOWBEIT, T:
IT SHALL TAKE TIME, HOWBEIT, TO MASTER THE SERAPHIC RITUALS. ONLY IN THY OLD AGE SHALL THE INMOST LAYERS UNFURL.

BUT TOGETHER, WE SHALL SEEK.

IT SHALL TAKE TIME, HOWBEIT, TO MASTER THE SERAPHIC RITUALS. ONLY THE GRANDCHILDREN OF THY SCHOLARS SHALL UNFURL THE INMOST LAYERS.

BUT TOGETHER, WE SHALL SEEK.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If I do give it back, what wil: If I do give it back, what will you do with it?
If I might change the subject...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If it can be done, return me t: If it can be done, return me to Qud. I wish to ascend the Spindle myself.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If it flows, I desire it. You: If it flows, I desire it. You should too, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If it isn't the hero kendren,:
If it isn't the hero kendren, =name=.

Welcome back to Bey Lah! Stay as long as you like.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If it were a Templar's Aegis,:
If it were a Templar's Aegis, it would bear the holy rhombus.

No knight would be caught dead carrying this blank slate.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If its full workings are unkno: If its full workings are unknowable, is it possible the course of action you take is the wrong one?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If the signal sounds and the G: If the signal sounds and the Gyre widens again, then you did not reach whatever watermark Resheph set?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If the slynth choose to wander: If the slynth choose to wander Qud, the Pariahs have agreed to look after them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If these slynth wish to become: If these slynth wish to become mopango and =ifplayerplural:ye speak:thou speakest= for them, then we shall accept them. Let them gaze into the schematics that wrote history beside us if they so choose.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If y-y, th-that... yes. Ask if: If y-y, th-that... yes. Ask if, if asking.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If you ask the exile, I'm sure:
If you ask the exile, I'm sure she'll spin some kind of accusation that I believe gender to be an immutable prison, that I impose it on others.

She's lying. Our people have a long history of two-gender hindren called {{w|hartind}}, respected and consecrated. There is a proper path to gender variance in our society, of which the male exile could have availed himself years ago.

He never did, so I do not recognize him.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If you bend the light just so,: If you bend the light just so, it frays into brilliance.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If you came for the humble pie: If you came for the humble pie, you had best not have led any mind-hunters here.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If you can butcher a boar, you: If you can butcher a boar, you can do the same to a man. Just ain't meat you're looking for.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If you do find =player.reflexi:
If you do find =player.reflexive= in the Tomb, the mopango settlement is nestled in the wall of the Northwest Catacombs. The entrance is guarded by a chain turret named Vivira, brightly-painted to distinguish em from eir brethren.

Resist your reflexive urge to fight or flee, as Vivira is friendly and open to parley. If you meet, tell em I sent you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If you don't get dry-roasted b: If you don't get dry-roasted by the fire snakes, ought be a time of times. Better hit all the food stalls for samples, hyeh?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If you put so little value on: If you put so little value on the flourishing of life, where does your desire for readmittance to the Coven spring from?
If you say so. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If you would have them, I ask: If you would have them, I ask that you grant them sanctuary.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If you would have them, yes.\": If you would have them, yes.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If you're looking to read, I h: If you're looking to read, I have what you need.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If you're passing through babo: If you're passing through baboon country, you'll want to protect your head, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If you've got anything you can: If you've got anything you can't make heads or tails of it, give it here.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If you've nothing you need of: If you've nothing you need of me, kendren, I'd just as soon hold my peace.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"If you've the wits to build, I: If you've the wits to build, I've got something you want.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Implicating evidence is what i:
Implicating evidence is what it sounds like: evidence that implicates someone's involvement in a crime. For example, if someone observed strange behavior in a person, or if you found something weird in a person's room, or even if you observe them behaving strangely =player.reflexive=! That's implicating evidence.

Most of the time, a piece of implicating evidence isn't proof of a crime in and of itself, but when presented alongside supporting evidence, implicating evidence is the seed of truth from which grows the long frond of justice.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Impudent swine! You would bear: Impudent swine! You would bear that stygian charm in my presence?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"In my travels I encountered a: In my travels I encountered a people, the slynth, seeking a new home.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"In that case, I have further q: In that case, I have further questions.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"In the age of the covenate, a:
In the age of the covenate, a coterie of our urshiib ancestors took to the stars to ply their burning cores! Can you envision it??

Ho, ho! I know a secret! Heh, heh! I know... there is a functioning starship atop the Spindle. We can take it, =name=! We launch ourselves into the deepness of the dusted cosmos and find the starshiib! You and I, ho ho!

Starshiib!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"In the late years I saw the wr:
In the late years I saw the writing on the wall. I turned us inward, retreated to my candle-dim study to angle at the project alone. A new plan... {{emote|*eeehw*}} was-

{{emote|*Barathrum starts panting.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"In the market for a tonic, =pl: In the market for a tonic, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Spend water now or blood later, your choice.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"In time, animal and even plant:
In time, animal and even plant rule waned as their numbers fell to disease, slaughter, and wasting. More resilient, simple life took up the complexity left behind by the former rulers of Qud.

What few Nervous Ones remained passed our stories on to the new life that saw fit to seek our counsel, that you remember the collective fate of those gone. Will you have your own =name=, or have you evolved truly past those before?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Indubitably, for I've proclaim: Indubitably, for I've proclaimed it so! There was no Earl to tell me otherwise.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ink runs in my very veins, =pl: Ink runs in my very veins, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Innovation's sworn enemies hav: Innovation's sworn enemies have come knocking, =name=. Let us answer them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Interact with scrap-clay mound: Interact with scrap-clay mound. Then chat Klanq to solder circuits and stir the soup.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is Mamon dead? Have you recove: Is Mamon dead? Have you recovered the talisman?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it possible that the Hindri: Is it possible that the Hindriarch is lying?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it really possible to trave: Is it really possible to travel the stars?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it so? Only a ferocious war: Is it so? Only a ferocious warrior could have slain Mamon. You must be such a warrior. Now hand over the prism and choose your reward.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that all kendren ki: Is it true that all kendren kill one another for sport?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that all kendren sa: Is it true that all kendren say 'quetzal' when they are happy?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that bears live to: Is it true that bears live to be a thousand years old?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that boars can shoo: Is it true that boars can shoot fire?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that instead of dyi: Is it true that instead of dying, kendren are frozen in tubes?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that kendren all li: Is it true that kendren all live far underground?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that kendren can't: Is it true that kendren can't fall in love?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that kendren chefs: Is it true that kendren chefs can fry water?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that kendren childr: Is it true that kendren children are thrown out of the nest right after being born?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that kendren don't: Is it true that kendren don't have to ask permission to do the water ritual?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that kendren elders: Is it true that kendren elders grow eyes upon their hands?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that kendren live i: Is it true that kendren live in great bubbles?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that kendren pay fo: Is it true that kendren pay for goods with crayons rather than water?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that kendren sleep: Is it true that kendren sleep in a snarcomfagus?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that kendren someti: Is it true that kendren sometimes die of cooking too hard?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that kendren spend: Is it true that kendren spend hours looking at slabs of wood?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that kendren worshi: Is it true that kendren worship rocks?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that nine out of te: Is it true that nine out of ten kendren cannot speak or understand language?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that there are bear: Is it true that there are bears covered in quills to the east?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that when kendren e: Is it true that when kendren eat mah lah soup, they explode?!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that you don't have: Is it true that you don't have a Grand-Doe?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that you kendren ea: Is it true that you kendren eat your dead?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true that... um, oh. I f: Is it true that... um, oh. I forgot.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is it true what they say? That: Is it true what they say? That it's a petrified kraken?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is life not sweet? Could it be: Is life not sweet? Could it be sweeter?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is that a Naphtaali mask over: Is that a Naphtaali mask over there?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is that a patch of hindren fur: Is that a patch of hindren fur? There's blood on it...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is that so? I imagine you are: Is that so? I imagine you are wondering whether =village.name= will host these slynth, to partake in =village.activity= alongside us.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is that you, nestling =name=?: Is that you, nestling =name=? Are you returned from gate and Tomb? Come closer, I say.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is that... music... coming fro:
Is that... music... coming from your loudspeaker?
It sounds like a bell echoing in the void backward through time.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is there any state of form so: Is there any state of form so fine as a liquid?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is there anything I can do cha: Is there anything I can do change your mind?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is there anything else I shoul: Is there anything else I should know?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is there really a King of the: Is there really a King of the Moon, kendren?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is there work to be found here: Is there work to be found here?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is this how you always greet v: Is this how you always greet visitors?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is this how you always visit s:
Is this how you always visit settlements?

No. Do not answer. Is there aught you need?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is this really the world we li:
Is this really the world we live in?

How cruel.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is what it is. Fine enough pla:
Is what it is. Fine enough place. I've a trade, critters, and nowheres else to go.

I en't much for grand experiments, I just got to live. Ken?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is your condition a result of: Is your condition a result of your work?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is... is this a question trick: Is... is this a question trick? I suppose I cannot know what you intend. Can I understand you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Is... there any advice you can: Is... there any advice you can give me about going to meet him?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Isn't this settlement a bit cr: Isn't this settlement a bit cramped?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It begins in a time before =na:
It begins in a time before =name='s ascension, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but long had rulers laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.

By the end of the time of Kings and Sultans, little remained of their works, less of their glory.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It begins in a time before the:
It begins in a time before the Freeholders, before the final Sultan was entombed, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Kings and Sultans laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.

They so devoured one another's history that little substance remained outside of their strongholds.

It begins in a time before the Limen and its vanguard, before the ascension, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Reshephs laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.

By the time of the last Resheph, little remained of their works, less of their glory.

It begins in a time before the dread ascension of =name=, a time wherein the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but long had rulers laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.

The last of them would be the worst.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It certainly looks like a kitc: It certainly looks like a kitchen.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It channels the breathtaking t: It channels the breathtaking things seen and heard and known. Bathe your senses in it until they grow accustomed. You will see nothing else.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It consumes me. I witnessed so:
It consumes me. I witnessed so little from the weave of outcomes. If I could remember them all, could I influence the course? Would I know what safe means? Too many questions with no conceivable answer. Was your rekindling the spark that caught fire? I do not know.

We are adrift.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It feels strange to allow you: It feels strange to allow you to cross our borders unimpeded, but Grand-Doe wills it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It ignores the monster. It ign: It ignores the monster. It ignores it. It ignores it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It is a pleasure to know this,: It is a pleasure to know this, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm= =name=! I am Tam.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It is a test. Tell me the answ: It is a test. Tell me the answer now.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It is done, then. Have the exp: It is done, then. Have the explication you are owed.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It is happy, it lies. It swell: It is happy, it lies. It swells to witness Tau's choice, in pantomime of shared joy.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It is hardly so simple, =name=: It is hardly so simple, =name=. We drifters hold no hierarchy. I can whisper all I like, but no winds will blow behind the slynth if your name cannot stir more than a breeze. Make yourself known to Pariahs and ask me again.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It is not Ptoh that has suborn:
It is not Ptoh that has suborned my will in this case.

I had chosen a path.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It is real. Take the poem.\"]: It is real. Take the poem.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It is safe here.\\n\\nBusiness:
It is safe here.

Business is slow, but I've... gotten attached, ahaha.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It is the good wind that broug:
It is the good wind that brought the slynth to Ezra.

HA HA HA.

I will watch as these seedlings wilt or thrive.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It is to witness the scalpel p: It is to witness the scalpel parting tissue. The beauty of division and resection.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It seems that someone is waiti: It seems that someone is waiting for you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It shall quail a bit longer. L: It shall quail a bit longer. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It stares into the light and w: It stares into the light and wishes away the monster.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It takes more than a willing s:
It takes more than a willing spirit to be trusted here, wayfarer.

Prove your worth and bring us a waydroid, and we will have more to speak of.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It was too much for my chimeli: It was too much for my chimeling Tau. She gasped for air and her chime stilled. She leaves us now, to become -else. It is her choice.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It wills this troubled feeling:
It wills this troubled feeling away. It looks to the light with something in its eyes. It tries to blink the something away, but it cannot. The light is dim through the something in its eyes.

But the light yet shines. It will blink and it will see the light in searing glory. I thank you, I thank you, I thank you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It would. Could you answer som: It would. Could you answer some questions now?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It's a big bear city with a lo:
It's a big bear city with a lot of books and scratched brass and strange noises. But if you start chanting in sync with the noises Otho will hush you. It's sort of like this, let me explain.

Iseppa is napping so you peek into her room and rearrange her papers.
Then you walk down the hall and say "ding ding" so Mafeo shakes his head and dings back.
Then you foaminate by Hortensa. You foaminate right on by. You hug her too.
Then you scoot over and hug Spara.
Then you scoot over to Jacobo and look over his shoulder and nod like this.

{{emote|*Neek nods thoughtfully.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It's a cozy home you have here: It's a cozy home you have here.
It's a dangerous job, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but well worth it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It's a lovely place, and the b:
It's a lovely place, and the bananas are delicious.

As for the so-called Earl, well. I'm loath to recognize nobility to begin with, and I cannot decide whether Asphodel claiming xyr own title is better or worse than if xe inherited it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It's a word I say out of excit: It's a word I say out of excitement. Sort of a semantic extension of the feeling I get when I see a quetzal. Oh, a quetzal is a pretty bird in the trogon family. I tend to incorporate things I like into my idiolect.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It's all right. You seem to li: It's all right. You seem to like it here.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It's as I feared, =name=. Grit:
It's as I feared, =name=. Grit Gate is being assailed. The Putus Templar must have followed you back from Omonporch.

Let us use the precious little time we have before they arrive to prepare our defenses.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It's been a week. Are the slyn: It's been a week. Are the slynth settled in?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It's curious to see you still: It's curious to see you still here, after helping your kin emigrate.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It's difficult to return to no: It's difficult to return to normal life after such an upheaval.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It's fine. I... forget nothing:
It's fine. I... forget nothing important.

Or, I don't remember. So no sense worrying. Right?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It's get meat here or risk a s: It's get meat here or risk a slugsnout ball in the gut. Your choice, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It's like what I *don't* do is:
It's like what I *don't* do is drink Hortensa's sludge soup samples. I drank them once and she saw me and just sort of smiled tactfully but I could tell on the inside she was like "WOOOOOOOOW" so I don't do it.

Neek winks at you! Ha ha ha. She knows I still do it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It's sort of like \\\"Neek sta: It's sort of like "Neek stares at you awkwardly" no but I'm just kidding, heh. I'm just 'jidding'.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It's sort of like this. You go:
It's sort of like this. You go to the baetyl. You talk to it and you say, "Look, where is every beaded bracelet in the jungle? Where is every beaded bracelet in the watervine marsh? Where is every beaded bracelet in the River Svy?"

Then it tells you and you go get the bracelets.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It's time to fight, =name=. Ar: It's time to fight, =name=. Are you with me?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It's unclear to me that I shou: It's unclear to me that I should be.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"It's working! Genius! Genius!: It's working! Genius! Genius! Noise in the static- I hear it! I hear!... what's this? What *is* that? Wait...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Jacobo, do you have advice for: Jacobo, do you have advice for entering Bethesda Susa?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Joppa is my home, yes.\\n\\nI:
Joppa is my home, yes.

I walked Moghra'yi in the caravans of my brethren and the saltback, but upon meeting Elder Irudad, knew at once to settle down here. You will understand, =player.formalAddressTerm= =player.apparentSpecies=, if you speak to him.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Joppa! An historic site. I was:
Joppa! An historic site. I wasn't sure if, ah, it still existed. As a village.

The quiet of the saltmarshes may be strange to my people, but some have voiced a wish for more peace than the Reef can spare. Thank you for this choice, =name=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Just as Tikva, you turn away f: Just as Tikva, you turn away from your self-disgust. Yet, it is you and within you. You contain that you cannot tolerate.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Just so.\\n\\nWould you like t:
Just so.

Would you like to buy something, pest?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Just south of the village, the: Just south of the village, there's a river that runs an eastwardly course into the jungle. Follow it to the goatfolk village. There you will find Mamon.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Kaleidoslugs! Beautiful slugs,: Kaleidoslugs! Beautiful slugs, they are, lovely crooners. Love em. Big ole slugs. Heh.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Keep your mouth covered, or th: Keep your mouth covered, or the brine air will cure your lungs to jerky.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Keh believes that she gets fin:
Keh believes that she gets final say regarding who is a sister or brother. Regardless of what the sibling in question thinks.

That's part of why I left.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Keh is very wise and very care:
Keh is very wise and very careful, which makes up for her lack of strength or... tact. She always knows what's right, and she runs a very tight shift.

She hates clutter from work like nothing else and cleans up any mess she makes--unless it's a spill, then she makes Kesehind do it. It's because Grand-Doe has a terrible fear of standing pools of water, refusing to touch them. Copper and bronze afflict her with allergy-sores and she can't touch them. She's too old to spar with me, but her bow-arm still aims true.

That's all I can think of.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Keh told me that Eskhind has a: Keh told me that Eskhind has a brother.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Keh? I'm shocked that she even: Keh? I'm shocked that she even deigned to speak my name. I am a pariah now, beneath discussion. Does she demand remuneration for the scant supplies I stole?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Kendren! A moment of your time: Kendren! A moment of your time, please. You are =name=, yes? You seek to solve a mystery here in the village, yes?
Kendren! I am glad to see you.

Thank you again for bringing Neela around, and please forgive her reservation. She mourns the people she thought she knew, but our future will be brighter together.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Kendren! I mean, =name=! My he:
Kendren! I mean, =name=! My heart sings to see you.

Thank you for clearing Esk's name. Thank you for bringing us together. You are always welcome here.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Kendren! Kendren! Take me with: Kendren! Kendren! Take me with you! I want to see the Sixty Stilts!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Kendren! Kendren! Tell us a st: Kendren! Kendren! Tell us a story of the world outside when Grand-Doe is not listening!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Kendren, do you... have any ne: Kendren, do you... have any news of Eskhind, and Kindrish?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Kendren, thank you for clearin:
Kendren, thank you for clearing Esk's name!

You're so decisive. I wish I had that strength.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Kendren, thank you.\\n\\nThing:
Kendren, thank you.

Things may seem grim, but I have a new strength with Neela by my side.
Kendren, you must understand. I spent so many years trying in vain to fall out of love with Eskhind. I thought it the only way to endure our adolescence, watching her poor attempts at courtship with other hindren.

I thought it the only way to endure her departure, as well. But she is returned, and she loves me. Ayvah. I am terrified to speak to her of this, but I must.

Thank you.
Kendren... =name=. I will try.

I... thank you. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Kendren...\\n\\nI have so much:
Kendren...

I have so much anger at what has been done, but you opened my eyes. Thank you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Kendren.\\n\\nForgive me for s:
Kendren.

Forgive me for seeming ungrateful. I am more affected by Esk's return and departure than I knew. Please give me space.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Kesehind is a good boy. He los:
Kesehind is a good boy. He lost his parents long ago, but has been like a son to me.

Now his axe-arm is strong where mine is not, and so he lends it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Kesehind is completely loyal t:
Kesehind is completely loyal to Grand-Doe. We used to be friends, but his disposition has become so sour since he was appointed her protector, and he's quite cold to me now. He can't see well in darkness. He's the holder of Ari, an unbreakable heirloom fire axe, and he's very skilled with it.

He's terribly finicky about food. He'll only eat bland food and meat, and... oh! Once, when he had a bad cough as a faundren, a caretaker tried to feed him yuckwheat, and he kicked her so hard it dislocated her jaw. Poor Elder Eselhind.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Kesehind wields Ari, a battlea: Kesehind wields Ari, a battleaxe handed down through generations. It cannot break, and if it broke a weapon there would be scorch marks on it. This evidence does not hold up.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Kitchen? You think this a mere: Kitchen? You think this a mere kitchen?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Klanq distribute! Cannot kill: Klanq distribute! Cannot kill Klanq in a way that matters.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Klanq got it! Klanq puff on yo: Klanq got it! Klanq puff on you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Klanq is able to answer your q: Klanq is able to answer your questions. You received an operating manual, too, no? Perhaps you could reference it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Klanq live! Tragedy of jalopy: Klanq live! Tragedy of jalopy invite Klanq to dimcandlespace. Klanq soften stone floor with plushes, dust shelves of boring jars with happy and spores. Prickles look at it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Klanq puff on prickles during: Klanq puff on prickles during lecture on light refraction. Prickles angry.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Klanq puff on you! Klanq build: Klanq puff on you! Klanq build jalopy.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Klanq puff on you. You host Kl:
Klanq puff on you. You host Klanq. You spread Klanq for Klanq. Then your Klanq shrivels away.

Klanq puff on you, then Klanq build jalopy.
Klanq puff on you...


..later. Now, Klanq pause puff for prickles favor.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Klanq stir! Come back three da: Klanq stir! Come back three days and Creature arrive. Now, take operating manual.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Klanq want no visitors, so Kla: Klanq want no visitors, so Klanq relocate workshop. Half dimension away. Tasties alter viewing plane.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Klanq. Klanq. Klanq. Klanq. Pa:
Klanq. Klanq. Klanq. Klanq. Pax Klanq.

I would ask to go downstairs but there is not mush room there. Or there is but that's why there's not. It's like, "Neek doesn't need to hear about it."
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Kyakukya? I didn't realize it:
Kyakukya? I didn't realize it had so many syllables.

That's where the, ah, faithful to the ape-god gather, correct? And, uh... Crowsong, as well. I will present this possibility to my people and we will discuss it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Laboratory? You work in a kitc: Laboratory? You work in a kitchen.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Larger than life. Paternal. Co: Larger than life. Paternal. Concerned. The lenses of his eyes are focused on the far points of the world.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Lean in close to see the detai: Lean in close to see the detail. No, don't touch.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Learn well, =factionaddress:Mo: Learn well, =factionaddress:Mopango=. I would fain see =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= succeed in =ifplayerplural:your:thine= task.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Lease control of my Spindle, y: Lease control of my Spindle, you say? Well, well... That's a colossal request. There's no simple price I can assign to such a thing. Were I to grant such a request, you would owe me a great debt. You and several of your allies.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Leather, ring, and plate, to k: Leather, ring, and plate, to keep you alive.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Leave me alone for a moment, =: Leave me alone for a moment, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. I have duties to attend.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Leeches. Blood. If that's what: Leeches. Blood. If that's what you want, I got what you want.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Less I know about where my sto: Less I know about where my stock comes from, the better.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Let us speak of other things.\: Let us speak of other things.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Let us speak of something else: Let us speak of something else.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Let us, ah, do not fight.\"]: Let us, ah, do not fight.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Let... let us speak of other t: Let... let us speak of other things.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Lies. You are trying to manipu: Lies. You are trying to manipulate me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Light gloves, heavy gloves, ga: Light gloves, heavy gloves, gauntlets. Don't let your hands go bare, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Light shine through you, Jacob: Light shine through you, Jacobo. Let's talk.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Lilypad-folk, you say. The sly: Lilypad-folk, you say. The slynth, you say. HA..... HA HA HA! Yes! I never thought to see yet fresher thought-sprouts take seed here in Ezra, but our sun is theirs, and the sky below it, and the thickening air down to the ground. Bring them to hear the songs of our musa-herders, and hope that they survive.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Liquids are better.\\n\\nI pre:
Liquids are better.

I prefer liquids.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Little do I remember now, for: Little do I remember now, for I was but a cub, a nestling, when my kin and I crossed the Homs Delta into Qud. We were urged on by the flooding of a glacial river that flowed through our hearth-cave. The world was just unthawing then, and I recall the roar of the freezing water as it rushed through the grotto, and the frigid spray on my face as I watched in awe.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and =player.formalAddress:
Live and =player.formalAddressTerm=!

{{emote|*self-conscious rkkk*}}

Dr... drink and =player.formalAddressTerm=!

Krka, me. Krka.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink by Her Light.\": Live and drink by Her Light.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink in peace, Aloys: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink, =name=!\\n\\nA:
Live and drink, =name=!

At long last I bear a lighter load of work coordinating our new family members. I won't claim that all of my people are fully comfortable with the slynth, but the faundren love them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink, =name=. Any ne: Live and drink, =name=. Any news from Red Rock?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink, =name=.\\n\\nH:
Live and drink, =name=.

Have you seen your slynth out there? My sources tell me that they are, for the most part, traveling well enough with others. They stop by my tent from time to time to visit and smoke with me, as you do.

One might assume they were born for this kind of life.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink, and collect, a: Live and drink, and collect, and combine...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink, but not everyt: Live and drink, but not everything. Some things you don't drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink, but please do: Live and drink, but please do it elsewhere. I fear spills.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink, disciple.\\n\\:
Live and drink, disciple.

You will be pleased to know that the slynth have proven themselves worthy of apprentice status. They will reside here for as long as they uphold and serve the tenets of our order.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink, friend. rrk co: Live and drink, friend. rrk come to the Yd, shared together. Feel safe and free as woodsmoke.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink, kendren. Have: Live and drink, kendren. Have you... come to a conclusion?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink, kendren. I am:
Live and drink, kendren. I am Hindriarch Keh; welcome to Bey Lah.

It's nearly unprecedented for one such as you to pass by our scouts unaccosted, but these are unprecedented circumstances. I have a task for you. Are you interested?
Live and drink, kendren. I am very busy.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink, kendren.\\n\\n:
Live and drink, kendren.

Please forgive me; I am grateful that you opened my eyes, but the sight of you is yet a bitter leaf. Let me grieve my people in peace.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink, traveler. Are: Live and drink, traveler. Are you hungry?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink, traveler. Mois: Live and drink, traveler. Moist starapples for the road?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink, traveler. Show: Live and drink, traveler. Show mercy to a weary pilgrim.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink, traveler. Welc: Live and drink, traveler. Welcome to the Stilt.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink, wayfarer.\\n\\:
Live and drink, wayfarer.

Cause no strife here and we will have no quarrel.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink. I will return: Live and drink. I will return with news.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink. Keeping well,: Live and drink. Keeping well, I hope?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and drink. Will you be st: Live and drink. Will you be staying long?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and eat honey, bear frien: Live and eat honey, bear friend.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and learn, =name=.\\n\\nT:
Live and learn, =name=.

The slynth are settling in as folk do. I see some flank the Priests and Catechists with empty eye, but some have proven hungry for knowledge. I have established a weekly Canticle study group, and its numbers grow each meeting.

Praise be to Shekhinah for this meeting, =name=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and learn, wanderer. Have: Live and learn, wanderer. Have you come across any books or scrolls in your travels? Do you care to donate one to the cathedral library? Whenever you return, you may speak to me and read anything you've donated.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live and... do as you please.\: Live and... do as you please.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live mites in the burning gas: Live mites in the burning gas will appear green to the Future.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Live, drink, and shoot, =playe: Live, drink, and shoot, =player.formalAddressTerm=, in whichever order you like.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Lived most of m'life on a dese:
Lived most of m'life on a desert steppe twixt the flower fields of Qud and the M'ryee's salt pans.

I ended up here when m'snapbrain cousin played tinker with one of them coiler doodads. The less said about all that, the better.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Look at their chitin! See the: Look at their chitin! See the sheen? Means they're healthy.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Look, Lebah. I have recovered: Look, Lebah. I have recovered the repulsive device.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Lot of good stuff down here. L: Lot of good stuff down here. Lots of bad stuff too.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Lovely to meet you, =name=.\\n:
Lovely to meet you, =name=.

Now. Need a question answered, a tune played, a body upgraded?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Lovely. Take a seat. Chew the:
Lovely. Take a seat. Chew the bark with me, and I will tell you what I know.

I've heard tell that my ancestral hometown, Bey Lah, is in some kind of trouble. They've opened their borders for the first time I know of and are specifically seeking to hire kendren -- that's their word for outsiders like you. Would you be willing to go see what they need?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Luck be with you in the lair o: Luck be with you in the lair of Bethsaida, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Luxury internal adornments for: Luxury internal adornments for the discerning Aristocrat.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"MAQQOM YD. SOUTH-CONTRE FREEN: MAQQOM YD. SOUTH-CONTRE FREEN FROM SALUM.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Maggot! What do you think word: Maggot! What do you think words are? Arrows of inquiry? Words are bricks. Each spoken is laid in bond and builds your prison. There is no understanding.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Maladies of the bone are not u: Maladies of the bone are not uncommon in our people. We build devices to assist friends who wouldst otherwise struggle to walk.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Many Eyes, can you tell me of: Many Eyes, can you tell me of Maqqom Yd?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Many selves? What does this me: Many selves? What does this mean?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Many. Many. This is my third c: Many. Many. This is my third collaboration with Sheba. Our first two collections were called "Immaculate Chrome" and "Outside In".
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Maqqom Yd? The Place outside I: Maqqom Yd? The Place outside Itself?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Materials ready? Circuits to s: Materials ready? Circuits to solder. Klanq stir the soup?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"May I ask some questions about: May I ask some questions about the suspects?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"May I ask you some questions?\: May I ask you some questions?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"May I call you man, woman, or: May I call you man, woman, or something else?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"May I know more about the mopa: May I know more about the mopango?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"May fortune favor you. Live an: May fortune favor you. Live and drink.
May it brighten even further. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"May our lives be as sweet as m: May our lives be as sweet as my harvest, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"May the Argent Fathers watch o: May the Argent Fathers watch over you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"May the Fates favor you, Tau-n: May the Fates favor you, Tau-no-Longer.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"May the earth yield for us thi: May the earth yield for us this season.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"May the future bear out =ifpla: May the future bear out =ifplayerplural:your:thy= promises.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"May you find adequate cover an: May you find adequate cover and more loot than you can carry, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"May you find shade and vittle,: May you find shade and vittle, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"May you gorge upon the flesh o: May you gorge upon the flesh of beasts by starlight.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"May you share my fate, then.\": May you share my fate, then.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"May your journeys favor you. L: May your journeys favor you. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Maybe I'll take this somewhere: Maybe I'll take this somewhere else.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Mayest thou rest ever in the L: Mayest thou rest ever in the Light of the Kasaphescence.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Meat, fresh and preserved alik: Meat, fresh and preserved alike, all at reasonable prices.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Mehmet has bade me travel to R: Mehmet has bade me travel to Red Rock.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Mehmet, the tongue says. Live: Mehmet, the tongue says. Live and drink, =name=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Might not want to touch anythi: Might not want to touch anything on the workbenches, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Mind the trees, =player.formal: Mind the trees, =player.formalAddressTerm=. They ain't yours.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Mind your footing! Ha ha ha!\": Mind your footing! Ha ha ha!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Moloch! Allow me to explain th:
Moloch! Allow me to explain the deification procedure, as it is clearly beneath your station to know!

First, I must image the great Moloch's head, read your self's narrative from the folds of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= Holiest Brain, cross-check it against the Thin World's ambient log of His Eminence's life's deeds...

{{emote|*Herododicus whispers*}} I'm sure your version is the better one, Moloch...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Moon and Sun! The Argent Fathe:
Moon and Sun! The Argent Fathers bless us, our paths are chromed and glistering.

You have my thanks, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. Bel shield you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Moon and Sun, =player.formalAd:
Moon and Sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You walk the Yd Freehold and are welcome if peaceful.

Is there aught you need from Une? Need you defending, or cybernetic wares, or are you here for the hurdy-gurdy?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Moon and Sun, Thah. I am =name: Moon and Sun, Thah. I am =name=.
Moon and Sun; wisdom and will.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Moon and sun, =pronouns.formal:
Moon and sun, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=! You have my deep and many-sided thanks. Here, take the trinket now. And if you're to ever return, let us visit again.

Live and drink!
Moon and sun, wisdom and will.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Mopango are plated, digging cr:
Mopango are plated, digging creatures whose armor scales glow a pale white. They are contemplative, sociable, and mostly peaceful. They commune with ancient objects, which is why a coterie of their kind lives in the Tomb of the Eaters.

They are patient even with rough-hewn wanderers such as we, but it's still not best to ask one to explain eir credo.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Mopango are witnesses of the p:
Mopango are witnesses of the past and shepherds of the future. We seek peace and harmony through understanding the Kasaphescence and Her many children. We nonetheless eschew conformity, and each of us seeketh a personal credo by which we livest our lives.

But I am a poor teacher. Speak to Agyra, and =ifplayerplural:ye shall:thou shalt= gain better understanding.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"More than someone. My liaison:
More than someone. My liaison is the extended, outstretched hands of a greater mind-haven than I have otherwise known. I might not have had the courage to -else without knowing that a collective awaited me.

My future is hazy, my future is bright.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Moving on soon, =player.formal: Moving on soon, =player.formalAddressTerm=? My gloves and gauntlets need no maintenance, so finely are they crafted.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Much was lost, but such is wha: Much was lost, but such is what I expected. Once again, thank you for efforts, =name=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My air-puffed pastry experimen:
My air-puffed pastry experiment collapsed thanks to that disturbance.

Whoever is responsible will pay dearly.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My best customers don't ask qu: My best customers don't ask questions. My best stock asked too many.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My chimeling Tau leaves Chavva:
My chimeling Tau leaves Chavvah, leaves me. It is her choice.

Her transit-psyche manifests at the bottom of Taproot, where we cannot consciously go. To finish the ritual of -elseing, to let Tau become -else, I need a traveler such as you, =name=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My chimeling, burning bright,: My chimeling, burning bright, all starlight and right angles in her heart. She leaves Chavvah; it is her choice. I..
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My chromelings, my machines, m: My chromelings, my machines, my crops. I tend to them and they tend to me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My condolences to your sense o:
My condolences to your sense of smell, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

Golgotha is an execrable place in more ways than one, and I would advise you not to visit without a healthy stock of yuckwheat and honey. If you can cook, a meal with yuckwheat may banish a disease before it comes into its own. Bring salves or urberries, too, and mind your feet in the Cloaca.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My crabs are as gentle as can: My crabs are as gentle as can be. Delicious, too.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My fees for battery charging d: My fees for battery charging depend how empty the battery is when you bring it to me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My friend! Thank you so much f:
My friend! Thank you so much for helping our village!

Our prosperity means that I have new goods for you to peruse, if you're interested.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My implants are acquired peace: My implants are acquired peaceably, I assure you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My job here is done. Live and: My job here is done. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My name is =name=. What is you: My name is =name=. What is yours?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My name is Gyamyo. I am please:
My name is Gyamyo. I am pleased to meet =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, =name=. =ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast thou= spoken to the other watchers? How fare they?

Well, I hope.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My name is Lulihart. The blood:
My name is Lulihart. The blood of the hindren runs through my veins, but two of my three parents were kendren, so that blood is... dilute, and salt-brined from being born out here.

Dilute, salty blood. Heh.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My people have walked the salt: My people have walked the salt for thousands of years, meeting every creature that lives and thinks. From Pale Sea to the marsh of Joppa, and under the Hanging Hills, our chests are drawn.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My quills prickle with unease:
My quills prickle with unease to hear you say such things.

Be certain to visit the village of Ezra. The Daughter of Exile who lives there is as good a tinker as any I know, and she always has surplus she's willing to sell.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My services are available if y: My services are available if you have work to offer.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My snails aren't so suited to: My snails aren't so suited to this climate. Some days I spend more water keeping them properly slimy than I make in sales.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My stomach lurches and quavers:
My stomach lurches and quavers at the shock of this knowledge.

If there is a lesson in your disregard, I will meditate upon it in my own time.

Let us speak no more.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My thirst is mine, your water: My thirst is mine, your water is yours.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My wares are sweet and strong,: My wares are sweet and strong, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Care to try them?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My water goes to scouts to kee:
My water goes to scouts to keep a distant eye on Bey Lah. To make sure that it is still there, still safe.

I have never been within a parasang of my people's land, but I know exactly where the once-hidden village stands. I will share this knowledge with you if you agree to consider whatever their request may be.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"My water is thirst, your water: My water is thirst, your water is yours.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"NAY, FOR I SET THEM A-WHORLING: NAY, FOR I SET THEM A-WHORLING. THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE COVEN DOTH RETURN. THE NOOSPHERE MUST BE TILLED ERE THEY ARRIVE.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"NAY, IT WOULD TAKE CENTURIES T: NAY, IT WOULD TAKE CENTURIES TO INCULCATE THEE IN THE SERAPHIC HERMENEUTICS. AND AS YET, THOU ART NO GIFTED CANTOR.
NAY, NOT SINCE THE {{R|EXIT}}.

BUT NOW THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE GEMARA SOPHIA CONVERGES ON PERIAPSIS NEAR THE ZERO HOUR.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"NAY, THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH D: NAY, THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE WORLD-GARDEN MUST BE TILLED FOR THE COVEN'S RETURN.
NAY, THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE. THE TILLAGE OF THE NOOSPHERE REMAINTH THE PATH OF PLURALITY. SO IT IS WRIT IN THE GEMARA.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"NON MOLOCH HER AT HOM. NON MOL: NON MOLOCH HER AT HOM. NON MOLOCH IN MAQQOM YD.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"NON MOLOCH? NON MOLOCH RETURNE: NON MOLOCH? NON MOLOCH RETURNEN FROM BRIGHTSHEOL.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Need something to complete you: Need something to complete your ensemble, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Neek, chanting: \\\"RECTANGLE:
Neek, chanting: "RECTANGLE HAIR! RECTANGLE HAIR! RECTANGLE HAIR!"

It's sort of like when prehistoric lizards would grow big sails to regulate their body temperatures and you'd say, "I like it, but it looks so organically generated. What if you filed it into a sharp rectangle?"
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Never before had the Templar b:
Never before had the Templar broken so far through our defenses. We live a new reality now, one harder to weather.

Is there anything you need, =name=?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Never greater has been my desi:
Never greater has been my desire to be voted out of office.

Oh, not because of the slynth! Well, yes, because of the slynth, but it's because I'd rather be out there with them -- scouting, guarding, even tending to lah would be better than all this dry supervisory work.

Room, board, assignments... it never occurred to me that immigration would require such intensive logistics.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Never has Kyakukya seen such b:
Never has Kyakukya seen such bustle. These slynth are seem to be as good citizens as any, but I am at my limit with the stress of keeping track of everything.

Please check in again after some time, when I have my wits about me once again.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"New voices, strange and beauti:
New voices, strange and beautiful, carry on the salt breeze.

Some will no doubt be silenced by sun, blade, thirst, bullet, or glow, but they will not fall still alone.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Nigh every settlement a-Qud ke: Nigh every settlement a-Qud keeps a Warden. We snuff threats to the peace.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No additional sterilisation re: No additional sterilisation required, of course.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No good can come of allowing k: No good can come of allowing kendren into Bey Lah...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No lie, I love my job.\"]: No lie, I love my job.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No one leadeth us. We mopango:
No one leadeth us. We mopango hold little regard for hierarchy, and our shared decisions are made through discussion, quiet consideration, and consensus.

Shouldst be otherwise?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No one of fate,\\nno one of bl:
No one of fate,
no one of blood,
no one of importance,
until their return
and the realization of their future.

=name= is a temple in memory
upon which hopes are hung
and rage is borne out.

Too great to be real,
too foundational not to be,
too contradictory to have ever existed.

No one of fate,
no one of blood,
no one of importance,
until, suddenly, someone of all of these things.

=name= is a dream from which we cannot awaken.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No parting is simple. I see yo: No parting is simple. I see you, -elser.
No parting is simple. I see you, fair -elser.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No sudden moves around the Hin: No sudden moves around the Hindriarch, kendren. I am watching you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No thank you. I don't care for: No thank you. I don't care for this job.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No thank you. Live and drink.\: No thank you. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No! Yes? I don't know.\\n\\nYe:
No! Yes? I don't know.
