Yes, I wish I burned it, but I wish I had given it. I wish I had never written it, or I had written it better, or I had simply confessed in person. I wish I had a harder heart.

I wish you would give it back, or burn it, or give it to her.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No, Eskhind. Take the poem. Be: No, Eskhind. Take the poem. Be brave.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No, Grand-Doe is absolutely me: No, Grand-Doe is absolutely meticulous about work clutter. She wouldn't leave scraps lying about.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No, I do not have enough evide: No, I do not have enough evidence yet.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No, I took it apart or sold it: No, I took it apart or sold it or something.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No, I wish to return to Qud.\": No, I wish to return to Qud.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No, I would risk too much.\"]: No, I would risk too much.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No, it can't be... how. This p:
No, it can't be... how. This place. This accursed village!

This whole village be damned!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No, no, =ifplayerplural:ye kno: No, no, =ifplayerplural:ye know:thou knowest= not our ways and I was too harsh. I apologize, and I am not wroth with =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No, no, give it to Neelahind.\:
No, no, give it to Neelahind.

Esk will thank you later.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No, no. Eskhind makes the most: No, no. Eskhind makes the most of what few possessions she keeps, and if she traded a treasure for so much water, she'd never have lost track of any.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No, of course it's a laborator: No, of course it's a laboratory, I wasn't thinking.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No, that can't be it. Eskhind: No, that can't be it. Eskhind hates everything about watervine and keeps a wide berth from it. If her blood was spilled, it would have happened nearer to the path.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No, that's not mine. But it lo: No, that's not mine. But it looks lovely!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No. Eskhind claims to be wrong: No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No. It's not true, and I won't:
No. It's not true, and I won't hear any more of your poisonous ideas, kendren. Consider the topic closed.

Do you actually have a question?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No. She must have sold the art: No. She must have sold the artifact.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No. The Hindriarch lied to you: No. The Hindriarch lied to you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No. Well... no, no. I don't th:
No. Well... no, no. I don't think so.

We're just... sharing nutrients.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No. You are the one investigat:
No. You are the one investigating, so my bias need not enter play. If you determine that Eskhind is guilty, I will heed your word and carry out a just sentence.

After that, I'm not sure.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No. You stole the treasure cal: No. You stole the treasure called Kindrish.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No... Qud is fractious, and no:
No... Qud is fractious, and no lasting peace has obtained. I tried... for decades on decades I tried our paws on the tiller, to shim together what blossomed in the wild...

The restoration of machines, the federation of free sovranties, the nourishing rituals of salt and star, the sacred, the profane...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"No... no, I can't... and the a:
No... no, I can't... and the artifact is lost?

It was all for nothing... for nothing...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"None hailed =name=\\nand =name:
None hailed =name=
and =name= hailed none
but with word and blade
deed and disregard
they stood against old rule.

To push back the Gyre,
to spill of Nephil ichor
they took to the spire
and quieted the remnants.

None hailed =name=
and =name= hailed none
but with word and blade
deed and disregard
they stood against their kind.

To push back the Gyre,
to spill of Nephil ichor
they took to the spire
and enacted a great betrayal.

Death of impossible scale reigned
and we Nervous Ones fell,
and as the Gyre swallowed us
we sang to the last.

None hailed =name=
and =name= hailed none
but with word and blade
deed and disregard
they stood apart and above

To push back the Gyre,
to spill of Nephil ichor
they took to the spire
and quieted the Reshephate.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"None yet. Live and drink, Thah: None yet. Live and drink, Thah.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Not a word of lie, I studied u: Not a word of lie, I studied under a chef who studied under Agate Severance Star herself. That's why my recipes are the best.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Not all life then. But most in: Not all life then. But most intelligent life. Why?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Not at this time. Live and dri: Not at this time. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Not like this. After all we've: Not like this. After all we've accomplished...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Not today, Asphodel. Live and: Not today, Asphodel. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Not today. Live and drink, chr: Not today. Live and drink, chronicler.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Not yet, but that's not the po: Not yet, but that's not the point.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Not yet, friend. Live and drin: Not yet, friend. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Not yet. But I require entranc: Not yet. But I require entrance to the city for the purposes of trade.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Not yet. How are you and Eskhi: Not yet. How are you and Eskhind?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Not yet. May I ask you some qu: Not yet. May I ask you some questions?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Not... the device. Repulsive a:
Not... the device. Repulsive as a key to a prison doth repulse. To know a key is to know of a prison.

Our watched children are bound, and lock swalloweth key. An =ifplayerplural:ye free:thou freest= one, three remaineth forever.

k-Goninon hath it now. An =ifplayerplural:ye seek:thou seekest=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Nothing for now. Live and drin: Nothing for now. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Nothing other than a pet theor: Nothing other than a pet theory of mine that the Spindle is a liquid in laminar flow.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Nothing sadder than a cookfire: Nothing sadder than a cookfire and nothing to cook over it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Nothing short of explosives or:
Nothing short of explosives or heavy equipment could have made such a sound.

Be ready for the worst, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Nothing wrong with beetle meat: Nothing wrong with beetle meat. Come, try it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Nothing. I will return with yo: Nothing. I will return with your knickknack.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Now don't you dare pop my amoe: Now don't you dare pop my amoeba.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Now don't you fret. My crabs a: Now don't you fret. My crabs are docile as dogs.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Now don't you go breaking my f: Now don't you go breaking my fence.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Now you keep your eyes off my: Now you keep your eyes off my young, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Now, =player.formalAddressTerm: Now, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I know you must have an eye for fashion, if you're here.
Now, matters have... evolved... in your absence. Do you choose now to learn more?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Now, our operators at Omonporc:
Now, our operators at Omonporch confirm that a clash with the Templar is inevitable.

This is a grim fact, but it does give space for your bond to flower. Go, become familiar with leading and piloting your creature. Return when you are ready, and we will finally go starward.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Now, uh... hop... hop into the:
Now, uh... hop... hop into the sarcophagus.

Safe travels.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"O Life, O Change! Embrace us,: O Life, O Change! Embrace us, entangle us...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"O Nephilim! Come for our star: O Nephilim! Come for our star bath??
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"O to step over a line\\none is:
O to step over a line
one is not meant to cross
to parts unknown and desired!
O to be halted
by chants and weapons
and crushing shibboleth.
O coven! O not coven?
I only want to see!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"O! O! A new life obtains? You: O! O! A new life obtains? You musn't shudder at old Death!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"O! What is it? I heave... I he: O! What is it? I heave... I heave the weight of ass across my crutch, but the bones are pullproof. My bones inosculate to this grotto, or rather- this grotto, this world is what my bones *are*. Can an old bear divest of his spine, leave it to mosses and the sunstrung birds?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"O, deceit! The grueling gate I:
O, deceit! The grueling gate I crossed on every tilt of glittering dusk. I slept in my crimeclothes and wept, did you hear?

Or could you hear only the damnable static, like me, and speak naught to the machine that belches it out. Heal none of the wounds of its grievous heart, or mine own...

O, oh... So much to bear.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"O, the thrill of coursing Chan: O, the thrill of coursing Change within. Each pump of the heart drives it deeper. Each breath a breath of new life.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"O? BUT THEN, A CHANGE MUST BE: O? BUT THEN, A CHANGE MUST BE WROUGHT FROM WHAT HATH BEEN BEFORE.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"O? THOU ART WISE BEYOND THY ST:
O? THOU ART WISE BEYOND THY STATURE.

THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE COVEN DOTH RETURN.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"O? What.. am I cohering? Curio: O? What.. am I cohering? Curious! To fetch my notebook. But, o...
ONE AGED PLAYER LIVETH STILL. WHILE BARATHRUM DOTH REMAIN UPON THE STAGE, NO PACT SHALL BE FORGED.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Objects out of place, certainl:
Objects out of place, certainly. Bey Lah produces little and sees almost no violence, so signs of the outside world should be easy to find.

You may wish to talk to the villagers, too. My people are starved for entertainment, gossip travels fast, and we are all notoriously poor liars.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Of a sort, yes. I'm part of a: Of a sort, yes. I'm part of a branch who deify the Kasaphescence only. We believe the argent fathers to be earthly beings: important to the faith's early history but not divine.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Of course it was only a matter:
Of course it was only a matter of time before you came to speak to me.

I don't suppose I can convince you to let me tend to my duties in peace? I know nothing of interest to a wayfarer. Each of my days is like the others; I maintain and protect my children, and this is enough. If I desire conversation, there is Ereshkigal.
Of course my eyes do not glow. You see the glint of my mask's optics.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Of course not. Let's back up.\: Of course not. Let's back up.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Offering adornment,\\nNo entry:
Offering adornment,
No entry for this.
My mat is small.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh dear, a mystery.\\n\\nPerha:
Oh dear, a mystery.

Perhaps I should have accepted Angohind's lessons after all.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh dear. Who dressed you, =pla: Oh dear. Who dressed you, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Let me help you, please.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh dear.\\n\\nThis is the cred:
Oh dear.

This is the credo by which I live my life, and =ifplayerplural:ye ask:thou asketh= "what does that mean?"

I cannot summarize such a thing for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. It is too great, too multifaceted.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh joy, another meat-being. Pl: Oh joy, another meat-being. Please tell me you're here to buy something.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh my, what a cute not-bear. G: Oh my, what a cute not-bear. Greetings, cute not-bear.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh wow, an animal.\\n\\nCongra:
Oh wow, an animal.

Congratulations for... not dying.

... wanna buy something?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh! =name=.\\n\\nIt makes me h:
Oh! =name=.

It makes me happy to see you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh! A real live kendren, here:
Oh! A real live kendren, here in our village! Live and drink, lovely friend!

If you'd care to trade, I have a modest amount of local goods I can offer.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh! Brightsheol? The forever b:
Oh! Brightsheol? The forever braid of life? The Garden Behind the High Gate? Why, you must rank among the crown echelon of machine and folk, and you must... well, you must...

Start to decompose. You must... You must be dead. Dead and entombed. The body remains, but the mind wanders...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh! Eskhind wrote that.\\n\\nY:
Oh! Eskhind wrote that.

You should give that to Neelahind. It was supposed to go to Neelahind.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh! Is this what... Esk!\\n\\n:
Oh! Is this what... Esk!

I could have gone years unknowing that my love for her was returned. But this is her script, and these words describe me.

Ayvah, I have to speak to her! Thank you so much, kendren.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh! Kendren, thank you, thank:
Oh! Kendren, thank you, thank you! You've done so much for us. Here is a reward for your hard work.

Um, that said, there's still the matter of finding out who stole our treasure. It'd mean a great deal if you could still help with the resolution of the case.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh! Well. For you to bring me:
Oh! Well. For you to bring me this after returning me to Bey Lah...

{{emote|*she smiles.*}}

Message received, =name=. If I expect my people to face their fear of the unknown, I owe it to them to face mine.

I will confess my feelings to Neelahind, give her the poem I wrote, and accept whatever reply she has for me. Thank you again.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, =name=! I'm so happy!\\n\\:
Oh, =name=! I'm so happy!

I can scarcely believe she loves me, much less that... that we could be together. But it's true. Wherever we go from now on, we go together.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, I am hardly an unbiased ob:
Oh, I am hardly an unbiased observer, I'm afraid -- the Freehold is the only welcoming home I could ever have imagined for myself, and my home before was worse than most. I feel a freedom and responsibility here that I would know nowhere else. That no one else could ever know at all.

But bias aside, you can see for yourself that we are a collective thriving without hierarchy. I'm rightly proud to defend that.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, I am joyous to reside here:
Oh, I am joyous to reside here.

Yd could do, mind, with some measure of hierarchy, and more infrastructure, to attract wayfarers less adventuresome than yourself. Also, Mak absolutely must cease advising that anyone enter the clam; it is not funny and someone could die.

But... the structure of friendships here is true, and sturdy! Kindly keep this exchange between us. I was mostly kidding. Somewhat kidding.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, I am leaden with this know:
Oh, I am leaden with this knowledge. Yet am I soothed by your pilgrimage.

Moon and Sun, I feel the warmth of the Kasaphescence yet. Praise the Argent Fathers.
Oh, I didn't notice you there. That's because I was ignoring you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, I have such a precious van: Oh, I have such a precious vantage point on my sweet neighbor! When he achieves a moment of perfection in his craft -- a flawlessly spiraled barrel, a mound of powder measured to the grain -- he beams like the high salt sun. What a lovely smile.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, I sell whatever sundries t:
Oh, I sell whatever sundries that meet my standards of quality, with some measure of curation. I try to ensure that my shelves carry a bit of many things, but you can count on finding more than enough ammunition and a few recoilers that can lead you back here in difficult times.

If you have anything in need of identification or repair, I can take care of that for you for a few drams as well.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, I'm fine, fine.\\n\\nI sim:
Oh, I'm fine, fine.

I simply adore being assigned this stinking backwater musa grove after decades of service, unceremoniously dumped in an office next to a fleshy tinker who works day and night, making all manner of racket through the thinnest, most conductive walls ever crafted.

What is it humans say? "Living the dreen?" Yes, I am living the dreen.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, Sheba Hagadias. She's the: Oh, Sheba Hagadias. She's the librarian at the cathedral of the Six Day Stilt. My water-sister and cohort in chrome.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, another of our dwellers. I: Oh, another of our dwellers. I won't speak to what Crowsong's deal is. Best you find them and ask yourself.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, do you mean this thing?\"]: Oh, do you mean this thing?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, how your words rasp my sou:
Oh, how your words rasp my soul, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You abrade me.

Let us speak no more.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, it changes by the hour, so:
Oh, it changes by the hour, sometimes the minute. Preserve this, observe that, add anything, taste everything.

But the starapple of my eye, the Spindle up which I cast my ambitious gaze... is edible vapor. Food that you eat, food that you breathe. Sadly, to date the most I have managed is an herbed saline suspension. Salty air, if you will.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, it is you. Stay safe.\"]: Oh, it is you. Stay safe.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, it is you. Thank you for h: Oh, it is you. Thank you for helping the village.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, it's the silver rondure. I: Oh, it's the silver rondure. It's a mark of devotion to the Kasaphescence.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, it's you. Need to rest by:
Oh, it's you. Need to rest by the fire?

It's fine, my wrath has clarified. You were never the problem. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, look. It is a not-bear. Gr: Oh, look. It is a not-bear. Greetings, not-bear.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, no, Eskhind is deathly afr: Oh, no, Eskhind is deathly afraid of saltbacks. She would never get close enough to trade with a dromad merchent.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, no, that wouldn't be Keseh: Oh, no, that wouldn't be Kesehind. He'd sooner die of fever than choke down a single stem of yuckwheat.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, not very much. The only ke: Oh, not very much. The only kendren who were allowed in the village before you are traders, and it's always a very big fuss when one comes by. It's been a while since that happened, though, so any kendren who have visited must have come in secret.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, so =ifplayerplural:ye have:
Oh, so =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast=, and what a sight. Please forgive my distance, but I am loath to touch it.

It appeareth of similar make to the children, and I believe its jaw seeketh them. Lebah claimeth that the device grants freedom, and I wonder what that freedom will look like. Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye should:thou shouldst= speak to the watchers of the children for further insight.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, so it called to you, a fel: Oh, so it called to you, a fellow dying animal?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, so you have! Amazing work,:
Oh, so you have! Amazing work, kendren. We owe you more than we can give, but here is what we can give nonetheless.

You are more than welcome here in Bey Lah any time.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, truly? You won't regret th:
Oh, truly? You won't regret this, kendren, I promise! So, let's get to it!

Every mystery hinges on the detection and interpretation of evidence. As Hemlock Cones said:

Ere any prosecution can commence, Accusers must obtain some evidence. The solving lies in seeing and locating Supporting clues as well as implicating.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, very funny. Live and drink: Oh, very funny. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, we're in but the first pha: Oh, we're in but the first phase of its foundation. The church has amassed a splendid collection of scripts through the years. Glorious Shekhinah, praise be upon Him, gifted us with several caches. The eremites work day and night reproducing them in the scriptorium, and I have taken it upon myself to beseech travelers, for the rarest finds often come from the least likely places.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, yes. Never doubt this.\\n\:
Oh, yes. Never doubt this.

Can one return? Hmm. There's the rub.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, yes. You see, years and ye:
Oh, yes. You see, years and years ago, we were studying optics in the course of our research into laser technology. Barathrum was giving a lecture to some guest attendees, and...

Oh, I'd rather not talk about it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh, yes? I see. Well.\\n\\nDo:
Oh, yes? I see. Well.

Do you... not hunt? Or align with hunters? You reek of predation yourself. You kill, yes?

I recall no promise to become a grazing hedonist. If I am called to hunt I will hunt.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh. Are you lost, =player.form:
Oh. Are you lost, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

I don't mind that you're here, but I was not expecting anyone.
Oh. Esk and I, we had a place... there's a path to the =EskhindRoadDirection= that leads to the remains of a lightning-struck tree, made hollow by the fire from above. It was the furthest from the village either of us had ever been, until I attended my first warden's moot.

She and I would spend time there, back then. Perhaps she is there now, but I don't dare check.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh. It looks like you are sort: Oh. It looks like you are sorting screws and fasteners.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh. Oh no. Yes, that's. That's:
Oh. Oh no. Yes, that's. That's mine.

I meant to burn it. I probably should have burned it. I wish I had burned it.

May I please have it back?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh. She's, well, she's a good:
Oh. She's, well, she's a good person with strong convictions, or has always seemed so. I suppose that isn't helpful.

Esk has a good eye for detail. She hates watervine so much that she avoids the paddies and won't eat matz without lah broth to make it taste better. Umm, she's afraid of saltbacks. She's good at foraging and terrible at crafting.

I've missed her so much.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh. Well, yes, that's... that':
Oh. Well, yes, that's... that's a good idea. You'll help, right? My axe-arm and conviction are strong, but deduction has never been my greatest strength.

I can answer questions about the people in town, if that would be helpful.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh. Yes, this does indicate th:
Oh. Yes, this does indicate that some kind of =motive.influence= transpired, and =thief.name|strip= was trying to hide it.

So what you're saying is....
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh... oh! It's you! You are a: Oh... oh! It's you! You are a dear friend, indeed. Of course, of course! You and your bear friends are most welcome to my Spindle.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh.\\n\\nAyvah, she-- Eskhind:
Oh.

Ayvah, she-- Eskhind wrote this about... me? How my head swims at these lavish words. If she wrote this and meant it for me, she must... love me.

But it can't be. Can it?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh.\\n\\nOh.\\n\\nDid... you r:
Oh.

Oh.

Did... you recover Kindrish?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh.\\n\\nWell then, I suppose:
Oh.

Well then, I suppose I have no insight for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh? A traveler? I see you, the: Oh? A traveler? I see you, then. Live... and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh? Is it really over? I'm afr: Oh? Is it really over? I'm afraid.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh? Oh! Do pick up the mopango: Oh? Oh! Do pick up the mopango recipe for bone babka while you're there, won't you? I must know how they make it so dense.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Oh? Oh. {{emote|*Mehmet pauses:
Oh? Oh. {{emote|*Mehmet pauses.*}}

Don't like the look o' that thing. Best bring it to Elder. Hut's northwise up the path.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Omonporch is a fine source of:
Omonporch is a fine source of bananas, but I have little to say about self-appointed nobility.

Claimed authority has a heady aroma, but no broth beneath it. Let us simply appease Asphodel and leave xem to xyr fantasies.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"On my honor, =player.formalAdd: On my honor, =player.formalAddressTerm=, my goods are of only the highest quality and I offer a fair trade.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Once in the fullness of time t:
Once in the fullness of time there met
the Fool of the Gyre and a wanderer.
The Fool offered a tale of the Reshephs,
and the wanderer sat to hear.

Once in the fullness of time there met
the Fool of the Gyre and a wanderer.
The Fool offered stories of journeyers past
and the wanderer sat to hear.

Once in the fullness of time there met
the Fool of the Gyre and a wanderer.
The Fool offered stories spanning ground to sky
and the wanderer sat to hear.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Once the Seraph had become con: Once the Seraph had become convinced of the Coven's return, they reified their authority and assumed a more material role in onworld matters. The decaying sultanate was a convenient tool.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Once, after it all burst apart:
Once, after it all burst apart,
the Fool of the Gyre met a wise jelly.
They sat in the slag of the world
and the Fool told the story of nowaday.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"One called 1-FF, who wandered: One called 1-FF, who wandered in errancy out from the Tomb and was reprogrammed by the Daughter who lived and died in the rot-black box, nine Daughters ago.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"One size fits all, =player.for: One size fits all, =player.formalAddressTerm=. If I sell it to you, it fits.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"One year ago, someone began br: One year ago, someone began broadcasting a signal from atop the Spindle. I have a recording of it here...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Only a fool asketh after the m: Only a fool asketh after the meaning of a credo.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Only in the Shallows' dawnstir: Only in the Shallows' dawnstirs did I let myself think it possible. And now...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Only silence on the ground\\nm:
Only silence on the ground
met we benighted things
until the Knights Liminal
drew their lines upon the salt.

Unknowing, unseeing,
waiting only to know
who will spin us around next.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Only those who pay their respe:
Only those who pay their respects to the Grave of Rebekah will know the way into the tomb.

If you make it inside, the mopango will offer you solace and knowledge, and can tell you more about the Tomb's contents.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Onworld and inside a polyp-str: Onworld and inside a polyp-strewn trellis, there is a giant frog who hates you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Otho has forbidden me from req:
Otho has forbidden me from requesting a sample of Klanq. I am to refrain from being puffed on, to cultivate my own!

Are we yet researchers? Is subject consent no longer adequate ethical rigor? Let Klanq puff on Dardi!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Otho informs me that you have: Otho informs me that you have a method for decoding the signal. Can you encode your instructions for the baetyl onto this disk?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Otho said you wished to speak: Otho said you wished to speak with me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Our little sanctuary here hath:
Our little sanctuary here hath a fissure in its inner walls. Find that gap and =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt= find Lebah.

Please be gentle. Ey hath ever been the most insightful reader among us, but beareth the weight of an anxious mind.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Our sleepy sage. So sweet. She: Our sleepy sage. So sweet. She calms me. I sit in her room and we muse on the nature of things.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Out East? Uegh. Wouldn't go, I: Out East? Uegh. Wouldn't go, I. Git ta Qudzu. Like as rust the pauldrons right off a-shoulders.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Outside of time I found myself: Outside of time I found myself in a place of light. I chose to return and was made new.
Over there, by your workbench. Is that... Pax Klanq?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"PERCHANCE. SOME BEETLES DOST H: PERCHANCE. SOME BEETLES DOST HOP FROM LEAF TO LEAF. AND SOME DO NOT.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"PHANTASM'D O'RE THE THIN BOUND:
PHANTASM'D O'RE THE THIN BOUNDARY?? 'TIS BEEN A TICK.

AND THOU, CHILD? THOU ART WHO OFF'D THE FLOW AHIND GJAUS.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Pass. This task is not to my l: Pass. This task is not to my liking.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Patience, Warden. I'll get to: Patience, Warden. I'll get to the bottom of this.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Pax Klanq has agreed to build: Pax Klanq has agreed to build the climber. What now?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Pax Klanq is an eccentric mush:
Pax Klanq is an eccentric mushroom prodigy. All their faults aside, they are a brilliant scientist and engineer, and I have little doubt that they could build the climber faster than we could. Several years have passed since we were last in contact, but they owe us a debt, and we must now collect.

Unfortunately, no one knows Pax Klanq's whereabouts. Through contacts I made over the years, I inquired as to their location. The most I was able to garner were these enigmatic instructions:

"Seek the heart of the rainbow, eat the god's flesh, and follow the Coral Path."
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Pax Klanq will mold the creatu:
Pax Klanq will mold the creature from raw bioelectrical materials. You must gather these entrails: the body as a model, the catalyst to charge the sanguine fluid, the atzmus as deistic direction, the armament for protection, and the hamsa for personality. You will bond with the creature, too, and act as its pilot. So you must speak an incantation to inscribe the connection.

You'll also need to procure the sanguine fluid itself. And, too, a power source shielded from electromagnetic attacks.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Peace and health in the light: Peace and health in the light of the Star, pilgrim. Brood with me on the life of Resheph, if you are willing.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Perhaps I shall visit. Live an: Perhaps I shall visit. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Perhaps I'm mistaken. Live and: Perhaps I'm mistaken. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Perhaps being Chavvah's parasi: Perhaps being Chavvah's parasite is affecting your mind.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Perhaps it was too much to wis:
Perhaps it was too much to wish that Bey Lah would change.

But Esk is happy again. That makes me feel happy too.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Perhaps we are,\\nperhaps we a:
Perhaps we are,
perhaps we are.
What wiggles in the hot soil?
Flagella?

Or could it be a tail?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Perhaps we will find out. Live: Perhaps we will find out. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Perhaps you should get back to: Perhaps you should get back to it rather than hanging around my village. Warden Neelahind may be able to help you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Perhaps. My future is hazy. My:
Perhaps. My future is hazy. My future twists in the chill wind of the Gyre. I can have no faith in your vision. You understand this, yes?

I do not wish to know you.

Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Peruse my wares, =player.forma: Peruse my wares, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Adorn your head or heads.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Pick a direction and walk in i: Pick a direction and walk in it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Pilgrims, drawn together by ne:
Pilgrims, drawn together by need and awe and inspiration. Tinkers and sodders and guards and scouts, alloyed under the pressure of lifeswork.

Family, like.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Plagues bloom a thousand year: Plagues bloom a thousand year then die back, shrink under the earth-sponge or move here and east. Vanta, girshling, rot die. rrk the hatchling once saw the Nephilim loom! rrk frightened and hid inside a sponge for thirty moons.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Please be gentle with the parc: Please be gentle with the parchment.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Please don't ask me where Bey: Please don't ask me where Bey Lah is. I will not tell you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Please inspect only the qualit: Please inspect only the quality of the letters. I am not a librarian.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Please knock the sand from you: Please knock the sand from your feet, =player.formalAddressTerm=. It gets everywhere.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Please tell me about the signa: Please tell me about the signal again.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Please understand that we mean:
Please understand that we mean no slight to =ifplayerplural:you:thee= in saying so, but what =ifplayerplural:ye ask:thou asketh= of us is too heavy a weight for =ifplayerplural:your names:thy name= to bear.

Perhaps this will change, come deed and time.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Please, =player.formalAddressT: Please, =player.formalAddressTerm=, buy a schematic. I'm sure it will be of use to you.
Please, =player.formalAddressTerm=, do come in. Take your time browsing my wares.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Poem? I detest poetry. Why wou:
Poem? I detest poetry. Why would one go about learning to write only to use purposefully unclear language, choosing rhyme scheme over clarity?

Of course it's not mine. Take it back.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Poem? Oh! This is a Shakesprig:
Poem? Oh! This is a Shakespriggan sonnet, but I didn't write it--the rhymes are a bit facile, and love poems don't interest me.

I've been teaching Eskhind about sonnets, so she must have written this. But that means... oh, poor thing.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Pouring, decanting, collecting: Pouring, decanting, collecting, mixing. I adore my calling.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Praise =village.sacred=, the s: Praise =village.sacred=, the slynth learn our ways and we theirs. Some do not wholly accept the depravity of =village.profane=, but their ways are born of kindness, and so =village.name= will be kind in kind.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Praise be to Shekhinah! O, sov: Praise be to Shekhinah! O, sovereign Fathers... at last, I am here!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Praise be to Shekhinah, =name=:
Praise be to Shekhinah, =name=, your slynth friends are hard workers and quick learners!

I can't help but feel a bit concerned at their ethic, and who in the church might take advantage of it. I hope to foster an interest in reading in them if I can, before they are taught incuriosity. Perhaps a book club?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Praise be upon Nisroch, who sh: Praise be upon Nisroch, who shelters us stiltseekers.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Precious Shem. They've such a: Precious Shem. They've such a wider view of the world than we do. What a momentous obligation we've created for ourselves, and how I wouldn't undo it!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Precisely. The evidence you pr:
Precisely. The evidence you present paints a picture that will forever hang in the halls of Bey Lah's history. Our fate is in your hands.

Hemlock Cones once said:

As like begets like in daily life
so too in mystery.
Should I paint pictures full of strife
thus violence comes to be.
If I in craft or trade should deal
then deals shall deal by troth
But if I pestilence reveal-
no honey be enough.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Present. Alone, afraid, but an: Present. Alone, afraid, but anticipating my return to the embrace of a collective.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Prickles install reshaping noo: Prickles install reshaping nook in Court of Sultans at Omonporch. There, respackle Creature with one dram of sunslag. Or recall creature if lost.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Primordial soup 20 drams. Act: Primordial soup 20 drams. Act as Creature circulatory liquid. Catalyzed and boom! Animating substance. Electromagnets induce sinusoidal flow.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Primordial soup, to be catalyz: Primordial soup, to be catalyzed and ran through its arteries as the animating substance.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Primrose and witchwood will bo: Primrose and witchwood will boil the boundaries of sense into death-pleasure!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Professor Cones taught me ever:
Professor Cones taught me everything about finding evidence!

Though evidence you found upon the ground may yet be sound,
If it will be sufficient is a toss-up.
Examine all your suspects and their homes and all around,
And find a witness who may dish the gossip.

You can find evidence by looking at things on the ground, but you can also look at your suspects to see if there's anything off about them. You can also ask around to see if anyone has seen or heard anything strange, and different witnesses may have different things to report.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Prune! The utensil prunes! -bu:
Prune! The utensil prunes! -but no, the utensil quivers in uncertainty and vibrates out a question?

The self is riddled with category errors. The thinking brain mistakes formation for meaning.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Psst!\\n\\nHey, can I interest:
Psst!

Hey, can I interest you in some Consortium wares?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Puff on yourself, mushroom. I': Puff on yourself, mushroom. I'm leaving.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Push out the walls of the new: Push out the walls of the new world, Qas, to be its center!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Quality implants for sale at r: Quality implants for sale at reasonable prices!
Quetzal! Thank you, thank you. What a poetic metaphor! You're a regular Shakesprig, aren't you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Quetzal, quetzal, quetzal! Wel: Quetzal, quetzal, quetzal! Welcome to the workshop, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Rainwater Shomer claimed Brigh: Rainwater Shomer claimed Brightsheol was the dream of the Seraph? Is that true?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Raw metals and gems buy and se: Raw metals and gems buy and sell for a fixed water-cost.
Reach out and touch the heart. Our bonds transcend distance!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Rebekah was a healer. But the: Rebekah was a healer. But the daughters of Exile, her acolytes, are tinkers. Why?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Rebekah was a physician, and a:
Rebekah was a physician, and an advisor to Resheph until she lost his favor. When, after years of exile, she lost her voice and her life, she was buried here, an outsider unfit to be interred with the honored dead. So she rests here.

I believe her proximity will help me find my credo.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Relief, relief. Relief from th: Relief, relief. Relief from the void, safety from its creases.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Resheph is gone, biographer. I: Resheph is gone, biographer. I am here, and I have need to travel to Brightsheol. Entomb me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Resheph is remembered as a hea: Resheph is remembered as a healer.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Resheph would not let her retu:
Resheph would not let her return home. O..

{{emote|*Barathrum expels a hushed whimper.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Resheph! If the archon rated n: Resheph! If the archon rated nothing of value in the felt and feeling animal, surely the triad does. You must reconsider.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Resheph! You are the Seraph at: Resheph! You are the Seraph atop the Spindle?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Resheph, I have annulled the n: Resheph, I have annulled the nephilim, the greatest of the Gyre's plagues. Your plan is broken.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Resheph, reverse the Gyre, or: Resheph, reverse the Gyre, or I will destroy you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Resheph, the plagues of the Gy: Resheph, the plagues of the Gyre have returned. Can you help annul them once again?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Returning so soon to check on:
Returning so soon to check on our seedlings?

HA. They grow, eat, sing, and joggle their curious little fingers at the salt sky. See for yourself.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Rocky soil fits only so many r: Rocky soil fits only so many roots, little walker. Perhaps if yours were more anchored here. HA.
Roil with me, and bubble over. Let us exceed ourselves!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Rokhas. I ranch these here bea: Rokhas. I ranch these here beauts.
Rude? How dare--

No, I... I apologize for my rudeness. Please understand that we have lost so much by leaving Bey Lah. My mind is not in a gentle place, and being revisited by the tyranny I left behind is causing newly-closed wounds to open.

Forgive my tone, but please understand: I did not steal Kindrish. You are being used.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"SO IT IS ONCE MORE.\\n\\nTHE C:
SO IT IS ONCE MORE.

THE CROWN IS PRUNED, YET THE TREE IS PRESERVED. THE SKIN IS SHED, YET THE NEWLY-WON SNAKE DOTH SLITHER TO TRIUMPH.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"SOME, LIKE THE INCIDENCE OF SA: SOME, LIKE THE INCIDENCE OF SALT, WERE EXTANT AFFLICTIONS AND ONLY SYNCRETIZED UNTO THE NAMESAKE GYRE WHEN THE MYTHOMOLD OF RESHEPH SET AND FIRMED.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"SOMEWISE ON A FOREST MOON IN H:
SOMEWISE ON A FOREST MOON IN HIGH ERIDANUS, A CAVE-MANK PRYTH A LEVER AND THE DEEP-RIVER MOTOR JUMPETH TO LIFE.

ELSEWISE IN THE SUN BATHS OF MIRACH, THREE PLASMOIDS DRAWTH THROUGH THEIR RITUAL THE SUITED TZEVAOT.

DOTH NAUGHT RELATE THESE TWO? NAY, THEY ARE SEQUENCE PROCEDURES THAT ARCETH TO COMMON PURPOSE, THOUGH NEITHER PARTY KNOWETH WHAT IT IS.
SOUTH-CONTRE FREEN FROM SALUM. BY TRETE WITH SAAD CALLEN MOLOCH, AND MONEIEN BI ALDERSESSE.

BY TRETE GALGALLIM BILDEN PIPE TO DRINKEN THANE SLIPSTREAM, AND FORGE TO BURNEN STEL-CRISTAL, AND CASKE TO HOLDEN GLOUINGE O FISH.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Saad, stonden thu at the heigh:
Saad, stonden thu at the heigh gate to Brightsheol.
Saad, thyn heres been wet with olde lif.
Saad, shaken thyn hed and cross in-to neue lif.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Saad, the bodi dien, but the m: Saad, the bodi dien, but the mind romen.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Saad, welcom.\\nSaad, from thy:
Saad, welcom.
Saad, from thyn heres shaken the wet and olde lif.
Saad, in-to a smal vessel pouren hit.
Saad, to thyn sash attachen the vessel.
Saad, crossen nou thrugh the heigh gate and in-to Brightsheol.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Salum? Is that another name fo: Salum? Is that another name for Qud?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Sapience? Hey!\\nThe time goes:
Sapience? Hey!
The time goes, since I have communed last, my adornments speak.
Has interstate power been declared among the Codex people?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"See how their skin glisters in: See how their skin glisters in the salt sun? Lovely.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"See my whiskers? Starapples. T: See my whiskers? Starapples. They'll boost your virility threefold.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Shall I deliver the poem for y: Shall I deliver the poem for you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Sharp as a tack, and living a: Sharp as a tack, and living a life of deep meaning. Inventive and orderly. I can't say I understand his music, but I do love how expressive he is with it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"She exiled herself by leaving:
She exiled herself by leaving Bey Lah. Our codes demand that no hindren who leaves us ever return.

She knew this, and still she chose to leave.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"She explodes like gas and dust: She explodes like gas and dust in a quiet corner of the galaxy. Radiant. Revolutionary. She's a good listener and companion for supper, which you mightn't expect.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"She loved me.\\n\\nShe loved m:
She loved me.

She loved me and I ... I exiled her. Oh, my heart.

Kendren I, I am grateful that you have opened my eyes to the truth, but how dearly I wish you had intervened earlier. This poem serves only as a harsh reminder that I must give up everything for my duty.

Please. Please leave me be. My heart... Esk, my heart...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"She says that you stole Kindri: She says that you stole Kindrish, the village's treasure.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"She was a healer, yes. The wir:
She was a healer, yes. The wire cutter can perform the work of a scalpel; and the soldering iron, a suture.

To take apart a history, and stitch something new...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"She's a sphinx! So enigmatic t: She's a sphinx! So enigmatic that one. It's not entirely clear if she was there, waiting, when Q Girl succeeded at retreading the mainframe's guts, or if she sparked into being that very moment. Or was it some synthesis of the two?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Shivering stillness, coldbark:
Shivering stillness, coldbark pricking with each thump.

It comes.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Shomer, you impudent whelp! Sa: Shomer, you impudent whelp! Saad Resheph stands before you. Do as I say.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Should I hide in the library?: Should I hide in the library? I believe it's the clever thing to do.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Signs of =circumstance.influen: Signs of =circumstance.influence=, seemingly hidden from the village. But that can't be your only evidence, can it? There's no culprit!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Smell a bit strong? That's how: Smell a bit strong? That's how you know it's good.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Snails find the spiral of anot: Snails find the spiral of another shell familiar and comforting. Should you wear one, they will look upon you favorably.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"So I am told. I have never had:
So I am told. I have never had the pleasure nor displeasure to meet another turret. I know only my friends here, who uplifted me by chance and cared for me by choice.

Wer't not for my shape, I wouldst be little different from other mopango.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"So I am, nestling. For a mille: So I am, nestling. For a millennium now I've watched the river of Time turn the gears of Qud. I even played my part in diverting the river where I could. Oh, but there have been so many players through the years! So many players.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"So help me, Argent Fathers, if: So help me, Argent Fathers, if someone has changed the order of my papers...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"So it's true! O Argent Fathers:
So it's true! O Argent Fathers, how far-reaching your works!

... and my trinket? Did you cast it into the Sacred Well?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"So large? Hoh hoh. Well. Hatch:
So large? Hoh hoh. Well. Hatchlings, so rage-dense. Size diffuses, no?

However. Mak diverges, hoh hoh. Egg-rage simmers on a greater pot. Our voice eld-feeble, close your ears to it. Hoh hoh hoh.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"So much change! I've been inve: So much change! I've been investigating the 'Democracy' that Hindriarch Esk has been espousing, and it strikes me as rife with vulnerabilities to malicious actors. Perhaps it can be refined.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"So much trash! Did a goatfolk: So much trash! Did a goatfolk bully crash through your workshop?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"So they do. Live and drink, Ja: So they do. Live and drink, Jacobo.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"So they do. Live and drink, Ma: So they do. Live and drink, Mafeo.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"So you can answer my questions: So you can answer my questions. You just don't want to.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"So you have seen the truth? Gr:
So you have seen the truth? Great are the machinations of our Argent Fathers!

Our meeting, a tiny Canticle. Fate dances in our shadows by their will and word.

Moon and sun, what a day! What a fine day. Praise Shekhinah!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"So you have, and what proceeds:
So you have, and what proceeds, proceeds.

I felt your coming here, =name=, in Gyredream. I've felt this moment. I feel it now.

The ritual of -elseing is complete, waterhand. You are done, and with our thanks.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"So you say. How can I appease: So you say. How can I appease you?
Soft churns Tau in beingstuff. She will -then, but perhaps not Taulike.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Some help you are! Now our vil:
Some help you are! Now our village lacks a warden.

How are we to protect ourselves?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Some say beetle jerky is too s: Some say beetle jerky is too sour. I say, learn to cook!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Some years later and twenty ag: Some years later and twenty ago, I came upon these mushrooms huts and their goodly inhabitants. They are a people full of earthen poetry, and I was charmed by the warmth they welcomed me with. Surely, I owed my acceptance at first to the countenance I share with their mighty god, but they soon grew to love me, and I them. I've remained here ever since in contemplation of those questions that first stirred in me all those years ago.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Someday I will plumb the depth: Someday I will plumb the depths of Bethesda Susa, that I may meet the Alchemist.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Something changed atop the Spi: Something changed atop the Spindle. If Brightsheol is indeed connected to the city there, then this change may suggest it's in peril...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Something strange is afoot her:
Something strange is afoot here in Bey Lah, and no mistake.

But I am forbidden from investigating. If only there were another detective that I could advise...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Sorry. Lost focus a bit. What: Sorry. Lost focus a bit. What do you need?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Soup, body, catalyst, atzmus,: Soup, body, catalyst, atzmus, armament, incantation, hamsa, power source, soup. Ask component!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Speak nothing of that name to: Speak nothing of that name to me. You are warned.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Speak to a... turret? I suppos: Speak to a... turret? I suppose I will; live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Speak to a... turret? No thank: Speak to a... turret? No thank you; live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Speaking creatures seem very e:
Speaking creatures seem very engrossed in this 'will' idea, but few agree what it is. Your mind is under influence from other thinkbeings the moment you observe them, yes? You 'learn' by imitating, your values and beliefs are adopted from observation. Yes?

I have made a choice to offer my consciousness to a new paradigm, but this choice seems distinct from your conception of 'will'. We speak past one another.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Speaking to other organics is:
Speaking to other organics is as strenuous to me as any physical exercise.

My reclusiveness is not born of antipathy; I simply cannot converse as easily as you do and don't wish to learn how.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Splendid! Perfect! Let me reco:
Splendid! Perfect! Let me record the signal to disk, which you'll need to guard with your life, I'm afraid.

I'll rig up a droid scrambler for you, too. You see, the Barathrumites have programmed a troupe of waydroids to guard the approach to Grit Gate. With the scrambler, you'll needn't worry about them. Wait there.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Spread starapple on yer matz!: Spread starapple on yer matz! It's proof against thirst and harm alike.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Starfarer, herald, disruptor,\:
Starfarer, herald, disruptor,
feared, revered,
savior and abandoner.

=name= is a dream from which we will one day awaken.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshii: Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Step in. Take shelter from the: Step in. Take shelter from the salt.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Still gathering landing pads f: Still gathering landing pads for your drifting vessels, then, =name=?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Strange and rocky times have b:
Strange and rocky times have befallen Bey Lah.

But I'm confident that we can get through this, as we always do. Shall we trade?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Strange creatures can be so cr: Strange creatures can be so cruel and arbitrary, I say in greeting.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Strange, this, and imprecise,:
Strange, this, and imprecise, but as tinkers we know: a crude blueprint is better than no blueprint. You must return to Omonporch and enter the Tomb of the Eaters. Once inside, trace the errant paths cut into the mausoleum by robbers and vandals, and ascend to Resheph's burial chamber.

As for gaining entrance to the Tomb, Resheph sealed the gates a thousand years ago, but there's a flaw in the seal. The ancient Mark of Death has been lost to time, but if you were to recover it and incise the mark on your body, the Death Gate would open for you, as it did for countless Eater cadavers in the long-blurred past.

Recover the Mark of Death, =name=, enter the Tomb, and cross into Brightsheol. Place your paws once again on the dial and drum.

Strange, this, and imprecise, but as tinkers we know: a crude blueprint is better than no blueprint. You must return to Omonporch and enter the Tomb of the Eaters. Once inside, trace the errant paths cut into the mausoleum by robbers and vandals, and ascend to Resheph's burial chamber.

As for gaining entrance to the Tomb, Resheph sealed the gates a thousand years ago, but there's a flaw in the seal. The ancient Mark of Death has been lost to time, but if you were to recover it and incise the mark on your body, the Death Gate would open for you, as it did for countless Eater cadavers in the long-blurred past.

You're to recover the Mark of Death, =name=, enter the Tomb, and cross into Brightsheol.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Stressed crab means tough crab: Stressed crab means tough crab meat. Buy domesticated meat.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Stunning! Eskhind as Hindriarc:
Stunning! Eskhind as Hindriarch?

Those poetry lessons I had been giving her must have inspired in her a sense of civic duty.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Such interesting times we inha:
Such interesting times we inhabit, =name=!

Good to see you well. Is there anything you need?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Such tremendous loss. I wonder: Such tremendous loss. I wonder if more could have been done to prevent it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Sun we once blotted out nestle:
Sun we once blotted out nestles our horizon. We tend thought-seeds with algae, wrap in crysteel, bathe in arc-light. Build, live, fight.

Here as elsewhere, grow is struggle. Fun to watch, no? Hoh. Hoh.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Supporting evidence can be any:
Supporting evidence can be any sign that something is amiss that you can't directly tie to an individual. One common example is a bloodstain, which indicates that violence was committed but doesn't tell you by whom.

At its heart, supporting evidence is most powerful when paired with implicating evidence. Once you have both, you'll be in a good position to accuse a suspect of wrongdoing.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Surely, if you were to interce: Surely, if you were to intercede on our behalf, some might welcome us? If, ah, let us say three settlements were to offer us shelter, this would grant us both direction and agency. Would you consider being our ambassador? Not unpaid.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Svardym Mak's static? Yes, twa: Svardym Mak's static? Yes, twas the Signal. My signal. My tolling bell.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING HAT:
THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING HATH FAILED.

WHEREFORE ART THOU?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING WAX:
THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING WAXES.

WHEREFORE ART THOU?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"THE GRAND KNIT-WORK OF BEINGS: THE GRAND KNIT-WORK OF BEINGS YONSIDE THE JEWELED COSMOS, LABORING INWITH THE 72-FOLD PEACE.
THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE. MINE ARGUMENTS OF PERIAPSIS NEAR THE ZERO HOUR, AND WE APPROACH PERIPOLITICON, AS NEAR THE WORK OF THE GEMARA APPROXIMATES THE MANIFOLDS OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"THEY ARE DICTATES AND CO-CONST:
THEY ARE DICTATES AND CO-CONSTITUITIVES OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA. THE GREAT MACHINE, WORSHIPPED ACROSS CULTURES, YET LIKEWISE BUILDED AND OPERATED.

VERILY, ITS FULL WORKINGS NO ONE-WISE BEING CAN KNOW, BUT THE SERAPHIM HAVE COMPILED THE GEMARA IN THE COURSE OF OUR STUDY.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"THIS IS BUT THE MERE PLURALITY: THIS IS BUT THE MERE PLURALITY, AND MANY OTHER INTERPRETATIONS DO OBTAIN. THE INQUIRY IS EVER RICH. YET INACTION DOTH BUT DEEPEN THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVELESS BE-ING, AND THUS A COURSE MUST NEEDS BE CHOSEN. PRUNING THE CROWN GRANTETH THE BEST CHANCE FOR THE TREE TO THRIVE.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"THIS TIME, THOU SHALT REMAIN A: THIS TIME, THOU SHALT REMAIN AT THE SHEVA WITH ME, AND LEND THY OWN HAND TO STEER THE COURSE OF THE WORLD FROM THIS LOFTY PERCH.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"THOU ART MISTAKEN IN WHAT I VA: THOU ART MISTAKEN IN WHAT I VALUE. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS WITHIN ME.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"THOU ART SAT IN THE MOVEMENTS:
THOU ART SAT IN THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH, AND I BEFORE THEE.

THOU ART AN IMPRESSIVE BEAD TO BE DRAWN UP GJAUS BY THY OWN SPIT AND WILES.

WHO ART THOU?

THOU ART SAT IN THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH, AND I BEFORE THEE.

WHEREFORE ART THOU?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"THOU DOST SURPRISE, WORLD-CHIL: THOU DOST SURPRISE, WORLD-CHILD. I KNEW THOU HADST WROUGHT MONUMENTS WITHIN ME, BUT I DEEMED THEM THINGS OF STONE.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"THOU KNOWEST IT NOT, BUT THE S:
THOU KNOWEST IT NOT, BUT THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVENLESS BE-ING IS AS LIVING A LIFE ALONE, BEREFT OF ALL KINSHIP.

I GRIEVE THAT THOU ART UNABLE TO PERCEIVE THIS. ALAS.

THOU KNOWEST IT NOT, BUT THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVENLESS BE-ING IS AS LIVING A LIFE ALONE, BEREFT OF ALL KINSHIP.

I GRIEVE THAT THOU ART UNABLE TO PERCEIVE THIS.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"THOU SHALT MAINTAIN DISCOURSE: THOU SHALT MAINTAIN DISCOURSE WITH THY CONTACTS UPON THE WORLD, AND FROM THIS PLACE SHALT THOU COUNSEL THEM.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"THOU SHALT REMAIN HERE, OR NO: THOU SHALT REMAIN HERE, OR NO COVENANT SHALL BE DRAWN.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"TO WHAT END? BARATHRUM OFFERED: TO WHAT END? BARATHRUM OFFERED NO INROADS TO SUCCESS.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Take Tau's chime, silent and s:
Take Tau's chime, silent and still. Carry it to the bottom of Taproot, deep under my trunk, where she will make the chime her transit-body and walk away forever. Finish the ritual of -elseing.

At the bottom of Taproot, Tau manifests. She tells us, too, that another waits for her there.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Take care, =factionaddress:Mop: Take care, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Let not complacency end =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, and I shall anticipate further news of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= exploits.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Take out what you've busted an: Take out what you've busted and I'll jury-rig it for a fair price.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Take this, too. A chute of mor: Take this, too. A chute of morphing gel from my personal collection. You've arrayed yourself in the artifacts of time, and so we have little left to give you. But still, this may be useful.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Take your time. The journey wi: Take your time. The journey will wait for you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Takes a simple person to tend: Takes a simple person to tend a simple creature. I don't mind it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Taste what on the wind today,: Taste what on the wind today, =name=?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Tau. We ache in her empty spac:
Tau. We ache in her empty space. Who awaits at taproot? What fate is this?

This is the path. Be wary.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Teach me a secret of the aggre: Teach me a secret of the aggregate mind.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Teach me to cook one of your s: Teach me to cook one of your signature dishes.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Teach me to think like a child: Teach me to think like a child again.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Technically, that makes you an: Technically, that makes you an Eater, doesn't it?
Tell me about the Yd Freehold.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Tell me about the mopango, the: Tell me about the mopango, then.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Tell me about the power source: Tell me about the power source.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Tell me about this ancient vil: Tell me about this ancient village.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Tell me again how the giant cr: Tell me again how the giant creature functions.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Tell me again of the plan to m: Tell me again of the plan to mold a giant creature to ascend the Spindle.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Tell me how to get in anyway.\: Tell me how to get in anyway.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Tell me, =player.formalAddress: Tell me, =player.formalAddressTerm=, is there any sight more sad than a hookah tent without wine?
Tell me. I wish to understand.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Thank you again for opening my:
Thank you again for opening my eyes, kendren.

I have trouble smiling for my grief, my loss. Nonetheless, Eskhind and I have a brighter future because of you, and we are together. The road is hazardous, but we will walk it in time.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Thank you for the help, Angohi: Thank you for the help, Angohind. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Thank you for the update, Otho: Thank you for the update, Otho.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Thank you for what you've done: Thank you for what you've done for our sister.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Thank you for your clarity and: Thank you for your clarity and patience, tinkerfriend.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Thank you for your help, Angoh: Thank you for your help, Angohind. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Thank you, =name=. I have, ah,:
Thank you, =name=. I have, ah, I have been crafting a personal project. Of sorts. I promise it to you for this task, and of course the gratitude of a young species.

Return to me after settlements agree to grant us refuge, and I will discuss them with my kin.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Thank you, =name=. I like you: Thank you, =name=. I like you too.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Thank you, Agyra. Live and dri: Thank you, Agyra. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Thank you, Dyvvrach. Live and: Thank you, Dyvvrach. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Thank you, Lulihart. Live and: Thank you, Lulihart. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Thank you, Yona. Live and drin: Thank you, Yona. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Thank you, that will do. Live: Thank you, that will do. Live and drink.
Thank you. I have more to ask.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Thank you. Live and drink, Dad: Thank you. Live and drink, Dadogom.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"That chrome orb earring you're: That chrome orb earring you're wearing. What's the meaning of it?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"That codex? A comfort, a guide: That codex? A comfort, a guidebook, a ledger. My crimes have no signatories, but the heart is its own document.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"That is all. Live and drink, f: That is all. Live and drink, faundren.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"That is sterling news, =factio: That is sterling news, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. I'll go inform Barathrum straightaway.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"That rumbling... what was it?: That rumbling... what was it? An explosion? Hmm...
That smell from the oven is... indescribable.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"That thing sounds like a dying: That thing sounds like a dying animal.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"That was not so much an explan: That was not so much an explanation as it was a rephrasing.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"That will be revealed to you i:
That will be revealed to you in due time.

Do not forget your place, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"That would be nigh unto imposs: That would be nigh unto impossible for Kesehind. He cannot perform fine tasks by torchlight; his night vision is too poor.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"That'd be the mushrooms. Bit h: That'd be the mushrooms. Bit heartier, a-ye?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"That's all for now. Live and d: That's all for now. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"That's all you have to say?\"]: That's all you have to say?
That's always a risk, kendren.

Neelahind knows everyone in the village very well. If you present supporting evidence that contradicts something the Warden knows to be true about the suspect, well, she probably won't believe you. In fact, she might not let you accuse that person again, so be careful.

If you make too many bad accusations, you might lose credibility with her entirely.
That's my dear friend, Euclid. It's a prattleplant. It stores every phrase it hears in its neuroot network, and it mimics speech by flicking its leaves against one another. What comes out is gibberish as often as not, but even so, it's agreeable company for my nights spent tinkering. It is old, perhaps older than I am, and it hasn't yet run out of things to say.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"That's not even how it works!\:
That's not even how it works!

First, I image your head, read your self's narrative from the folds of your brain, cross-check it against the Thin World's ambient log of your life's deeds...

Then I... stylize... the story, and I engrave it on the walls. Once I'm done... then you can entomb =player.reflexive=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"That's right. By concealing =a: That's right. By concealing =all.influence=, it was =thief.name|strip= who stole Kindrish!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"That's right. I've leased your:
That's right. I've leased your friends the Spindlegrounds and appointed you viceroy to oversee their operation.

Welcome to court, asphodelyte. You serve at my pleasure.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Barathrumites of Grit Gate: The Barathrumites of Grit Gate agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Barathrumites say I must p: The Barathrumites say I must plumb a cave called Golgotha before joining them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Fishhead will catalyze the: The Fishhead will catalyze the electric lake, and sure we as fossils will brick the ground but what a dais it will be!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Freeholds of Qud, that web:
The Freeholds of Qud, that web of folk-clusters, of committees and caucuses, syndicated slime-mold cities held in peace by mutual frustration and monumental effort.

If you need detail, ask a Freeholder, but clear your day first.
The Grounded Mind cannot soar. The Mind Aloft is limitless.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Hindriarch is the most lik:
The Hindriarch is the most likely suspect, in my opinion. She might have kept it for herself or sold it. I've been suspicious of her pet bodyguard, Kesehind, for years--I wouldn't put it past him to steal the treasure himself.

That said, it might have been an outsider like you. I doubt any of the villagers had the nerve to steal such a valuable object, but I suppose it's faintly possible.

But it wasn't Neelahind. You won't find a purer heart in all of Qud than hers.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Hindriarch mentioned that: The Hindriarch mentioned that you have a brother. Where is he?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Kasaphescence shine upon =:
The Kasaphescence shine upon =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, =name=.

Although the welcome of these slynth be not entirely without incident, I am yet hopeful that their curiosity and dedication to tasks will serve them well among us.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Mechanimists of the Six Da: The Mechanimists of the Six Day Stilt agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Putus Templar, or the Sons:
The Putus Templar, or the Sons and Daughters, as they call themselves, are an order of knights who claim descendancy from the Eaters, the ancient folk who wrought the chrome halls of Qud. Beware them, for while they despise all mutants, they harbor a special malice for Barathrum.

Take care that you do not find =player.reflexive= inside one of their slave pens.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Rainbow Wood is a fair bit:
The Rainbow Wood is a fair bit too dangerous for a casual promenade, but nothing compares to its beauty. Once, I viewed it from above by means of a gyrocopter, and I will never forget the sights that I saw.

Nor will I forget crashing to the ground because the gyrocopter broke, but every adventure has its complications, wouldn't you say?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Resheph, power-haver,\\nru:
The Resheph, power-haver,
ruler of souls,
holder of land,
authority made singular.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Seekers of the Sightless W: The Seekers of the Sightless Way hunt espers.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Seraph spoke of a Great Ma: The Seraph spoke of a Great Machine that spanned galaxies, the motion of whose sails and gear trains directed the fluidic shifting of stars and cultures. But they spoke little of it, and little I know.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Svardym Geeub mentioned a: The Svardym Geeub mentioned a machine speaker and her ursine apprentice. Was that you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Templar are assaulting the:
The Templar are assaulting the enclave? Oh dear, dear...

May our guns' lasers shine with the light of the Kasaphescence.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Templar are defeated, but: The Templar are defeated, but will they return in force?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Temple of the Rock is cut: The Temple of the Rock is cut off from the wider world, and I hear the Mechanimist colonists no longer recognize High Priest Eschelstadt. That said, if you are favored by the Mechanimists, if you are welcome in their holy places, then I've no doubt that Phinae Hoshaiah will grant you peaceful entry.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Tomb of the Eaters consist:
The Tomb of the Eaters consisteth of twelve strata, or ten, once =ifplayerplural:ye account:thou accounteth= for transitional levels: the Folk Catacombs (in which =ifplayerplural:ye currently stand:thou currently standeth=), the Crematory and Columbarium, the Two Crypts, and the Six Tombs of Qud's Sultans above.

An =ifplayerplural:ye seek:thou seekest= fortune here, gird =ifplayerplural:thyselves:thyself= for disappointment. The tomb playeth host to objects wondrous and profane alike, but little of what surface-dwellers considereth treasure.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The Yd Freehold agreed to acce: The Yd Freehold agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The amaranthine dream! The hei: The amaranthine dream! The heights within ourselves we might yet reach with his guidance. There it is in all of us -- shades of our elder selves. Within each man, a goat. Within each goat, a man!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The beacon confirmed my hypoth:
The beacon confirmed my hypothesis. The Spindle is an elevator, engineered by the Eaters to convey freight to and from the vault of heaven. You see, nestling, in the earliest aurora of our past, the Eaters of Earth were joined by a great coven of beings that spanned the firmament. But the Eaters succumbed to some terrible temptation, and an injunction was placed on our world.

Since then, the stars were silent to us, and our world was left to molder and decay. But something changed. The signal affirms that an entity roosts atop the Spindle, and invites us to join it.

Dare I say, is the injunction at an end? It's too early to tell, but alas, there could be hope for our world.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The bell sounds wheel at right: The bell sounds wheel at right angles and shock the wet meat off our perfect bones! I was made to be bones.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The carved reliefs here are Ea: The carved reliefs here are Eater-ancient. What is the history of this place?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The cats are not for sale.\"]: The cats are not for sale.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The chimes of Chavvah have agr: The chimes of Chavvah have agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The climber design relies on t:
The climber design relies on the use of electromagnets to interface with the planet's magnetic field and generate torque. Unfortunately, the Spindle generates its own interfering field, perhaps as a mechanism to prevent unwanted ascension.

Our aim is to access the Spindle's control unit and disable the field. How we accomplish this, however, is an enigma. From disparate bits across the archives of the digitum, Ereshkigal has stitched together a cryptic but instructional brocade. She's learned the field can be turned off from a place called Brightsheol, located in the Thin World and accessible only through Resheph's tomb inside the Tomb of the Eaters.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The cracked egg from we crawl:
The cracked egg from we crawl yet rest, in the Reef.

Siblings there. One speak very well: Thah.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The creature has been made. Wh: The creature has been made. What now?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The creature is born, and you: The creature is born, and you are bonded? What work! You are a sterling shaper of world, =name=, and I've nothing left to give you but my praise.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The echoes of ending reverbera:
The echoes of ending reverberate from the roots I once called mine.

My liaison is severed. Why?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The electric sizzle of life! P: The electric sizzle of life! Prickling and crisping skin, red and raw and beautiful beneath.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The engraving is done, Moloch!:
The engraving is done, Moloch! I do hope it's to your liking. Your deeds are incised here for all time.

You may now enter the sarcophagus, Moloch. Be at peace.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The entity I spoke with at Eyn: The entity I spoke with at Eyn Roj mentioned a chiming rock...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The evidence is clear. In viol:
The evidence is clear. In violation of sacred law and the will of her people, Eskhind stole the artifact called Kindrish from Bey Lah. She will be stripped of honor, stripped of water, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will her name be spoken here again, and she will never return... on pain of death.

And I... I will go with her. May my property be payment for the harm she has done to our people, and I will gladly pay it for the privilege of walking by her side.

I have no doubt that Bey Lah will thrive in my absence as it did before I became warden. Live and drink, my kin. Long may Hindriarch Keh lead you.

She will be stripped of honor, stripped of water, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will her name be spoken here again, and she will never return... on pain of death.

And I... I will go with her. May my property be payment for the harm she has done to our people, and I will gladly pay it for the privilege of walking by her side.

May the fates have mercy upon us all.

She will be stripped of honor, stripped of water, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will her name be spoken here again, and she will never return... on pain of death.

She could never hope to repay the harm caused by her actions, but we will grant her this last mercy: Bey Lah will forget her debt alongside her name.

Just is the leadership of Hindriarch Keh. Long may she live!

She will be stripped of honor, stripped of water, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will her name be spoken here again, and she will never return... on pain of death.

May the fates have mercy upon us all.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The evidence is clear: Bey Lah:
The evidence is clear: Bey Lah's own Hindriarch has betrayed her people. She took our ancestral treasure as her own, pinning the crime on an exile she knew could not defend herself. For this treason, she is hereby stripped of title, stripped of property, stripped of home.

With the exile of Keh-Hind, the hindriarchy lies vacant, with no elders fit to take it. Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people. It will be a challenge to accept change, but we will be stronger for it.

The evidence is clear: Bey Lah's own Hindriarch has betrayed her people. She took our ancestral treasure as her own, pinning the crime on an exile she knew could not defend herself. For this treason, she is hereby stripped of title, stripped of property, stripped of home.

With the exile of Keh-Hind, the hindriarchy lies vacant, with no elders fit to take it. Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people. May Hindriarch Esk lead us to a brighter future!

The evidence is clear: Bey Lah's own Hindriarch has betrayed her people. She took our ancestral treasure as her own, pinning the crime on an exile she knew could not defend herself. For this treason, she is hereby stripped of title, stripped of property, stripped of home.

With the exile of Keh-Hind, the hindriarchy lies vacant, with no elders fit to take it. Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people.

I fear dark times ahead. We must remain strong in the coming days.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The evidence is clear: Eskhind:
The evidence is clear: Eskhind did not steal Kindrish. In fact, I believe that no hindren was responsible for its theft, but one of the kendren who permeated our borders well before our investigator arrived. Any of them could have committed the theft.

Eskhind is free to go, and I'm... I'm going with her. I cannot serve under Hindriarch Keh while my beloved returns to exile.

Goodbye. May the fates have mercy upon you.

Eskhind is free to go, and I'm... I'm going with her. I cannot serve under Hindriarch Keh while my beloved returns to exile.

I have no doubt that Bey Lah will thrive in my absence as it did before I became warden. Live and drink, my kin. Long may Hindriarch Keh lead you.

The evidence is clear: Eskhind did not steal Kindrish. In fact, I believe that no hindren was responsible for its theft, but rather one of the kendren who permeated our borders well before our investigator arrived. Any of them could have committed the theft.

Eskhind helped us cleave to the path of justice. She is free to go, and her name will not be forgotten, but she must remain in exile.

Just is the leadership of Hindriarch Keh. Long may she live!
