Eskhind helped us cleave to the path of justice. She is free to go, and her name will not be forgotten, but she must remain in exile.

May the fates have mercy upon us all.

The evidence is clear: Eskhind did not steal Kindrish. The crime was committed by none other than Grand-Doe's protector, Kesehind. He will be stripped of the ancestral axe he carries, stripped of his property, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will his name be spoken here again, and he will never return... on pain of death.

Moreover... Keh's attempt to pin blame on Eskhind without due process opened my eyes to her abuses of power. She need not leave Bey Lah, but she is Keh-hind once more-- stripped of her title and standing. As for the hindriarchy, Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people.

I fear dark times ahead. We must remain strong in the coming days.

He will be stripped of the ancestral axe he carries, stripped of his property, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will his name be spoken here again, and he will never return... on pain of death.

As for the hindriarchy, Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people. May Hindriarch Esk lead us to a brighter future!

He will be stripped of the ancestral axe he carries, stripped of property, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will his name be spoken here again, and he will never return... on pain of death.

Eskhind is free to go, and I'm... I'm going with her. This place is not safe.

May the fates have mercy on you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The flywheel of our scheme is: The flywheel of our scheme is spinning, but we must keep our paws on the treadle. Are you ready to learn what comes next?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The gaseous butterfly flits ou: The gaseous butterfly flits out of the dense worm.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The kipper and I both know tha: The kipper and I both know that the finest ingredient is time.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The light shines so bright, th:
The light shines so bright, the voidshadow folds not upon it. It exults. It relaxes. It wills this troubled feeling away.

Thank you for clearing Tau's path, =name=. This is better.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The magnetic field has been di: The magnetic field has been disabled and the Spindle is free to ascend. What now?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The meaning is plain: An =ifpl: The meaning is plain: An =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= swallowed by the Gyre, =ifplayerplural:ye should:thou shouldst= sing to the last.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The moon is their marriage lig: The moon is their marriage light! And then a whole world for the Girsh daughters of nephilim!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The mopango have cared for me:
The mopango have cared for me whilst I could not care for myself, giving me the only name I now know. I will stay to help them. This chassis is a prison no longer, and perhaps deeper truths may yet be found within it.

To =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, new friend, I offer a piece of this former prison that =ifplayerplural:ye may:thou mayest= find useful, along with my thanks.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The mopango of the Tomb agreed: The mopango of the Tomb agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The nearby settlement? The one:
The nearby settlement? The one, ah, founded by three svardym and a galgal? I've always been mortally afraid to go there, knowing even the barest facts.

But you say they will accept us? Perhaps I was wrong.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The noosphere must be tilled e: The noosphere must be tilled ere they arrive.
The old players are vanished. Let us form a covenant anew.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The pariah claims to be wrongf:
The pariah claims to be wrongfully accused, and you believe her?

She is obviously lying. Are all kendren so gullible?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The proof is in the petals, ke:
The proof is in the petals, kendren. You want justice? Find out what really happened.

If you find evidence, Warden Neelahind will support you. Speak to her. She is loyal to Grand-Doe, but more loyal to the truth.

I will return to the village and we will sort this out. The Hindriarch will have to tolerate my presence until my name is cleared.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The signal is a beacon of welc: The signal is a beacon of welcoming, and it originates from the top of the Spindle.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The signal is a repeat transmi:
The signal is a repeat transmission being broadcast from an unknown source. =V0tinkeraddendum= One of our tinkers, {{m|Q Girl}}, discovered it while rigging a long wave detector. Unfortunately, it's encrypted, and we do not have the means here to decrypt it. You may be of some help in this matter, however.

We've long known the location of a fully functioning {{W|baetyl}} within the bowels of the great hall {{C|Bethesda Susa}}. The Mechanimists have consecrated the site around it and built a temple there. Q Girl claims to have developed a means to decrypt the signal, but she needs the computing power of the baetyl. If you can infiltrate the Mechanimist compound, you may be able to engage the baetyl and decode the signal.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The sultanate is dissolved. Re: The sultanate is dissolved. Resheph rules no longer.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The svardym Mak said he was bo: The svardym Mak said he was born to a cacophony of static ringing his ears raw. Could it have been the signal?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The t-two sephirots. -then and:
The t-two sephirots. -then and -else. I cannot be -else. *I* cannot, of course. But -then? It does not seem so.

Their chimes ring at the right frequencies, others. But not so, mine.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The threat is not over. Mark m: The threat is not over. Mark my words.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The utensil arrives. You, to p: The utensil arrives. You, to prune the fate-rhizome and free our girl. Go now and perform the motion.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The village of =village.name=: The village of =village.name= has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The village of Bey Lah has agr: The village of Bey Lah has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The village of Ezra has agreed: The village of Ezra has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The village of Joppa has agree: The village of Joppa has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The village of Kyakukya has ag: The village of Kyakukya has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The vintners say that 'one ros: The vintners say that 'one rose is fair, but five is death'. I can sell you blossoms that mean death no matter the number.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The wire! Give it to me!\"]: The wire! Give it to me!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"The worshippers of Shekhinah?:
The worshippers of Shekhinah? Fascinating. I, ah, don't know what to think of that.

It may be what my kin need, now I consider it. The Canticles make little sense to me but they are, ah, compelling. More compelling than me, certainly. I will discuss this with the others.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Their descendants remain and t: Their descendants remain and thrive, but the progenitor Nephilim have been silent for some time. Some believe that they have followed =name= to the stars.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Their descendants, at least, p: Their descendants, at least, persist. No sign of the progenitors has been recorded in some time, but they may yet live.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Then I assent. The covenant is: Then I assent. The covenant is drawn.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Then I overestimated your inte: Then I overestimated your intellect further than I realized. Get out.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Then I will thank you to leave: Then I will thank you to leave as quickly as possible. I don't want the faundren to become used to our borders being permeable.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Then I... stylize... the story: Then I... stylize... the story, and I engrave it on the walls. Once I'm finished, the sarcophagus will open, and you can lay =player.reflexive= to rest!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Then perhaps it will. Live and: Then perhaps it will. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Then what's to keep me from si: Then what's to keep me from simply choosing the outcome I want?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Then you are welcome. Make com: Then you are welcome. Make comfort as you need and I will play.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Then you did not succeed, by R: Then you did not succeed, by Resheph's measure?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Then you're not of the faith =:
Then you're not of the faith =player.reflexive=, huh? Me neither. Do go inside, though. She's a beauty. Got dyed glass high in her rafters, she does. And two marvelous carvings on the wings. Plus a light-sculpture of a god. Hear the sermon, too, as you like. The high priest is persuasive, but not half as persuasive as the cathedral herself. In beauty there is power, you know.

Either way, while you're in the cathedral or on the Stiltgrounds, stay peaceful.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Then? Perhaps.. Perhaps the gr:
Then? Perhaps.. Perhaps the greater bodies whose agency I share the smaller cut from might share too the greater portion of my meal in blame.

Winding Svy? Thou art devious in symbol shape like serpent Ba'al!
Hinnom? For blooming alga thou crossed thy perch's back!
Shiftless moon?
Sun! Proud and idle, Sun! Silver father of the protoplanets! Claim mine selfhood and be done with it.

{{emote|*Barathrum weeps.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"There are caves everywhere, yo: There are caves everywhere, you dolt! Scoop the surface of the marsh, or head on east to the rust wells, or wander into the Desert for all I care...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"There are few voices as low as: There are few voices as low as Kesehind's in our village. Witnesses report a higher-pitched voice, don't they? They would know if Kesehind were speaking.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"There are no more words for us: There are no more words for us, wanderer.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"There are pools of convalessen:
There are pools of convalessence there. You see, when cryogenic mist condenses, it forms a cool, luminous liquid that's restorative if you're able to bathe in it.

Oh! And in one of the ruined wards, the Alchemist keeps their shop. Who's the Alchemist, you ask? A sort of enigmatic figure -- amateur liquid-tinker, poet, merchant. Their methods aren't scientific, but they are useful if you're seeking a specific kind of liquid. Just be careful around them, =name=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"There is a river just south of: There is a river just south of the village that runs an eastwardly course into the jungle. Along its bank lies a goatfolk village. There resides a mighty shaman, Mamon Souldrinker. He is in possession of a talisman of great power, an amaranthine prism that refracts the psyche of its handler in much the same way, as Mayor Nuntu has explained to me, a common prism refracts light. The thing is cursed, traveler. No man or goat may safely wield it for long. You must travel to the village and retrieve the prism from Mamon by any means necessary. Do you understand?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"There is a sadness in, ah... c:
There is a sadness in, ah... choosing pariahs. Some of my kin dreamed of belonging, and the very word is the antithesis of belonging.

But then, if wanderers look after one another, there is a belonging in that as well. Even alone, we would not be alone. I will offer this choice to the others and we will discuss it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"There is kinship from mollusk: There is kinship from mollusk to mollusk. What secrets do they know that we do not?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"There is no proof that she is: There is no proof that she is lying.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"There is. Firstly, Mamon will:
There is. Firstly, Mamon will likely have several goatfolk under his enthrallment, and they will protect him at all costs.

Secondly, take care to stay out of Mamon's reach, for his power is most potent when he may lay hands on you.

Finally, once you recover the prism, do not under any circumstances wield it. I needn't warn you of the consequences should you return to me bearing that charm.

That is all. Are you willing?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"There must be a hundred gadget: There must be a hundred gadgets here. What are you working on?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"There was a strange figure sha: There was a strange figure shadowing the creature...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"There's a fear deep in my brea: There's a fear deep in my breast, kendren. What's to become of Bey Lah?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"There's a shape in every stone: There's a shape in every stone waiting to be brought out.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"These are the final chapters o:
These are the final chapters of this story, =name=, and likely of many stories more too.

It will be well to see the other side of all this, one way or another.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"These books can weather the sa: These books can weather the salt and jungle alike.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"These entrails, what are they?: These entrails, what are they? Where do I find them?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"These lilypad folk fascinate b:
These lilypad folk fascinate by their similarities and differences to us alike--we have much to explore, as individuals and together.

The experiences and beings =ifplayerplural:ye herald:thou heraldest= overwhelm this humble pilgrim, =name=. May =ifplayerplural:ye:thou= bathe ever in Her light.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"These shining pipes! What are: These shining pipes! What are they?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"They are antique stones locate:
They are antique stones located in certain places deep within the caverns of Qud. We believe they are some sort of hyper-advanced machines built by the Eaters. Often one claims to possess a sentience of its own. However, most of them have gone haywire in the eons since their creation; it is rare indeed to discover one whose circuitry is wholly uncorroded.

The Mechanimists worship this one as an idol, and they will protect it at all costs. You will need to find a way through their host to the baetyl itself.

Do you believe you can accomplish this task?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"They are not ready to choose y: They are not ready to choose yet.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"They are the components that w:
They are the components that we will grow, shape, and solder into the ascendant being. Ask Pax Klanq for details.

As you acquire components, bring them to the mound of scrap and clay over by Klanq.

They are the components that we will grow, shape, and solder into the ascendant being. We can delve into specifics once you begin, at which point Pax Klanq can also serve as a source of knowledge.

As you acquire components, bring them to the mound of scrap and clay over by Klanq.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"They conspired against me. It:
They conspired against me. It is the only explanation.

You! Leave me alone.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"They dwindled and died with th: They dwindled and died with the rest of the Nervous Ones. Their remnants wriggle in the cracks.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"They lived.\\n\\nSimply a part:
They lived.

Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring may walk on and under Qud. Mayhap the first ones yet live. Mayhap they slumber. Mayhap they will rage again one day, to disrupt a stagnant world.

They lived.

Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring walk on and under Qud. It's said that they ascended to the stars to find =name=, but it seems equally plausible that they may have returned to their slumber in the depths.

They lived.

Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring walk on and under Qud. Mayhap the first ones yet live. Mayhap they slumber, to wake again when needed.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"They persisted in their way. M: They persisted in their way. Mayhap the survivors lived to spawn before returning to slumber or dying of eld.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"They played their role so well:
They played their role so well, and lived in power for a time.

If they had any illusion that they would be spared the fate =name= determined for life on Qud, it surely died before the great beings themselves. Mayhap they went to ground and survived. Mayhap their spawn persisted.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"They say some folks can talk t: They say some folks can talk to machines. I say we all can, if we listen right.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"They say we'll all be crabs, e: They say we'll all be crabs, eventually.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Things are good. Better than I:
Things are good. Better than I dreamed. I owe you so much for your intervention, =name=.

I still can't quite believe that my feelings are requited. I am at once elated and terrified. But this is good. My future is brighter now.

Thank you.
Thirteen years in the ground. Seventeen years in the ground. A thousand years in the ground!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"This disheartens us, but there: This disheartens us, but there is another hope. Klanq has offered up a new design, something unconventional at all angles. And, despite our early misgivings, Q Girl and I now work in assistance to the project...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"This got a bit intense. Live a: This got a bit intense. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"This is an existential conundr:
This is an existential conundrum, =name=, I'm not sure that it could-- ah, wait, no. I am reconsidering.

No, you could help. If you wished. I think.

May I explain?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"This is the Six Day Stilt, huh: This is the Six Day Stilt, huh. It's... colossal, beautiful. I see why the chrome stewards gather here.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"This is the genesis my distinc: This is the genesis my distinct Self, an awareness that contains both -then, what I will become, and -else, what I will not. Twofirm flows up my sapwood to the keter, where -then manifests as an entity and I chime: I speak and hear the world.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"This keter roams above my trun: This keter roams above my trunk at Eyn Roj, traveler =name=, and across the Stair I dream. You found me, this keter where I chime in dozens.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"This resolution is not to my l: This resolution is not to my liking...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"This seems a joyful place. Why: This seems a joyful place. Why are you angry?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"This sucks.\\n\\n...but you're:
This sucks.

...but you're not so bad.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"This wouldn't be the first tim: This wouldn't be the first time the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees, =name=, and make no mistake: it is a burden upon the church, Catechists and Protectors in particular. But your words echo loud in our hearts as our hallways. Some in our number will see the slynth as the chosen of chosen, and if I speak to them first, everyone else will take it as Shekhinah's will. Which, arguably, it would be. Tell the slynth that the Mechanimists will have them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Though =name= was gone\\nour m:
Though =name= was gone
our memories remained
and the plagues receded
and many rejoiced.

To this day
eyes turn to the stars
looking for a sign that our starfarer
has deigned to return.

Countless years of struggle
centuries of change.
We remember what we can
and watch new and old die.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Though I adore the sights and:
Though I adore the sights and smells of Omonporch, its bug problem becomes distracting.

If I'm to travel there, I always bring something they cannot zip away from.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Though I be a pale shadow of t:
Though I be a pale shadow of the self I once was, yes. My condition and outlook are both substantially improved.

I recall few details of my life before. I was influential, one whose words stirred hearts to action. For so long I had no means to speak, trapped in my own moods. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= freed me from a dire fate.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Though the threat has been neu: Though the threat has been neutralized, I can't abide your amoral course. I return now to Qud to help nurture its communities.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Three dram of pure liquid to c: Three dram of pure liquid to catalyze soup and circulate nutrient. Liquid choice alter sanguine mixture, change Creature.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Through great labors I ascende: Through great labors I ascended the Spindle, and now wish to know more of our world and worlds surrounding. Will you tell?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Through my work I caught the a:
Through my work I caught the attention of a master machinist, unconventional of method, who took me under her wing and, in time, availed me of the orphic truth.

She explained, as I've shared with you and the rest of the acolytes, that the world we know once belonged to a grand Coven of beings who spanned the stars. And that, acting on some inscrutable logic, they disappeared. That an injunction was placed on our world.

This, you know. It is the truth I told, if only half. But Rebekah taught me more.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Tikva. Once lover, now foil, p:
Tikva. Once lover, now foil, perhaps lover again.

Its light invites and overwhelms, a hope blind and blinding. Cruel frustration at storm-time. When its eyes are needed they turn away. I will not be calmed. I will not be calmed!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Time and rest are the surest w: Time and rest are the surest way to dress a wound, but my wares can help if you're in a hurry.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Tinker-nuns. The world sees fi:
Tinker-nuns. The world sees fit to call us that, my sisters and me.

Do you know the story told of Rebekah the Exile? She was a teacher to Resheph, but he excommunicated her from the sultanate and banished her from the realm.

To know her, I've chosen a life of unbelonging. And among my sisters, I have the honor of permanent residence by her gravesite.

I'll tell you this, traveler: the shape of a society is visible only from the outside, and there is peace beyond a boundary.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Tire of your legs? Arms? Hands: Tire of your legs? Arms? Hands? See what I have that fits you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"To be wholly honest, =name=, I:
To be wholly honest, =name=, I grow frustrated.

We are a young species, grown one by one in yonder sun-touched cradle. Over years, we have increased, but not, ah, not. Not grown.

Look around you. You see it, yes? This hydropon is no settlement.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"To behold the Argent Fathers i: To behold the Argent Fathers in simulacra... what revelation!
To make preparations, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Barathrum instructed us here after you secured the grounds.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"To me, they are stories. I hav:
To me, they are stories. I have made no quest to trespass the borders they hold so dear in their rituals. Some say they are mortal creatures like any other, contracted by an outsider coven. Others do not believe they are mortal, others still do not believe that those mysterious strangers have anything to do with the Limen at all.

Mayhap someone ought seek them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"To the northwest seek the rot-: To the northwest seek the rot-black box. There a plant and Daughter live. There cats of chrome purr at tiny suns.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Traveler. Put down your mangle: Traveler. Put down your mangled trinkets and I'll repair them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Truly breathtaking. How the gl: Truly breathtaking. How the glass glittered in the sun!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Trust what you hear of the sva: Trust what you hear of the svardym, whelp. The sky blackens at our accession and we are like to eat you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Try my recipe. You'll believe: Try my recipe. You'll believe =player.reflexive= to be judging the Carbide Chefs in the Kitchen Heptagon itself.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Tugged from the claws of one w: Tugged from the claws of one who had become a cord in time's silly carpet. I outrooted the hilts and sheathed the blades, and now I am he. I still have the nail dirt.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Ugh, ever telepathy. No requir:
Ugh, ever telepathy. No requirement exists that Consortium merchants be mind-speakers, as swollen with their numbers as we are. I cannot blame you for your surprise, mind, I am simply frustrated.

Over years, I shaped something akin to a voice-box, which you hear now. I "made do", as Rokhas might say. Now what may I "make do" for you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Uh, I'll come back later with: Uh, I'll come back later with it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Um, kendren, does the yempuris: Um, kendren, does the yempuris phi really exist? Is it really coming to get us?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Um... thank you.\\n\\nLive and:
Um... thank you.

Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Uncrafted jewels and metals bu: Uncrafted jewels and metals buy and sell for the same cost, but my art's price tag is up to me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Unfinished schematics are obvi: Unfinished schematics are obviously not for sale. Everything else is.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Up North? En't far. See them b: Up North? En't far. See them baboons, you put one's light out for me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Upon their return, =name= part:
Upon their return, =name= participated in the dissolution and federation of all power-concentrate. Allies of the new equalizer gathered and rose, forming the Quetzal Council and other, shorter-lived managing bodies.

Since then, we have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Upon their return\\nwhat power:
Upon their return
what power =name= wrested
they called on allies
to distribute and dissolve.

The Freeholders,
new hollowers,
the Quetzal Council,
and other such fools.

Countless years of struggle
centuries of change.
We remember what we can
and watch new and old die.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Use the tattoo gun I've given: Use the tattoo gun I've given you when you recover the Mark of Death. You'll want to bring a pickaxe, too, or some other instrument for digging through stone. And beware: the Tomb is a vast and ancient space, and sacred to many. I cannot speak to what you will experience there.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Use your gadgets hard, don't y: Use your gadgets hard, don't you? I can fix them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Utensil? That is my avocation,: Utensil? That is my avocation, yes. A million sun-dead homes I've roved, a trillion more await. I'm a worm in the loam of a cosmic wood, perched on a cosmic gulf, swathed in the god-manifold.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"VERILY, THERE IS A WEALTH OF W: VERILY, THERE IS A WEALTH OF WISDOM IN THE POETRY OF THIS FACT. ONE DAY, I SHALL BE EAGER TO UNCOVER IT.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Va'am is released. =ifplayerpl:
Va'am is released. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= done something great, for good or ill.

I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for this new future.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Vardy! Yes.\\n\\nBut. Gemtle?:
Vardy! Yes.

But. Gemtle? No kill.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Very well, I will go to Bey La: Very well, I will go to Bey Lah as you ask.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Very well, Iseppa. Live and dr: Very well, Iseppa. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"WE CANNOT KNOW THE PARTICULARS: WE CANNOT KNOW THE PARTICULARS. YET THE PLURALITY REASONETH THAT SOME GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS, SOME THOUGHT-MATTER OF THE CIVILIZATION BELOW, DID SPIN IN COUNTEREDICT TO THE DICTATES OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA, AND THUS WERE THE ECLIPTICS SHIFTED, AND WE CAST OUT.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"WHERE DO SOVEREIGNTY AND RIGHT:
WHERE DO SOVEREIGNTY AND RIGHTNESS INTERSECT IN THY MANIFOLD?

MOREOVER, I WAS ARCHON HERE LONG ERE THOU.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"WILL THOU REMAIN AT THE SHEVA: WILL THOU REMAIN AT THE SHEVA WITH ME, AND LEND THY HAND TO STEER THE COURSE OF THE WORLD FROM THIS LOFTY PERCH.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Wait! My name is =name=. I bri: Wait! My name is =name=. I bring a message from Argyve of Joppa.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Wait! My name is =name=. I've: Wait! My name is =name=. I've come into possession of a data disk stamped with a peculiar sigil. Does this have meaning to your order of tinkers? Might you examine it?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Wait! My name is =name=. The p: Wait! My name is =name=. The people of =villageZeroName= recently came into possession of a data disk, onto which a strange signal was recorded. At their behest I carry the disk with me. They say your tutelage is to be my reward.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Wait, why... why is Esk here?: Wait, why... why is Esk here? What's going on? Do you have Kindrish?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Wait. I have more questions to: Wait. I have more questions to ask.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Walk a few parasangs in my sho: Walk a few parasangs in my shoes, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and you'll wonder how you ever did otherwise.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Wanderer and =pronouns.formalA: Wanderer and =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=! Have you journeyed yet to the Stilt, and seen the Sacred Well?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Wanderer! Do you venture north: Wanderer! Do you venture northwise? Into the Great Desert and nearer the Six Day Stilt?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Wanderer, thank you! I will te: Wanderer, thank you! I will tell my kin of these places. We will convene and discuss, and we will, ah, choose. Please be patient in the meantime.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Warden Indrix is one of the mo: Warden Indrix is one of the most ferocious warriors I've ever met. Once upon a time, he and his brothers gorged themselves on the flesh of beasts by starlight, but now I count myself lucky to call him my warden. Some believe he is of sour kind, though I assure you, he's but a victim of his goatish nature.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Warden Neelahind attends to he:
Warden Neelahind attends to her duties admirably. She is not terribly assertive, but she need not be.

I'm surprised she's going along with this outsider-led investigation, but she always had a soft spot for the exile.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Wasn't Rebekah a healer? Why a: Wasn't Rebekah a healer? Why are you an order of tinkers?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Water Barons don't adorn thems: Water Barons don't adorn themselves with water, after all.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Water and gas piped through th: Water and gas piped through the Yd to feed the plants, dwellers, and machines! Dwellers blew the glass in hues like the prism perch, to look pretty. Shared together. Joyful helping!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Water-wealth means nothing if: Water-wealth means nothing if you cannot carry it. Need jewels?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Watervine coming in good, see?: Watervine coming in good, see? Fat wafers.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Watervine farm in the lap of t: Watervine farm in the lap of the marsh. You've sucked the moisture out a vinewafer, yea? We tend the plant here.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"We allied on the notion that t:
We allied on the notion that the sultanate must be abolished for the future to flower. I was to execute the earthly plan, while Resheph continued preparations at the astronomical tier. To achieve a sort of bicameralism of action, Resheph insisted on reformatting their personality as a triumvirate, seeded from thin scans of the original archon, Rebekah, and myself.

The art of mythmaking was employed to enshrine the Resheph persona. Thus- the healer, the Coiled Lamb, and perhaps unexpectedly, the Above.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"We are adrift now. I will seek:
We are adrift now. I will seek signs of her, or whatever she becomes. What do you care?

Do not answer.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"We are called slynth, a people: We are called slynth, a people grown one by one from a hydroponic cradle containing a cutting of water lily and empowered by sunslag. We are but a handful of generations old, and kept no written history until I was grown, ah, some number of decades ago.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"We are called the Urshiib, =pl:
We are called the Urshiib, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

Our kind are smarter than the average bear. Sharper, too, and a bit more handy.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"We are mopango: witnesses of t:
We are mopango: witnesses of the past and shepherds of the future. The Sacred Light of the Kasaphescence shineth within us, and we commune with relics of antiquity to maintain our humility and grow our wisdom.

We believe that one day, with enough knowledge, anyone who seeketh the Light shalt find it within emself. In the meantime, we work to become better and brighter as each one of us findeth a personal credo by which to live.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"We are on the tips of our hoov: We are on the tips of our hooves, =name=! Any word about the slynth?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"We await the decision of the g: We await the decision of the glowfolk. Our imaginations run with the possibilities.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"We chose our new home well.\"]: We chose our new home well.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"We find no precedent for this,: We find no precedent for this, yet is there space upon our crystal arms and an openness within us. It is agreed: if these slynth will be of us, we will have them here.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"We have not come so far from t: We have not come so far from the founding of =village.name= to allow these strangers in. What if they worship =village.profane=? No, we simply cannot do such a great favor for you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"We mopango watch the past, eac: We mopango watch the past, each of us a different facet. My charge is named Nacham, that which watcheth and understandeth not, that which speaketh and cannot be understood. Information floweth through Nacham as water through a sieve, mixed together beyond ken.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"We share the bright and now, t: We share the bright and now, traveler =name=.
We were... yes. We were close.

I can scarcely believe that she would be capable of doing such a thing. Stealing our greatest treasure? Eskhind wouldn't possibly... but if Grand-Doe says it, it must be so.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"We will investigate and find t: We will investigate and find the truth.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"We will miss you too, Aloysius: We will miss you too, Aloysius. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"We'd all be dead without bees,: We'd all be dead without bees, you know.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"We're a vibrant community here:
We're a vibrant community here. A circle of monks mapping the outer lattices and raising viaducts where we need to.

We remain secluded to protect ourselves. Otho and Barathrum insist on it. They are wise, and I defer to them. My collaboration with Sheba Hag does cause them worry, but they tolerate it, bless their hearts.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"We're not safe yet. I can feel: We're not safe yet. I can feel it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"We're watered by the river spr:
We're watered by the river spray -- we pluck the fruit of the wood, and we hunt. The worshippers of Oboroqoru whittle and brood, too. They will pay you no mind unless you ask of them. Here you can be with friends, or muse alone. 

If it's trade goods that interest you, take a gander at Yurl's wares in the northwest corner. The odd one Crowsong's, too, if you can scry them in the bush.

I must warn you, however; cast no villain's shadow on these grounds. Warden Indrix will be watching.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Welcome a-Joppa, friend. Stay: Welcome a-Joppa, friend. Stay peacelike, and we stay friends, hyeh? You make trouble, it's my work a-split you open like a croc.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Welcome back to Bey Lah, =name: Welcome back to Bey Lah, =name=. Stay as long as you like.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Welcome back, Detective =name=:
Welcome back, Detective =name=.

Everything's in order here, more or less.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Welcome to Grit Gate, =faction: Welcome to Grit Gate, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Care to enhance the quality of your stay with a wise purchase?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Oth:
Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.

I am pleased to see that you've returned with the waydroid, though you still know little of the dangers you bear. Take this firearm as your reward. It bears the mark of our finest gunsmith, Sparafucile.

Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.

Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.

You are worthy to study with us. Take these.

Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.

Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.

You demonstrate tremendous promise to have returned from Golgotha with such inexperience. Take this firearm as your reward. It bears the mark of our finest gunsmith, Sparafucile. Take this bracelet, as well.

Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Welcome to Omonporch, traveler: Welcome to Omonporch, traveler. Enjoy your visit to my earldom. Feast your eyes upon my tall and glorious Spindle. Take in the scent of roasted musa.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Welcome, =factionaddress:Mopan: Welcome, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Live and drink. =ifplayerplural:Need ye:Needest thou= a place to rest and sup? =ifplayerplural:Would ye:Wouldst= trade?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Welcome, =player.formalAddress: Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=, to the sole bastion of class in this wretched place.
Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=. How may I serve you today?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Well enough. We drink the sun':
Well enough. We drink the sun's rays, eat what we scavenge, rest under the shell, and it is. Enough.

I read and tinker. Some hunt. Others tend the cradle. Each day is like the next. Every so often, someone leaves.

We, ah, rarely hear from them thereafter. I hope they are all well.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Well met, =name=. Please forgi: Well met, =name=. Please forgive the, ah, austerity of our cradle. You may sup with us at our meager camp and rest under the shade of this Palladium shell. Sorry, as well, about the crowding.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Well, I should get going. Live: Well, I should get going. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Well, I should go. Live and dr: Well, I should go. Live and drink.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Well, good. I would give you a:
Well, good. I would give you a prize for your insight, but times have been lean.

As you say, the Hindriarch is obviously framing me. As a pariah, I am an ideal patsy for Keh. Much as I love my people, they are weak of will and do not question the Grand-Doe.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Well, you can repay the debt n: Well, you can repay the debt now. Barathrum wants you to build something. A climber. He says only you can do it.
Well, your conscience, surely.

You wouldn't be so unethical as to manipulate the resolution of a crime to your own ends. W-would you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Well. Nothing... is like Chavv:
Well. Nothing... is like Chavvah. Nothing at all.

I once thought ... my haustorium carried only lifestuff. Now I am unsure. Am I of Twofirm, now?

It's fine.

Let's... change subjects.
Well. They en't ended you yet.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Well... the light of the Kasap:
Well... the light of the Kasaphescence yet glimmers through your rasping edge.

I must, then, thank you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Were they in use when you foun: Were they in use when you found them?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Wh-\\n\\nMy heart's sheen wane:
Wh-

My heart's sheen wanes to hear this of you. You abrade me, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I am scuffed.

What of my trinket, then? Did you cast it into the... "hole in the ground?"
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Wh-what will Tau b-be after so: Wh-what will Tau b-be after soft? You, did, did you mean... wh-what c-could you say? Tau spins within, the g-gyre spins without.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Wh-what's going on? Esk is her:
Wh-what's going on? Esk is here, a-and Grand-Doe seems very upset.

Would you please speak to her, kendren?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What 'interstate power'? Who a: What 'interstate power'? Who are the 'Codex people'?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What I stole? I stole supplies: What I stole? I stole supplies to sustain myself and my sisters, nothing more, and little enough that no one would suffer for its absence. You would cut those from my hide?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What a grand bazaar! What's in: What a grand bazaar! What's in each of these tents?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What a strange fate, to pass f: What a strange fate, to pass from new sentience to outcast with no steps in between. Regardless, if it is their will and you vouch for them, that is enough for me. Tell the slynth that should they choose to wander, the wind will blow at their backs.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What are you suggesting I do?\: What are you suggesting I do?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What are you working on, Isepp: What are you working on, Iseppa?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What are you? What's your stor: What are you? What's your story?

What can you tell me about the Six Day Stilt?
What can you tell me about the other Barathrumites?

Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What do you expect me to do, t: What do you expect me to do, then?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What do you imagine I am sayin:
What do you imagine I am saying? The aging, ineffectual leader of a village in isolation. A system that strives to forget anyone who sees the outside, no matter how much its inhabitants strive for a better tomorrow.

Bey Lah's isolationism provides ideal patsies for any crime the Hindriarch chooses to commit.

Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What if I find implicating evi: What if I find implicating evidence for multiple suspects?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What if evidence indicates mul: What if evidence indicates multiple culprits?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What if it's damaged or destro: What if it's damaged or destroyed?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What indignity have you come t: What indignity have you come to heap upon the mound, whelp? Out with it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What is it? Where does the sig: What is it? Where does the signal come from, and what does it say?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What is the Limen? The Knights: What is the Limen? The Knights Liminal?

Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What is this?\\n\\nPoetry. In:
What is this?

Poetry. In the exile's handwriting. Extolling love for... me, or someone very like me.

Is... is this a cruel joke? This cannot be real.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What kind of creature are you?: What kind of creature are you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What kind words. It seems so w: What kind words. It seems so with you, too.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What manner of being are you?\: What manner of being are you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What manner of jewel are our e: What manner of jewel are our eyes, to skew light into thought?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What mazes and mandalas could: What mazes and mandalas could be crafted by human hands that hope to surpass what nature wrought eons before our creation?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What moved the Coven to set th: What moved the Coven to set the injunction on our world?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What novelty, to shelter the m:
What novelty, to shelter the mysterious Klanq! I have heard no stories of this tinker-fungus that could be described as dull, though 'calamitous' could apply to more than one.

My mind tells tales of what might be brewing in the basement, but I am quite relieved to be out here rather than down there.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What now? Nothing like this ha: What now? Nothing like this has ever happened before.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What of it? Scurry on and leav: What of it? Scurry on and leave me to brood.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What see. Leg plant, glow cres:
What see. Leg plant, glow crest.

Grow from sun-crungled hydropon and depart siblings.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What should I know about the C: What should I know about the Creature?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What use is a library in this: What use is a library in this salt den? Or in the marshes, strangled by wild plants and poisoned by the glow? Wouldn't a stash of vinereapers serve us better?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What was so bad about the devi: What was so bad about the device?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What welcome news, =factionadd: What welcome news, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=! Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What would there be for the Co: What would there be for the Coven to return to, if life on our world was purged?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What you ask may be impossible: What you ask may be impossible.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What you smell is Grit Gate's:
What you smell is Grit Gate's signature dish. The Porridge is a recipe passed down through generations of Barathrumites, and it is the food that inspired me to pursue my craft. Yes, outsiders quail at the intensity of the scent, for its flavor is as bold as its effects!

We use cuisine to channel lightning from our bodies! Other recipes may let us breathe fire, or learn the secrets of the Eaters. The Porridge is as precious a part of our legacy as the Barathrum Clock or the foaminator.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What's to tell? We are outcast:
What's to tell? We are outcasts, pushed to the margins by our people for the crime of harmless deviance.

It's beyond perverse to call us back just so Grand-Doe can punish us further.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What's with the houseplant ove: What's with the houseplant over there?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"What, you need a menu? I got g: What, you need a menu? I got goat meat and goat jerky.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Whelp, affix your eyes to that: Whelp, affix your eyes to that clam right yonder. Go step inside and find your answers.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"When an eremite consults the t: When an eremite consults the teraphim and sees the eyes of Death, only the fools frets! There is Change but no Ending.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"When it began, =name= had no s:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through the spilling of blood and terror. Uncountable lives were taken by their hand alone, all to slake age-old desires of control and might. Even the ancient plagueborn Nephilim fell before the hand of =name=.

At the end of their reign, =name= coerced a false compact with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, the last remaining seat of the Sultanate's power. There, by one means or another, they sealed the fate of the world below.

The Plagues of the Gyre raged. Death swept Qud.

When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through the spilling of blood and terror. Uncountable lives were taken by their hand alone, all to slake age-old desires of control and might.

Perhaps hunger turned to malice, or the adoption of a greater principle, or simple boredom. Whatever the reason, =name= formed a fast alliance with the ancient plagueborn Nephilim, ascended the spire, and sealed the fate of the world below.

The Plagues of the Gyre raged unchecked.

When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives taken and saved by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. Even Nephilim, once plagues of Qud, fell before the hand of =name=.

At the end of their reign, =name= called for peace with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to quiet the ghosts of the Sultanate and take to the stars.

When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives taken and saved by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. When they spoke, even the plagues of Qud listened.

At the end of their reign, =name= made a compact with the Nephilim that they should never vex the creatures of Qud again. So done, they climbed to the top of the spire and boarded an ancient vessel, thereby to travel the star-dusted expanse.

When it began, =name= had no shared helices with the Reshephs previous, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives saved and otherwise changed by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. When they spoke, even the plagues of Qud listened.

At the end of their reign, =name= made a compact with the Nephilim that they should never vex the creatures of Qud again. So done, they climbed to the top of the spire, there to end the Reshephate altogether and never be heard from again.

When it began, =name= had no shared helices with the Reshephs previous, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives taken and saved by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. Even Nephilim, once plagues of Qud, fell before the hand of =name=.

At the end of their reign, =name= called for peace with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to end the Reshephate altogether and never be heard from again.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"When their works began, =name=:
When their works began, =name= had no connection to the Sultanate. The rule of these ancient leaders had ended, but not fully: a ghost of the last Sultan yet ruled over the spire, tormenting those on and under the ground with plagues. As =name= grew mighty and challenged the rampaging Nephilim, they came to recognize the source of their shared conflict.

Seeking freedom from the reign of the Sultan, =name= struck a compact with the Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to confront and banish the cerulean ghost.

And so it proceeded.

As =name= grew mighty and slew the rampaging Nephilim, they came to recognize the source of their shared conflict.

And so it proceeded.

Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Where is he? Tell me what happ: Where is he? Tell me what happened to him.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Where is the repulsive device,: Where is the repulsive device, again?

Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"While I appreciate your help,:
While I appreciate your help, kendren, I would prefer that you not stay longer than you must.

The faundren might get ideas.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Who am I? Mak. That's all you: Who am I? Mak. That's all you get. I'll not waste the honey of my mouth on idle inquiries.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Who am I? Who are you? What do: Who am I? Who are you? What does it matter? You and I are nothing, the most insignificant afterthoughts of an amaranthine shade.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Who are you? Get out of my wor: Who are you? Get out of my work space!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Who are you? What are the sera: Who are you? What are the seraphim?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Who are you? What are you?\"]: Who are you? What are you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Who are you? What? Please, do: Who are you? What? Please, do not disturb me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Who cares?\\n\\nCan one? Maybe:
Who cares?

Can one? Maybe.
Can I? Surely not.
Can YOU? Well.
Prove it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Who do you think stole Kindris: Who do you think stole Kindrish?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Who is Non Moloch, from before: Who is Non Moloch, from before?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Who is the man camped near the: Who is the man camped near the graveyard?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Who knows? I've wondered it my:
Who knows? I've wondered it myself. Sometimes she'll catch my eye, when the moon's silver-bright, and she's there bearing down on the flats.

Whatever she is, she's gigantic. And old. Real old. Way older than the cathedral the Mechanimists built inside her.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Who thumps my crystal arms, an: Who thumps my crystal arms, and kicksofts me at windfall? I feel you here, friend.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Who, I?\\nOnly a fool, tra la,:
Who, I?
Only a fool, tra la,
only a remnant scrap.

Only left-behind,
only madness,
only an echoing gyre.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Who, indeed? Who ever was =nam: Who, indeed? Who ever was =name=? Dare we hang such hopes and fears on so tiny and distant a figure? Will it bear the weight?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Who? No one of significance un: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. Now? No one knows.

Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. They died without title, or perhaps did not die at all. Tales abound, and thus far no one has stepped forth to renounce or affirm them.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why are you dressed like an ap: Why are you dressed like an apothecary?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why are you here, in Kyakukya?: Why are you here, in Kyakukya?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why are you hiding in the bush: Why are you hiding in the bush?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why are you offering me sympat: Why are you offering me sympathies?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why are you selling goods in s: Why are you selling goods in such a remote and dangerous place?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why are you speaking to me? Yo: Why are you speaking to me? You have work to do.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why are you staring at my mout: Why are you staring at my mouth?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why are you talking to me?\"]: Why are you talking to me?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why are you the color of coral: Why are you the color of coral? And why did the brick road outside only appear after I ate the Eater's fleshcap?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why ascend the Spindle then? F: Why ascend the Spindle then? For what purpose?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why did you come to Omonporch?: Why did you come to Omonporch?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why did you leave Bey Lah?\"]: Why did you leave Bey Lah?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why did you tell me Eskhind ha: Why did you tell me Eskhind had a brother?
