Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why do we speak strangely? Why:
Why do we speak strangely? Why =ifplayerplural:do ye:dost thou= speak strangely?

Is not all speech strange?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why do you believe the Coven n: Why do you believe the Coven now returns?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why do you call it \\\"your\\\: Why do you call it "your" village?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why do you call me Saad?\"]: Why do you call me Saad?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why do you care about Bey Lah?: Why do you care about Bey Lah?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why do you owe... \\\"prickles: Why do you owe... "prickles"... a debt?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why do you remain here? Please: Why do you remain here? Please, finish your business.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why do you speak so strangely?: Why do you speak so strangely?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why don't I see myself out?\"]: Why don't I see myself out?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why don't you go there yoursel: Why don't you go there yourself?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why don't you retrieve it your: Why don't you retrieve it yourself?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why have you asked me to retur: Why have you asked me to return?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why is an exile standing in my: Why is an exile standing in my village? Are you trying to play me for a fool?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why purge all life? Aside from: Why purge all life? Aside from the immorality of it, nothing would remain.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why should you believe me? Wel:
Why should you believe me? Well, why should you believe Keh? Ayvah, think about this!

I'm not asking you to give me your unconditional trust, understand? Only to extend to me the same level of trust you give Keh. Is that not reasonable? Is that not just?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why would you put mushrooms in: Why would you put mushrooms in cider?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why wouldn't an outsider bring: Why wouldn't an outsider bring their own leather? It would better disguise Kindrish. It seems a lot of work to find and raid our leather stores.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why, =name=, Brightsheol treat:
Why, =name=, Brightsheol treated you well. There is a new gravity about you; your proverbial boots ring louder in the Annals with each step.

I imagine you're off to Teach's study? They're already at work down there.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why, this place is Grit Gate!:
Why, this place is Grit Gate! O the vaulted halls, the glint of chrome, the gentle hum of chain turret emplacements!

There's nowhere like Grit Gate in the whole of Qud, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I've journeyed in my comparatively short time, but I always return here. The very air buzzes with knowledge, as well as quite a few other things.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why? A lifetime of vexation. B:
Why? A lifetime of vexation. Born to a cacophony of static ringing the ears raw. Thousands of my kinfolk cut down by that porphyric wasp fools called Lamb. A millenium of hot stinking sun and disgusting brine lice for supper.

Misery obtains on this pond, whelp. By Chavvah if you start beaming like a sunray and yodeling at the Beetle Moon, I'll eat you where you stand.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Why? Why did I leave a single:
Why? Why did I leave a single parasang square piece of land upon which I was expected to live my entire life, forever obeying a woman whose sole qualification of rule is her gender and age? Why did I leave a place where we eat the same damned soup for nine out of ten meals and the height of occupational versatility is leatherworking?

The question isn't why I left, it's why I'm the only one who chose to do so, why none of my pleas were convincing to the hindren I love. If we would just open the borders, it would never have come to this.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Wh—no! No! What? No, that's no: Wh—no! No! What? No, that's not possible! Ayvah, what an absurd idea!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Will I?\\n\\nYour prediction w:
Will I?

Your prediction warms little against the chill wind of the Gyre. My future is free. My future is murky. I am freshly tender from the burn of your hand.

I feel I had rather not encounter you for a time. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Will you inherit leadership of: Will you inherit leadership of Joppa from your father?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Will you resign your charge an: Will you resign your charge and swear to unvex the beings of this world?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Will you sing and work with me: Will you sing and work with me, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Wind off the Great Desert cool:
Wind off the Great Desert cools a touch and gives up moisture. Just enough. A tongue can taste a hundred kinds of wind, y'know?

Anywhile, that's where my wandering mind goes. More's about Joppa I say speak to our Elderfriend. Irudad. Up northwise the path.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Wine, cheese, bread. =player.F: Wine, cheese, bread. =player.FormalAddressTerm=, tell me, is there anything else you truly need?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Witchwood for pain, bandages f: Witchwood for pain, bandages for bleeding, yuckwheat and honey for when your guts act up. Coldcaps when I can find them. Why not take a look?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"With a good hat, =player.forma: With a good hat, =player.formalAddressTerm=, you'll last longer in the salt sun.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"With the chrome key card I gav:
With the chrome key card I gave you, you now have access to our power grid. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Use Ereshkigal's reconnaissance to decide which defenses to enable. You can also broadcast an overclock command or activate Rodanis Y by interfacing with Ereshkigal.

Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.

Act quickly, =name=! The Templar near us even as we speak.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Within my gemstones there burn: Within my gemstones there burns a brighter fire than in some hearts.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Without bees, all life in Qud: Without bees, all life in Qud would eventually die.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Word of =name='s deeds reached: Word of =name='s deeds reached record only after the unheralded appearance of the Knights Liminal, and broad assumption suggests that the former established the latter. It could be that the ancient Resheph yet lives within or outside of the boundaries of the Limen, but no word escapes its borders.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Words spoken from your experie: Words spoken from your experience and inscribed to form being-bond. First sounds heard in Creature's early dreambrain.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Would you kill your double? Wo: Would you kill your double? Would you let it kill you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Would you like to eat vapor?\": Would you like to eat vapor?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Would you like to hear? When I:
Would you like to hear? When I was first put together by Father and friends, I was Shem 2, the second iteration of the make-me project.

As I came along, scampered through the halls, listened to the stories Neek read me, climbed onto Sparafucile's workbench to have my screws replaced, I realized I was not what I could be. And so I downgraded myself to Shem 1.

That has happened three times.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Would you like to read me a st: Would you like to read me a story?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Would you share the favorite d: Would you share the favorite dish of your people?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Would you teach me to craft =r: Would you teach me to craft =recipe=?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Would you teach me your ways?\: Would you teach me your ways?
Would you? Yes.

What may... can I help with?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Wouldn't these make a fine con: Wouldn't these make a fine conversation piece for a water ritual?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Wrong on both counts. Resheph: Wrong on both counts. Resheph stands before you. Entomb me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Y'ain't peeled open any Sons o: Y'ain't peeled open any Sons or Daughters, have you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"YEA, FOR RIGHT AND WRONG ARE T: YEA, FOR RIGHT AND WRONG ARE TOO COARSE AS CONCEPTS TO MATCH THE RICHNESS OF THE GEMARA. YET THE PLURALITY HOLDETH THAT THE {{R|EXIT}} WAS DRAWN BY A GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS WITHIN THE PRIOR FIELD. AND THAT THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED, TO TILL AND RESEED THE NOOSPHERE.
YEA, THE INQUIRY IS EVER RICH. BUT IDLE INQUIRY DOTH BUT DEEPEN THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVENLESS BE-ING. OR GIVETH RUDE ACTORS FODDER TO PERVERT THE LEARNINGS FOR THEIR OWN PAROCHIAL GAIN.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"YOU. YOU REGNEN NON HER. NON M: YOU. YOU REGNEN NON HER. NON MOLOCH IN MAQQOM YD.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yea! So you like it? Sheba Hag: Yea! So you like it? Sheba Hag and I composed it on a wavelathe. We made a series of songs about the birth and life of the Kasaphescence. Together we call them "Spun on the Cosmic Loom".
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes rrk was once, \\\"plague\\: Yes rrk was once, "plague" in the sky hundreds of years. Not so now. Longtime rrk, Geeub, Mak hide in the sponge and eat lice. When find Many Eyes, rrk and friends built the Yd. Joyful helping!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes! But before then, can walk: Yes! But before then, can walk around with creature. Talk, fight, sleep... the normal. Friend.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes! I have braved its wharf i:
Yes! I have braved its wharf in the past, to gather precious convalessence for my experiments.

Are you going? Dress warmly and mind the trolls.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes! I was even provided with: Yes! I was even provided with a brief premonition of it, as my workbench liquids are sensitive to small vibrations around the enclave.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of t:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I fished it out a mound of pig stool. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...

Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was scything the vine when the flat of my blade turned it loose from the soil. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead toward the beam on the abacus of Beauty...

Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was scything the vine when the flat of my blade turned something loose from the soil. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...

Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was supping on summer offal when I noticed something glinting in the guts. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...

Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was wrenching moisture from a banner when I kicked something 'neath the salt. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...

Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, =factionaddress:Barathrum: Yes, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Follow the stairs down to his study. He awaits.
Yes, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Take this key and follow the stairs down to his study. He awaits.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, =name=! Begin the gatheri:
Yes, =name=! Begin the gathering, and the molding will follow. The materials you choose will influence the being we create, but any such being will be suitable for ascent.

This is our last task before we make our historic climb, =name=. Be safe and well in doing it. If you have more questions, return here. Klanq and I will be available.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, I am ready to accuse the: Yes, I am ready to accuse the thief.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, I do, but Eskhind didn't: Yes, I do, but Eskhind didn't have it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, I have news about the sly: Yes, I have news about the slynths' sanctuary.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, I threw it in the hole.\": Yes, I threw it in the hole.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, I've decided to stay. I d:
Yes, I've decided to stay. I don't disbelieve that the Yd Freehold is as safe as you say, but the fears instilled in me when I first learned to read as a fresh sprout haunt me even now. Perhaps in time I will visit, but in the meantime I can look after the cradle, as someone ought to do.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, I've decided to stay. I'm:
Yes, I've decided to stay. I'm sure =village.name= is a good home for my kin, but I have no particular loathing for =village.profane= and even less reverence for =village.sacred=. Someone must look over the cradle, besides.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, I've decided to stay. It':
Yes, I've decided to stay. It's not that, ah, it's not that I wouldn't enjoy a life of farming. But the thought of leaving the cradle after decades of watching it... I couldn't.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

Yes, I've decided to stay. It's not that, ah, it's not that I wouldn't enjoy sharing knowledge with the mayor of our new home. But the thought of leaving the cradle after decades of watching it... I couldn't.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, I've decided to stay. The:
Yes, I've decided to stay. The Tomb sounds, ah, cozy, but I cannot fathom making such a macabre place my home. Someone must look over the cradle, besides.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

Yes, I've decided to stay. The flower fields sound beautiful, and no doubt there is much to learn from the hindren. But the thought of leaving the cradle after decades of watching it... I couldn't.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, I've stayed. As fascinate:
Yes, I've stayed. As fascinated as I would be to examine the statuary and bas-reliefs, my favorite mode of, ah, interaction with history is through the written word. Someone must watch over the cradle, besides.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, I've stayed. I don't, ah,:
Yes, I've stayed. I don't, ah, resent that my kin have found succor in the embrace of faith, but I don't know how to walk that path myself. Someone needs to watch over the hydropon, besides.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, I've stayed. I'd love to:
Yes, I've stayed. I'd love to see the vaunted halls and, ah, bathe in the light of brilliant minds, but when I think about the journey my roots lock up. I feel, ah, unready. Someone must watch over the cradle, besides.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, I've stayed. If I am enti:
Yes, I've stayed. If I am entirely honest, the idea of a life on the road sounds, ah... unpleasant. To me, personally. I have grown accustomed to a life of collection, curation, and study that I don't care to abandon for adventure. Someone must stay to watch over the cradle, besides.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, I, ah, I remain.\\n\\nI b:
Yes, I, ah, I remain.

I badly wish to taste of Chavvah's secrets, but the wonder I feel for such an entity is eclipsed only by the terror of such an experience. I cling to an excuse that the hydropon must be watched and wait. Perhaps someday I will shed that excuse's film and step free.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, and I fear the worst. Hie: Yes, and I fear the worst. Hie to Ereshkigal. She will know what to do.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, apothecary. Do you know w: Yes, apothecary. Do you know what those are?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, that paper, twas mine. Th:
Yes, that paper, twas mine. This racket of a Signal is mine, too, of sorts.

It is my tolling bell.
Yes, the Consortium of Phyta. We're a merchant fellowship of trees, vines, shrubs, weeds, flowers, herbs, cacti, algae -- most sorts of plants, really.

I can't say I trust any of them, but there is no doubting their usefulness. My shelves are full and the gossip flows.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, the question of power is:
Yes, the question of power is a trickier one. Our standard power sources might suffice, but they would be vulnerable to electromagnetic attacks on the ascent, and we believe it within the competency of the Putus Templar to execute such an attack.

This leaves us two options. Klanq and Q Girl have worked out a design for a neutronic battery, free from vulnerabilities on the EM spectrum. But it requires 3 drams of neutron flux. The alternative is remote power, but to carry us across the Spindle's length the source would have to be extraordinary. I would look to Chavvah, the Tree of Life, for a psychic quickening. Reports tell of the resumption of their roaming across the Moon Stair. Seek the trunk at Eyn Roj to begin your investigation, if that's the path you choose.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, we were present, if less: Yes, we were present, if less active than other-bodies. But we saw, and rattle with memory-artifacts as a Consortium lockbox rattles with jewels; shards of an eon-old data disk, bits of stories and places. Kin-fleeing, louse-meals, ghastly boredom. But Fate's caprice brought us through history's footsteps. There was a machine-speaker, and her ursine apprentice with his little plant, and the Sower with a tetrad of chubby whelps, and then, at last, Many-Eyes. Our dear galgal. So many.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, yes of course.\\n\\nI am:
Yes, yes of course.

I am Angohind: grandson of esteemed Elder Eselhind, young scholar of Shakesprig, and best dressed hindren in Bey Lah. I am also, as luck would have it, an aspirant investigator with an ear... for mystery.

My grandhind has forbidden me from looking into the strange doings in the village, but she said nothing about me teaching you the ins and outs of detective work! What say you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes, yes, yes. They are so que: Yes, yes, yes. They are so quetzal!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:T:
Yes. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= quelled the mania.

I can focus. I can render sensible the things I have seen and heard now, though I remember little of my time before the mania. Was I artisan? Teacher? I possessed great knowledge that this shell twisted into a prison. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for the gift of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= untwisting.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes. I am falsely accused.\\n\:
Yes. I am falsely accused.

See, Bey Lah strives to forget anyone who sees the outside. The gerontocracy ensures that its leaders will always be aging and fearful. Pariahs like me can be easily accused of crimes committed by Keh or her cronies.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes. I found the vermin and bi: Yes. I found the vermin and bits of gnawed watervine. I carry one's corpse with me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes. I thank =ifplayerplural:y:
Yes. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.

=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= freed me from a deep stupor. Once I was a protector, before being sentenced to protect nothing and no one.

I remember little of that time.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes. Is there anything else I: Yes. Is there anything else I should know?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes. It is a rite of passage f:
Yes. It is a rite of passage for the mopango people: a statement that inspires contemplation, discussion, and thought. An ideal credo has no single explanation or interpretation and is meant to inspire contemplation in those who hear it. For this reason, it is considered rude among mopango to ask the meaning of a credo.

Someday I will find mine.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes. It looks into the light w: Yes. It looks into the light with you.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes. Mamon is dead and I posse: Yes. Mamon is dead and I possess the prism.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes. That was not the voice of:
Yes. That was not the voice of the caverns.

It feels like one of my nightmares come to life at last.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes. The flavor, the breathabi: Yes. The flavor, the breathability, all successful, but the barrier between flavor and food is in the calories, and they have yet eluded me. But it is only a matter of time. I am patient, and I am relentless.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes. We were close. More than:
Yes. We were close. More than close.

If it tore my heart to ragged halves to leave my people behind, leaving Neelahind shredded it into scraps.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yes. \\\"Anyone may strike a s: Yes. "Anyone may strike a slumberling once."
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yet some remained\\nin comb-ca:
Yet some remained
in comb-cave and vault,
we Nervous Ones,
watching our successors burgeon:

You alveolates, you diatoms,
you scum-blooms and gillcaps,
you one-cells and slime-cities.
rising glorious and shining
out of our withering shadow.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yet you are an expert in your: Yet you are an expert in your field? How inspiring!
Yet, what you break is broken. -else is not -then regardless of will. This way split me again from Tikva, sundered early the love I knew, the denial. Our cowardice.

Ignore this digression. Ask, if asking.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"Yikes! Yes! The intensity was: Yikes! Yes! The intensity was too great to be the result of one of my experiments. What was it, I wonder?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You again?\\n\\nIt is only a m:
You again?

It is only a matter of time until we are overtaken by hostile kendren. Your presence mocks our fate.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You and the Warden were close,: You and the Warden were close, were you not?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You appear... refreshed. My ol: You appear... refreshed. My old eyes spy the swim lines of the waking world and to you they cede precedence. A newness obtains.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You are a bear of few words.\": You are a bear of few words.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You are a dying animal. So am:
You are a dying animal. So am I. We are all dying animals, scrabbling for what extra scraps of time we can grasp. Even the eons-old. We are each and every one of us a dying animal. Or plant. We all decay, is the point.

And the hurdy-gurdy doesn't like how you sound either, for what it is worth.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You are among friends here, pi: You are among friends here, pilgrim. Stay peaceful.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You are either very brave or v: You are either very brave or very foolish, to stop me in my path. Perhaps both. What do you want?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You are encysted as Tikva, jus:
You are encysted as Tikva, just as they! Milky white keratinous thoughts melt to a sick mass, wrapped in a protective membrane. I tremble. So it is.

Ask, if asking.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You are forgiven. Now entomb m: You are forgiven. Now entomb me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You are free to do as you plea: You are free to do as you please.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You are friendlier than most t: You are friendlier than most turrets.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You are happy because you are: You are happy because you are with your family?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You are kind, Earl Asphodel. Y: You are kind, Earl Asphodel. You have my thanks.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You are not partial to talking: You are not partial to talking.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You are now.\\n\\nAre you goin:
You are now.

Are you going to buy something, pest?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You are terribly small. Your l:
You are terribly small. Your love, small. Confined.

I cannot will not uplift your little concept. Do it yourself.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You are useless. I'll get to t: You are useless. I'll get to the bottom of this.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You are welcome in the village: You are welcome in the village of Ezra, seedling. Sit with me and watch the sun breathe shadows over the day.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You are welcome. I yet have qu: You are welcome. I yet have questions.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You are well-found, =name=. Th: You are well-found, =name=. Though several have chosen their -else, the first of the slynth have joined to us like our Sant, mobile and apart but shared and together. This is a strange -then, but what branches may spill forth from it? I anticipate the witnessing.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You are... unable to hear or s: You are... unable to hear or speak.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You ask so much. I must consid: You ask so much. I must consider it.
You best not hurt my critters.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You can be it. We can all be i: You can be it. We can all be it! Behold Nephilim!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You can preserve almost anythi: You can preserve almost anything. Al... most.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You can still activate our def:
You can still activate our defenses, =name=. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Use Ereshkigal's reconnaissance to decide which defenses to enable. You can also broadcast an overclock command or activate Rodanis Y by interfacing with Ereshkigal.

Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You can't go wrong with my slu: You can't go wrong with my slugspitters, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You didn't need to be rude abo: You didn't need to be rude about it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You don't have enough primordi: You don't have enough primordial soup.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You don't look so good. You ne: You don't look so good. You need more yuckwheat and honey in your diet.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You don't need to be so rude.\: You don't need to be so rude.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You don't seem happy with the: You don't seem happy with the status quo.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You don't seem sure about any: You don't seem sure about any of this.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You don't seem to like your ac: You don't seem to like your accommodations.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You don't talk with that mango: You don't talk with that mangoat -- you listen to him.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You ever run into one of these: You ever run into one of these in the wild? The lengths some folks will go for a crab leg!
You felt it too! Every. rock. moved. Wooooooow! It's sort of like a community dance we all performed together. Mafeo. Sparafucile. The chromelings. The rocks. Everyone else.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You get used to the nicks and: You get used to the nicks and burns, after years working with spark and solder.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You go and run at Q Girl and t:
You go and run at Q Girl and tap all the gadgets and tap her on the head.
Then you sneak by Otho's office.
Then you hug Shem -1 and you drag them to the library and read to them. Sometimes Barathrum and Hortensa are in there, and they smile at you.
Then you get hungry and you roll toward the kitchen. You slurp honey from the vase and Dardi glares at you. You say, "I'm just 'jidding'."
Then you climb the pipes and whisper to Aloysius, "Live and drink, live and drink, live and drink."
Then you pat the chromelings on their heads. You say to Ereshkigal, "boom boom boom boom boom I love you."
Then you sneak into storage and pat all the chromelings on their heads.
You take a nap in the peptic chair.
Then you get a bright idea and go back to your room to write it in your notebook.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You harvest it, you keep it.\": You harvest it, you keep it.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You have a great deal of nerve: You have a great deal of nerve to speak to me after what you've done.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You have completed the ritual:
You have completed the ritual of -elseing. You have set bright Tau free.

Yes, =name=. I will turn my chimes Spindleward to tune, then vibrate at our verve frequency. I will power your starclimb.

Be vested to tell whoever you must that Chavvah has made this commitment.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You have done much for =villag: You have done much for =village.name=, =name=, and your request befits your stature. If these slynth will join us in =village.activity= and if they can come to cherish =village.sacred= as we do, then they are welcome here.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You have grown bold beyond you: You have grown bold beyond your station. What you have asked of us you have not earned. If you must ask again, become worthier first.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You have me helpless. That poe:
You have me helpless. That poem is my clumsy expression of a deep truth that frightens me. It is a risk that I lacked the strength to take or leave.

My heart quails in your hands, kendren.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You have my gratitude for this:
You have my gratitude for this exoneration, kendren. This worked out better than I expected thanks to you.

I'll admit, I would have preferred to avoid becoming Hindriarch, but I'm hoping to bring my people to a more Democratic form of governance. Then I can vote myself out.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You have no right to sovereign: You have no right to sovereignty here.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You have prophetic visions in: You have prophetic visions in your sleep?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You have severed the hand outs:
You have severed the hand outstretched to me. Why?

What have you done? What am I to do?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You have so many data disks.\": You have so many data disks.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You haven't provided the mound: You haven't provided the mound with all the necessary materials.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You imagine they will thrive h: You imagine they will thrive here at the Stiltgrounds, among the faithful?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You know how to make starapple: You know how to make starapple jam? If not, you can buy it from me.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You know, =player.formalAddres: You know, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I once had an traveler from Yawningmoon tell me my shop smelled of home. Now I want to visit! Hah!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You know, bees communicate by: You know, bees communicate by dancing. Got a whole language.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You look dangerous. Ever go hu: You look dangerous. Ever go hunting for parts?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You look... refreshed. Thank y: You look... refreshed. Thank you, =name=. Take this polygel we recently recovered from the Palladium Reef.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You monster! You monster! How: You monster! You monster! How dare you!
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You must be dead? Is that trul: You must be dead? Is that truly the only way?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You must grant ME alone access: You must grant ME alone access to the Gemara Sophia, and all other knowledge of the cosmos and Coven you possess. In this new accord, we shall be peers, and the onworlders agents of our schemes.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You must grant me and my cohor: You must grant me and my cohort at Grit Gate access to the Gemara Sophia, and all other knowledge of the cosmos and Coven you possess. In this new accord, we shall be peers all of us.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You need a new hat, =player.fo: You need a new hat, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Or a helmet, if that's the life you lead.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You really think Keh stole the: You really think Keh stole the treasure?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You return. Have you succeeded: You return. Have you succeeded in decoding the signal?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You ruminant people are imposs: You ruminant people are impossible. I will find Eskhind myself.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You say plurality. Are there o: You say plurality. Are there other interpretations?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You see, =name=, when I, a you: You see, =name=, when I, a young bruin, crossed the Homs Delta with my flood-fleeing clan and into the western reach of Qud, the plagues of the Gyre were already ascendant. We took root at our new hearth, in the chrome grottos where we urshiib find natural peace, and by the providence of my elders, I was able to study the tinkering craft.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You seem more irritated than u: You seem more irritated than usual.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You share the pessimism of my:
You share the pessimism of my kin, and several of the priests as well. My heart hears you, but listen to my words, and maybe you will come to feel as I do.

To devalue wisdom is to devalue the Kasaphescence. She shines in the void, refracting light, illuminating those around her. So does the written wisdom of our elders.

The machinery of chromium is complex in its divinity. Don't we do a disservice to our Fathers when we remain ignorant of it, of our past, of our future? Don't we deserve the joy of knowing? Bless Eschelstadt II, first Child, for he believes as I do.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"You should be proud, Detective:
You should be proud, Detective =name=.

The hand of justice can be harsh, but it is fair. You have been its agent here.

{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}

{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}

{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}

{{emote|*Barathrum's countenance suddenly gravens.*}}

Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Hortensa chuckles.*}}:
{{emote|*Hortensa chuckles.*}}

Years. Decades on decades. Centuries, perhaps. Most of these wet-earred cubs were merely sketches in their mothers' dreambooks when I arrived to study under Barathrum. We knew so little then, know so little now.

{{emote|*Hortensa chuckles.*}}

You are sharp, =name=. In a way that's what I am. But liquids are more willful than scrap. I can't solder them together; they would run away, hide in the shale cracks, slowly come apart and disappear. I moreso think of myself as a wisewoman in dialogue with them -- I manage their moods and phases. My notebooks are full of their quirks and caprices. It's a wonder, isn't it, how at just the right temperature and pressure the continuity of matter is smashed apart? How the gaseous butterfly flits out of the dense worm?

Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Sparafucile smiles. =: {{emote|*Sparafucile smiles. =pronouns.Subjective= raises a flat hand to =pronouns.possessive= chin and lowers it in your direction.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Sparafucile stares at: {{emote|*Sparafucile stares at you as if you have grown an additional, substantially uglier head, which you have not.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Swimming in sound, Na: {{emote|*Swimming in sound, Nacham stares at you and looks away simultaneously, giving no indication of understanding.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a broad:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a broad and booming tone.*}}

You! Purpose-driven mad... madhand. You've come here, right? Then you must know power is our... the domain of being is one of power, wouldn't you say? W-Would you please agree with that?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a queru:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a querulous tone*}}

O-oh. Elsefolder... th-this path you have l-laid upon Tau, it-it is best. It is good? P-please be good.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a small:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a small and bright noise.*}}

Ta- Tammuz. Who becomes. Who is Twofirm even in -then.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Tammuz is nearly sile:

...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Tammuz quiets, then c:

You beast! You m-moon king! You... Our roars are beastial! Would you say so?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Tammuz quivers and ch:
{{emote|*Tammuz quivers and chimes a jarring tone.*}}

O-Oh. Oh u-uh oh oh. By contrasts, a q-quake stills even the most anxious trembling...

The world... the world becomes and unbecomes. All the nervous, volcanic energy of being. Who becomes who? Three became one, but what of them now? 

And w-what becomes of Tau? Of me? Of y-you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Tammuz rings a waveri:
{{emote|*Tammuz rings a wavering chime*}}

Y-you are here. Elseing h... hand.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Tammuz's chime rings:
{{emote|*Tammuz's chime rings even quieter and more tremulous*}}

Un, un-uncertain. Tau l-leaves unfolded but the g-g-g-gyre yet s-spins. The s-spinning leaves me dizzy.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*The apple farmer's da: {{emote|*The apple farmer's daughter shies away from you.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*The chime rings a bon:
{{emote|*The chime rings a bone-shaking alarm.*}}

Is this a taunt? A challenge? What cruelty drives you to attempt communication after what you have done?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*The chime rings a kne:
{{emote|*The chime rings a knell.*}}

O gesticulating hand.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*The chiming rock burn: {{emote|*The chiming rock burns in soft light.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*The chiming rock is s: {{emote|*The chiming rock is silent and still.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*The chiming rock ring:
{{emote|*The chiming rock rings a sonorous tone.*}}

Touch the chiming rock and seek me at the keter. Will you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*The clothes shrouding:
{{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form are still for many moments.*}}

Saad, the Seraph sprecen.
Saad, thu asken, and the shomrim assenten.
Saad, wiltou return to Salum or crossen in-to Brightsheol?

{{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form are still for many moments.*}}

The shomrim connen. Why oghte we?

Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*The creature-silhouet: {{emote|*The creature-silhouette lacks any means to make sound, save for the pointed tips of its six flexible legs. Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*The hardened shell-th: {{emote|*The hardened shell-thing traces a path around you slowly, its strange brush-feet scrabbling at the floor, a pace unaffected by your presence and movement. Behind the hissing of those feet on the ground is the strains of a faint voice, someone speaking from inside a distant cave. Audible, but not understandable.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*The jagged, serpentin: {{emote|*The jagged, serpentine entity stares you down, twitching with feigned half-strikes in your direction as if goading an aggressive response from you. Though it has no mouth, it is not silent: piercing the air is a strange, external tinnitus, the whine of an ancient viewscreen.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*The moment stretches: {{emote|*The moment stretches on into a steep asymptote, the peaks and valleys of possible outcomes speeding by in an imaginary blur. You imagine the sound of a tiny metal thread brushing across the bottom of a dusty valley, amplified a thousand times.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*The warden is lost in: {{emote|*The warden is lost in rumination.*}} It can't be. It simply can't be.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*There's scratching an: {{emote|*There's scratching and clicking coming from inside.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Thicksalt chimes a si:
{{emote|*Thicksalt chimes a single, outstretched tone.*}}

The naming act is imponderable. So Tau called me Thicksalt, one brickword in a towerful poem whose everyshape I forget, but whose flushing of Soft in afterfeel I am in allway.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Tzedech chimes, buzzi:
{{emote|*Tzedech chimes, buzzing with agitation*}}

Twofirm roils in me with the enormity. Can it contain so much gone and unremunerated? Tau, Tikva, and more to come. Consumed, we, and paralyzed.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Tzedech emits a power:
{{emote|*Tzedech emits a powerful, body-thrumming chime*}}

Yes. You understand destroying. You know the weight. We are past time of querulous inquisition, of confessions on lined parchment. Was the whole of this in your weight? It no longer matters. Scale the firmament, smite or soothe what rouses there.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Vaam seems oblivious: {{emote|*Vaam seems oblivious to your words, but does slow its patrol as it nears you.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Warden Une tilts thei:
{{emote|*Warden Une tilts their head and purses their lips*}}

Very well. Need you aught, O Nameless One?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Wielding an oversized: {{emote|*Wielding an oversized jar in little hands, a child tips it into the running current of a softly burbling creek. Tiny creatures that had been living in the jar spill into the creek, protected from the killing current by a clump of slimy biofilm. The child peers at a little fry swimming in the jar.}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*With a nod, Sparafuci: {{emote|*With a nod, Sparafucile waits for you to continue, keeping =pronouns.possessive= eyes focused on your lips.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*With a small smile of: {{emote|*With a small smile of gratitude, Sparafucile taps his chin with a flat hand and lowers it toward you like a drawbridge.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Yla Haj pauses.*}}\\n:
{{emote|*Yla Haj pauses.*}}

You presume too narrow a meaning of "health".
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*You are a little sapf: {{emote|*You are a little sapfly resting in the crook of a swarmshade tree. The boughs stretch in great barkish deserts before exploding into a tangle of branches. Your brethren buzz in an agitated cloud, feeling fear or excitement or hunger. Something buzzes beyond the leafy reaches of your sight, all-consuming but unclear.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*You tumble from the j: {{emote|*You tumble from the jar, your sinewy body twisting against the electric emptiness in your belly, the weight of eggs. You discover a morsel and consume it soft and delicious. You will spawn here. You will eat the morsels. Your babies will eat all of the morsels.}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Your entire self buzz: {{emote|*Your entire self buzzes at the sound of _'s chime, a shock from the center and radiating outward. Sensation bubbles up to the surface, a tightening of the self. It is as if cresting a great hill atop a cathedra or an oncoming witchwood overdose; the void yawns under you. Something terrible is born.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*Yurl flicks a leaf in:
{{emote|*Yurl flicks a leaf in displeasure.*}}

What about fungi?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*aloud, in a high-pitc:
{{emote|*aloud, in a high-pitched buzzing voice*}}

A customer? A customer! Enter, =player.formalAddressTerm=, browse, buy. The Consortium's finest, stocked and sold by Tillifergaewicz! Tilli will do, but what will Tilli do... for you?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*crackle, crackle*}}-o:
{{emote|*crackle, crackle*}}-othom? My sympathies.

=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= of course welcome here, wayfarer. Speak to Agyra an =ifplayerplural:ye need:thou needest= aught, as ey delighteth in hospitality.

{{emote|*croaking sigh*}}

Congratulation, condolence, which ever. Mind and name slip by another.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*krka!*}}\\n\\nYes! To:
{{emote|*krka!*}}

Yes! To like! But... never home else. So {{emote|*reep?*}}.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*long, smoky croak*}}\:
{{emote|*long, smoky croak*}}

Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, here at last. Sit. Smoke. Rest.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*mumbling*}} ...exceed: {{emote|*mumbling*}} ...exceeding mass thresholds, perhaps a ganglionic teleprojector fitted with suspensors...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*mumbling*}} ...waste: {{emote|*mumbling*}} ...waste heat from the thermo cask? Or centrifugal extraction to the p-density of sunslag...
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*one long, luminous st:

I think it best if we kept to more practical questions.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*reeeeeps joyfully*}}\:

Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*several moments of so:

G-good!

{{emote|*the chime is hard to distinguish from the rising cacophony.*}}

Crungled allway. Soft reaches through the bounds of everyshape and afflicts us with fireless hotbark. It resonates through Tau's cavernous absence. Arid tearsalt dries between the Lovers.

Crungled allway. Soft reaches through the bounds of everyshape and afflicts us with fireless hotbark. It resonates through Tau's cavernous absence. Touchloss blooms, each facet trembling for shearpull.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*the chime is louder t:
{{emote|*the chime is louder this time, but just as querulous*}}

Sh-sh-she, th-this fate, it. It is a d-deep dark. Will Tau f-fold herself, I wonder?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*the chime rings a lon:
{{emote|*the chime rings a long and pensive tone.*}}

How something stirs, deep in Soft.

{{emote|*the chime rings a long, clarion tone.*}}

You are as beautiful as imagined. You ring with a shining purpose. This chime is awed to bask in your presence.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*the chime rings a sha:
{{emote|*the chime rings a sharp, urgent gonging tone*}}

Entity! You are given persistent will and agency, twice-hewn architecture of body and strong fiber that pulls. You bolt upright and damp-haired into fullness, your grasp abrading the threads of existence. Your responsibility remains whether acknowledged or not. Have strength, the time is now.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*the chime rings again:
{{emote|*the chime rings again*}}

It is called Tikva, low and humble. The chime rests in a web of strong love, a little piece of something greater and so much more beautiful. As are you, but a gestalt unto yourself. A world to be orbited.

{{emote|*the chime rings again, echoing louder in the walls of your mind*}}

Hear me! It is more important than ever to know that you are a driver, reforged and honed. You tool yourself to apply selective atrocity. It cannot be helped. You shape this, your path bloody and blooming. You start in sleep and shake the ground.

All must, but you most of all. The weight may have been negligent once, but it is terribly heavy now.

Do you accept responsibilty?
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*the chime rings clear:
{{emote|*the chime rings clear and loud*}}

This called Tzedech. Compass, judgment, motivation. Once lover of Tikva, apart now after gyredream.

{{emote|*the chime rings shaky and loud*}}

Wh-what is this? H-how is it meant? This outcome j-judders within and w-without us.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*the chime rings*}}\\n:
{{emote|*the chime rings*}}

{{emote|*In your mind's eye, you see yourself touching a mirror. You tap the glass and it ripples like the surface of a placid lake.*}}
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*the chime rings, a qu:
{{emote|*the chime rings, a querulous and tinny sound*}}

It... can scarce find the dream in this light. It thinks of Tzedech and weeps. It was not here, last time the static was in high pitch, but it remembers the pain and fear. It is not ready to feel these, it cannot. Gaze into its light and speak not of nightmares.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*the entity chimes, an: {{emote|*the entity chimes, and you witness water lapping at the long edge of a pebble beach. Slowly, the tide brushes clean the surface of each rock, etching time's passage onto millions of tiny canvases. Somewhere, something dies.*}}

Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*the plant gives no in: {{emote|*the plant gives no indication of understanding*}}

{{emote|*the sound of the chime rings querulous and faint, its light flickering.*}}

Please… no…

{{emote|*the sound of the chime rings querulous.*}}

The light shines upon you but illuminates nothing. It quails.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*there is an agitation:
{{emote|*there is an agitation in Thicksalt's accepting chime.*}}

Pluck the air, then, with your mouth sounds.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|*through the chime you:
{{emote|*through the chime you hear an echoing cacophony, muted by distance and matter.*}}

How we ring with it. Your kicksoft drowns under the beat of our selfcries.
Strings.Conversations.[\"S\", \"{{emote|Herododicus pauses.}}\:
{{emote|Herododicus pauses.}}

Ye... yes? Is this a test? I suppose you... could we... could we have been in Brightsheol all along? Is that the answer?

{{emote|The chime rings loud and sharp.}}

Heavy the hand. Heavy the head.

Walls.[\"AgateWall\", \"part\", \"Description\: Clay and quartz were dried and smashed into the red rock that's been quarried by hillfolk for thousands after thousands of years. The whole stone is cut across by shining black ribbons.
Walls.[\"AmethystWall\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Clay and quartz were dried and smashed into the red rock that's been quarried by hillfolk for thousands after thousands of years. The whole stone is cut across by shining purple ribbons.
Walls.[\"Basalt\", \"part\", \"Description\",: The scars of lava flow are legible as little ledges across the wide stone. The small darkling holes were once the birth craters of dissolved gases.
Walls.[\"BaseForcefield\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Potential is polarized into a cyanic hex mesh and keyed to its arranger. Objects of sufficient mass are blocked, but small ones fired leeward can pass through.
Walls.[\"BaseMuralCenter\", \"part\", \"Descri: Stone quarried from the early earth divides the art of a life.
Walls.[\"BaseMuralLeftend\", \"part\", \"Descr: Stone quarried from the early earth binds the art of a life.
Walls.[\"BaseMuralRightend\", \"part\", \"Desc: Stone quarried from the early earth binds the art of a life.
Walls.[\"BaseMushroomWall\", \"part\", \"Descr: Spore-rich slime glistens on the cage-like fruiting body, trimmed like a hedge to conform with the ordered angles of domesticity.
Walls.[\"BaseNephilimWall_Agolgot\", \"part\",: Mountainous streamers of oily shellac are moulded to floor contours and trace a star orchid path. The whole section is glazed with dried death sludge.
layer of resin extruded by Agolgot
Walls.[\"BaseNephilimWall_Bethsaida\", \"part\: Mountainous streamers of oily shellac are moulded to floor contours and trace a star orchid path. The whole section is glazed with furcate nerves.
layer of resin extruded by Bethsaida
Walls.[\"BaseNephilimWall_QasQon\", \"part\",: Mountainous streamers of oily shellac are moulded to floor contours and trace a star orchid path. The whole section is glazed at right angles with solidified dream gas.
layer of resin extruded by Qas and Qon
Walls.[\"BaseNephilimWall_Rermadon\", \"part\": Mountainous streamers of oily shellac are moulded to floor contours and trace a star orchid path. The whole section is glazed with solidified star gas.
layer of resin extruded by Rermadon
Walls.[\"BaseNephilimWall_Shug'rith\", \"part\: Mountainous streamers of oily shellac are moulded to floor contours and trace a star orchid path. The whole section is glazed with shale chips and dust.
layer of resin extruded by Shug'ruith
Walls.[\"BaseNephilimWall_Shug'rithSpawn\", \": Sloping streamers of oily shellac are moulded to floor contours and trace a star orchid path. The whole section is glazed with shale chips and dust.
layer of resin extruded by Shug'ruith spawn
Walls.[\"Black Marble\", \"part\", \"Descripti: World-voids in the nethermost reaches of the planet are partitioned by numinous masonry. There is meaning in the patterns of its faint white filigree, but it's discerned by no one.
Walls.[\"Black Shale\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Black stone stands in monument to the cities of snails that perished under clay and rotted into pyrite.
Walls.[\"BrickWall\", \"part\", \"Description\: Burnt clay ingots are laid crosswise, and a barrier is made. Each brick is marred by the variegated cuts of time, imperfections in the heat balance of the oven it was fired in, and fungi in its birthing mud.
Walls.[\"BrinestalkArrowslit\", \"part\", \"De: Several sharpened trunks of sallow brinestalk were driven into the ground here. The gaps aren't wide enough to squeeze through.
Walls.[\"BrinestalkFence\", \"part\", \"Descri: Salt-tracing waves cross the grain on the brinestalk pickets stuck into the ground.
Walls.[\"BrinestalkStakes\", \"part\", \"Descr: Several sharpened trunks of sallow brinestalk were driven into the ground here.
Walls.[\"BrinestalkWall\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Here are several stripped trunks of sallow brinestalk bonded with mud.
Walls.[\"Burnished Azzurum\", \"part\", \"Desc: Cyan bursts through a glassy hull and looks as though the sky was crystallized into a thicket of hexagonal prisms. The Eaters dug it up from its magmatic birthsite and arranged it into mounds to enshrine the Spindle.
Walls.[\"BurntWood\", \"part\", \"Description\: Tree bark was burnt black by skyfire assault and now gleams in the after light.
Walls.[\"CanvasWall\", \"part\", \"Description: The quickened flax of the earth was duck-weaved in a simple square pattern and hung up on pickets.
Walls.[\"CatacombWall\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Bone-shapes of the human form are disarranged to tessellate properly. Round skulls require ulna knots to fill the gaps in their sequences. The boundaries of this world are rice-white and filled with presence.
Walls.[\"Chavvah Taproot\", \"part\", \"Descri: Little crystal shoots were crushed by pure ego-weight to a girthful, stout, and equant transducer of transient thoughtsoft. Decohered emotion and memory crystallize as they shoot up the root.
Walls.[\"ChavvahTrunk\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Quartzstuff in the radial habit crusts over a layer of softstone, and beneath that, a layer of dead crystal dripping in static resin and singing with psychic promise.
Walls.[\"ColumbariumWall\", \"part\", \"Descri: Whole worlds are carved in bas relief, simulacra of the motley lives of ash-dreaming Eaters. Palm leaves lift pyramids into the star-ribboned sky, and the water of life pours over the lip of an oinochoe.
Walls.[\"Concrete\", \"part\", \"Description\": Smooth grey stone hides its bonded pebbly innards and cement blood-paste. It's streaked with dirt.
Walls.[\"Coral Rag\", \"part\", \"Description\: Reefs were the arcologies of the young oceans. Now they are turquoise crypts, their surfaces bitten by acid water into rough wounds.
Walls.[\"Crematory Mainframe Monitor 1\", \"pa: Scanlines paint the lune in cathode amber.
Walls.[\"Crematory Mainframe Status Panel\", \: Across a field of brass and chrome diodes blink in gyres.
Walls.[\"CryochamberPlaque\", \"part\", \"Desc: The shining surface of quickchrome swims in shifting refraction patterns. As its light is focused, glyphs begin to appear.
Walls.[\"CryochamberPlaqueSkybear\", \"part\",: SPECIMEN: SAAD AMUS, THE SKY-BEAR, CHAMPION OF SALUM
Walls.[\"CryochamberWall\", \"part\", \"Descri: Freezing mist coils out of lateral vents cut into the chrome wainscotting of a marble pillar.
Walls.[\"CryochamberWallBroken\", \"part\", \": Cold dew dresses the lateral vents cut into the chrome wainscotting of a marble pillar.
Walls.[\"CryptWall\", \"part\", \"Description\: Whole worlds are threaded in three-dimensional filigree, simulacra of the motley lives of ash-dreaming Eaters. Palm leaves lift pyramids into the star-ribboned sky, and the water of life pours over the lip of an oinochoe.
Walls.[\"CrystalWall\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: A quantum mess cooled and arranged itself as a towering hexagon. Bubbles of earth gas and other quirks of time are frozen in the quartz-amber, and existence is chipped off the lathe of nothingness by moonlight.
Walls.[\"CrysteelPlatedWall\", \"part\", \"Des: Longwise infill plates of burnished crysteel are girdered by fulcrete beams. Life sounds echo through their empty spaces.
Walls.[\"CyberWall\", \"part\", \"Description\: Fluted columns of prism glass scatter the sight of becoming into a thousand fractured vistas.
Walls.[\"EbonFulcrete\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Black islands of carbon gravel populate an ocean of bitumen and rise from the horizontal plane toward the emptiness of the air-rasp. Time and pressure have laid hair-line trenches along the basin.

Walls.[\"Foamcrete\", \"part\", \"Description\: The cracks in the wall are fossils of the compressed foamcrete's hexagonal expansion pattern.
Walls.[\"ForceBarrier\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Potential is polarized into a scarlet hex mesh and keyed to its arranger. Objects are blocked unless they are molecularly whitelisted.

Walls.[\"GlassWall\", \"part\", \"Description\: Sand was crush-fired and molded into lucent panes.
Walls.[\"GolemInteriorWall\", \"part\", \"Desc: A moist tissue lining stretches over electrofired clay and soldered metal plates. Underneath a translucent film, grids of undercircuitry blink their golden light.

Walls.[\"Granite\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Feldspar and its cousin rocks are composited and pocked with static-pattern grain. Cracks foreshadow the pebbles of the future.
Walls.[\"GritGate Mainframe Monitor 1\", \"par: Scanlines paint the lune in cathode amber.
Walls.[\"GritGate Mainframe Monitor 2\", \"par: Springfoam keys push back against fingers in the course of flirtatious coupling between machine and folk.
Walls.[\"GritGate Mainframe Status Panel\", \": Across a field of brass and chrome diodes blink in gyres.
Walls.[\"GritGate Mainframe Tape Drive\", \"pa: Magnetic tape is spooled around a wheel and fed to a drive head that scribes and scries, stamping data out of the third dimension then quickening it back in.
Walls.[\"Gypsum\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Burnt crystal gold tosses its geometric shadows onto the floors of a million watery grottos.
Walls.[\"HalfWall\", \"part\", \"Description\": Old stone worked to waist height to stop spilling but not seeing.
Walls.[\"Halite\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Carmine clouds assume their crystal habit: cubes nested inside and out. Why does Moghra'yi conceal this form from the sun?
Walls.[\"HoloMarble\", \"part\", \"Description: Glinting light is sculpted in parallax to the illusion of a marble wall: snails and coral were crushed on the geologic press, painted into ribbons of impurity, and polished along the ideal plane.
Walls.[\"HolographicLowSandstoneWall\", \"part: Glinting light is sculpted in parallax to the illusion of a sandstone wall: rock is eroded to sand, sand is blown into lakes, lakes are buried in mud, and mud crushes sand to rock. Earth is rearranged.

Walls.[\"HolographicThatchedWall\", \"part\",: Glinting light is sculpted in parallax to the illusion of a thatched wall: stripes of watervine and brinestalk straw are batched and angled to divert salt slag.

Walls.[\"PlantWall\", \"part\", \"Description\: Time and chance -- the two hands of nature -- have woven roots, stems, and leaves into a fibrous dam.

Walls.[\"Quartzite\", \"part\", \"Description\: Dappled crystal mosaics of red and cyan are the metamorphic remnants of crumbling world-plates. The new earth struggles to be born.
Walls.[\"Relief1\", \"part\", \"Description\",: This is an exquisitely detailed high relief cut from precious cerulean marble. It depicts the Sacred Joining, as recounted by Shekhinah the Father to the temple high priests. In the early dawn of our universe, the Argent Fathers roamed the timeless aether with inert hearts. There, in the coldest distance of space, they discovered beauty-and-chrome incarnate, the Kasaphescence. Together they wrought machines from Her naked womb to inhabit a hundred earths. In the scene here, the Fathers first approach Her Radiance. They are led by Shekhinah, who occupies a position of prominence.

Walls.[\"Relief2\", \"part\", \"Description\",: This is a high relief cut with exquisite detail from rare, cerulean marble. It depicts the Edification, as chanted in the Canticles Chromaic. After the Sacred Joining, the Argent Fathers molded the plasmatic metal of the Kasaphescence into edifices fit for inhabitance by mortal folk. They wrought spires onto mountains and arches over rivers. Here, Shekhinah oversees the construction, gazing east upon His new, gleaming world.
Walls.[\"Rubble\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Irregular volumes of stone are heaped together. Across its surface, points of order poke sporadically through the pile of entropy: a statue's finger, the gnomon of a sundial, a parcel of circuitboard.

Walls.[\"Slate\", \"part\", \"Description\", \: Volcanic dust pupated in its deep-earth cocoon and cracked free as grey stone. Sophists theorize it's the color of pure aether.
Walls.[\"SmallHexCrystal\", \"part\", \"Descri: Moss hems the little moonlit faces of speed-grown quartz. When entropy obliterates order, it reassembles at smaller scales.
Walls.[\"SpindleGlassWall\", \"part\", \"Descr: Cerulean light from inside the Spindle channel glimmers across the pane like stars on a galactic disc or diodes on a circuitboard. The light breathes godliness into the glass.
Walls.[\"Star Orchid Marble\", \"part\", \"Des: Outworld hard-shelled beings were harvested from planetesimals, burned bright in the magenta exhaust of their scavengers' ships, and crushed together in astral slingshot to reentry.
Walls.[\"Stasisfield\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: A blurry film cordons off a wedge of spacetime with so much quantum friction that its inhabitants are ground to a halt.

WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainAsphaltMines\", \"part\", \"De: Rubble encases this abandoned mine where ancient tribes siphoned the black blood for their own inscrutable purposes.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainBananaGrove\", \"part\", \"Des: The grove's million laced fingers sway in gentle opulence. Verdant fronds nestle the base of the Spindle from its mountainous nook.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainBaroqueRuins\", \"part\", \"De: Rampant greenspread canopies a starburst of the Eaters' richest works. The jungle is torn at the corners, where crysteel balustrades and star orchid lancets peek through.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainBethesdaSusa\", \"part\", \"De: Eons-shifted stone entombs the angleless architecture of Bethsaida's lair.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainDeepJungle\", \"part\", \"Desc: Thriving florae pack the loam with maze-dense roots, and a high-wreath canopy chokes off the last beams of light.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainDesertCanyon\", \"part\", \"De: Long ago the rivers themselves were ravenous, and they feasted on shale and limestone before taking bloated respite in the Great Salt Sea. Now the fissure-wounds have rotted to crimson and salt.

WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainEynRoj\", \"part\", \"Descript: Tucked into a marble glade is the cloven trunk of Chavvah, the Tree of Life. Its fallen leaves lay like a mirrored carpet, and the dream wrens chirr a psychal carol.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainFlowerfields\", \"part\", \"De: Prismatic filament colonizes the cracks between the salted rot. There are meadows here, She says.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainFungalBase\", \"part\", \"Desc: Spores dance in eddies across kaleidoscopic fungal bonnets. Rivers of primordial soup, cast in the light of lava, gurgle a quickening melody.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainGolgotha\", \"part\", \"Descri: Shrouded in the rotting jungle are the mouths of the rust-caves of Golgotha, chrome's graveyard.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainGritGate\", \"part\", \"Descri: Still erect is the superior half of the colossal gate inscribed with the runes of a hundred indecipherable tongues. Beneath its chrome palings a wide passage opens into the jungle loam.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainHills\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Blips in the wave graph of stone over time.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainJoppa\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Ants in the viridian chaff, the farmers sap the last drops of pristine moisture out of the salt-spangled earth.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainJoppaRedrockChannel\", \"part\: In stagnant pools, luminous lilies compete with the ribbon of stars in the night sky. Under the salt sun, though, they shrink into the shade of brine weed.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainJoppaRuins\", \"part\", \"Desc: In stagnant pools, luminous lilies compete with the ribbon of stars in the night sky. Under the salt sun, though, they shrink into the shade of brine weed.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainJungle\", \"part\", \"Descript: Braids of roots and ribbons of fronds dimensionalize the flat loam. Something's home a discarded leaf makes.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainKyakukya\", \"part\", \"Descri: Here is the jungle village of ape god worshippers and their giant mushroom dwellings.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainLakeHinnom\", \"part\", \"Desc: Coral fingers poke out from the spongebed and pierce the algal bloom, where white esh flock in the hundreds.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainMoonStair\", \"part\", \"Descr: Hex prisms burst out of black marble beds, and their edges decohere as warm static dew. The Stair purrs at low frequency.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainMountainStream\", \"part\", \": Old alps opened in the ageless past fill with a cool brine.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainMountains\", \"part\", \"Descr: In the wave graph of stone over time, where the world plates once vexed themselves into war, a quiet peace has settled.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainOmonporch\", \"part\", \"Descr: Through the umbrage of choking trees fly the hundred archways and buttresses of funerary monuments. They peer over marble arcades that roof the catacombs of the Eaters of earth.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainOpalDuskwaters\", \"part\", \": The umbrage of the boughs wrings the warmth from Opal's waters and leave behind a shady pool.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainPalladiumReef 3l\", \"part\",: Dyed pipework topology mounted in the spongebed is a lodestar to the lyrical community.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainPalladiumReef\", \"part\", \"D: An arcology of bright polyps arches across the soldered trellis of old, and a rich diversity of life peoples it.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainRedRock\", \"part\", \"Descrip: A naturally reddened outcropping of stone juts out of the salted crag.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainRiverOpal\", \"part\", \"Descr: The Spindle scintillates in watery effigy on her surface. She ferries crushed granite through a mountain pass and into her leafy firth.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainRiverSvy\", \"part\", \"Descri: Svy urges over the salt-capped peaks and spills into the vine-braided loam. Her banks are shaded by the chrome carcasses of giants.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainRiverYonth\", \"part\", \"Desc: Yonth breaks the massif to the strange East and ushers its nameless waters into Qud. Fish-things feed on her basalt chips.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainRuins\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Here crumble the mysterious Eaters' vine-swathed works, spun on the cyclopean lathe in an ageless past. Chrome steeples and parapets that rise above the clutches of shale hint at the labyrinths beneath them.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainRustWell\", \"part\", \"Descri: Red qudzu vines take as their trellises chrome wells bored into the earth.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainRustedArchway\", \"part\", \"D: An arc of rust paints the sky and circles the path once taken by gargantuans in chrome.
WorldTerrain.[\"TerrainSaltdunes\", \"part\", \"Descr: The ivory sea's dunes are like waves frozen in place.
