ZoneTerrain.[\"Arsplice Hyphae\", \"part\", \"Descri: Fairy rings of braided grass-coral-fungi hybrids poke along their shadow network and excrete replicated struts as sheathing.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Banana Tree\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Fruited hands climb the stalks of the grifter tree. When the light catches on the surface of the exposed corm, Spindle glitter throws it back to the widened grove.
ZoneTerrain.[\"BlackMarbleWalkway\", \"part\", \"Des: Black marble rectangles tesselate the path.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Bop Sponge\", \"part\", \"Description: It's laminated jelly molded as a globoid with pores to filter and nosh algae, and it jiggles.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Brightshroom\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Shining hyphae pour their soft light up into the orbicular cap of the earthlamp.
ZoneTerrain.[\"BrineBridge\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: A bridge made of dried brinestalk.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Brinestalk\", \"part\", \"Description: Girthy pilings of fibrous salt-rot stake out these pools of brine. They belong to no one.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Chavvah Branch\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Microcolumns of incandescent crystal are bundled in dense posies, and branch through the sky as magnificent fractals. They toss moonlight back and forth between them.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Chavvah Chime Left\", \"part\", \"Des: Its corners were waxed off by static and its crystal corms burn with transduced moonlight. It chimes in near and far keys.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Chavvah Chime Right\", \"part\", \"De: Its corners were waxed off by static and its crystal corms burn with transduced moonlight. It chimes in near and far keys.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Chavvah Dense Leaves\", \"part\", \"D: Drops of static dew fuzz the sharp crystal edges. The flats themselves are radiant and rustle on a psychic breeze. In gestalt, they flow like reversible sequins across the mind/body divide.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Chavvah Sparse Leaves\", \"part\", \": Drops of static dew fuzz the sharp crystal edges. The flats themselves are radiant and rustle on a psychic breeze. In gestalt, they flow like reversible sequins across the mind/body divide.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Chavvah Spiral StairsDown\", \"part\": Smooth and cloudy frustums hover in a helix of psionic suspension.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Chavvah Spiral StairsUp\", \"part\",: Smooth and cloudy frustums hover in a helix of psionic suspension.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Chavvah Taproot Floor\", \"part\", \": Little crystal shoots were crushed by pure ego-weight to a girthful, stout, and equant transducer of transient thoughtsoft. Decohered emotion and memory crystallize as they shoot up the root.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Coral Polyp\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Feelers sway in a circlet on a skeletal vase-column. The aboral side is yoked to other polyps, forming a fossilized arcology.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Coral and Palladium Strut\", \"part\": Bow polyps colonize the cylindrical topology of the lattice and pattern out an orthogonal neighborhood in a network of life.
ZoneTerrain.[\"CryptTrail\", \"part\", \"Description: Black marble rectangles tesselate the path.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Crystalline Radicle\", \"part\", \"De: Hexagon fibers of delicate, newly shedded crystal twine through the earth and vibrate with pre-psychal fullness. They radiate an early glow.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Crystalline Root\", \"part\", \"Descr: Hexagon fibers of delicate crystal twine through the earth and push the ambient psychal glow up the phloem to the sapient chimes.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Dandy Cap\", \"part\", \"Description\: Nature bequeathed a dandy cap to the slender, bowed stalk and gills that pucker on its underside. The pigment of its skin is liquid dye from a nearby weep.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Dicalyptus Tree\", \"part\", \"Descri: A hut's girth of bug-gnawed bark shoots up into ethereal sky and splays into a crown of foliage.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Dogthorn Tree\", \"part\", \"Descript: A tangled nest of roots spill through the earth. The bark is splintered into pointy spines. The leaves are greasy and stinking.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Dreadroot\", \"part\", \"Description\: Skin peels on the tuber belly as it hums with grounding bass, and the shoots throb in upsetting staccato.
ZoneTerrain.[\"ElevatorShaft\", \"part\", \"Descript: A freightless tether slings down a dark and vast channel.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Finger Coral\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Soft-body beings excrete the calcified walls of their arcologies as air-climbing spires. They have stone texture and house microlife in their cavities.
ZoneTerrain.[\"FrostWeb\", \"part\", \"Description\": Glistening silk was spun to a capture spiral and mounted on a series of bridge threads. Hoarfrost fractals texture the strands outside the 2D plane.
ZoneTerrain.[\"FungalTrailBrick\", \"part\", \"Descr: Coral bricks tesselate the path toward an otherplace.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Glitchwood Tree\", \"part\", \"Descri: Bent roots chunnel upward to a canopy of fuzz. The eye tries to draw a boundary around single leaves, but their light lines sputter and lose their derivatives.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Gnawed Watervine\", \"part\", \"Descr: Salt gathers in its furrows. It's knotted with moisture-swollen wafers in place of leaves, and it appears to be half-eaten.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Godshroom\", \"part\", \"Description\: Its aspect imbued with lucent coral, this mushroom catches your eye like no other. Qud knows no such hue, and so you ask =player.reflexive=: what sort of radiant rain dyed its flesh? Could it be an iota of the Eaters themselves, mummified in the soil of the Rainbow Wood?
ZoneTerrain.[\"Grave Moss\", \"part\", \"Description: It's achromous and brittle; it crunches under the foot. How it clusters into mats must conform to the shape of life-wet body-banks it once flowered from, and with dark red blood will again.
ZoneTerrain.[\"GreyMarbleWalkway\", \"part\", \"Desc: Grey marble rectangles tesselate the path.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Icosahedar\", \"part\", \"Description: Waxen sprigs sag to the weight of the algebraic tubers. Each one is perfect and regular, its faces matte with sheenless platonic dew.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Lahbloom\", \"part\", \"Description\": Insects circle and buzz around a quartet of golden brown petals that droop over their thickling stalk. When something touches it, the floret lashes up in a dreamful rage.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Leafless Dogthorn Tree\", \"part\", \: A tangled nest of roots spill through the earth. The bark is splintered into pointy spines.
ZoneTerrain.[\"MiasmaticStalagmite\", \"part\", \"De: A squadron of flowstone limbs grip the cave floor, and a banded trunk of calcite pokes the rotting air. Its twirling apex is wrapped in bone-made-vapor.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Nachash Tree\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Moss-slick shoots coil at the crown of a slouching trunk like the she-medusa. Air musses them into more disarray.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Nimbus Beam\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: Puffy halos of acid and myrtle green leaves gird the length of a sky-toward wood minaret. The peak breaks out the canopy to win the sun-drinking game.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Noisegrass\", \"part\", \"Description: Real potential surfs the rhizome on choppy waves and quantizes into woody blades of grass.
ZoneTerrain.[\"OpenShaft\", \"part\", \"Description\: Darkness floods up from the empty space.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Palladium Strut\", \"part\", \"Descri: Cry-packed casing freckles on cylinders joined at right angles. Shine from the softer metal pokes through, silvery-white palladium that once performed hydro- and electroconduction across a vast arcological lattice.
ZoneTerrain.[\"PhaseWeb\", \"part\", \"Description\": Glistening silk was spun to a capture spiral and mounted on a series of bridge threads. The filament vibrates across dimensions in the manifold.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Pit\", \"part\", \"Description\", \"S: Space is emptied of solid impediments.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Pit\", \"part\", \"StairsDown\", \"Ju: It looks like an awfully long fall. Are you sure you want to jump?
ZoneTerrain.[\"Pit\", \"part\", \"StairsDown\", \"Pu: You scramble down a craggy ledge.
ZoneTerrain.[\"PolypCache\", \"part\", \"Description: Stuck to the feelers of a polyp cluster and beetling from a corroded strut is a swollen lump of film. A bright broth of carbon-melted platinum goo burns inside.
ZoneTerrain.[\"PondDown\", \"part\", \"Description\": A cleft in the red stone opens to a waterspray of underearth.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Psychal Rhythm Rock\", \"part\", \"De: Stalactitic prisms stutter-hum the compressed thoughtstuff of trillions across the psychic sea.
ZoneTerrain.[\"ReefOpenShaft\", \"part\", \"Descript: Darkness floods up the polyp-strewn fringes of an open pit.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Shimscale Mangrove Tree\", \"part\",: Light peaks through its wet leaves in scattershot, and its roots look like a wax colonnade melted into a maze and resolidified.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Shimscale Mangrove Tree_blue\", \"par: Light peaks through its wet leaves in scattershot, and its roots look like a wax colonnade melted into a maze and resolidified.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Slime Grass\", \"part\", \"Descriptio: The strands glisten with a frothing film.
ZoneTerrain.[\"SlimyShaft\", \"part\", \"Description: Machinic tones are made soft against the slime-wet walls of a darkling shaft. A void is beneath.
ZoneTerrain.[\"SlimyShaft\", \"part\", \"StairsDown\: You fall down the slimy shaft!
ZoneTerrain.[\"Spotted Shagspook\", \"part\", \"Desc: Its stalk is trunk-fat, and powder coats the spots on its humongous cap. The pigment of its skin is liquid dye from a nearby weep.
ZoneTerrain.[\"StairsDown\", \"part\", \"Description: Light ebbs off the descending stair.
ZoneTerrain.[\"StairsUp\", \"part\", \"Description\": Dust blooms on the ascending stair.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Star Palm\", \"part\", \"Description\: Sun-sated fronds sag against a bug-scarred trunk in the shape of a melted star.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Starapple Tree Ripe\", \"part\", \"De: Starapples hang from ashen branches, motes of luscious, red light in a bleached tableau.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Starapple Tree\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Starapples hang from ashen branches, motes of luscious, red light in a bleached tableau.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Stillvine\", \"part\", \"Description\: Ghost-canes are twirled to pictorial stillness, and moisture gathers on their buds.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Sunflower\", \"part\", \"Description\: Bright florets explode from a central disc of darker, spiraling florets. Together they're like a tiny sun.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Sunken Room Stairs\", \"part\", \"Des: Dappled marble rectangles are stepping stones in and out of the pit.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Swarmshade Tree\", \"part\", \"Descri: A nebula of spaded leaves swish with dry creek and beetle munch.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Swarmshade Tree_blue\", \"part\", \"D: A nebula of spaded leaves swish with dry creek and beetle munch.
ZoneTerrain.[\"TauSoft\", \"part\", \"Description\",: Heartroots tangle at the yawning psychal nexus of the crystal tree. They burn with the light of gaseous feelstuff, all the bits of ambient order in the soil and rock animated by a deeper dimensional warping. This is a shore on the psychic sea.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Tunnel Sponge\", \"part\", \"Descript: Porous skeletons of spongin poke the inverted tunnel buttes, stone-like, out to angles.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Urberry Bush\", \"part\", \"Descripti: Through the nether of a vaulted root-trellis, leaves point at perfect angles to sift sunlight and bathe ur-buds in soft gold warmth.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Watervine\", \"part\", \"Description\: Salt gathers in its furrows. It's knotted with moisture-swollen wafers in place of leaves.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Web\", \"part\", \"Description\", \"S: Glistening silk was spun to a capture spiral and mounted on a series of bridge threads.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Witchwood Tree\", \"part\", \"Descrip: Golden fronds unfurl when the desert wind moistens. Pieces of bark, collated into tiny intersecting rings, have been chewed off by wood grazers.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Yempuris\", \"part\", \"Description\": Bubbles of green stipules are arrayed in rings of quickening lattice growth. The pace is sorcerous; the earnest and everforward will of the plantworld is captured here at a millionfold.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Yuckwheat\", \"part\", \"Description\: Coral petals sprout from the top of a flimsy stem. A metal or bone hoof has crushed its siblings and spread their acid fibers across the soil.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Ziv Bough\", \"part\", \"Description\: The trunk column corkscrews on the radial path of light and blossoms a crown of victory laurel.
ZoneTerrain.[\"Ziv Bough_blue\", \"part\", \"Descrip: The trunk column corkscrews on the radial path of light and blossoms a crown of victory laurel.
ZoneTerrain.[\"n-Ary Tree\", \"part\", \"Description: Bright sequin leaves shimmer in indigo constellations, and branches fork through the entropy fungus.
